```go
}

func TestPlacementSwitchOnBackfillsEveryDatabaseInOwnerDatabaseOrder(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsReadyFSM(t)
	dba := addGroupTable(t, f, 0, "dba", "a", 200)
	dbz := addGroupTable(t, f, 1, "dbz", "a", 210)
	version := registryVersion(f)
	turnOnStage3Switch(t, f, a, Stage3SwitchPlacement)
	genesisID := mustGenesisID(t, f)
	wantKeys := []struct {
		owner    uint64
		database string
		salt     string
	}{{0, "db0", "0x150"}, {0, "dba", "0x200"}, {1, "db", genesisID}, {1, "dbz", "0x210"}}
	if len(f.st.Stage3.Groups) != len(wantKeys) || len(f.st.Stage3.GroupGenerations) != len(wantKeys) {
		t.Fatalf("groups %+v, generations %+v", f.st.Stage3.Groups, f.st.Stage3.GroupGenerations)
	}
	for i, k := range wantKeys {
		g, gen := f.st.Stage3.Groups[i], f.st.Stage3.GroupGenerations[i]
		want := expectedPlacement(t, f, k.owner, k.database, k.salt)
		if g.Owner != k.owner || g.DatabaseID != k.database || g.Salt != k.salt || g.Generation != 1 || gen != (GroupGeneration{k.owner, k.database, 1}) ||
			!slices.Equal(groupMemberIDs(g), want.Members) || g.NetworkFill != want.NetworkFill {
			t.Fatalf("group %d = %+v (generation %+v), want %+v placing %+v", i, g, gen, k, want)
		}
	}
	// The genesis-origin database, which never passed through AddTable,
	// has its group, and every physical incarnation records its group's
	// members; the Legacy db.old records none.
	for _, inc := range f.st.TableRegistry.Incarnations {
		g := f.groupOfIncarnationLocked(inc)
		switch {
		case inc.hasPhysicalTables() && (g == nil || !slices.Equal(inc.PurgeMembers, groupMemberIDs(g))):
			t.Fatalf("incarnation %d (%s) purge_members %v, group %+v", inc.Seq, inc.Key(), inc.PurgeMembers, g)
		case !inc.hasPhysicalTables() && len(inc.PurgeMembers) != 0:
			t.Fatalf("incarnation %d (%s, %s) has purge_members", inc.Seq, inc.Key(), inc.Status)
		}
	}
	if f.st.TableRegistry.incarnation(dba).PurgeMembers == nil || f.st.TableRegistry.incarnation(dbz).PurgeMembers == nil {
		t.Fatal("the backfill skipped a Pending incarnation")
	}
	if got := registryVersion(f); got != version+1 {
		t.Fatalf("registry version %d, want one bump from %d", got, version)
	}
	if last := f.st.Stage3.Switches[len(f.st.Stage3.Switches)-1]; last.Switch != Stage3SwitchPlacement {
		t.Fatalf("last cutover %+v, want placement", last)
	}
}

func TestPlacementSwitchOnRefusesAGroupBelowTheFloorWithStateUnchanged(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsReadyFSM(t)
	// member-0 replicates only and the pool is delisted: G(1, db) would hold
	// two verify members and no pool.
	updateStage3(t, f, a, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) {
		u.Verifiers = slices.DeleteFunc(u.Verifiers, func(v arbiter.VerifierEntry) bool { return v.HostIndexerID == nil })
		for i := range u.Verifiers {
			if u.Verifiers[i].NodeID == "member-0" {
				u.Verifiers[i].Verify = false
			}
		}
	})
	u := stage3Update(t, f)
	u.Stage3 = stage3WithSwitch(u.Stage3, Stage3SwitchPlacement)
	rejectStage3Unchanged(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, u),
		`consensus update: placement would leave group of indexer 1 database "db" with 2 verifiers, below the per-group floor of 3`)
	if f.PlacementOn() || len(f.st.Stage3.Groups) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("the refused switch-on changed state")
	}
}

func TestPlacementSaltIsTheFirstPhysicalIncarnationsCreatedBlockHash(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsReadyFSM(t)
	// dbq's first incarnation is Purged before the switch-on, so the second
	// one, the lowest-seq physical incarnation, gives the salt.
	first := addGroupTable(t, f, 1, "dbq", "a", 200)
	purgeByOwnerAndPool(t, f, "dbq", "a", 202, first)
	if f.st.TableRegistry.incarnation(first).Status != TableStatusPurged {
		t.Fatal("dbq.a is not Purged")
	}
	addGroupTable(t, f, 1, "dbq", "b", 210)
	turnOnStage3Switch(t, f, a, Stage3SwitchPlacement)
	if got := mustGroup(t, f, 1, "dbq").Salt; got != "0x210" {
		t.Fatalf("salt of dbq = %s, want 0x210", got)
	}
	if got := mustGroup(t, f, 0, "db0").Salt; got != "0x150" {
		t.Fatalf("salt of db0 = %s, want 0x150", got)
	}
	// After the switch an AddTable places with its own TableCreated hash.
	addGroupTable(t, f, 0, "dbs", "a", 220)
	if got := mustGroup(t, f, 0, "dbs").Salt; got != "0x220" {
		t.Fatalf("salt of dbs = %s, want 0x220", got)
	}
}

func TestExcludeQuarantinedHostsDropsCandidates(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsReadyFSM(t)
	updateStage3(t, f, a, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) { u.Stage3.ExcludeQuarantinedHosts = true })
	mustApply(t, f, quarantineQ(t, f, a, 2, 0, "host lost"))
	turnOnStage3Switch(t, f, a, Stage3SwitchPlacement)
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		owner    uint64
		database string
		want     []string
	}{{0, "db0", []string{"member-1", "member-3"}}, {1, "db", []string{"member-0", "member-3"}}} {

	g, _ := groupsFSM(t)

func TestGroupIsRemovedWhenItsLastPhysicalIncarnationIsPurged(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := groupsFSM(t)
	seq := addGroupTable(t, f, 1, "dbq", "a", 200)
	mustApply(t, f, retireCmd("dbq", wire.TableRetireReasonTableDeleted, ev(202, "0x202", 0), "a"))
	mustApply(t, f, snodePurged(t, f, indexerSigner1(t), "s1", seq))
	for _, v := range []string{"v1", "v2"} {
		mustApply(t, f, verifierPurged(t, f, v, v[len(v)-1], seq))
	}
	if f.groupLocked(1, "dbq") == nil {
		t.Fatal("the group left before its database's last physical incarnation was Purged")
	}
	version := registryVersion(f)
	mustApply(t, f, verifierPurged(t, f, "v3", '3', seq))
	if f.st.TableRegistry.incarnation(seq).Status != TableStatusPurged || f.groupLocked(1, "dbq") != nil {
		t.Fatal("the group outlived its database's last physical incarnation")
	}
	if got := f.groupGenerationLocked(1, "dbq"); got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("durable generation %d, want 1 after the removal", got)
	}
	if registryVersion(f) != version+1 {
		t.Fatal("the removal did not bump the registry version once")
	}
}

func TestGroupGenerationSurvivesRemovalAndReplacement(t *testing.T) {

}

func TestPurgeMembersAccumulateAtRecordPlacementAndAdd(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	genesis := f.st.TableRegistry.Live("db.t")
	if !slices.Equal(genesis.PurgeMembers, []string{"member-0", "member-2", "member-3"}) ||
		!slices.Equal(f.st.TableRegistry.Live("db0.x").PurgeMembers, []string{"member-1", "member-2", "member-3"}) {
		t.Fatalf("backfill purge_members %v and %v", genesis.PurgeMembers, f.st.TableRegistry.Live("db0.x").PurgeMembers)
	}
	enrolGroupHosts(t, f, a, map[uint64]string{4: "node:n4"})
	listGroupMembers(t, f, a, groupMemberEntry(t, f, 4, "member-4"))
	recorded := addGroupTable(t, f, 1, "db", "n", 200)
	if got := f.st.TableRegistry.incarnation(recorded).PurgeMembers; !slices.Equal(got, []string{"member-0", "member-2", "member-3"}) {
		t.Fatalf("record-time purge_members %v", got)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 1, []string{"member-4"}, []string{"member-3"}, true))
	want := []string{"member-0", "member-2", "member-3", "member-4"}
	for _, inc := range []*TableIncarnation{genesis, f.st.TableRegistry.incarnation(recorded)} {
		if !slices.Equal(inc.PurgeMembers, want) {
			t.Fatalf("incarnation %d purge_members %v, want %v: a removed member stays", inc.Seq, inc.PurgeMembers, want)
		}
	}
	if got := f.st.TableRegistry.Live("db0.x").PurgeMembers; !slices.Equal(got, []string{"member-1", "member-2", "member-3"}) {
		t.Fatalf("another group's incarnation changed: %v", got)
	}
}

func TestPastMembersLeaveOnlyByReportingOrEviction(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	registerMember(t, f, "member-2")
	registerMember(t, f, "member-3")
	seq := addGroupTable(t, f, 1, "dbq", "a", 200)
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "dbq", 1, nil, []string{"member-2", "member-3"}, true))
	g := mustGroup(t, f, 1, "dbq")
	if !slices.Equal(g.PastMembers, []string{"member-2", "member-3"}) {
		t.Fatalf("past members %v", g.PastMembers)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, retireCmd("dbq", wire.TableRetireReasonTableDeleted, ev(202, "0x202", 0), "a"))
	mustApply(t, f, verifierPurged(t, f, "v1", '1', seq))
	if !slices.Equal(g.PastMembers, []string{"member-2", "member-3"}) {
		t.Fatalf("another node's report removed a past member: %v", g.PastMembers)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, memberPurged(t, f, "member-3", seq))
	if !slices.Equal(g.PastMembers, []string{"member-2"}) {
		t.Fatalf("past members %v after member-3 reported", g.PastMembers)
	}
	version := registryVersion(f)
	mustApply(t, f, evictCmd(t, f, a, "member-2", 1))
	if len(g.PastMembers) != 0 || registryVersion(f) != version+1 {
		t.Fatalf("past members %v and version %d after the eviction, want none and one bump", g.PastMembers, registryVersion(f))
	}
	if f.st.TableRegistry.incarnation(seq).Status != TableStatusPurging {
		t.Fatal("the purge completed although s1, v2 and v3 have not reported")
	}
}

func TestRegistryViewServesMemberHostsFromTheListing(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	hostsOf := func(gv GroupView) []string {
		var out []string
		for i, mv := range gv.MemberViews {
			host := "-"
			if mv.HostIndexerID != nil {
				host = fmt.Sprint(*mv.HostIndexerID)
			}
			out = append(out, gv.Group.Members[i].NodeID+"@"+host)
		}
		return out
	}
	view, _ := f.TableRegistryView()
	if len(view.Groups) != 2 || !slices.Equal(hostsOf(view.Groups[1]), []string{"member-0@0", "member-2@2", "member-3@3"}) {
		t.Fatalf("view groups %+v", view.Groups)
	}
	// The view is a deep copy.
	*view.Groups[1].MemberViews[0].HostIndexerID = 9
	view.Groups[1].Group.Members[0].NodeID = "forged"
	if again, _ := f.TableRegistryView(); !slices.Equal(hostsOf(again.Groups[1]), []string{"member-0@0", "member-2@2", "member-3@3"}) {
		t.Fatal("a reader changed the committed groups")
	}
	updateStage3(t, f, a, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) {
		u.Verifiers = slices.DeleteFunc(u.Verifiers, func(v arbiter.VerifierEntry) bool { return v.NodeID == "member-0" })
	})
	if view, _ = f.TableRegistryView(); !slices.Equal(hostsOf(view.Groups[1]), []string{"member-0@-", "member-2@2", "member-3@3"}) {
		t.Fatalf("after delisting member-0: %v", hostsOf(view.Groups[1]))
	}
}

func TestParamsUpdateChangingAMembersEntryBumpsTheRegistryVersion(t *testing.T) {

			}

func TestCopyFloorSetCountsDomainsNotMembers(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	// member-0 moves into owner 1's domain and member-2 and member-3 share
	// one: two members of one domain count once.
	updateStage3(t, f, a, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) {
		for i, d := range u.Stage3.IndexerFailureDomains {
			switch d.IndexerID {
			case 0:
				u.Stage3.IndexerFailureDomains[i].FailureDomain = "node:n1"
			case 2, 3:
				u.Stage3.IndexerFailureDomains[i].FailureDomain = "node:x"
			}
		}
		for i := range u.Verifiers {
			switch u.Verifiers[i].NodeID {
			case "member-0":
				u.Verifiers[i].FailureDomain = "node:n1"
			case "member-2", "member-3":
				u.Verifiers[i].FailureDomain = "node:x"
			}
		}
	})
	g := mustGroup(t, f, 1, "db")
	for _, m := range []string{"member-0", "member-2", "member-3"} {
		setMemberClass(t, g, m, MemberCaughtUp)
	}
	check := func(strict bool, exclude string, want []string, domains uint32) {
		t.Helper()
		nodes, n := f.copyFloorSetLocked(g, strict, exclude)
		if !slices.Equal(nodes, want) || n != domains {
			t.Fatalf("E(strict %v, exclude %q) = %v in %d domains, want %v in %d", strict, exclude, nodes, n, want, domains)
		}
	}
	check(false, "", []string{"member-2", "member-3"}, 1)
	check(false, "member-2", []string{"member-3"}, 1)
	setMemberClass(t, g, "member-3", MemberLagging)
	check(false, "", []string{"member-2"}, 1)
	check(true, "", []string{"member-2", "member-3"}, 1)
	setMemberClass(t, g, "member-3", MemberBootstrapping)
	check(true, "", []string{"member-2"}, 1)
}

func TestRestoreRefusesAMissingOrExtraGroup(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := groupsFSM(t)
	if !slices.Equal(snapshotBytes(t, restoreInto(t, snapshotBytes(t, f))), snapshotBytes(t, f)) {
		t.Fatal("an honest container does not round-trip")
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		f      *FSM
		mutate func(st *State)
		want   string
	}{
		{f, func(st *State) { st.Stage3.Groups = st.Stage3.Groups[1:] }, `snapshot stage3 groups: database "db0" of indexer 0 has a physical incarnation and no group`},
		{f, func(st *State) {
			extra := &DatabaseGroup{Owner: 1, DatabaseID: "nodb", Generation: 1, Salt: "0x1"}
			st.Stage3.Groups = append(st.Stage3.Groups, extra)
			st.Stage3.GroupGenerations = append(st.Stage3.GroupGenerations, GroupGeneration{Owner: 1, DatabaseID: "nodb", Generation: 1})
		}, `snapshot stage3 groups: group of indexer 1 database "nodb" has no physical incarnation`},
	} {
		if err := restoreErr(t, forgedGroupsSnapshot(t, tc.f, tc.mutate)); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), tc.want) {
			t.Fatalf("restore = %v, want %q", err, tc.want)
		}
	}
	ready, _ := groupsReadyFSM(t)
	forged := forgedGroupsSnapshot(t, ready, func(st *State) {
		st.Stage3.Groups = []*DatabaseGroup{{Owner: 0, DatabaseID: "db0", Generation: 1, Salt: "0x150"}}
	})
	want := `snapshot stage3 groups: group of indexer 0 database "db0" exists while the placement switch is off`
	if err := restoreErr(t, forged); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), want) {
		t.Fatalf("restore = %v, want %q", err, want)
	}
}

func TestRestoreRefusesAMemberMissingFromPurgeMembers(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := groupsFSM(t)
	seq := f.st.TableRegistry.Live("db.t").Seq
	forged := forgedGroupsSnapshot(t, f, func(st *State) {
		inc := st.TableRegistry.Incarnations[seq-1]
		inc.PurgeMembers = slices.DeleteFunc(slices.Clone(inc.PurgeMembers), func(id string) bool { return id == "member-2" })

	want := fmt.Sprintf(`snapshot stage3 groups: member member-2 of group of indexer 1 database "db" is missing from purge_members of incarnation %d`, seq)
	if err := restoreErr(t, forged); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), want) {
		t.Fatalf("restore = %v, want %q", err, want)
	}
}

// TestRestoreRefusesMalformedGroupRecords covers the remaining refusals of
// validateStage3Groups, one forged field each.
func TestRestoreRefusesMalformedGroupRecords(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 1, nil, []string{"member-3"}, true))
	g := func(st *State) *DatabaseGroup { return st.Stage3.Groups[1] }
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		mutate func(st *State)
		want   string
	}{
		{func(st *State) { st.Stage3.Groups[0], st.Stage3.Groups[1] = st.Stage3.Groups[1], st.Stage3.Groups[0] }, "groups are not sorted by (owner, database_id) without duplicates"},
		{func(st *State) {
			gens := st.Stage3.GroupGenerations
			gens[0], gens[1] = gens[1], gens[0]
		}, "group generations are not sorted by (owner, database_id) without duplicates"},
		{func(st *State) { g(st).Salt = "" }, `group of indexer 1 database "db" has no salt`},
		{func(st *State) { m := g(st).Members; m[0], m[1] = m[1], m[0] }, `members of group of indexer 1 database "db" are not sorted and unique`},
		{func(st *State) { g(st).Members[0].JoinedGeneration = 3 }, `member member-0 of group of indexer 1 database "db" has joined_generation 3 outside [1, 2]`},
		{func(st *State) { g(st).Members[0].Class = MemberLeaving }, `member member-0 of group of indexer 1 database "db" has class "leaving"`},
		{func(st *State) { g(st).Leaving[0].Member.Class = MemberBehind }, `leaving member member-3 of group of indexer 1 database "db" is malformed: its class is "behind", not leaving`},
		{func(st *State) { g(st).Leaving[0].Entry.IndexerID = 0 }, `leaving member member-3 of group of indexer 1 database "db" is malformed: its entry names indexer 0`},
		{func(st *State) { g(st).PastMembers = []string{"member-0", "member-3"} }, `past members of group of indexer 1 database "db" are not sorted, unique and disjoint from members`},
	} {
		want := "snapshot stage3 groups: " + tc.want
		if err := restoreErr(t, forgedGroupsSnapshot(t, f, tc.mutate)); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), want) {
			t.Fatalf("restore = %v, want %q", err, want)
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package fsm

// rebalanceRefusalFSM is groupsFSM plus the entries the refusal table needs:
// indexer 4 shares indexer 2's failure domain, indexer 5 is in owner 1's,
// member-2b shares member-2's host, and member-4 and member-5 are listed on
// hosts 4 and 5.
func rebalanceRefusalFSM(t *testing.T) (*FSM, *authority.Signer, func() *FSM) {
	t.Helper()
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	enrolGroupHosts(t, f, a, map[uint64]string{4: "node:n2", 5: "node:n1"})
	listGroupMembers(t, f, a, groupMemberEntry(t, f, 2, "member-2b"), groupMemberEntry(t, f, 4, "member-4"), groupMemberEntry(t, f, 5, "member-5"))
	snapshot := snapshotBytes(t, f)
	return f, a, func() *FSM { return restoreInto(t, snapshot) }
}

// TestRebalanceGroupRefusals: contract §50's 18 refusals, verbatim and in
// order, each with state unchanged, on G(1, db) = {member-0, member-2,
// member-3} at generation 1 with fill on.
func TestRebalanceGroupRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	ready, _ := groupsReadyFSM(t)
	unsigned := func(c wire.RebalanceGroup) wire.Command {
		c.AuthorityJWS = "a.b.c"
		return wire.Command{RebalanceGroup: &c}
	}
	rejectGroupCommand(t, ready, unsigned(wire.RebalanceGroup{OwnerIndexerID: 1, DatabaseID: "db", ExpectedGeneration: 1, Remove: []string{"member-3"}, NetworkFill: true}),
		"group rebalancing is refused until the placement switch is on", false)

	r, a, fresh := rebalanceRefusalFSM(t)
	sign := func(target *FSM, generation uint64, add, remove []string, fill bool) wire.Command {
		return rebalanceCmd(t, target, a, 1, "db", generation, add, remove, fill)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		cmd    wire.Command
		want   string
		prefix bool
	}{
		{"database_id", unsigned(wire.RebalanceGroup{OwnerIndexerID: 1, ExpectedGeneration: 1, NetworkFill: true}), "rebalance group: database_id is required", false},
		{"unsorted add", unsigned(wire.RebalanceGroup{OwnerIndexerID: 1, DatabaseID: "db", ExpectedGeneration: 1, Add: []string{"member-5", "member-4"}, NetworkFill: true}),
			"rebalance group: add and remove must be sorted, unique and disjoint node ids", false},
		{"overlap", unsigned(wire.RebalanceGroup{OwnerIndexerID: 1, DatabaseID: "db", ExpectedGeneration: 1, Add: []string{"member-4"}, Remove: []string{"member-4"}, NetworkFill: true}),
			"rebalance group: add and remove must be sorted, unique and disjoint node ids", false},
		{"no group", unsigned(wire.RebalanceGroup{OwnerIndexerID: 1, DatabaseID: "nope", ExpectedGeneration: 1, NetworkFill: false}),
			`rebalance group: no group for indexer 1 database "nope"`, false},
		{"authority", rebalanceCmd(t, r, indexerSigner2(t), 1, "db", 1, nil, nil, false), `rebalance group indexer 1 database "db": authority: `, true},
		{"generation", sign(r, 2, nil, nil, false), `rebalance group: expected_generation 2 differs from generation 1 of indexer 1 database "db"`, false},
		{"remove a non-member", sign(r, 1, nil, []string{"member-4"}, true), "rebalance group: member-4 is not a member of the group", false},
		{"add a member", sign(r, 1, []string{"member-2"}, nil, true), "rebalance group: member-2 is already a member of the group", false},
		{"add an unlisted node", sign(r, 1, []string{"nobody"}, nil, true), "rebalance group: nobody is not a listed, non-evicted member entry with verify or replicate", false},
		{"add a pool verifier", sign(r, 1, []string{"v1"}, nil, true), "rebalance group: v1 is not a listed, non-evicted member entry with verify or replicate", false},
		{"add the owner's member", sign(r, 1, []string{"member-1"}, nil, true), "rebalance group: member-1 is hosted by the owner indexer 1", false},
		{"shared host", sign(r, 1, []string{"member-2b"}, nil, true), "rebalance group: member-2 and member-2b share host indexer 2", false},
		{"shared domain", sign(r, 1, []string{"member-4"}, nil, true), `rebalance group: member-2 and member-4 share failure domain "node:n2"`, false},
		{"owner's domain", sign(r, 1, []string{"member-5"}, nil, true), `rebalance group: member-5 is in the owner's failure domain "node:n1"`, false},
		{"no change", sign(r, 1, nil, nil, true), "rebalance group: the command changes nothing", false},
		{"fill off below three", sign(r, 1, nil, []string{"member-3"}, false), "rebalance group: network_fill off needs at least 3 listed verify members, the result has 2", false},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) { rejectGroupCommand(t, r, tc.cmd, tc.want, tc.prefix) })
	}

	// Refusal 10 needs a listed entry whose host is not enrolled, which no
	// committed update can list: synthesized on a copy.
	unenrolled := fresh()
	host := uint64(9)
	unenrolled.st.Params.Verifiers = append(unenrolled.st.Params.Verifiers, arbiter.VerifierEntry{NodeID: "member-9", HostIndexerID: &host,
		FailureDomain: "node:n9", Weight: 1, Verify: true, Replicate: true, Counts: true, SharedRMT: true})
	rejectGroupCommand(t, unenrolled, sign(unenrolled, 1, []string{"member-9"}, nil, true), "rebalance group: host indexer 9 of member-9 is not enrolled", false)

	// Refusal 16: with two pool verifiers evicted, fill on and two members
	// removed the group keeps one member and one pool verifier.
	small := fresh()
	mustApply(t, small, evictCmd(t, small, a, "v1", 0))
	mustApply(t, small, evictCmd(t, small, a, "v2", 0))
	rejectGroupCommand(t, small, sign(small, 1, nil, []string{"member-2", "member-3"}, true), "rebalance group: the result has 2 verifiers, below the per-group floor of 3", false)

	// Refusal 18: the open block holds a statement of db and its seal cannot
	// be prepared (synthesized corruption: a non-empty open block without an
	// owner, the owner-switch precedent).
	unsealable := fresh()
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	admitTrack(t, unsealable, key, account, 1, 1)
	unsealable.st.OpenBlock.Owner = nil
	rejectGroupCommand(t, unsealable, sign(unsealable, 1, nil, []string{"member-3"}, true), "rebalance group seal: open block has no owner", false)
}

func TestRebalanceGroupSealsAnOpenBlockHoldingTheDatabaseFirst(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	stmt := admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 1)
	blocks := len(f.st.Blocks)
	// Another owner's group: the open block holds no statement of it.
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 0, "db0", 1, nil, []string{"member-3"}, true))
	if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks || !slices.Equal(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs, []uint64{stmt}) {
		t.Fatal("a rebalance of another database sealed the open block")
	}
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 1, nil, []string{"member-3"}, true))
	if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks+1 || len(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("blocks %d (was %d), open block %+v: the rebalance did not seal first", len(f.st.Blocks), blocks, f.st.OpenBlock)
	}
	hdr := f.st.Blocks[len(f.st.Blocks)-1]
	if hdr.Track == nil || hdr.Track.IndexerID != 1 || hdr.StatementCount != 1 || f.st.Statements[stmt].BlockSeq != hdr.L3BlockSeq {
		t.Fatalf("sealed header %+v", hdr)
	}
	if g := mustGroup(t, f, 1, "db"); g.Generation != 2 || groupMemberIndex(g, "member-3") >= 0 {
		t.Fatalf("group after the rebalance %+v", g)
	}
}

func TestRebalanceGroupRefusesWithStateUnchangedWhenTheSealCannotBePrepared(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 1)
	owner := *f.st.OpenBlock.Owner
	f.st.OpenBlock.Owner = nil // synthesized corruption, as in the owner-switch test
	cmd := rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 1, nil, []string{"member-3"}, true)
	rejectGroupCommand(t, f, cmd, "rebalance group seal: open block has no owner", false)
	if g := mustGroup(t, f, 1, "db"); g.Generation != 1 || groupMemberIndex(g, "member-3") < 0 {
		t.Fatalf("the refused rebalance changed the group: %+v", g)
	}
	f.st.OpenBlock.Owner = &owner
	blocks := len(f.st.Blocks)
	mustApply(t, f, cmd)
	if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks+1 {
		t.Fatal("the rebalance did not seal once the seal could be prepared")
	}
}

func TestRebalanceGroupRecordsLeavingWithTheFrozenEntryAndE(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	g := mustGroup(t, f, 1, "db")
	setMemberClass(t, g, "member-0", MemberLagging)
	setMemberClass(t, g, "member-2", MemberCaughtUp)
	setMemberClass(t, g, "member-3", MemberBehind)
	entry := f.publishedTrackFrontierLocked(1)
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 1, nil, []string{"member-2"}, true))

		FrozenE: []string{"member-3"}, FrozenEDomains: 1}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(g.Leaving, []LeavingMember{want}) || entry.IndexerID != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("leaving %+v, want %+v", g.Leaving, want)

	}

func TestRebalanceGroupReaddingALeavingMemberReplacesItsRecord(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 1, nil, []string{"member-3"}, true))
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 2, []string{"member-3"}, nil, true))
	g := mustGroup(t, f, 1, "db")
	i := groupMemberIndex(g, "member-3")
	if i < 0 || g.Members[i] != (GroupMember{NodeID: "member-3", JoinedGeneration: 3, Class: MemberBootstrapping}) {
		t.Fatalf("re-added member %+v", g.Members)
	}
	if len(g.Leaving) != 0 || len(g.PastMembers) != 0 || g.Generation != 3 {

	}
}

func TestRebalanceGroupRerunsCompletePurges(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	registerMember(t, f, "member-3")
	seq := addGroupTable(t, f, 1, "dbq", "a", 200)
	mustApply(t, f, retireCmd("dbq", wire.TableRetireReasonTableDeleted, ev(202, "0x202", 0), "a"))
	mustApply(t, f, memberPurged(t, f, "member-3", seq))
	version := registryVersion(f)
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "dbq", 1, nil, []string{"member-3"}, true))
	g := mustGroup(t, f, 1, "dbq")
	// member-3 already reported the purge of every incarnation that lists
	// it, so the rerun inside the same Apply leaves it out of past_members;
	// its Leaving record stays.
	if len(g.PastMembers) != 0 || len(g.Leaving) != 1 || g.Leaving[0].Member.NodeID != "member-3" {
		t.Fatalf("past members %v, leaving %+v", g.PastMembers, g.Leaving)
	}
	if registryVersion(f) != version+1 {
		t.Fatalf("registry version %d, want one bump from %d", registryVersion(f), version)
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 11: Write the determinism test**

It follows `fsm/determinism_tracks_test.go`: one recorded history replayed on a replica restored from the same snapshot. Create `fsm/determinism_stage3_test.go`:

```go
package fsm

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	"github.com/hashicorp/raft"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// TestDeterminism_PlacementAndRebalance: a log that turns placement on,
// places a group at AddTable, seals an open block before a RebalanceGroup,
// re-adds a Leaving member and purges a database answers every command the
// same on a replica restored from the same snapshot, and both end with the
// same snapshot bytes, which a third replica restored from them reproduces.
// Placement, the backfill order and the Leaving records depend only on
// committed state, never on map order.
func TestDeterminism_PlacementAndRebalance(t *testing.T) {
	ready, a := groupsReadyFSM(t)
	start := snapshotBytes(t, ready)
	h := &trackHistory{f: restoreInto(t, start)}
	f := h.f
	u := stage3Update(t, f)
	u.Stage3 = stage3WithSwitch(u.Stage3, Stage3SwitchPlacement)
	h.must(t, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, u))
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	h.must(t, wire.Command{SubmitStatement: &wire.SubmitStatement{Envelope: trackEnvelope(t, f, key, account, "", 1, 1)}})
	h.must(t, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 1, nil, []string{"member-2"}, true))
	h.must(t, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 0, "db0", 1, nil, []string{"member-3"}, true))
	h.apply(t, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 1, []string{"member-2"}, nil, true)) // stale: refused
	h.must(t, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 2, []string{"member-2"}, nil, true))
	h.must(t, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "dbq", "a", ev(200, "0x200", 0), ev(201, "0x201", 0), 1))
	h.must(t, retireCmd("dbq", wire.TableRetireReasonTableDeleted, ev(202, "0x202", 0), "a"))
	seq := f.st.TableRegistry.Live("dbq.a").Seq
	h.must(t, snodePurged(t, f, indexerSigner1(t), "s1", seq))
	for _, v := range []string{"v1", "v2", "v3"} {
		h.must(t, verifierPurged(t, f, v, v[len(v)-1], seq))
	}
	if f.groupLocked(1, "dbq") != nil || f.groupGenerationLocked(1, "dbq") != 1 || mustGroup(t, f, 1, "db").Generation != 3 || len(f.st.Blocks) < 2 {
		t.Fatal("the history did not reach the states it is meant to replay")
	}
	replica := restoreInto(t, start)
	for i, b := range h.log {
		if got := replica.Apply(&raft.Log{Data: b}); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, h.answers[i]) {
			t.Fatalf("command %d: the replica answered %+v, the recorded history %+v", i, got, h.answers[i])
		}
	}
	want := snapshotBytes(t, f)
	if !bytes.Equal(want, snapshotBytes(t, replica)) || fmt.Sprint(f.GroupStats()) != fmt.Sprint(replica.GroupStats()) {
		t.Fatal("replaying the log on a replica diverged")
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(want, snapshotBytes(t, restoreInto(t, want))) {
		t.Fatal("a replica restored from the final snapshot writes different bytes")
	}
}
```

```go
// TestPlacementIsReDerivableFromTheRegistryView: an auditor holding only the
```

- [ ] **Step 14: Add the group records and their rules**

Create `fsm/stage3_groups.go`, with the state types of contract §50 verbatim, the switch predicates of §49, the FSM placement, the backfill, removal, `purge_members`, E, the per-group floor, the authority and seal hooks, the metrics source and the restore rule:

```go
package fsm

import (
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"slices"
	"strings"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
)

// Database groups (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §6, plan S3-E3 contract §50,
// clarifications K73, K74). From the placement switch on, every (owner,
// database) with a physical incarnation has exactly one DatabaseGroup: placed
// by Apply when the database gains its first physical incarnation, or by the
// switch-on backfill, changed only by an authority-signed RebalanceGroup, and
// removed in the Apply that purges the database's last physical incarnation.
// Its generation counter is durable (GroupGenerations), so a re-placed group
// continues from it and no old RebalanceGroup or MemberReady replays against
// it. Delisting, unlisting verify or evicting a member never changes Members
// (K73): rings, keys and E filter by the listing and node status when they
// are evaluated.

// MemberClass is a member's class in one group (spec §9.2). Task 71 places
// every member as bootstrapping; Plan S3-E3 Task 75 moves it.
type MemberClass string

const (
	MemberBootstrapping MemberClass = "bootstrapping"
	MemberCaughtUp      MemberClass = "caught_up"
	MemberBehind        MemberClass = "behind"
	MemberLagging       MemberClass = "lagging"
	MemberLeaving       MemberClass = "leaving"
)

// MemberClasses lists every class in export order.
var MemberClasses = []MemberClass{MemberBootstrapping, MemberCaughtUp, MemberBehind, MemberLagging, MemberLeaving}

// DatabaseGroup is G(Owner, DatabaseID) (spec §6.2).
type DatabaseGroup struct {
	Owner       uint64          `json:"owner"`
	DatabaseID  string          `json:"database_id"`
	Generation  uint64          `json:"generation"`
	Salt        string          `json:"salt"`
	NetworkFill bool            `json:"network_fill"`
	Members     []GroupMember   `json:"members,omitempty"`      // sorted by NodeID, unique
	Leaving     []LeavingMember `json:"leaving,omitempty"`      // sorted by Member.NodeID, unique, disjoint from Members
	PastMembers []string        `json:"past_members,omitempty"` // sorted, unique, disjoint from Members
}

// GroupMember is one current member. Plan S3-E3 Tasks 73 and 75 append the
// readiness and checkpoint fields (contract §50).
type GroupMember struct {
	NodeID           string      `json:"node_id"`
	JoinedGeneration uint64      `json:"joined_generation"`
	Class            MemberClass `json:"class"`
}

// LeavingMember is a member a RebalanceGroup removed (spec §6.4, K74): its
// record, the generation that removed it, the owner's published entry then,
// and E (node ids, the leaving member excluded) and |E| as they were then,
// for Plan S3-E4 Task 76's release outside strict mode.
type LeavingMember struct {
	Member            GroupMember          `json:"member"` // Class == MemberLeaving
	RemovedGeneration uint64               `json:"removed_generation"`
	Entry             replay.TrackFrontier `json:"entry"`                      // O's published entry when the RebalanceGroup applied
	FrozenE           []string             `json:"frozen_e,omitempty"`         // E's node ids then, sorted, the leaving member excluded
	FrozenEDomains    uint32               `json:"frozen_e_domains,omitempty"` // |E| then
	Released          bool                 `json:"released,omitempty"`         // set once by Plan S3-E4 Task 76
}

// GroupGeneration is the durable generation counter of one (owner,
// database); it outlives the group.
type GroupGeneration struct {
	Owner      uint64 `json:"owner"`
	DatabaseID string `json:"database_id"`
	Generation uint64 `json:"generation"`
}

// GroupOwnerStats is one SI indexer's row of the group metrics.
type GroupOwnerStats struct {
	Owner   uint64
	Groups  int
	Members map[MemberClass]int
}

// placementOnLocked, reselectionOnLocked and checkpointsOnLocked are the
// switches of Plan S3-E3 (spec §10.4 steps 5, 7, 8). The caller holds f.mu.
func (f *FSM) placementOnLocked() bool   { return f.stage3SwitchOnLocked(Stage3SwitchPlacement) }
func (f *FSM) reselectionOnLocked() bool { return f.stage3SwitchOnLocked(Stage3SwitchReselection) }
func (f *FSM) checkpointsOnLocked() bool { return f.stage3SwitchOnLocked(Stage3SwitchCheckpoints) }

// PlacementOn, ReselectionOn and CheckpointsOn are the read-locked forms.
func (f *FSM) PlacementOn() bool   { return f.Stage3SwitchOn(Stage3SwitchPlacement) }
func (f *FSM) ReselectionOn() bool { return f.Stage3SwitchOn(Stage3SwitchReselection) }
func (f *FSM) CheckpointsOn() bool { return f.Stage3SwitchOn(Stage3SwitchCheckpoints) }

// indexerFailureDomain is params' failure domain of indexer id, "" when
// absent.
func indexerFailureDomain(params Params, id uint64) string {
	return stage3FailureDomain(params.Stage3, id)
}

// compareGroupKey orders groups and generations by (owner, database).
func compareGroupKey(aOwner uint64, aDatabase string, bOwner uint64, bDatabase string) int {
	switch {
	case aOwner < bOwner:
		return -1
	case aOwner > bOwner:
		return 1
	}
	return strings.Compare(aDatabase, bDatabase)
}

// groupLocked is G(owner, database), nil when none exists.
func (f *FSM) groupLocked(owner uint64, database string) *DatabaseGroup {
	if f.st.Stage3 == nil {
		return nil
	}
	groups := f.st.Stage3.Groups
	i, found := slices.BinarySearchFunc(groups, owner, func(g *DatabaseGroup, o uint64) int {
		return compareGroupKey(g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, o, database)
	})
	if !found {
		return nil
	}
	return groups[i]
}

// groupOfIncarnationLocked is the group of inc's (owner, database).
func (f *FSM) groupOfIncarnationLocked(inc *TableIncarnation) *DatabaseGroup {
	if inc == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return f.groupLocked(f.incarnationOwnerLocked(inc), inc.DatabaseID)
}

// groupGenerationLocked is the durable counter of (owner, database), 0 when
// no group was ever placed for it.
func (f *FSM) groupGenerationLocked(owner uint64, database string) uint64 {
	if f.st.Stage3 == nil {
		return 0
	}
	gens := f.st.Stage3.GroupGenerations
	i, found := slices.BinarySearchFunc(gens, owner, func(g GroupGeneration, o uint64) int {
		return compareGroupKey(g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, o, database)
	})
	if !found {
		return 0
	}
	return gens[i].Generation
}

// setGroupGenerationLocked writes the durable counter of (owner, database),
// keeping GroupGenerations sorted.
func (f *FSM) setGroupGenerationLocked(owner uint64, database string, generation uint64) {
	gens := f.st.Stage3.GroupGenerations
	i, found := slices.BinarySearchFunc(gens, owner, func(g GroupGeneration, o uint64) int {
		return compareGroupKey(g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, o, database)
	})
	if found {
		gens[i].Generation = generation
		return
	}
	f.st.Stage3.GroupGenerations = slices.Insert(gens, i, GroupGeneration{Owner: owner, DatabaseID: database, Generation: generation})
}

// evictedUnderLocked reports whether nodeID's node is evicted once params
// apply: its record is NodeEvicted, or it is a registered verifier that
// params do not list under its registered key, which the update committing
// params evicts (rule 6, signedClaimsMembershipLocked). Under the committed
// params the second case never holds, because that update already evicted
// it, so the per-group floor and the candidates of an update count exactly
// the nodes the update leaves standing, as the global floor does. A listed
// node that never registered is not evicted.
func (f *FSM) evictedUnderLocked(params Params, nodeID string) bool {
	n := f.st.Nodes[nodeID]
	if n == nil {
		return false
	}
	if n.Status == NodeEvicted {
		return true
	}
	return hasRole(n.Registration.Roles, arbiter.NodeRoleVerifier) && !listsVerifier(params.Verifiers, nodeID, n.Registration.Ed25519Pubkey)
}

// placementCandidatesLocked is PlacementCandidatesFrom over params and the
// committed node records and quarantine.
func (f *FSM) placementCandidatesLocked(params Params, owner uint64) []PlacementCandidate {
	exclude := params.Stage3 != nil && params.Stage3.ExcludeQuarantinedHosts
	return PlacementCandidatesFrom(params.Verifiers, params.SIIndexers, owner, exclude,
		func(nodeID string) bool { return f.evictedUnderLocked(params, nodeID) }, f.indexerQuarantinedLocked)
}

// placementSaltLocked is PlacementSaltFrom over the committed registry.
func (f *FSM) placementSaltLocked(owner uint64, database string, created *arbiter.L2EventRef) (string, error) {
	genesisID, err := f.genesisSnapshotIDLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("placement salt: %v", err)
	}
	return PlacementSaltFrom(f.st.TableRegistry.Incarnations, f.st.Params.TableRegistry.SIIndexerID, owner, database, genesisID, created)
}

// placeGroupLocked places G(owner, database) under params with salt, at the
// generation after the durable counter. It mutates nothing.
func (f *FSM) placeGroupLocked(params Params, owner uint64, database, salt string) (*DatabaseGroup, error) {
	p, err := PlaceGroup(PlacementInput{NetworkID: params.NetworkID, Owner: owner, OwnerFailureDomain: indexerFailureDomain(params, owner),
		Database: database, Salt: salt, GroupSize: params.Stage3.GroupSize, NetworkFillDefault: params.Stage3.NetworkFillDefault,
		Candidates: f.placementCandidatesLocked(params, owner)})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	generation := f.groupGenerationLocked(owner, database) + 1
	g := &DatabaseGroup{Owner: owner, DatabaseID: database, Generation: generation, Salt: salt, NetworkFill: p.NetworkFill}
	for _, id := range p.Members {
		g.Members = append(g.Members, GroupMember{NodeID: id, JoinedGeneration: generation, Class: MemberBootstrapping})
	}
	return g, nil
}

// physicalDatabasesLocked is PlacementTargetsFrom over the committed
// registry.
func (f *FSM) physicalDatabasesLocked() []PlacementTarget {
	return PlacementTargetsFrom(f.st.TableRegistry.Incarnations, f.st.Params.TableRegistry.SIIndexerID)
}

// backfillGroupsLocked places, under params and in ascending (owner,
// database) order, one group per (owner, database) holding a physical
// incarnation that has no group, genesis-origin incarnations included, which
// never pass through AddTable (spec §6.3). It mutates nothing.
func (f *FSM) backfillGroupsLocked(params Params) ([]*DatabaseGroup, error) {
	var groups []*DatabaseGroup
	for _, key := range f.physicalDatabasesLocked() {
		if f.groupLocked(key.Owner, key.Database) != nil {
			continue
		}
		salt, err := f.placementSaltLocked(key.Owner, key.Database, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		g, err := f.placeGroupLocked(params, key.Owner, key.Database, salt)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		groups = append(groups, g)
	}
	return groups, nil
}

// placementBackfillLocked is the placement switch-on's plan (spec §10.4 step
// 5), computed by applyUpdateConsensusParams before its first mutation: nil
// and "" for every other update; else the backfill under next, refused when a
// placement fails or a planned group would hold fewer than three verifiers.
func (f *FSM) placementBackfillLocked(next Params) ([]*DatabaseGroup, string) {
	if f.placementOnLocked() || !stage3SwitchValue(next.Stage3, Stage3SwitchPlacement) {
		return nil, ""
	}
	groups, err := f.backfillGroupsLocked(next)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Sprintf("consensus update: placement backfill: %v", err)
	}
	for _, g := range groups {
		if n := f.groupVerifierFloorLocked(g, next); n < 3 {
			return nil, fmt.Sprintf("consensus update: placement would leave group of indexer %d database %q with %d verifiers, below the per-group floor of 3", g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, n)
		}
	}
	return groups, ""
}

// installPlacementBackfillLocked installs the switch-on's planned groups,
// each recording its members in purge_members of every physical incarnation
// of its database (plan S3-E1 K60), and clears the plan. The switch-on's
// change of Params.Stage3 already bumps the registry version once (Plan S3-E2
// contract §45), and adding purge members completes no purge, so it neither
// bumps nor reruns completePurgesLocked itself.
func (f *FSM) installPlacementBackfillLocked() {
	groups := f.placementBackfill
	f.placementBackfill = nil
	for _, g := range groups {
		f.installGroupLocked(g)
		f.addPurgeMembersLocked(g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, groupMemberIDs(g))
	}
}

// installGroupLocked records g and its generation, keeping Groups and
// GroupGenerations sorted by (owner, database).
func (f *FSM) installGroupLocked(g *DatabaseGroup) {
	groups := f.st.Stage3.Groups
	i, found := slices.BinarySearchFunc(groups, g.Owner, func(x *DatabaseGroup, o uint64) int {
		return compareGroupKey(x.Owner, x.DatabaseID, o, g.DatabaseID)
	})
	if found {
		groups[i] = g
	} else {
		f.st.Stage3.Groups = slices.Insert(groups, i, g)
	}
	f.setGroupGenerationLocked(g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, g.Generation)
}

// groupMemberIDs lists g's current members, sorted.
func groupMemberIDs(g *DatabaseGroup) []string {
	out := make([]string, 0, len(g.Members))
	for _, m := range g.Members {
		out = append(out, m.NodeID)
	}
	return out
}

// groupMemberIndex is the index of nodeID in g.Members, -1 when absent.
func groupMemberIndex(g *DatabaseGroup, nodeID string) int {
	i, found := slices.BinarySearchFunc(g.Members, nodeID, func(m GroupMember, id string) int { return strings.Compare(m.NodeID, id) })
	if !found {
		return -1
	}
	return i
}

// dropUnplacedGroupsLocked removes every group whose (owner, database) no
// longer holds a physical incarnation (spec §6.2); its durable generation
// stays.
func (f *FSM) dropUnplacedGroupsLocked() {
	physical := f.physicalDatabasesLocked()
	f.st.Stage3.Groups = slices.DeleteFunc(f.st.Stage3.Groups, func(g *DatabaseGroup) bool {
		_, found := slices.BinarySearchFunc(physical, PlacementTarget{Owner: g.Owner, Database: g.DatabaseID}, comparePlacementTargets)
		return !found
	})
	if len(f.st.Stage3.Groups) == 0 {
		f.st.Stage3.Groups = nil
	}
}

// prunePastMembersLocked removes a past member once it is evicted, or once
// every incarnation of its group's database whose purge_members lists it is
// Purged or names it in purged_by (spec §6.2: it leaves only by reporting or
// through EvictNode).
func (f *FSM) prunePastMembersLocked() {
	for _, g := range f.st.Stage3.Groups {
		if len(g.PastMembers) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		kept := make([]string, 0, len(g.PastMembers))
		for _, p := range g.PastMembers {
			if !f.pastMemberDoneLocked(g, p) {
				kept = append(kept, p)
			}
		}
		g.PastMembers = nil
		if len(kept) > 0 {
			g.PastMembers = kept
		}
	}
}

// pastMemberDoneLocked reports whether past member p of g may leave
// past_members.
func (f *FSM) pastMemberDoneLocked(g *DatabaseGroup, p string) bool {
	if n := f.st.Nodes[p]; n != nil && n.Status == NodeEvicted {
		return true
	}
	for _, inc := range f.st.TableRegistry.Incarnations {
		if inc == nil || inc.DatabaseID != g.DatabaseID || f.incarnationOwnerLocked(inc) != g.Owner || !slices.Contains(inc.PurgeMembers, p) {
			continue
		}
		if inc.Status != TableStatusPurged && !slices.Contains(inc.PurgedBy, p) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// addPurgeMembersLocked merges nodes, sorted and unique, into purge_members
// of every physical incarnation of (owner, database) (plan S3-E1 K60): at
// record time the group's members, at placement and backfill the placed
// members, and every member a RebalanceGroup adds.
func (f *FSM) addPurgeMembersLocked(owner uint64, database string, nodes []string) {
	if len(nodes) == 0 {
		return
	}
	for _, inc := range f.st.TableRegistry.Incarnations {
		if inc == nil || inc.DatabaseID != database || !inc.hasPhysicalTables() || f.incarnationOwnerLocked(inc) != owner {
			continue
		}
		merged := slices.Clone(inc.PurgeMembers)
		for _, id := range nodes {
			if i, found := slices.BinarySearch(merged, id); !found {
				merged = slices.Insert(merged, i, id)
			}
		}
		inc.PurgeMembers = merged
	}
}

// copyFloorSetLocked is E of g (spec §9.3): the sorted node ids and the
// number of distinct failure domains of the members, exclude left out,
// listed with replicate and counts, not evicted, of class caught_up or behind
// (lagging too when strict), whose failure domain differs from the owner's.
// Plan S3-E4's floor and Leaving release read it.
func (f *FSM) copyFloorSetLocked(g *DatabaseGroup, strict bool, exclude string) (nodes []string, domains uint32) {
	params := f.st.Params
	ownerDomain := indexerFailureDomain(params, g.Owner)
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, m := range g.Members {
		if m.NodeID == exclude {
			continue
		}
		v, ok := findVerifierEntry(params.Verifiers, m.NodeID)
		if !ok || !v.Replicate || !v.Counts || f.evictedUnderLocked(params, m.NodeID) {
			continue
		}
		if !(m.Class == MemberCaughtUp || m.Class == MemberBehind || (strict && m.Class == MemberLagging)) {
			continue
		}
		if v.FailureDomain == ownerDomain {
			continue
		}
		nodes = append(nodes, m.NodeID)
		seen[v.FailureDomain] = true
	}
	return nodes, uint32(len(seen))
}

// groupVerifierFloorLocked is g's per-group verifier count (spec §6.1, K73)
// under params: its members listed with verify that are not evicted, plus,
// while g's fill is on, the listed network-pool entries that are not
// evicted.
func (f *FSM) groupVerifierFloorLocked(g *DatabaseGroup, params Params) int {
	n := 0
	for _, m := range g.Members {
		if v, ok := findVerifierEntry(params.Verifiers, m.NodeID); ok && v.Verify && !f.evictedUnderLocked(params, m.NodeID) {
			n++
		}
	}
	if g.NetworkFill {
		for _, v := range params.Verifiers {
			if v.HostIndexerID == nil && !f.evictedUnderLocked(params, v.NodeID) {
				n++
			}
		}
	}
	return n
}

// groupFloorRefusalLocked is the per-group verifier floor of a consensus
// update (spec §6.1): every group must keep at least three verifiers under
// next. It runs in the Apply-only half (stage3MembershipRefusalLocked),
// never on restore, and EvictNode never calls it.
func (f *FSM) groupFloorRefusalLocked(next Params) string {
	if f.st.Stage3 == nil {
		return ""
	}
	for _, g := range f.st.Stage3.Groups {
		if n := f.groupVerifierFloorLocked(g, next); n < 3 {
			return fmt.Sprintf("consensus update would leave group of indexer %d database %q with %d verifiers; at least 3 are required", g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, n)
		}
	}
	return ""
}

// memberEntriesChangedLocked reports whether next adds, removes or changes
// the verifiers entry of a current member of a group: the registry view
// serves each member's host from that entry (D27), so such an update bumps
// the registry version.
func (f *FSM) memberEntriesChangedLocked(previous, next []arbiter.VerifierEntry) bool {
	if f.st.Stage3 == nil {
		return false
	}
	for _, g := range f.st.Stage3.Groups {
		for _, m := range g.Members {
			before, listedBefore := findVerifierEntry(previous, m.NodeID)
			after, listedAfter := findVerifierEntry(next, m.NodeID)
			if listedBefore != listedAfter || (listedBefore && !reflect.DeepEqual(before, after)) {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}

// groupsChangedLocked finishes every Apply of Plan S3-E3 that changes a
// group, once and last: it reruns completePurgesLocked, which also drops
// unplaced groups and prunes past members, and bumps the registry version
// once. Plan S3-E4 Task 76 inserts its release evaluation at its start.
func (f *FSM) groupsChangedLocked() {
	f.completePurgesLocked()
	f.registryChangedLocked(f.st.TableRegistry)
}

// groupRecordCountLocked counts the groups and past members, both of which
// completePurgesLocked only ever removes.
func (f *FSM) groupRecordCountLocked() int {
	if f.st.Stage3 == nil {
		return 0
	}
	n := len(f.st.Stage3.Groups)
	for _, g := range f.st.Stage3.Groups {
		n += len(g.PastMembers)
	}
	return n
}

// completePurgesReportLocked runs completePurgesLocked and reports whether it
// changed what the registry view serves: a purge completed, or a group or a
// past member was removed. Callers that bump the registry only on a change
// (EvictNode, the evictions of a consensus update) use it.
func (f *FSM) completePurgesReportLocked() bool {
	reg := f.st.TableRegistry
	if reg == nil {
		return false
	}
	purged, records := purgedCount(reg), f.groupRecordCountLocked()
	f.completePurgesLocked()
	return purgedCount(reg) != purged || f.groupRecordCountLocked() != records
}

// authorityCommandRefusalLocked verifies an authority-signed stage-3 command
// like trackCommandLocked does (quarantine.go): under the current authority
// set with the exact current {network, genesis, epoch} and no clock (only the
// RPC enforces token age). kind carries the command's target, so the refusal
// reads "<kind>: authority: <err>".
func (f *FSM) authorityCommandRefusalLocked(kind string, verify func(*authority.Validator, authority.ConsensusContext) error) string {
	genesisID, err := f.genesisSnapshotIDLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s: %v", kind, err)
	}
	validator := &authority.Validator{AllowedAddresses: authorityAddressSet(f.st.Params.AuthorityAddresses)}
	ctx := authority.ConsensusContext{NetworkID: f.st.Params.NetworkID, GenesisSnapshotID: genesisID, AuthorityEpoch: f.st.ConsensusEpoch}
	if err := verify(validator, ctx); err != nil {
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s: authority: %v", kind, err)
	}
	return ""
}

// openBlockDatabasesLocked lists, sorted and unique, the databases of the
// open block's statements (their live incarnations' database ids).
func (f *FSM) openBlockDatabasesLocked() []string {
	var out []string
	for _, seq := range f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs {
		ss := f.st.Statements[seq]
		if ss == nil {
			continue
		}
		live := f.st.TableRegistry.Live(ss.Env.TargetTableID)
		if live == nil {
			continue
		}
		if i, found := slices.BinarySearch(out, live.DatabaseID); !found {
			out = slices.Insert(out, i, live.DatabaseID)
		}
	}
	return out
}

// prepareGroupSealLocked is the C10 seal-first hook of a command that changes
// a group (spec §6.4, §7.1): nil and "" when the open block holds no
// statement whose live incarnation belongs to (owner, one of databases), else
// the open block's seal prepared with the current spent-ids root. It mutates
// nothing; the caller refuses on a non-empty reason and commits the seal
// before its first mutation.
func (f *FSM) prepareGroupSealLocked(owner uint64, databases []string) (*preparedSeal, string) {
	ob := f.st.OpenBlock
	if ob == nil || len(ob.StatementSeqs) == 0 || f.st.TableRegistry == nil {
		return nil, ""
	}
	held := false
	for _, seq := range ob.StatementSeqs {
		ss := f.st.Statements[seq]
		if ss == nil {
			continue
		}
		live := f.st.TableRegistry.Live(ss.Env.TargetTableID)
		if live != nil && f.incarnationOwnerLocked(live) == owner && slices.Contains(databases, live.DatabaseID) {
			held = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !held {
		return nil, ""
	}
	return f.prepareStatementSealLocked(f.spentIDsRootLocked())
}

// cloneDatabaseGroup is a deep copy of g.
func cloneDatabaseGroup(g *DatabaseGroup) DatabaseGroup {
	c := *g
	c.Members = slices.Clone(g.Members)
	c.PastMembers = slices.Clone(g.PastMembers)
	c.Leaving = nil
	for _, l := range g.Leaving {
		l.FrozenE = slices.Clone(l.FrozenE)
		c.Leaving = append(c.Leaving, l)
	}
	return c
}

// GroupStats is the group metrics' source: one row per si_indexers entry, in
// indexer order, while stage 3 is active, and none before. Members counts
// every class, Leaving records included, zeros present.
func (f *FSM) GroupStats() []GroupOwnerStats {
	f.mu.RLock()
	defer f.mu.RUnlock()
	if f.st.Stage3 == nil {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]GroupOwnerStats, 0, len(f.st.Params.SIIndexers))
	for _, e := range f.st.Params.SIIndexers {
		row := GroupOwnerStats{Owner: e.IndexerID, Members: make(map[MemberClass]int, len(MemberClasses))}
		for _, class := range MemberClasses {
			row.Members[class] = 0
		}
		for _, g := range f.st.Stage3.Groups {
			if g.Owner != e.IndexerID {
				continue
			}
			row.Groups++
			for _, m := range g.Members {
				row.Members[m.Class]++
			}
			row.Members[MemberLeaving] += len(g.Leaving)
		}
		out = append(out, row)
	}
	return out
}

// validateStage3Groups is the restore rule of the database groups (housegate
// spec 2026-10-14 §6.2, plan S3-E3 contract §50): sorted unique records,
// exactly one group per (owner, database) with a physical incarnation while
// the placement switch is on and none before, each group's generation equal
// to its durable counter, a salt, sorted members within their generations, a
// well-formed Leaving list, past members disjoint from members, and every
// member recorded in purge_members of every physical incarnation of its
// database. It never reads node status.
func validateStage3Groups(st *State) error {
	if st.Stage3 == nil {
		return nil
	}
	refuse := func(format string, args ...any) error {
		return fmt.Errorf("snapshot stage3 groups: "+format, args...)
	}
	groups, gens := st.Stage3.Groups, st.Stage3.GroupGenerations
	for i, g := range groups {
		if g == nil || (i > 0 && compareGroupKey(groups[i-1].Owner, groups[i-1].DatabaseID, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID) >= 0) {
			return refuse("groups are not sorted by (owner, database_id) without duplicates")
		}
	}
	for i := 1; i < len(gens); i++ {
		if compareGroupKey(gens[i-1].Owner, gens[i-1].DatabaseID, gens[i].Owner, gens[i].DatabaseID) >= 0 {
			return refuse("group generations are not sorted by (owner, database_id) without duplicates")
		}
	}
	placement := stage3SwitchValue(st.Params.Stage3, Stage3SwitchPlacement)
	if !placement && len(groups) > 0 {
		return refuse("group of indexer %d database %q exists while the placement switch is off", groups[0].Owner, groups[0].DatabaseID)
	}
	if !placement || st.TableRegistry == nil || st.Params.TableRegistry == nil {
		return nil
	}
	founding := st.Params.TableRegistry.SIIndexerID
	ownerOf := func(inc *TableIncarnation) uint64 {
		if inc.OwnerIndexerID != nil {
			return *inc.OwnerIndexerID
		}
		return founding
	}
	// The physical incarnations of each (owner, database), in seq order. The
	// map is only looked up, never ranged over.
	physical := map[PlacementTarget][]*TableIncarnation{}
	for _, inc := range st.TableRegistry.Incarnations {
		if inc != nil && inc.hasPhysicalTables() {
			key := PlacementTarget{Owner: ownerOf(inc), Database: inc.DatabaseID}
			physical[key] = append(physical[key], inc)
		}
	}
	for _, inc := range st.TableRegistry.Incarnations {
		if inc == nil || !inc.hasPhysicalTables() {
			continue
		}
		if _, found := slices.BinarySearchFunc(groups, PlacementTarget{Owner: ownerOf(inc), Database: inc.DatabaseID}, func(g *DatabaseGroup, t PlacementTarget) int {
			return compareGroupKey(g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, t.Owner, t.Database)
		}); !found {
			return refuse("database %q of indexer %d has a physical incarnation and no group", inc.DatabaseID, ownerOf(inc))
		}
	}
	for _, g := range groups {
		incs := physical[PlacementTarget{Owner: g.Owner, Database: g.DatabaseID}]
		if len(incs) == 0 {
			return refuse("group of indexer %d database %q has no physical incarnation", g.Owner, g.DatabaseID)
		}
		var counter uint64
		if i, found := slices.BinarySearchFunc(gens, g.Owner, func(x GroupGeneration, o uint64) int {
			return compareGroupKey(x.Owner, x.DatabaseID, o, g.DatabaseID)
		}); found {
			counter = gens[i].Generation
		}
		if g.Generation == 0 || g.Generation != counter {
			return refuse("group of indexer %d database %q has generation %d, the durable counter is %d", g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, g.Generation, counter)
		}
		if g.Salt == "" {
			return refuse("group of indexer %d database %q has no salt", g.Owner, g.DatabaseID)
		}
		for i, m := range g.Members {
			if m.NodeID == "" || (i > 0 && g.Members[i-1].NodeID >= m.NodeID) {
				return refuse("members of group of indexer %d database %q are not sorted and unique", g.Owner, g.DatabaseID)
			}
		}
		for _, m := range g.Members {
			if m.JoinedGeneration < 1 || m.JoinedGeneration > g.Generation {
				return refuse("member %s of group of indexer %d database %q has joined_generation %d outside [1, %d]", m.NodeID, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, m.JoinedGeneration, g.Generation)
			}
			switch m.Class {
			case MemberBootstrapping, MemberCaughtUp, MemberBehind, MemberLagging:
			default:
				return refuse("member %s of group of indexer %d database %q has class %q", m.NodeID, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, m.Class)
			}
		}
		for i, l := range g.Leaving {
			if reason := leavingMemberMalformed(g, i, l); reason != "" {
				return refuse("leaving member %s of group of indexer %d database %q is malformed: %s", l.Member.NodeID, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, reason)
			}
		}
		for i, p := range g.PastMembers {
			if p == "" || (i > 0 && g.PastMembers[i-1] >= p) || groupMemberIndex(g, p) >= 0 {
				return refuse("past members of group of indexer %d database %q are not sorted, unique and disjoint from members", g.Owner, g.DatabaseID)
			}
		}
		for _, m := range g.Members {
			for _, inc := range incs {
				if !slices.Contains(inc.PurgeMembers, m.NodeID) {
					return refuse("member %s of group of indexer %d database %q is missing from purge_members of incarnation %d", m.NodeID, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, inc.Seq)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// leavingMemberMalformed is why Leaving record i of g is malformed, or "".
func leavingMemberMalformed(g *DatabaseGroup, i int, l LeavingMember) string {
	switch {
	case l.Member.NodeID == "" || (i > 0 && g.Leaving[i-1].Member.NodeID >= l.Member.NodeID):
		return "leaving members are not sorted by node_id without duplicates"
	case groupMemberIndex(g, l.Member.NodeID) >= 0:
		return "it is also a current member"
	case l.Member.Class != MemberLeaving:
		return fmt.Sprintf("its class is %q, not leaving", l.Member.Class)
	case l.RemovedGeneration < 2 || l.RemovedGeneration > g.Generation || l.Member.JoinedGeneration < 1 || l.Member.JoinedGeneration >= l.RemovedGeneration:
		return fmt.Sprintf("joined_generation %d and removed_generation %d are not within [1, %d] in order", l.Member.JoinedGeneration, l.RemovedGeneration, g.Generation)
	case l.Entry.IndexerID != g.Owner:
		return fmt.Sprintf("its entry names indexer %d", l.Entry.IndexerID)
	case !strictlySortedIDs(l.FrozenE) || slices.Contains(l.FrozenE, l.Member.NodeID):
		return "frozen_e is not sorted and unique or names the member itself"
	case l.FrozenEDomains > uint32(len(l.FrozenE)):
		return fmt.Sprintf("frozen_e_domains %d exceeds its %d members", l.FrozenEDomains, len(l.FrozenE))
	}
	return ""
}
```

- [ ] **Step 15: Add RebalanceGroup**

Create `fsm/rebalance_group.go` (contract §50's refusals and effects; refusal 17 is checked before 16, Notes):

```go
package fsm

import (
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// RebalanceGroup (Raft tag 38; housegate spec 2026-10-14 §6.4, plan S3-E3
// contract §50, K74) is the only command that changes a placed group's
// members or fill. It is authority-signed and bound to the group's
// generation, which it raises, so a replayed or stale command is refused. It
// seals an open block holding a statement of the database first, with the C10
// discipline: the seal is prepared before any mutation and the command is
// refused with state unchanged when it cannot be.

// rebalanceBeforePlacementReason refuses the command before the placement
// switch (plan S3-E1 K67), first and with state unchanged.
const rebalanceBeforePlacementReason = "group rebalancing is refused until the placement switch is on"

// strictlySortedIDs reports a list of non-empty node ids, strictly
// ascending.
func strictlySortedIDs(ids []string) bool {
	for i, id := range ids {
		if id == "" || (i > 0 && ids[i-1] >= id) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (f *FSM) applyRebalanceGroup(c *wire.RebalanceGroup) any {
	if !f.placementOnLocked() {
		return Rejected{Reason: rebalanceBeforePlacementReason}
	}
	if c.DatabaseID == "" {
		return Rejected{Reason: "rebalance group: database_id is required"}
	}
	// The committed lists themselves, not their canonical form, must be
	// sorted, unique and disjoint (the ReleaseIndexer precedent).
	if !strictlySortedIDs(c.Add) || !strictlySortedIDs(c.Remove) || slices.ContainsFunc(c.Add, func(id string) bool { return slices.Contains(c.Remove, id) }) {
		return Rejected{Reason: "rebalance group: add and remove must be sorted, unique and disjoint node ids"}
	}
	owner, database := c.OwnerIndexerID, c.DatabaseID
	g := f.groupLocked(owner, database)
	if g == nil {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("rebalance group: no group for indexer %d database %q", owner, database)}
	}
	kind := fmt.Sprintf("rebalance group indexer %d database %q", owner, database)
	if reason := f.authorityCommandRefusalLocked(kind, func(v *authority.Validator, ctx authority.ConsensusContext) error {
		_, err := v.VerifyRebalanceGroup(c.Canonical(), c.AuthorityJWS, ctx)
		return err
	}); reason != "" {
		return Rejected{Reason: reason}
	}
	if c.ExpectedGeneration != g.Generation {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("rebalance group: expected_generation %d differs from generation %d of indexer %d database %q", c.ExpectedGeneration, g.Generation, owner, database)}
	}
	if reason := f.rebalanceMembershipRefusalLocked(g, c); reason != "" {
		return Rejected{Reason: reason}
	}
	// The seal is prepared last, after every check and before any mutation.
	seal, reason := f.prepareGroupSealLocked(owner, []string{database})
	if reason != "" {
		return Rejected{Reason: "rebalance group seal: " + reason}
	}
	// E of each removed member, the member itself excluded, as it is before
	// this command changes anything (K74).
	frozen := make(map[string][]string, len(c.Remove))
	frozenDomains := make(map[string]uint32, len(c.Remove))
	for _, id := range c.Remove {
		frozen[id], frozenDomains[id] = f.copyFloorSetLocked(g, false, id)
	}
	// The sealed block records the group as it was.
	if seal != nil {
		f.commitSealLocked(seal)
	}
	generation := g.Generation + 1
	g.Generation = generation
	f.setGroupGenerationLocked(owner, database, generation)
	entry := f.publishedTrackFrontierLocked(owner)
	for _, id := range c.Remove {
		i := groupMemberIndex(g, id)
		member := g.Members[i]
		member.Class = MemberLeaving
		g.Members = slices.Delete(g.Members, i, i+1)
		g.Leaving = insertLeavingMember(g.Leaving, LeavingMember{Member: member, RemovedGeneration: generation, Entry: entry,
			FrozenE: frozen[id], FrozenEDomains: frozenDomains[id]})
		if j, found := slices.BinarySearch(g.PastMembers, id); !found {
			g.PastMembers = slices.Insert(g.PastMembers, j, id)
		}
	}
	for _, id := range c.Add {
		// A re-added Leaving member gets a fresh record (K74) and is no
		// longer a past member.
		g.Leaving = slices.DeleteFunc(g.Leaving, func(l LeavingMember) bool { return l.Member.NodeID == id })
		g.PastMembers = slices.DeleteFunc(g.PastMembers, func(p string) bool { return p == id })
		i, _ := slices.BinarySearchFunc(g.Members, id, func(m GroupMember, n string) int { return strings.Compare(m.NodeID, n) })
		g.Members = slices.Insert(g.Members, i, GroupMember{NodeID: id, JoinedGeneration: generation, Class: MemberBootstrapping})
	}
	if len(g.Members) == 0 {
		g.Members = nil
	}
	if len(g.Leaving) == 0 {
		g.Leaving = nil
	}
	if len(g.PastMembers) == 0 {
		g.PastMembers = nil
	}
	g.NetworkFill = c.NetworkFill
	f.addPurgeMembersLocked(owner, database, c.Add)
	f.groupsChangedLocked()
	return Applied{}
}

// rebalanceMembershipRefusalLocked is RebalanceGroup's member, placement-rule
// and floor checks (refusals 7 to 17 of contract §50), in order, over the
// committed parameters. Refusal 17 is checked before refusal 16: with fill
// off the per-group floor counts exactly the listed, non-evicted verify
// members, so in the other order refusal 17 could never be reached.
func (f *FSM) rebalanceMembershipRefusalLocked(g *DatabaseGroup, c *wire.RebalanceGroup) string {
	params := f.st.Params
	for _, id := range c.Remove {
		if groupMemberIndex(g, id) < 0 {
			return fmt.Sprintf("rebalance group: %s is not a member of the group", id)
		}
	}
	for _, id := range c.Add {
		if groupMemberIndex(g, id) >= 0 {
			return fmt.Sprintf("rebalance group: %s is already a member of the group", id)
		}
	}
	for _, id := range c.Add {
		v, ok := findVerifierEntry(params.Verifiers, id)
		if !ok || v.HostIndexerID == nil || !(v.Verify || v.Replicate) || f.evictedUnderLocked(params, id) {
			return fmt.Sprintf("rebalance group: %s is not a listed, non-evicted member entry with verify or replicate", id)
		}
	}
	for _, id := range c.Add {
		v, _ := findVerifierEntry(params.Verifiers, id)
		host := *v.HostIndexerID
		if _, ok := f.siIndexerLocked(host); !ok {
			return fmt.Sprintf("rebalance group: host indexer %d of %s is not enrolled", host, id)
		}
		if host == g.Owner {
			return fmt.Sprintf("rebalance group: %s is hosted by the owner indexer %d", id, g.Owner)
		}
	}
	// The resulting members, sorted, with their listed entries; a delisted
	// member keeps its record (K73) but has no host or domain to compare.
	var result []string
	for _, m := range g.Members {
		if !slices.Contains(c.Remove, m.NodeID) {
			result = append(result, m.NodeID)
		}
	}
	result = append(result, c.Add...)
	slices.Sort(result)
	var listed []arbiter.VerifierEntry
	for _, id := range result {
		if v, ok := findVerifierEntry(params.Verifiers, id); ok && v.HostIndexerID != nil {
			listed = append(listed, v)
		}
	}
	for i := range listed {
		for j := i + 1; j < len(listed); j++ {
			if *listed[i].HostIndexerID == *listed[j].HostIndexerID {
				return fmt.Sprintf("rebalance group: %s and %s share host indexer %d", listed[i].NodeID, listed[j].NodeID, *listed[i].HostIndexerID)
			}
		}
	}
	for i := range listed {
		for j := i + 1; j < len(listed); j++ {
			if listed[i].FailureDomain == listed[j].FailureDomain {
				return fmt.Sprintf("rebalance group: %s and %s share failure domain %q", listed[i].NodeID, listed[j].NodeID, listed[i].FailureDomain)
			}
		}
	}
	ownerDomain := indexerFailureDomain(params, g.Owner)
	for _, v := range listed {
		if v.FailureDomain == ownerDomain {
			return fmt.Sprintf("rebalance group: %s is in the owner's failure domain %q", v.NodeID, ownerDomain)
		}
	}
	if len(c.Add) == 0 && len(c.Remove) == 0 && c.NetworkFill == g.NetworkFill {
		return "rebalance group: the command changes nothing"
	}
	after := &DatabaseGroup{Owner: g.Owner, DatabaseID: g.DatabaseID, NetworkFill: c.NetworkFill}
	for _, id := range result {
		after.Members = append(after.Members, GroupMember{NodeID: id})
	}
	if !c.NetworkFill {
		if verify := f.groupVerifierFloorLocked(after, params); verify < 3 {
			return fmt.Sprintf("rebalance group: network_fill off needs at least 3 listed verify members, the result has %d", verify)
		}
	}
	if n := f.groupVerifierFloorLocked(after, params); n < 3 {
		return fmt.Sprintf("rebalance group: the result has %d verifiers, below the per-group floor of 3", n)
	}
	return ""
}

// insertLeavingMember inserts l into list, sorted by node id.
func insertLeavingMember(list []LeavingMember, l LeavingMember) []LeavingMember {
	i, _ := slices.BinarySearchFunc(list, l.Member.NodeID, func(x LeavingMember, id string) int { return strings.Compare(x.Member.NodeID, id) })
	return slices.Insert(list, i, l)
}
```

```go
// TestTableRegistryToPBCarriesGroups: every field Task 71 maps reaches

func TestTableRegistryToPBCarriesGroups(t *testing.T) {
	zero, two := uint64(0), uint64(2)
	view := fsm.TableRegistryView{Groups: []fsm.GroupView{{
		Group: fsm.DatabaseGroup{Owner: 1, DatabaseID: "db", Generation: 3, Salt: "0xsalt", NetworkFill: true,
			Members: []fsm.GroupMember{
				{NodeID: "member-0", JoinedGeneration: 1, Class: fsm.MemberBootstrapping},
				{NodeID: "member-2", JoinedGeneration: 2, Class: fsm.MemberCaughtUp},
				{NodeID: "member-4", JoinedGeneration: 3, Class: fsm.MemberBehind},
				{NodeID: "member-6", JoinedGeneration: 3, Class: fsm.MemberLagging},
			},
			Leaving: []fsm.LeavingMember{{Member: fsm.GroupMember{NodeID: "member-3", JoinedGeneration: 1, Class: fsm.MemberLeaving}, RemovedGeneration: 2,
				Entry: replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 1, SafeBlockSeq: 9, AppliedPromotionSeq: 4}, FrozenE: []string{"member-2"}, FrozenEDomains: 1, Released: true}},
			PastMembers: []string{"member-3"}},
		Key:         "0xkey",
		MemberViews: []fsm.GroupMemberView{{HostIndexerID: &zero}, {HostIndexerID: &two, LagAdvances: 9}, {}, {}},
	}}}
	got := tableRegistryToPB(view).GetGroups()
	want := []*pb.DatabaseGroup{{OwnerIndexerId: 1, DatabaseId: "db", Generation: 3, GroupKey: "0xkey", PlacementSalt: "0xsalt", NetworkFill: true,
		Members: []*pb.GroupMember{
			{NodeId: "member-0", JoinedGeneration: 1, MemberClass: pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_BOOTSTRAPPING, HostIndexerId: &zero},
			{NodeId: "member-2", JoinedGeneration: 2, MemberClass: pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_CAUGHT_UP, HostIndexerId: &two, LagAdvances: 9},
			{NodeId: "member-4", JoinedGeneration: 3, MemberClass: pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_BEHIND},
			{NodeId: "member-6", JoinedGeneration: 3, MemberClass: pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_LAGGING},
		},
		Leaving: []*pb.LeavingMember{{NodeId: "member-3", RemovedGeneration: 2, ReleaseEntry: &pb.TrackFrontier{IndexerId: 1, SafeBlockSeq: 9, AppliedPromotionSeq: 4},
			FrozenMembers: []string{"member-2"}, FrozenDomains: 1, Released: true}},
		PastMembers: []string{"member-3"}}}
	if len(got) != 1 || !proto.Equal(got[0], want[0]) {
		t.Fatalf("groups %v\nwant   %v", got, want)

	if got[0].GetMembers()[0].HostIndexerId == nil || got[0].GetMembers()[0].GetHostIndexerId() != 0 || got[0].GetMembers()[2].HostIndexerId != nil {
		t.Fatal("host_indexer_id must be present for indexer 0 and absent for a delisted member")
	}
	if tableRegistryToPB(fsm.TableRegistryView{}).GetGroups() != nil {
		t.Fatal("a view without groups serves groups")
	}
}
```

```go
// memberClassToPB maps the four classes a current member can hold; a Leaving
// member is served only in DatabaseGroup.leaving (plan S3-E1 §39).
var memberClassToPB = map[fsm.MemberClass]pb.MemberClass{
	fsm.MemberBootstrapping: pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_BOOTSTRAPPING,
	fsm.MemberCaughtUp:      pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_CAUGHT_UP,
	fsm.MemberBehind:        pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_BEHIND,
	fsm.MemberLagging:       pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_LAGGING,
}

// groupsToPB maps the registry view's groups (plan S3-E3 contract §50).
// group_key is the view's Key (Plan S3-E3 Task 72 fills it), each member's
// host_indexer_id is the view's HostIndexerID, left absent while the member is
// delisted (D27), and lag_advances is the view's LagAdvances (Task 75 fills
// it). ready_generation (Task 73), checkpoint and observed_entry (Task 75) are
// mapped by the tasks that add them; ReadySignature and ReadyEpoch are never
// served (D33).
func groupsToPB(v []fsm.GroupView) []*pb.DatabaseGroup {
	if len(v) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]*pb.DatabaseGroup, 0, len(v))
	for _, view := range v {
		g := view.Group
		dg := &pb.DatabaseGroup{OwnerIndexerId: g.Owner, DatabaseId: g.DatabaseID, NetworkFill: g.NetworkFill, Generation: g.Generation,
			PastMembers: slices.Clone(g.PastMembers), GroupKey: view.Key, PlacementSalt: g.Salt}
		for i, m := range g.Members {
			member := &pb.GroupMember{NodeId: m.NodeID, JoinedGeneration: m.JoinedGeneration, MemberClass: memberClassToPB[m.Class]}
			if i < len(view.MemberViews) {
				mv := view.MemberViews[i]
				if mv.HostIndexerID != nil {
					host := *mv.HostIndexerID
					member.HostIndexerId = &host
				}
				member.LagAdvances = uint64(mv.LagAdvances)
			}
			dg.Members = append(dg.Members, member)
		}
		for _, l := range g.Leaving {
			dg.Leaving = append(dg.Leaving, &pb.LeavingMember{NodeId: l.Member.NodeID, RemovedGeneration: l.RemovedGeneration,
				ReleaseEntry: wire.TrackFrontierToPB(l.Entry), FrozenMembers: slices.Clone(l.FrozenE), FrozenDomains: l.FrozenEDomains, Released: l.Released})
		}
		out = append(out, dg)
	}
	return out
}
```
