```go
package server

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority/authoritytest"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// applyServerStage3Update is applyServerUpdate carrying every committed list,
// flag and the stage3 parameter, edited by edit.
func applyServerStage3Update(t *testing.T, node *fakeNode, edit func(*arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate)) {
	t.Helper()
	view, err := node.f.ConsensusParamsView()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	applyServerUpdate(t, node, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) {
		u.MaxWriters = max(view.Current.MaxWriters, 1)
		u.SIIndexers, u.Verifiers, u.TracksEnabled = view.Current.SIIndexers, view.Current.Verifiers, view.Current.TracksEnabled
		if s := view.Current.Stage3; s != nil {
			c := *s
			u.Stage3 = &c
		}
		edit(u)
	})
}

// placementServer is activateServerTracks (indexer 1 on s1 owns the genesis
// table db.t, indexer 2 on the unregistered s2 owns nothing, verifiers
// v1..v3), then the v21 activation with failure domains node:n1 and node:n2,
// the switches through owner_aware_selection, the member entry member-2
// hosted by indexer 2, and the placement switch-on, all bypassing the
// gateway: G(1, db) = {member-2} at generation 1, with fill forced on.
func placementServer(t *testing.T, node *fakeNode) {
	t.Helper()
	activateServerTracks(t, node)
	applyServerStage3Update(t, node, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) {
		u.Stage3 = &arbiter.Stage3Params{GroupSize: 3, NetworkFillDefault: true, MinSafeCopies: 1,
			IndexerFailureDomains: []arbiter.IndexerFailureDomain{{IndexerID: 1, FailureDomain: "node:n1"}, {IndexerID: 2, FailureDomain: "node:n2"}},
			MaxLagPublications:    8, LagLow: 2, EvidenceTimeoutL2Blocks: 30, MaxUncleanedPartsPerPartition: 2000, MaxUncleanedPartsPerTable: 20000}
	})
	for _, turn := range []func(*arbiter.Stage3Params){
		func(s *arbiter.Stage3Params) { s.Purge = true },
		func(s *arbiter.Stage3Params) { s.EvictionVoiding = true },
		func(s *arbiter.Stage3Params) { s.OwnerAwareSelection = true },
	} {
		applyServerStage3Update(t, node, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) { turn(u.Stage3) })
	}
	host := uint64(2)
	seed := sha256.Sum256([]byte("server member-2"))
	replica := authoritytest.MustSigner(t, hex.EncodeToString(seed[:]))
	entry := arbiter.VerifierEntry{NodeID: "member-2", Ed25519Pubkey: ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(seed[:]).Public().(ed25519.PublicKey), HostIndexerID: &host,
		ReplicaSigner: strings.ToLower(replica.Address()), Weight: 1, FailureDomain: "node:n2", Verify: true, Replicate: true, Counts: true, SharedRMT: true}
	ctx := serverMessageContext(t, node.f)
	consent, err := authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.IndexerKeyHex1).SignGroupMemberConsentAt(authority.GroupMemberConsentStatement{
		NetworkID: ctx.NetworkID, GenesisSnapshotID: ctx.GenesisSnapshotID, HostIndexerID: host, NodeID: entry.NodeID,
		Ed25519Pubkey: entry.Ed25519Pubkey, ReplicaSigner: entry.ReplicaSigner}, authoritytest.Iat)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	entry.ConsentJWS = consent
	applyServerStage3Update(t, node, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) { u.Verifiers = append(u.Verifiers, entry) })
	applyServerStage3Update(t, node, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) { u.Stage3.Placement = true })
	view, _ := node.f.TableRegistryView()
	if !node.f.PlacementOn() || len(view.Groups) != 1 || view.Groups[0].Group.DatabaseID != "db" || view.Groups[0].Group.Generation != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("placement groups %+v", view.Groups)
	}
}

// rebalanceRequest is the RebalanceGroup request for G(1, db), signed now by
// signer under f's current authority context.
func rebalanceRequest(t *testing.T, f *fsm.FSM, signer *authority.Signer, generation uint64, add, remove []string, fill bool) *pb.RebalanceGroupCmd {
	t.Helper()
	cmd := wire.RebalanceGroup{OwnerIndexerID: 1, DatabaseID: "db", ExpectedGeneration: generation, Add: add, Remove: remove, NetworkFill: fill}
	token, err := signer.SignRebalanceGroupWithContext(cmd.Canonical(), serverAuthorityContext(t, f))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cmd.AuthorityJWS = token
	return wire.RebalanceGroupToRequest(cmd)
}

// TestRebalanceGroupRPCRefusesBeforePlacement: plan S3-E1 K67. Before the
// placement switch the RPC answers FailedPrecondition with Apply's text and
// proposes nothing; with consensus updates disabled it answers that first.
func TestRebalanceGroupRPCRefusesBeforePlacement(t *testing.T) {
	rec := newRecordingNode(t)
	activateServerTracks(t, rec.fakeNode)
	req := &pb.RebalanceGroupCmd{OwnerIndexerId: 1, DatabaseId: "db", ExpectedGeneration: 1, Remove: []string{"member-2"}, AuthorityJws: "a.b.c"}
	_, err := evictionAdmin(rec, 5*time.Minute).RebalanceGroup(context.Background(), req)
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || status.Convert(err).Message() != groupRebalancingRefusedMessage {
		t.Fatalf("before placement = %v", err)
	}
	disabled := evictionAdmin(rec, 5*time.Minute)
	disabled.s.d.Cfg.ConsensusUpdatesEnabled = false
	if _, err := disabled.RebalanceGroup(context.Background(), req); status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || status.Convert(err).Message() != consensusUpdatesDisabledMessage {
		t.Fatalf("updates disabled = %v", err)
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a refused rebalance was proposed")
	}
}

// TestRebalanceGroupRPCAuthorizesAndProposes: shape and authority refusals
// before anything is proposed, then the signed command reaches the log as
// sent and commits.
func TestRebalanceGroupRPCAuthorizesAndProposes(t *testing.T) {
	rec := newRecordingNode(t)
	placementServer(t, rec.fakeNode)
	admin := evictionAdmin(rec, 5*time.Minute)
	ctx := context.Background()
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		req  *pb.RebalanceGroupCmd
		want string
	}{
		{&pb.RebalanceGroupCmd{OwnerIndexerId: 1, ExpectedGeneration: 1, AuthorityJws: "a.b.c"}, "database_id is required"},
		{&pb.RebalanceGroupCmd{OwnerIndexerId: 1, DatabaseId: "db", ExpectedGeneration: 1, Add: []string{"m-b", "m-a"}, AuthorityJws: "a.b.c"},
			"add and remove must be sorted, unique and disjoint node ids"},
		{&pb.RebalanceGroupCmd{OwnerIndexerId: 1, DatabaseId: "db", ExpectedGeneration: 1, Add: []string{"m-a"}, Remove: []string{"m-a"}, AuthorityJws: "a.b.c"},
			"add and remove must be sorted, unique and disjoint node ids"},
		{&pb.RebalanceGroupCmd{OwnerIndexerId: 1, DatabaseId: "db", ExpectedGeneration: 1, Remove: []string{"member-2"}, AuthorityJws: "not-a-jws"},
			"authority_jws must be a JWS compact serialization with 3 dot-separated parts"},
	} {
		if _, err := admin.RebalanceGroup(ctx, tc.req); status.Code(err) != codes.InvalidArgument || status.Convert(err).Message() != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("request %v = %v, want InvalidArgument %q", tc.req, err, tc.want)
		}
	}
	foreign := rebalanceRequest(t, rec.f, authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.IndexerKeyHex1), 1, nil, []string{"member-2"}, true)
	if _, err := admin.RebalanceGroup(ctx, foreign); status.Code(err) != codes.PermissionDenied || !strings.HasPrefix(status.Convert(err).Message(), "rebalance group authority: ") {
		t.Fatalf("a non-authority key = %v", err)
	}
	other := rebalanceRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, nil, []string{"member-2"}, true)
	other.NetworkFill = false
	if _, err := admin.RebalanceGroup(ctx, other); status.Code(err) != codes.PermissionDenied {
		t.Fatalf("a token for another command = %v", err)
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a refused rebalance was proposed")
	}
	req := rebalanceRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, nil, []string{"member-2"}, true)
	if _, err := admin.RebalanceGroup(ctx, req); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("authority rebalance = %v", err)
	}
	lastProposalIs(t, rec, wire.Command{RebalanceGroup: &wire.RebalanceGroup{OwnerIndexerID: 1, DatabaseID: "db", ExpectedGeneration: 1,
		Remove: []string{"member-2"}, NetworkFill: true, AuthorityJWS: req.GetAuthorityJws()}})
	view, _ := rec.f.TableRegistryView()
	if g := view.Groups[0].Group; g.Generation != 2 || len(g.Members) != 0 || len(g.Leaving) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("group after the rebalance %+v", g)
	}
}

// TestRebalanceGroupRPCMapsApplyRefusalsToFailedPrecondition: a refusal only
// Apply can decide (a stale generation) reaches the caller as
// FailedPrecondition with the FSM's reason, not as a leader hint.
func TestRebalanceGroupRPCMapsApplyRefusalsToFailedPrecondition(t *testing.T) {
	rec := newRecordingNode(t)
	placementServer(t, rec.fakeNode)
	req := rebalanceRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 2, nil, []string{"member-2"}, true)
	_, err := evictionAdmin(rec, 5*time.Minute).RebalanceGroup(context.Background(), req)
	want := `rebalance group: expected_generation 2 differs from generation 1 of indexer 1 database "db"`
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || isNotLeader(err) || status.Convert(err).Message() != want {
		t.Fatalf("a stale rebalance = %v, want FailedPrecondition %q", err, want)
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("the stale rebalance was not proposed")
	}
}
```

```go
package server

import (
	"context"
	"slices"
	"strings"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// groupRebalancingRefusedMessage refuses ConsensusAdmin.RebalanceGroup before
// the placement switch (plan S3-E1 K67): Apply refuses Raft tag 38 with the
// same text, so the leader proposes nothing earlier.
const groupRebalancingRefusedMessage = "group rebalancing is refused until the placement switch is on"

// RebalanceGroup changes one database group's members or fill on an
// authority-signed request (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §6.4, plan S3-E3
// contract §50). It keeps QuarantineIndexer's order and texts: updates
// enabled, the switch, shape, leadership, authority with the configured token
// age; nothing reaches the log before the checks, and Apply re-verifies the
// token and decides the generation, the membership rules, the floor and the
// seal atomically. Apply's refusal names committed state, so it reaches the
// caller as FailedPrecondition with the FSM's reason. Ack means committed.
func (svc *consensusAdminService) RebalanceGroup(ctx context.Context, req *pb.RebalanceGroupCmd) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	if !svc.s.d.Cfg.ConsensusUpdatesEnabled {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, consensusUpdatesDisabledMessage)
	}
	// Applied state is enough: the switch is one-way and applied implies
	// committed, so a true answer never goes stale.
	if !svc.s.d.FSM.PlacementOn() {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, groupRebalancingRefusedMessage)
	}
	cmd := wire.RebalanceGroupFromRequest(req)
	switch {
	case cmd.DatabaseID == "":
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "database_id is required")
	case !sortedUniqueNodeIDs(cmd.Add) || !sortedUniqueNodeIDs(cmd.Remove) || slices.ContainsFunc(cmd.Add, func(id string) bool { return slices.Contains(cmd.Remove, id) }):
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "add and remove must be sorted, unique and disjoint node ids")
	case len(strings.Split(cmd.AuthorityJWS, ".")) != 3:
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "authority_jws must be a JWS compact serialization with 3 dot-separated parts")
	}
	// quarantineAuthority is the shared leader check and authority context of
	// the authority-signed commands outside ConsensusParamsUpdate.
	consensus, validator, err := svc.quarantineAuthority(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err := validator.AuthorizeRebalanceGroup(cmd.Canonical(), cmd.AuthorityJWS, consensus); err != nil {
		// The validator names the recovered address or the failed check and
		// never the token itself; keep it that way.
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "rebalance group authority: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := svc.s.propose(ctx, wire.Command{RebalanceGroup: &cmd}); err != nil {
		return nil, applyRefusalAsFailedPrecondition(err)
	}
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}

// sortedUniqueNodeIDs reports a list of non-empty node ids, strictly
// ascending.
func sortedUniqueNodeIDs(ids []string) bool {
	for i, id := range ids {
		if id == "" || (i > 0 && ids[i-1] >= id) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
```

```go
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net"
	"reflect"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/emptypb"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"

// groupsAdmin serves the reads and the RebalanceGroup the group commands use,
// ConsensusAdmin and TableRegistry on one listener.
type groupsAdmin struct {
	pb.UnimplementedConsensusAdminServer
	pb.UnimplementedTableRegistryServer
	state       *pb.ConsensusParamsState
	book        *pb.NodeFeatures
	tracks      *pb.TrackStateView
	registry    *pb.TableRegistrySnapshot
	rebalanceFn func(*pb.RebalanceGroupCmd) error
	mu          sync.Mutex
	rebalances  []*pb.RebalanceGroupCmd
}

func (g *groupsAdmin) GetConsensusParams(context.Context, *emptypb.Empty) (*pb.ConsensusParamsState, error) {
	return g.state, nil
}
func (g *groupsAdmin) GetNodeFeatures(context.Context, *emptypb.Empty) (*pb.NodeFeatures, error) {
	return g.book, nil
}
func (g *groupsAdmin) GetTrackState(context.Context, *emptypb.Empty) (*pb.TrackStateView, error) {
	return g.tracks, nil
}
func (g *groupsAdmin) GetTableRegistry(context.Context, *emptypb.Empty) (*pb.TableRegistrySnapshot, error) {
	if g.registry == nil {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, "table registry is disabled")
	}
	return g.registry, nil
}
func (g *groupsAdmin) RebalanceGroup(_ context.Context, req *pb.RebalanceGroupCmd) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	g.mu.Lock()
	g.rebalances = append(g.rebalances, req)
	g.mu.Unlock()
	if g.rebalanceFn != nil {
		if err := g.rebalanceFn(req); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}

func serveGroupsAdmin(t *testing.T, g *groupsAdmin) string {
	t.Helper()
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s := grpc.NewServer()
	pb.RegisterConsensusAdminServer(s, g)
	pb.RegisterTableRegistryServer(s, g)
	go func() { _ = s.Serve(ln) }()
	t.Cleanup(s.Stop)
	return ln.Addr().String()
}

// groupsFixture is a leader with stage3 committed (domains node:n0 … node:n3,
// exclude_quarantined_hosts on), si_indexers 0 … 3, the pool verifier v1 and
// member entries member-0 … member-3 (member-2 replicate-only), indexer 3
// quarantined, and a registry holding the genesis table db.t of indexer 1,
// db0.old (Purged) and db0.x (Active, created at 0x150) of indexer 0, and the
// Legacy dbl.l.
func groupsFixture(t *testing.T) (*groupsAdmin, string) {
	t.Helper()
	t.Setenv(authorityPrivateKeyEnv, gateTestKey)
	var verifiers []*pb.VerifierEntry
	verifiers = append(verifiers, &pb.VerifierEntry{NodeId: "v1", Ed25519Pubkey: bytes.Repeat([]byte{1}, 32)})
	var si []*pb.SIIndexerEntry
	var domains []*pb.IndexerFailureDomain
	for host := uint64(0); host <= 3; host++ {
		h, n := host, strconv.FormatUint(host, 10)
		domain := "node:n" + n
		verifiers = append(verifiers, &pb.VerifierEntry{NodeId: "member-" + n, Ed25519Pubkey: bytes.Repeat([]byte{byte(10 + host)}, 32),
			HostIndexerId: &h, ReplicaSigner: "0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000a" + n, Weight: 1 + uint32(host%2),
			FailureDomain: domain, Verify: host != 2, Replicate: true, Counts: true, SharedRmt: true})
		si = append(si, &pb.SIIndexerEntry{IndexerId: host, ActivationBlock: 100 + host, Signer: "0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000b" + n,
			SnodeNodeId: "s" + n})
		domains = append(domains, &pb.IndexerFailureDomain{IndexerId: host, FailureDomain: domain})
	}
	stage3 := &pb.Stage3Params{GroupSize: 3, NetworkFillDefault: false, MinSafeCopies: 1, IndexerFailureDomains: domains, MaxLagPublications: 8, LagLow: 2,
		EvidenceTimeoutL2Blocks: 30, MaxUncleanedPartsPerPartition: 2000, MaxUncleanedPartsPerTable: 20000, ExcludeQuarantinedHosts: true,
		Purge: true, EvictionVoiding: true, OwnerAwareSelection: true}
	g := &groupsAdmin{
		state: &pb.ConsensusParamsState{ProtocolVersion: arbiter.ConsensusAdminProtocolVersion, NetworkId: "net-1", GenesisSnapshotId: "0xgenesis", Epoch: 7,
			Current: &pb.ConsensusMutableParams{AuthorityAddresses: []string{"0x9ef3a259d1d87c864431cab5ed5f6578ad5ad705"}, MaxWriters: 4,
				SiIndexers: si, Verifiers: verifiers, TracksEnabled: true, Stage3: stage3}},
		tracks: &pb.TrackStateView{TracksEnabled: true, Indexers: []*pb.IndexerTrackView{{IndexerId: 0}, {IndexerId: 1}, {IndexerId: 2}, {IndexerId: 3, Quarantined: true}}},
	}
	for _, v := range verifiers {
		g.book = appendBook(g.book, v.GetNodeId())
	}
	zero, one := uint64(0), uint64(1)
	at := func(block uint64, hash string) *pb.L2EventRef {
		return &pb.L2EventRef{BlockNumber: block, BlockHash: hash, TxHash: "0xtx"}
	}
	g.registry = &pb.TableRegistrySnapshot{Version: 12, Params: &pb.TableRegistryParams{SiIndexerId: 1}, Incarnations: []*pb.TableIncarnation{
		{Seq: 1, DatabaseId: "db", TableId: "t", Origin: pb.TableIncarnationOrigin_TABLE_INCARNATION_ORIGIN_GENESIS, Status: pb.TableIncarnationStatus_TABLE_INCARNATION_STATUS_ACTIVE, OwnerIndexerId: &one},
		{Seq: 2, DatabaseId: "dbl", TableId: "l", Origin: pb.TableIncarnationOrigin_TABLE_INCARNATION_ORIGIN_LEGACY, Status: pb.TableIncarnationStatus_TABLE_INCARNATION_STATUS_LEGACY, OwnerIndexerId: &one, Created: at(5, "0x5")},
		{Seq: 3, DatabaseId: "db0", TableId: "old", Origin: pb.TableIncarnationOrigin_TABLE_INCARNATION_ORIGIN_CHAIN, Status: pb.TableIncarnationStatus_TABLE_INCARNATION_STATUS_PURGED, OwnerIndexerId: &zero, Created: at(120, "0x120")},
		{Seq: 4, DatabaseId: "db0", TableId: "x", Origin: pb.TableIncarnationOrigin_TABLE_INCARNATION_ORIGIN_CHAIN, Status: pb.TableIncarnationStatus_TABLE_INCARNATION_STATUS_ACTIVE, OwnerIndexerId: &zero, Created: at(150, "0x150")},
	}}
	return g, serveGroupsAdmin(t, g)
}

func appendBook(book *pb.NodeFeatures, node string) *pb.NodeFeatures {
	if book == nil {
		book = &pb.NodeFeatures{}
	}
	book.Entries = append(book.Entries, &pb.NodeFeatureEntry{NodeId: node, RegisteredUnix: 1})
	return book
}

// previewOutput is group preview's document.
type previewOutput struct {
	Groups []struct {
		Owner       string   `json:"owner"`
		Database    string   `json:"database"`
		Salt        string   `json:"salt"`
		Members     []string `json:"members"`
		NetworkFill bool     `json:"network_fill"`
		Order       []struct {
			NodeID  string `json:"node_id"`
			Score   string `json:"score"`
			Chosen  bool   `json:"chosen"`
			Skipped string `json:"skipped"`
		} `json:"order"`
	} `json:"groups"`
}

// TestGroupPreviewMatchesTheFSMPlacement: the preview prints, in (owner,
// database) order, exactly fsm.PlaceGroup over the FSM's rules: the pool
// entry, the owner's own member and a quarantined host's member are no
// candidates, the salt is the genesis snapshot id for a genesis-origin
// database and else the lowest-seq physical incarnation's TableCreated hash
// (the Purged db0.old is skipped), and a Legacy database has no group.
func TestGroupPreviewMatchesTheFSMPlacement(t *testing.T) {
	_, addr := groupsFixture(t)
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if err := run(context.Background(), []string{"group", "preview", "--address", addr, "--data-address", addr}, &out); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var got previewOutput
	if err := json.Unmarshal(out.Bytes(), &got); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	candidate := func(host uint64, weight uint32, verify bool) fsm.PlacementCandidate {
		n := strconv.FormatUint(host, 10)
		return fsm.PlacementCandidate{NodeID: "member-" + n, HostIndexerID: host, FailureDomain: "node:n" + n, Weight: weight, Verify: verify}
	}
	wants := []struct {
		owner    uint64
		database string
		salt     string
		in       []fsm.PlacementCandidate
	}{
		{0, "db0", "0x150", []fsm.PlacementCandidate{candidate(1, 2, true), candidate(2, 1, false)}},
		{1, "db", "0xgenesis", []fsm.PlacementCandidate{candidate(0, 1, true), candidate(2, 1, false)}},
	}
	if len(got.Groups) != len(wants) {
		t.Fatalf("preview %s", out.String())
	}
	for i, w := range wants {
		owner := strconv.FormatUint(w.owner, 10)
		p, err := fsm.PlaceGroup(fsm.PlacementInput{NetworkID: "net-1", Owner: w.owner, OwnerFailureDomain: "node:n" + owner, Database: w.database,
			Salt: w.salt, GroupSize: 3, Candidates: w.in})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		g := got.Groups[i]
		var order []fsm.PlacementScore
		for _, s := range g.Order {
			order = append(order, fsm.PlacementScore{NodeID: s.NodeID, Score: s.Score, Chosen: s.Chosen, Skipped: s.Skipped})
		}
		if g.Owner != owner || g.Database != w.database || g.Salt != w.salt || !reflect.DeepEqual(g.Members, p.Members) ||
			g.NetworkFill != p.NetworkFill || !reflect.DeepEqual(order, p.Order) {
			t.Fatalf("preview group %d = %+v, want %+v of %s with salt %s", i, g, p, w.database, w.salt)
		}
	}
}

// TestGroupPreviewRefusesAnUnregisteredMemberEntry: a listed member entry the
// feature book does not hold could be evicted, so the preview refuses
// instead of guessing; before the activation it names the missing stage3.
func TestGroupPreviewRefusesAnUnregisteredMemberEntry(t *testing.T) {
	g, addr := groupsFixture(t)
	g.book.Entries = g.book.Entries[:3] // v1, member-0, member-1
	err := run(context.Background(), []string{"group", "preview", "--address", addr, "--data-address", addr}, &bytes.Buffer{})
	want := "group preview: member entry member-2 is not among the leader's non-evicted registrations; register it or delist it before previewing"
	if err == nil || err.Error() != want {
		t.Fatalf("preview = %v, want %q", err, want)
	}
	g.state.Current.Stage3 = nil
	if err := run(context.Background(), []string{"group", "preview", "--address", addr, "--data-address", addr}, &bytes.Buffer{}); err == nil || err.Error() != "group preview: stage3 is not set" {
		t.Fatalf("preview before the activation = %v", err)
	}
}

// TestGroupRebalanceSignsTheCanonicalCommand: the CLI sends the sorted lists
// and a token over their canonical form in the leader's context, and prints
// the committed command.
func TestGroupRebalanceSignsTheCanonicalCommand(t *testing.T) {
	g, addr := groupsFixture(t)
	var out bytes.Buffer
	args := []string{"group", "rebalance", "--address", addr, "--owner", "1", "--database", "db", "--expected-generation", "4",
		"--add", "member-3", "--add", "member-2", "--remove", "member-0", "--network-fill", "true"}
	if err := run(context.Background(), args, &out); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(g.rebalances) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("%d rebalances sent", len(g.rebalances))
	}
	req := g.rebalances[0]
	want := &pb.RebalanceGroupCmd{OwnerIndexerId: 1, DatabaseId: "db", ExpectedGeneration: 4, Add: []string{"member-2", "member-3"}, Remove: []string{"member-0"},
		NetworkFill: true, AuthorityJws: req.GetAuthorityJws()}
	if !proto.Equal(req, want) {
		t.Fatalf("request %v, want %v", req, want)
	}
	signer, err := authority.NewSignerFromHex(gateTestKey)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	validator := authority.Validator{AllowedAddresses: map[string]bool{strings.ToLower(signer.Address()): true}}
	ctx := authority.ConsensusContext{NetworkID: "net-1", GenesisSnapshotID: "0xgenesis", AuthorityEpoch: 7}
	if _, err := validator.VerifyRebalanceGroup(wire.RebalanceGroupFromRequest(req).Canonical(), req.GetAuthorityJws(), ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("token does not verify over the canonical command: %v", err)
	}
	var printed map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(out.Bytes(), &printed); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	wantOut := map[string]any{"owner": "1", "database": "db", "expected_generation": "4", "add": []any{"member-2", "member-3"},
		"remove": []any{"member-0"}, "network_fill": true, "outcome": "committed"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(printed, wantOut) {
		t.Fatalf("output %v, want %v", printed, wantOut)
	}
	// A refusal that may hide a commit names the read-back.
	g.rebalanceFn = func(*pb.RebalanceGroupCmd) error { return status.Error(codes.Unavailable, "leader lost") }
	if err := run(context.Background(), args, &bytes.Buffer{}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "run consensus groups against the current leader before retrying") {
		t.Fatalf("an unknown outcome = %v", err)
	}
	g.rebalanceFn = func(*pb.RebalanceGroupCmd) error {
		return status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, `rebalance group: expected_generation 4 differs from generation 5 of indexer 1 database "db"`)
	}
	if err := run(context.Background(), args, &bytes.Buffer{}); err == nil || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "commit outcome may be unknown") ||
		!strings.Contains(err.Error(), "expected_generation 4 differs") {
		t.Fatalf("an Apply refusal = %v", err)
	}
}

// TestGroupRebalanceFlagRefusals: the flag refusals, before any RPC.
func TestGroupRebalanceFlagRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	g, addr := groupsFixture(t)
	base := func(extra ...string) []string {
		return append([]string{"group", "rebalance", "--address", addr, "--owner", "1", "--database", "db", "--expected-generation", "1"}, extra...)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		args []string
		want string
	}{
		{[]string{"group", "rebalance", "--owner", "1", "--database", "db", "--expected-generation", "1", "--network-fill", "true"}, "--address is required"},
		{[]string{"group", "rebalance", "--address", addr, "--database", "db", "--expected-generation", "1", "--network-fill", "true"}, "--owner is required"},
		{[]string{"group", "rebalance", "--address", addr, "--owner", "1", "--expected-generation", "1", "--network-fill", "true"}, "--database is required"},
		{[]string{"group", "rebalance", "--address", addr, "--owner", "1", "--database", "db", "--network-fill", "true"}, "--expected-generation is required"},
		{base(), "--network-fill is required"},
		{base("--network-fill", "yes"), "--network-fill must be true or false"},
		{base("--network-fill", "true", "--add", "member-2", "--remove", "member-2"), "--add and --remove must name distinct nodes"},
		{base("--network-fill", "true", "--add", "member-2", "--add", "member-2"), "--add and --remove must name distinct nodes"},
		{[]string{"group", "rebalance", "--address", "not-an-address", "--owner", "1", "--database", "db", "--expected-generation", "1", "--network-fill", "true"},
			"--address must be a direct node host:port"},
	} {
		if err := run(context.Background(), tc.args, &bytes.Buffer{}); err == nil || err.Error() != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("%v = %v, want %q", tc.args, err, tc.want)
		}
	}
	t.Setenv(authorityPrivateKeyEnv, "")
	if err := run(context.Background(), base("--network-fill", "true"), &bytes.Buffer{}); err == nil || err.Error() != authorityPrivateKeyEnv+" is required" {
		t.Fatalf("without the key = %v", err)
	}
	t.Setenv(authorityPrivateKeyEnv, "zz")
	err := run(context.Background(), base("--network-fill", "true"), &bytes.Buffer{})
	if err == nil || err.Error() != authorityPrivateKeyEnv+" is invalid: expected a 32-byte secp256k1 private key in hex" || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "zz") {
		t.Fatalf("an invalid key = %v", err)
	}
	if len(g.rebalances) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a refused invocation reached the leader")
	}
}

// TestConsensusGroupsPrintsTheRegistryGroups: consensus groups prints the
// registry version and every group and checkpoint sequence in protojson with
// proto names.
func TestConsensusGroupsPrintsTheRegistryGroups(t *testing.T) {
	g, addr := groupsFixture(t)
	host := uint64(0)
	g.registry.Groups = []*pb.DatabaseGroup{{OwnerIndexerId: 1, DatabaseId: "db", Generation: 2, PlacementSalt: "0xgenesis", NetworkFill: true,
		Members:     []*pb.GroupMember{{NodeId: "member-0", JoinedGeneration: 1, MemberClass: pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_BOOTSTRAPPING, HostIndexerId: &host}},
		Leaving:     []*pb.LeavingMember{{NodeId: "member-3", RemovedGeneration: 2, ReleaseEntry: &pb.TrackFrontier{IndexerId: 1, SafeBlockSeq: 4}}},
		PastMembers: []string{"member-3"}}}
	g.registry.MemberCheckpointSeqs = []*pb.MemberCheckpointSeq{{NodeId: "member-0", OwnerIndexerId: 1, CheckpointSeq: 3, ReplicaSigner: "0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000a0"}}
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if err := run(context.Background(), []string{"consensus", "groups", "--data-address", addr}, &out); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var printed struct {
		RegistryVersion      string                       `json:"registry_version"`
		Groups               []map[string]json.RawMessage `json:"groups"`
		MemberCheckpointSeqs []map[string]json.RawMessage `json:"member_checkpoint_seqs"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(out.Bytes(), &printed); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%v in %s", err, out.String())
	}
	if printed.RegistryVersion != "12" || len(printed.Groups) != 1 || len(printed.MemberCheckpointSeqs) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("output %s", out.String())
	}
	for key, want := range map[string]any{"owner_indexer_id": "1", "database_id": "db", "generation": "2", "placement_salt": "0xgenesis", "past_members": []any{"member-3"}} {
		var got any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(printed.Groups[0][key], &got); err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("groups[0].%s = %v (%v), want %v", key, got, err, want)
		}
	}
	var members []map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(printed.Groups[0]["members"], &members); err != nil || members[0]["host_indexer_id"] != "0" || members[0]["member_class"] != "MEMBER_CLASS_BOOTSTRAPPING" {
		t.Fatalf("members %v (%v)", members, err)
	}
	var seq any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(printed.MemberCheckpointSeqs[0]["checkpoint_seq"], &seq); err != nil || seq != "3" {
		t.Fatalf("checkpoint_seq = %v (%v)", seq, err)
	}
	g.registry = nil
	if err := run(context.Background(), []string{"consensus", "groups", "--data-address", addr}, &bytes.Buffer{}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "table registry is disabled") {
		t.Fatalf("a disabled registry = %v", err)
	}
	if err := run(context.Background(), []string{"consensus", "groups"}, &bytes.Buffer{}); err == nil || err.Error() != "--data-address is required" {
		t.Fatalf("without --data-address = %v", err)
	}
}
```

```go
	"google.golang.org/grpc/credentials/insecure"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/emptypb"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// Database group administration (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §6, plan S3-E3
// contract §50): consensus groups reads the registry's groups, group preview
// re-derives what placement would choose with the FSM's own placement
// functions, and group rebalance signs an authority RebalanceGroup.

// nodeFlags collects a repeated node id flag in command-line order.
type nodeFlags []string

func (n *nodeFlags) String() string { return strings.Join(*n, ",") }
func (n *nodeFlags) Set(value string) error {
	*n = append(*n, strings.TrimSpace(value))
	return nil
}

// parseGroupFlags parses args without writing to the terminal; --help prints
// the usage and the flag defaults to out.
func parseGroupFlags(fs *flag.FlagSet, args []string, out io.Writer) (help bool, err error) {
	fs.SetOutput(io.Discard)
	if err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, flag.ErrHelp) {
			if _, err := fmt.Fprintln(out, usage); err != nil {
				return true, err
			}
			fs.SetOutput(out)
			fs.PrintDefaults()
			return true, nil
		}
		return false, err
	}
	if fs.NArg() != 0 {
		return false, errors.New("unexpected positional arguments")
	}
	return false, nil
}

// requireFlags refuses the first flag of names that was not given.
func requireFlags(fs *flag.FlagSet, names ...string) error {
	present := map[string]bool{}
	fs.Visit(func(f *flag.Flag) { present[f.Name] = true })
	for _, name := range names {
		if !present[name] {
			return fmt.Errorf("--%s is required", name)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// checkHostPort refuses an endpoint that is not host:port.
func checkHostPort(flagName, address string) error {
	if host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(address); err != nil || host == "" || port == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("--%s must be a direct node host:port", flagName)
	}
	return nil
}

// dialTableRegistry opens a TableRegistry client on exactly address.
func dialTableRegistry(address string) (pb.TableRegistryClient, func(), error) {
	conn, err := grpc.NewClient("passthrough:///"+address, grpc.WithTransportCredentials(insecure.NewCredentials()))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	return pb.NewTableRegistryClient(conn), func() { _ = conn.Close() }, nil
}

// runConsensusGroups prints the registry's groups and member checkpoint
// sequences, read on the data-plane listener (plan S3-E1 K64).
func runConsensusGroups(ctx context.Context, args []string, out io.Writer) error {
	fs := flag.NewFlagSet("consensus groups", flag.ContinueOnError)
	dataAddress := fs.String("data-address", "", "the Arbiter's data-plane gRPC host:port (grpc_listen), which serves TableRegistry")
	timeout := fs.Duration("timeout", 10*time.Second, "timeout for the entire operation")
	if help, err := parseGroupFlags(fs, args, out); help || err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requireFlags(fs, "data-address"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := checkHostPort("data-address", *dataAddress); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if *timeout <= 0 {
		return errors.New("--timeout must be positive")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, *timeout)
	defer cancel()
	client, closeFn, err := dialTableRegistry(*dataAddress)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("connect to %s: %w", *dataAddress, err)
	}
	defer closeFn()
	snap, err := client.GetTableRegistry(ctx, &emptypb.Empty{})
	if err != nil {
		return rpcError("read table registry", *dataAddress, err)
	}
	result := struct {
		RegistryVersion      string            `json:"registry_version"`
		Groups               []json.RawMessage `json:"groups"`
		MemberCheckpointSeqs []json.RawMessage `json:"member_checkpoint_seqs"`
	}{RegistryVersion: strconv.FormatUint(snap.GetVersion(), 10), Groups: []json.RawMessage{}, MemberCheckpointSeqs: []json.RawMessage{}}
	for _, g := range snap.GetGroups() {
		b, err := jsonOptions.Marshal(g)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("encode result: %w", err)
		}
		result.Groups = append(result.Groups, b)
	}
	for _, s := range snap.GetMemberCheckpointSeqs() {
		b, err := jsonOptions.Marshal(s)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("encode result: %w", err)
		}
		result.MemberCheckpointSeqs = append(result.MemberCheckpointSeqs, b)
	}
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(out)
	encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
	return encoder.Encode(result)
}

// runGroup dispatches group preview and group rebalance.
func runGroup(ctx context.Context, args []string, out io.Writer) error {
	if len(args) == 0 {
		return errors.New(usage)
	}
	switch args[0] {
	case "preview":
		return runGroupPreview(ctx, args[1:], out)
	case "rebalance":
		return runGroupRebalance(ctx, args[1:], out)
	}
	return errors.New(usage)
}

var incarnationStatusFromPB = map[pb.TableIncarnationStatus]fsm.TableIncarnationStatus{
	pb.TableIncarnationStatus_TABLE_INCARNATION_STATUS_LEGACY:   fsm.TableStatusLegacy,
	pb.TableIncarnationStatus_TABLE_INCARNATION_STATUS_PENDING:  fsm.TableStatusPending,
	pb.TableIncarnationStatus_TABLE_INCARNATION_STATUS_REFUSED:  fsm.TableStatusRefused,
	pb.TableIncarnationStatus_TABLE_INCARNATION_STATUS_ACTIVE:   fsm.TableStatusActive,
	pb.TableIncarnationStatus_TABLE_INCARNATION_STATUS_RETIRING: fsm.TableStatusRetiring,
	pb.TableIncarnationStatus_TABLE_INCARNATION_STATUS_PURGING:  fsm.TableStatusPurging,
	pb.TableIncarnationStatus_TABLE_INCARNATION_STATUS_PURGED:   fsm.TableStatusPurged,
}

var incarnationOriginFromPB = map[pb.TableIncarnationOrigin]fsm.TableOrigin{
	pb.TableIncarnationOrigin_TABLE_INCARNATION_ORIGIN_GENESIS: fsm.TableOriginGenesis,
	pb.TableIncarnationOrigin_TABLE_INCARNATION_ORIGIN_LEGACY:  fsm.TableOriginLegacy,
	pb.TableIncarnationOrigin_TABLE_INCARNATION_ORIGIN_CHAIN:   fsm.TableOriginChain,
}

// incarnationsFromPB is what the placement functions read of the registry's
// incarnations: seq, keys, origin, status, owner and the TableCreated event.
func incarnationsFromPB(snap *pb.TableRegistrySnapshot) []*fsm.TableIncarnation {
	out := make([]*fsm.TableIncarnation, 0, len(snap.GetIncarnations()))
	for _, m := range snap.GetIncarnations() {
		inc := &fsm.TableIncarnation{Seq: m.GetSeq(), DatabaseID: m.GetDatabaseId(), TableID: m.GetTableId(),
			Origin: incarnationOriginFromPB[m.GetOrigin()], Status: incarnationStatusFromPB[m.GetStatus()]}
		if m.OwnerIndexerId != nil {
			owner := m.GetOwnerIndexerId()
			inc.OwnerIndexerID = &owner
		}
		if created := m.GetCreated(); created != nil {
			inc.Created = &arbiter.L2EventRef{BlockNumber: created.GetBlockNumber(), BlockHash: created.GetBlockHash(), LogIndex: created.GetLogIndex(), TxHash: created.GetTxHash()}
		}
		out = append(out, inc)
	}
	return out
}

// runGroupPreview prints, per (owner, database) holding a physical
// incarnation, the placement the FSM would make now under the committed
// parameters: the same candidate, salt and placement functions Apply calls.
// It refuses while a listed member entry is not among the leader's
// non-evicted registrations, because the FSM counts an unregistered entry as
// non-evicted and the feature book cannot tell an unregistered entry from an
// evicted one; once every member entry is registered the preview is exact.
func runGroupPreview(ctx context.Context, args []string, out io.Writer) error {
	fs := flag.NewFlagSet("group preview", flag.ContinueOnError)
	address := fs.String("address", "", "leader gRPC host:port (ConsensusAdmin)")
	dataAddress := fs.String("data-address", "", "the leader's data-plane gRPC host:port (TableRegistry)")
	timeout := fs.Duration("timeout", 10*time.Second, "timeout for the entire operation")
	if help, err := parseGroupFlags(fs, args, out); help || err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requireFlags(fs, "address", "data-address"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := checkHostPort("address", *address); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := checkHostPort("data-address", *dataAddress); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if *timeout <= 0 {
		return errors.New("--timeout must be positive")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, *timeout)
	defer cancel()
	admin, closeAdmin, err := dialAdmin(*address)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("connect to %s: %w", *address, err)
	}
	defer closeAdmin()
	registry, closeRegistry, err := dialTableRegistry(*dataAddress)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("connect to %s: %w", *dataAddress, err)
	}
	defer closeRegistry()
	state, err := admin.GetConsensusParams(ctx, &emptypb.Empty{})
	if err != nil {
		return rpcError("read consensus parameters", *address, err)
	}
	stage3 := wire.Stage3ParamsFromPB(state.GetCurrent().GetStage3())
	if stage3 == nil {
		return errors.New("group preview: stage3 is not set")
	}
	book, err := admin.GetNodeFeatures(ctx, &emptypb.Empty{})
	if err != nil {
		return rpcError("read node features", *address, err)
	}
	tracks, err := admin.GetTrackState(ctx, &emptypb.Empty{})
	if err != nil {
		return rpcError("read track state", *address, err)
	}
	snap, err := registry.GetTableRegistry(ctx, &emptypb.Empty{})
	if err != nil {
		return rpcError("read table registry", *dataAddress, err)
	}
	verifiers := wire.VerifierEntriesFromPB(state.GetCurrent().GetVerifiers())
	siIndexers := wire.SIIndexerEntriesFromPB(state.GetCurrent().GetSiIndexers())
	registered := map[string]bool{}
	for _, e := range book.GetEntries() {
		registered[e.GetNodeId()] = true
	}
	for _, v := range verifiers {
		if v.HostIndexerID != nil && !registered[v.NodeID] {
			return fmt.Errorf("group preview: member entry %s is not among the leader's non-evicted registrations; register it or delist it before previewing", v.NodeID)
		}
	}
	quarantined := map[uint64]bool{}
	for _, ix := range tracks.GetIndexers() {
		quarantined[ix.GetIndexerId()] = ix.GetQuarantined()
	}
	incarnations := incarnationsFromPB(snap)
	founding := snap.GetParams().GetSiIndexerId()
	type previewScore struct {
		NodeID  string `json:"node_id"`
		Score   string `json:"score"`
		Chosen  bool   `json:"chosen"`
		Skipped string `json:"skipped"`
	}
	type previewGroup struct {
		Owner       string         `json:"owner"`
		Database    string         `json:"database"`
		Salt        string         `json:"salt"`
		Members     []string       `json:"members"`
		NetworkFill bool           `json:"network_fill"`
		Order       []previewScore `json:"order"`
	}
	result := struct {
		Groups []previewGroup `json:"groups"`
	}{Groups: []previewGroup{}}
	for _, target := range fsm.PlacementTargetsFrom(incarnations, founding) {
		salt, err := fsm.PlacementSaltFrom(incarnations, founding, target.Owner, target.Database, state.GetGenesisSnapshotId(), nil)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("group preview: %w", err)
		}
		ownerDomain, _ := stage3.FailureDomain(target.Owner)
		candidates := fsm.PlacementCandidatesFrom(verifiers, siIndexers, target.Owner, stage3.ExcludeQuarantinedHosts,
			func(string) bool { return false }, func(id uint64) bool { return quarantined[id] })
		p, err := fsm.PlaceGroup(fsm.PlacementInput{NetworkID: state.GetNetworkId(), Owner: target.Owner, OwnerFailureDomain: ownerDomain,
			Database: target.Database, Salt: salt, GroupSize: stage3.GroupSize, NetworkFillDefault: stage3.NetworkFillDefault, Candidates: candidates})
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("group preview: indexer %d database %q: %w", target.Owner, target.Database, err)
		}
		g := previewGroup{Owner: strconv.FormatUint(target.Owner, 10), Database: target.Database, Salt: salt,
			Members: append([]string{}, p.Members...), NetworkFill: p.NetworkFill, Order: []previewScore{}}
		for _, s := range p.Order {
			g.Order = append(g.Order, previewScore{NodeID: s.NodeID, Score: s.Score, Chosen: s.Chosen, Skipped: s.Skipped})
		}
		result.Groups = append(result.Groups, g)
	}
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(out)
	encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
	return encoder.Encode(result)
}

// runGroupRebalance signs and submits one RebalanceGroup.
func runGroupRebalance(ctx context.Context, args []string, out io.Writer) error {
	fs := flag.NewFlagSet("group rebalance", flag.ContinueOnError)
	address := fs.String("address", "", "leader gRPC host:port")
	timeout := fs.Duration("timeout", 10*time.Second, "timeout for the entire operation")
	owner := fs.Uint64("owner", 0, "required owner SI indexer id")
	database := fs.String("database", "", "required database id")
	expected := fs.Uint64("expected-generation", 0, "required: the group's current generation (consensus groups prints it)")
	fill := fs.String("network-fill", "", "required: true or false, the group's network_fill after the command")
	var add, remove nodeFlags
	fs.Var(&add, "add", "a member entry the command adds; repeat once per node")
	fs.Var(&remove, "remove", "a member the command removes; repeat once per node")
	if help, err := parseGroupFlags(fs, args, out); help || err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requireFlags(fs, "address", "owner", "database", "expected-generation", "network-fill"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := checkHostPort("address", *address); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if *fill != "true" && *fill != "false" {
		return errors.New("--network-fill must be true or false")
	}
	all := append(slices.Clone(add), remove...)
	slices.Sort(all)
	if len(slices.Compact(slices.Clone(all))) != len(all) || slices.Contains(all, "") {
		return errors.New("--add and --remove must name distinct nodes")
	}
	if *timeout <= 0 {
		return errors.New("--timeout must be positive")
	}
	keyHex := os.Getenv(authorityPrivateKeyEnv)
	if keyHex == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", authorityPrivateKeyEnv)
	}
	signer, err := authority.NewSignerFromHex(keyHex)
	if err != nil {
		// Do not copy key material or parser fragments into operator logs.
		return fmt.Errorf("%s is invalid: expected a 32-byte secp256k1 private key in hex", authorityPrivateKeyEnv)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, *timeout)
	defer cancel()
	client, closeFn, err := dialAdmin(*address)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("connect to %s: %w", *address, err)
	}
	defer closeFn()
	state, err := client.GetConsensusParams(ctx, &emptypb.Empty{})
	if err != nil {
		return rpcError("read consensus parameters", *address, err)
	}
	if state.GetProtocolVersion() != arbiter.ConsensusAdminProtocolVersion {
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported consensus admin protocol %d (this CLI supports %d)", state.GetProtocolVersion(), arbiter.ConsensusAdminProtocolVersion)
	}
	consensus := authority.ConsensusContext{NetworkID: state.GetNetworkId(), GenesisSnapshotID: state.GetGenesisSnapshotId(), AuthorityEpoch: state.GetEpoch()}
	// The canonical lists are what is signed and what the server's shape
	// check requires: sorted, unique, nil when empty.
	canonical := wire.RebalanceGroup{OwnerIndexerID: *owner, DatabaseID: *database, ExpectedGeneration: *expected, Add: add, Remove: remove,
		NetworkFill: *fill == "true"}.Canonical()
	token, err := signer.SignRebalanceGroupWithContext(canonical, consensus)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("sign group rebalance: %w", err)
	}
	request := wire.RebalanceGroupToRequest(wire.RebalanceGroup{OwnerIndexerID: canonical.OwnerIndexerID, DatabaseID: canonical.DatabaseID,
		ExpectedGeneration: canonical.ExpectedGeneration, Add: canonical.Add, Remove: canonical.Remove, NetworkFill: canonical.NetworkFill, AuthorityJWS: token})
	if _, err := client.RebalanceGroup(ctx, request); err != nil {
		return groupRPCError("rebalance group", *address, err)
	}
	result := struct {
		Owner              string   `json:"owner"`
		Database           string   `json:"database"`
		ExpectedGeneration string   `json:"expected_generation"`
		Add                []string `json:"add"`
		Remove             []string `json:"remove"`
		NetworkFill        bool     `json:"network_fill"`
		Outcome            string   `json:"outcome"`
	}{strconv.FormatUint(canonical.OwnerIndexerID, 10), canonical.DatabaseID, strconv.FormatUint(canonical.ExpectedGeneration, 10),
		append([]string{}, canonical.Add...), append([]string{}, canonical.Remove...), canonical.NetworkFill, "committed"}
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(out)
	encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
	return encoder.Encode(result)
}

// groupRPCError maps a failed RebalanceGroup exactly as indexerRPCError maps
// a failed quarantine: an error that can hide a commit is an unknown outcome,
// read back with consensus groups before any retry (a retry at the same
// expected generation is refused once the first one committed).
func groupRPCError(operation, address string, err error) error {
	wrapped := rpcError(operation, address, err)
	if _, ok := leaderHint(err); ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w; commit outcome may be unknown: run consensus groups against the current leader before retrying", wrapped)
	}
	switch status.Code(err) {
	case codes.DeadlineExceeded, codes.Canceled, codes.Unavailable, codes.Unknown, codes.Internal:
		return fmt.Errorf("%w; commit outcome may be unknown: run consensus groups against the current leader before retrying", wrapped)
	default:
		return wrapped
	}
}
```

```go
package metrics

import (

// groupSnapshot is a metrics source with group statistics.
type groupSnapshot struct {
	snapshot fsm.MetricsSnapshot
	groups   []fsm.GroupOwnerStats
}

func (s groupSnapshot) MetricsSnapshot() fsm.MetricsSnapshot { return s.snapshot }
func (s groupSnapshot) GroupStats() []fsm.GroupOwnerStats    { return s.groups }

// TestGroupMetricsExportEveryClassIncludingZeros: plan S3-E3 contract §50.
// One arbiter_database_groups series per owner and one arbiter_group_members
// series per owner and class, every class of fsm.MemberClasses, zeros
// included.
func TestGroupMetricsExportEveryClassIncludingZeros(t *testing.T) {
	m := New(groupSnapshot{groups: []fsm.GroupOwnerStats{
		{Owner: 0, Groups: 2, Members: map[fsm.MemberClass]int{fsm.MemberBootstrapping: 5, fsm.MemberLeaving: 1}},
		{Owner: 1, Groups: 0, Members: map[fsm.MemberClass]int{}},
	}})
	want := `
# HELP arbiter_database_groups Placed database groups of one SI indexer in this replica's FSM. Only after the stage-3 activation.
# TYPE arbiter_database_groups gauge
arbiter_database_groups{owner="0"} 2
arbiter_database_groups{owner="1"} 0
# HELP arbiter_group_members Group member records of one SI indexer's groups by class, Leaving records included. Only after the stage-3 activation.
# TYPE arbiter_group_members gauge
arbiter_group_members{class="behind",owner="0"} 0
arbiter_group_members{class="behind",owner="1"} 0
arbiter_group_members{class="bootstrapping",owner="0"} 5
arbiter_group_members{class="bootstrapping",owner="1"} 0
arbiter_group_members{class="caught_up",owner="0"} 0
arbiter_group_members{class="caught_up",owner="1"} 0
arbiter_group_members{class="lagging",owner="0"} 0
arbiter_group_members{class="lagging",owner="1"} 0
arbiter_group_members{class="leaving",owner="0"} 1
arbiter_group_members{class="leaving",owner="1"} 0
`
	if err := testutil.GatherAndCompare(m.registry, strings.NewReader(want), "arbiter_database_groups", "arbiter_group_members"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

// TestGroupMetricsAreAbsentBeforeStage3: no series while GroupStats is empty
// (before the stage-3 activation) or the source has no group statistics.
func TestGroupMetricsAreAbsentBeforeStage3(t *testing.T) {
	for _, source := range []snapshotReader{groupSnapshot{}, laneSnapshot{fsm.MetricsSnapshot{}}} {
		m := New(source)
		for _, name := range []string{"arbiter_database_groups", "arbiter_group_members"} {
			if n, err := testutil.GatherAndCount(m.registry, name); err != nil || n != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("%s: %d series, %v", name, n, err)
			}
		}
	}
}
```

Notes:
- **Switch off is Plan S3-E2's branch.** `currentGroupSealLocked` answers `nil` while `placement` is off, so admission's key is `""` for every statement and the `group_switch` arm never fires; `prepareStatementSealLocked` adds the key only under `placementOnLocked()`; the cutover pointer and every new field are `omitempty`; `pendingTableSetChangesBySealKeyLocked` keys every change on `SealKey{Owner: owner}`, which sorts exactly as the owner ids did; `orderByOwner` is now the wrapper that maps each owner to that key, and `TestOrderBySealKeyGroupsByOwnerAndKey` compares the two on 200 random windows. Plan S3-E2's frozen v21 containers (`stage3_v21_plain.snapshot`, `stage3_v21_interned.snapshot`, captured with every switch off) and every older golden therefore stay byte-identical; Step 17 re-runs them.
- **One key per open block, sealed first (C10).** Admission computes the new statement's key after every existing check and before the spent-id insert; an owner switch (`owner_switch`) or, for the same owner, a key that differs from `OpenBlock.GroupKey` (`group_switch`) prepares the seal there and commits it after the insert, as today. The first statement of the next open block records the key, the members and the fill flag. Equal keys mean equal members and fill, so databases whose groups hash alike keep sharing blocks (`TestDatabasesWithEqualKeysShareABlock`). With placement on and no group for the live incarnation's database, admission answers `Rejected` before any mutation; Task 71's restore rule (`database %q of indexer %d has a physical incarnation and no group`) makes that unreachable.
- **The cutover.** The update that turns `placement` on prepares the seal of a non-empty open block while the switch is still off, so the cutover block carries no key; it commits that seal right after `f.st.Params = next`, then records `PlacementCutoverBlock = len(Blocks)`, which is also the `BlockSeq` that Task 64's `recordStage3SwitchesLocked` records for the switch later in the same Apply. Task 71's `installPlacementBackfillLocked`, in the `placement` case of `onStage3SwitchOnLocked` that `recordStage3SwitchesLocked` calls, installs the planned groups after both, as its comment (`Plan S3-E3 Task 72 commits the cutover seal first`) expects; that hook needs no edit. An empty open block seals nothing and records the tip.
- **Key changes by update and by command.** From the switch on, an update under whose `next.Verifiers` the key of any database of the open block's statements differs from `OpenBlock.GroupKey` (a member's `verify` flipped, a ready member delisted or listed again) seals first with `key_change`; an update that leaves the open block's key alone seals nothing (`TestParamsUpdateFlippingVerifySealsFirst`). The seal is prepared after every refusal of the update, Task 71's backfill and floor refusals included, and before its first mutation; a seal that cannot be prepared refuses the update with state unchanged (`TestKeyChangeSealRefusesWithStateUnchangedWhenItCannotBePrepared`, which, like `TestRefusedOwnerSwitchSealsNothing`, synthesizes the only failing case, a corrupted open block). `EvictNode` reads no key, so it never seals (K73, `TestGroupKeyIgnoresEvictionAndNodeStatus`). `RebalanceGroup` keeps Task 71's `prepareGroupSealLocked` and commits with `key_change` before it raises the generation, so the sealed block records the group as it was; Task 73's `MemberReady` will do the same.
- **What a sealed block records.** `commitSealLocked` copies the open block's key, members and fill into the `BlockVerification` and sets `GroupDatabases` to the block's distinct statement databases (the `<database>` of each target id; `AddTable` refuses a dotted id, so it is the incarnation's `DatabaseID`) with each group's generation at the commit (S3-E1 K62); a transition block records the databases of its changes. Restore checks the header key against the record, the key against the recorded members and fill, the list's order, and that every retained statement and every changed table belongs to a recorded database; it does not compare the recorded generations with the durable counter, which later rebalances legitimately raise.
- **Transitions per key.** `pendingTableSetChangesBySealKeyLocked` partitions the committed changes by (owner, the current key of the change's database's group) and accumulates each key's `GroupSeal`; `plannedTrackTransitionLocked` walks the keys in (owner, key) order with today's rules, so a track still holds at most one unpublished transition block whatever its key, and a second key of the same owner waits for the first one's publication with today's reason (`TestOneUnpublishedTransitionPerTrackAcrossKeys`). A change whose database has no group while placement is on (unreachable after Task 71's restore rule) makes its key unsealable with `table-set transition of indexer %d: database %q has no group`, through the new `tableSetChanges.refusal`.
- **Readiness before Task 73.** Contract §51's key hashes the members with `ReadyGeneration != 0`, but Task 71 left `GroupMember` with only `NodeID`, `JoinedGeneration` and `Class` (it defers the readiness fields to Task 73). This task therefore adds `ReadyGeneration` with contract §50's tag, and nothing else; Task 73's `MemberReady` sets it and adds `ReadySignature` and `ReadyEpoch` (recorded for the consistency pass: Task 73 must not add `ReadyGeneration` again). No member is ready until `MemberReady`, so every key in this task's Apply paths is `GroupKey([], fill)`. The tests reach a ready member with `readyGK`: it restores the FSM from its own plain v21 container with that member's `ready_generation`, `ready_signature` and `ready_epoch` set as Task 73's `MemberReady` writes them, the signature made with the member's listed ed25519 key (`stage3MemberKey`) over the `MemberReadyBody` in the FSM's message context. The snapshot decoder ignores the two keys this task does not declare, and once Task 73 declares them its restore re-verification accepts the same fixtures. `generationGK` raises one group and its durable counter to generation 2 the same way, as a `RebalanceGroup` that changed nothing else would.
- **The grouping window.** `TableSealKey` runs under the read lock, never builds the live index (it reads `liveReadOnly`, like `TableOwner`), answers `ok=false` exactly when `TableOwner` does, and computes the key from the committed group and listing. `orderBySealKey` is `orderByOwner`'s algorithm on the whole key, lane rule unchanged.
- **The registry view.** `TableRegistryView` fills `GroupView.Key` when it is read, under the same lock as Task 71's group views; the view carries no ready verify members (D33), while `GetBlockVerification` serves the block's recorded `group_members` (field 18), which contract §51 names. A served key changes only with a member's `verifiers` entry (Task 71's registry-version rule bumps that update once) or with a group change (Task 71's `groupsChangedLocked`, Task 73's readiness); `TestRegistryViewServesEachGroupsCurrentKey` pins the first.
- **The seal counter is node-local.** `sealReasons` sits beside `registryWake` and Plan S3-A's `stateSize`: Apply increments it on every replica, nothing in Apply reads it, it is never snapshotted and a restore does not reset it, so it cannot change a digest. It is the one metric updated in Raft apply, which `docs/specs/issue-31-metrics.md` otherwise rules out; Step 24 records the exception there and in the README. The collector is registered only for a source that implements `BlockSealReasons` (`*fsm.FSM`), like Plan S3-E2 Task 67's encoding collector, so the metrics fakes export no new series.
- **Earlier tests.** A Task 71 test that asserts a block layout which the seal key now splits (statements of two databases whose groups differ in `network_fill`, sealed as one block) or a `GroupView.Key` of `""` is the only expected casualty of this task: change that assertion to the split layout or the served key, and name the test in the commit message. Any other failing test of an earlier task is a defect of this task: stop and find it.

- [ ] **Step 2: Recompute the frozen group-key digests outside Go**

Create `$HOME/.cache/s3e3/goldens.py` (contract §49's throwaway script; if Task 71 left one, replace it: this one recomputes Task 71's placement vectors too, so nothing is lost; it is never committed):

```python
# Recomputes the frozen digests of plan S3-E3 contract §50 (placement) and
# §51 (group key, header group_key) outside Go: replay.CanonicalDigest is
# sha256(b"housegate-replay-mvp-v0:" + domain + b"\x00" + json), json being
# encoding/json's compact form. Standard library only; run with python3 -I.
# Throwaway: never committed.
import hashlib
import json
import sys

PROFILE = b"housegate-replay-mvp-v0:"
failed = False


def digest(domain, raw):
    return "0x" + hashlib.sha256(PROFILE + domain.encode() + b"\x00" + raw.encode()).hexdigest()


def compact(obj):
    return json.dumps(obj, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True)


def check(name, got, want):
    global failed
    status = "ok" if got == want else "MISMATCH"
    if got != want:
        failed = True
    print(f"{status} {name} {got}")


# The recomputation first reproduces two digests l3_track_golden_test.go froze.
```

```go
import (

// A database group's key (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §7.1) enters the track of
// every block sealed after the placement cutover as track.group_key, after
// indexer_id and before anything a later field adds, and that header's chain
// hash is anchored on L2. GroupKey's preimage, its domain and the key's
// position and JSON tag in the header therefore join the frozen L3 commitment
// preimages here, in a file of their own: l3_track_golden_test.go is never
// edited, and a header whose group key is empty must keep hashing to its
// digests. The values were recomputed outside Go (python3 -I, standard
// library only) when this file was written. If a test here fails, revert
// whatever changed the encoding; never regenerate these.
const (
	goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill   = "0x8fb5ec393f832df4189e09686a36bad26bee385bb58d35d41fd2051e87470cf1"
	goldenGroupKeyNoMembersNoFill = "0x3a68f2111a77a1236c362aa10a84745386e0305a922fb870ce1c82b42a40cf2e"
	goldenGroupKeyBCFill          = "0x7cafb3ca53aac2ccec03f3358f69857cab98263df5fb4e4395ddc3b9c5107b7a"
	goldenGroupKeyBCNoFill        = "0x0814ff32a3f381d601e64c58e32e6ee5b153db31adf4fbd21129de118d7dc6ed"

	goldenGroupKeyHeaderChainHash           = "0x38e143f7c938f259f10f202dbfa782a20ba9cdd98e2306dd0832b2f2b71eb820"
	goldenGroupKeyTransitionHeaderChainHash = "0xa39e76507084fa79b0d93a12c81243c5e638519ff5e26f24b560859c7d9e8ea2"

// TestGroupKeyGoldenVectorsAreFrozen pins GroupKey's domain, its preimage's
// JSON form and five keys: no member with and without fill (a nil and an
// empty list alike), two members with and without fill, and another pair.
func TestGroupKeyGoldenVectorsAreFrozen(t *testing.T) {
	if GroupKeyDomain != "arbiter-group-key-v1" {
		t.Fatalf("GroupKeyDomain = %q", GroupKeyDomain)
	}
	seen := map[string]string{}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name     string
		members  []string
		fill     bool
		preimage string
		key      string
	}{
		{"no members, fill", nil, true, `{"members":[],"network_fill":true}`, goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill},
		{"no members, no fill", []string{}, false, `{"members":[],"network_fill":false}`, goldenGroupKeyNoMembersNoFill},
		{"member-b and member-c, fill", []string{"member-b", "member-c"}, true, `{"members":["member-b","member-c"],"network_fill":true}`, goldenGroupKeyBCFill},
		{"member-b and member-c, no fill", []string{"member-b", "member-c"}, false, `{"members":["member-b","member-c"],"network_fill":false}`, goldenGroupKeyBCNoFill},
		{"member-a and member-c, fill", []string{"member-a", "member-c"}, true, `{"members":["member-a","member-c"],"network_fill":true}`, goldenGroupKeyACFill},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			members := tc.members
			if members == nil {
				members = []string{}
			}
			assertMarshalsTo(t, tc.name, groupKeyPreimage{Members: members, NetworkFill: tc.fill}, json.RawMessage(tc.preimage))
			got, err := GroupKey(tc.members, tc.fill)
			if err != nil || got != tc.key {
				t.Fatalf("GroupKey(%q, %v) = %s (%v), want %s", tc.members, tc.fill, got, err, tc.key)
			}
			if other, dup := seen[got]; dup {
				t.Fatalf("%s and %s hash alike", tc.name, other)
			}
			seen[got] = tc.name
		})
	}
	if empty, err := GroupKey([]string{}, true); err != nil || empty != goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill {
		t.Fatalf("an empty list = %s (%v), want the nil list's %s", empty, err, goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill)
	}
}

// TestL3GroupKeyHeaderPreimagesAreFrozen pins the statement and the
// transition header of indexer 1's track with goldenGroupKeyBCFill: the key
// sits inside track after indexer_id, the back-filled anchor stays out of the
// preimage, a key changes the chain hash, and an empty key leaves both
// headers hashing exactly as l3_track_golden_test.go froze them.
func TestL3GroupKeyHeaderPreimagesAreFrozen(t *testing.T) {
	statement := goldenTrackHeader(1)
	statement.Track = &L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 1, GroupKey: goldenGroupKeyBCFill}
	transition := goldenTransitionHeader()
	transition.Track = &L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 1, GroupKey: goldenGroupKeyBCFill}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, preimage, digest, keyless string
		header                          L3BlockHeader
	}{
		{"statement block", goldenGroupKeyHeaderJSON, goldenGroupKeyHeaderChainHash, goldenTrack1HeaderChainHash, statement},
		{"transition block", goldenGroupKeyTransitionHeaderJSON, goldenGroupKeyTransitionHeaderChainHash, goldenTrack1TransitionHeaderChainHash, transition},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			assertMarshalsTo(t, tc.name, tc.header, json.RawMessage(tc.preimage))
			if got, err := tc.header.ChainHash(); err != nil || got != tc.digest {
				t.Fatalf("ChainHash = %s (%v), want %s", got, err, tc.digest)
			}
			anchored := tc.header
			anchored.L2AnchorRef = &arbiter.AnchorRef{L3BlockHash: "0xdeadbeef"}
			if got, err := anchored.ChainHash(); err != nil || got != tc.digest {
				t.Fatalf("anchored ChainHash = %s (%v), want %s: the back-filled anchor stays out of the preimage", got, err, tc.digest)
			}
			keyless := tc.header
			keyless.Track = &L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 1}
			if got, err := keyless.ChainHash(); err != nil || got != tc.keyless {
				t.Fatalf("an empty group key hashes to %s (%v), want the frozen track digest %s", got, err, tc.keyless)
			}
		})
	}
	for _, digest := range []string{goldenGroupKeyHeaderChainHash, goldenGroupKeyTransitionHeaderChainHash} {
		if digest == goldenTrack1HeaderChainHash || digest == goldenTrack1TransitionHeaderChainHash {
			t.Fatal("a group key must change the chain hash")
		}
	}
}
```
