Create `fsm/group_key_test.go`:

```go
package fsm

import (
	"crypto/ecdsa"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// The group-key fixture (plan S3-E3 Task 72) is tracksReadyFSM's two-owner
// network with a second database of indexer 0: indexer 1 (SNode s1) owns
// db.t, indexer 0 (SNode s0) owns db0.x and db1.y, both made Active through
// transition block 1, v1..v3 are the Active pool. On top come the tracks and
// stage-3 activations, switches 1-3, and two listed members: member-0
// (hosted by indexer 0, failure domain node:n0) and member-1 (hosted by
// indexer 1, node:n1). The placement switch then gives indexer 1's db the
// group [member-0] and indexer 0's db0 and db1 the group [member-1] each,
// every one with network_fill on (fewer than three verify members). No
// member is ready, so every key is GroupKey([], true) until readyGK marks
// one. Names end in GK so they stay clear of the other tasks' fixtures.

// groupKeyReadyFSMGK is the fixture before the placement switch: stage3 with
// purge, eviction_voiding and owner_aware_selection on, member-0 and member-1
// listed, no group.
func groupKeyReadyFSMGK(t *testing.T) (*FSM, *authority.Signer) {
	t.Helper()
	f, a := claimsFSM(t)
	registerActive(t, f, "s0", arbiter.NodeRoleSNode)
	activateClaims(t, f, a, siEntry(t, f, indexerSigner2(t), 0, 150, "s0"))
	mustApply(t, f, advanceTo(149))
	mustApply(t, f, seedIndexerCmd(0, 149))
	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db0", "x", ev(150, "0x150", 0), ev(151, "0x151", 0), 0))
	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db1", "y", ev(152, "0x152", 0), ev(153, "0x153", 0), 0))
	seq := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	verifyTransition(t, f, seq)
	anchorFinal(t, f, seq)
	publishManifestInputs(t, f)
	for _, table := range []string{"db0.x", "db1.y"} {
		if inc := f.st.TableRegistry.Live(table); inc == nil || inc.Status != TableStatusActive || inc.OwnerIndexerID == nil || *inc.OwnerIndexerID != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("%s = %+v, want Active and owned by indexer 0", table, inc)
		}
	}
	activateTracks(t, f, a)
	activateStage3(t, f, a)
	turnOnStage3SwitchesThrough(t, f, a, Stage3SwitchOwnerAwareSelection)
	u := stage3Update(t, f)
	u = withVerifier(u, memberEntry(t, f, 0, stage3TestMember(0), "node:n0"))
	u = withVerifier(u, memberEntry(t, f, 1, stage3TestMember(1), "node:n1"))
	mustApply(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, u))
	return f, a
}

// groupKeyFSMGK is the fixture after the placement switch, which an empty
// open block turns on without a seal.
func groupKeyFSMGK(t *testing.T) (*FSM, *authority.Signer) {
	t.Helper()
	f, a := groupKeyReadyFSMGK(t)
	turnOnStage3Switch(t, f, a, Stage3SwitchPlacement)
	for _, g := range []struct {
		owner    uint64
		database string
		member   string
	}{{0, "db0", stage3TestMember(1)}, {0, "db1", stage3TestMember(1)}, {1, "db", stage3TestMember(0)}} {
		group := f.groupLocked(g.owner, g.database)
		if group == nil || len(group.Members) != 1 || group.Members[0].NodeID != g.member || !group.NetworkFill {
			t.Fatalf("group of indexer %d database %s = %+v, want [%s] with network_fill", g.owner, g.database, group, g.member)
		}
	}
	return f, a
}

// readyGK is f restored from its own plain v21 container with node marked
// ready in owner's group of database: ready_generation the group's
// generation, the ed25519 signature node's key (stage3MemberKey) makes over
// that MemberReady body in f's message context, and the current epoch, the
// record Plan S3-E3 Task 73's MemberReady writes. Until that command exists a
// restore is the only way to a ready member; the open block must be empty,
// since readiness changes the group's key. The decoder ignores
// ready_signature and ready_epoch until Task 73 adds those fields, whose
// restore re-verification then accepts the signature made here.
func readyGK(t *testing.T, f *FSM, owner uint64, database, node string) *FSM {
	t.Helper()
	if len(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("readyGK needs an empty open block")
	}
	g := f.groupLocked(owner, database)
	if g == nil {
		t.Fatalf("indexer %d database %s has no group", owner, database)
	}
	body := arbiter.MemberReadyBody{NodeID: node, OwnerIndexerID: owner, DatabaseID: database, Generation: g.Generation}
	sig, err := authority.SignMemberReady(stage3MemberKey(node), messageContextFor(t, f), body)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	marked := false
	data := rewriteSnapshotDocument(t, plainSnapshotBytes(t, f), snapshotVersionV21, func(doc map[string]any) {
		for _, raw := range doc["stage3"].(map[string]any)["groups"].([]any) {
			group := raw.(map[string]any)
			if uint64(group["owner"].(float64)) != owner || group["database_id"] != database {
				continue
			}
			for _, m := range group["members"].([]any) {
				if member := m.(map[string]any); member["node_id"] == node {
					member["ready_generation"], member["ready_signature"], member["ready_epoch"] = g.Generation, sig, f.st.ConsensusEpoch
					marked = true
				}
			}
		}
	})
	if !marked {
		t.Fatalf("%s is not a member of indexer %d's group of %s", node, owner, database)
	}
	restored, err := restoreConfigured(t, f, data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("restore with %s ready: %v", node, err)
	}
	return restored
}

// keyGK is the current key of owner's group of database.
func keyGK(t *testing.T, f *FSM, owner uint64, database string) string {
	t.Helper()
	seal, err := f.currentGroupSealLocked(owner, database)
	if err != nil || seal == nil {
		t.Fatalf("indexer %d database %s: seal %+v (%v)", owner, database, seal, err)
	}
	return seal.Key
}

// mustGroupKeyGK is GroupKey that fails the test on an error.
func mustGroupKeyGK(t *testing.T, members []string, fill bool) string {
	t.Helper()
	key, err := GroupKey(members, fill)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return key
}

// envelopeGK is account's legacy-lane statement seq for table, under its
// registered schema hash (trackEnvelope for any table).
func envelopeGK(t *testing.T, f *FSM, key *ecdsa.PrivateKey, account string, seq uint64, table string) arbiter.StatementEnvelope {
	t.Helper()
	inc := f.st.TableRegistry.Live(table)
	if inc == nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s is not registered", table)
	}
	env := validEnvelope(t, key, account, seq)
	env.TargetTableID = table
	env.SchemaHash = inc.SchemaHash
	env.UserJWS = signStatementV2(t, key, env)
	return env
}

// admitGK submits account's statement seq for table, requires it to be
// admitted and returns its statement seq.
func admitGK(t *testing.T, f *FSM, key *ecdsa.PrivateKey, account string, seq uint64, table string) uint64 {
	t.Helper()
	r := submit(t, f, envelopeGK(t, f, key, account, seq, table))
	if r.Code != arbiter.AdmissionCodeAccepted {
		t.Fatalf("statement %d for %s = %+v", seq, table, r)
	}
	return r.StatementSeq
}

// entryUpdateGK is f's next update with node's verifiers entry changed by
// edit, or left out when edit is nil.
func entryUpdateGK(t *testing.T, f *FSM, node string, edit func(*arbiter.VerifierEntry)) arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate {
	t.Helper()
	u := stage3Update(t, f)
	var out []arbiter.VerifierEntry
	found := false
	for _, v := range u.Verifiers {
		if v.NodeID == node {
			found = true
			if edit == nil {
				continue
			}
			edit(&v)
		}
		out = append(out, v)
	}
	if !found {
		t.Fatalf("%s is not listed", node)
	}
	u.Verifiers = out
	return u
}

// registerMemberGK registers node as an Active verifier under its listed key
// (stage3MemberKey), registration sequence 1.
func registerMemberGK(t *testing.T, f *FSM, node string) {
	t.Helper()
	key := stage3MemberKey(node)
	reg := wire.RegistrationFromPB(wire.RegistrationToPB(arbiter.NodeRegistration{NodeID: node,
		Roles: []arbiter.NodeRole{arbiter.NodeRoleVerifier}, Ed25519Pubkey: key.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey), RegistrationSeq: 1}))
	sig, err := authority.SignVerifierMessage(key, authority.VerifierMessageRegistration, messageContextFor(t, f), reg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, wire.Command{RegisterNode: &wire.RegisterNode{Registration: reg, Ed25519Signature: sig}})
	sig, err = authority.SignVerifierMessage(key, authority.VerifierMessageMarkActive, messageContextFor(t, f),
		authority.MarkActiveBody{NodeID: node, RegistrationSeq: 1})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, wire.Command{MarkActive: &wire.MarkActive{NodeID: node, RegistrationSeq: 1, Ed25519Signature: sig}})
}

// evictGK is the authority's EvictNode of node at registration sequence seq.
func evictGK(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer, node string, seq uint64) wire.Command {
	t.Helper()
	cmd := arbiter.EvictNodeCommand{NodeID: node, ExpectedRegistrationSeq: seq, Reason: "host lost"}
	token, err := a.SignEvictNodeWithContext(cmd, authorityContextFor(t, f))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return wire.Command{EvictNode: &wire.EvictNode{NodeID: node, Reason: cmd.Reason, ExpectedRegistrationSeq: seq, AuthorityJWS: token}}
}

// TestGroupKeyRefusesUnsortedOrRepeatedMembers: GroupKey hashes only a
// strictly ascending list of non-empty node ids; nil and empty hash alike.
func TestGroupKeyRefusesUnsortedOrRepeatedMembers(t *testing.T) {
	for _, members := range [][]string{{"member-c", "member-b"}, {"member-b", "member-b"}, {""}, {"member-a", ""}} {
		if key, err := GroupKey(members, true); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "group key: members must be sorted, unique, non-empty node ids") {
			t.Errorf("GroupKey(%q) = %s, %v; want the refusal", members, key, err)
		}
	}
	if a, b := mustGroupKeyGK(t, nil, false), mustGroupKeyGK(t, []string{}, false); a != b || a != goldenGroupKeyNoMembersNoFill {
		t.Fatalf("nil = %s, empty = %s, want %s", a, b, goldenGroupKeyNoMembersNoFill)
	}
}

// TestGroupKeyIgnoresEvictionAndNodeStatus: Review Focus 1, clarification
// K73. The key reads committed group records and the verifiers listing only:
// a ready member's registration, activation and eviction leave it unchanged
// and seal nothing, and members that are not ready or not listed with verify
// never enter it.
func TestGroupKeyIgnoresEvictionAndNodeStatus(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupKeyFSMGK(t)
	member := stage3TestMember(1)
	f = readyGK(t, f, 0, "db1", member)
	want := mustGroupKeyGK(t, []string{member}, true)
	if got := keyGK(t, f, 0, "db1"); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("key with %s ready = %s, want %s", member, got, want)
	}
	if got := keyGK(t, f, 0, "db0"); got != goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill {
		t.Fatalf("db0's key without a ready member = %s, want %s", got, goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill)
	}
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	admitGK(t, f, key, account, 1, "db1.y")
	blocks := len(f.st.Blocks)
	registerMemberGK(t, f, member)
	if got := keyGK(t, f, 0, "db1"); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("key once %s is Active = %s, want %s", member, got, want)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, evictGK(t, f, a, member, 1))
	if f.st.Nodes[member].Status != NodeEvicted {
		t.Fatalf("%s = %+v, want evicted", member, f.st.Nodes[member])
	}
	if got := keyGK(t, f, 0, "db1"); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("key once %s is evicted = %s, want %s", member, got, want)
	}
	if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks || f.st.OpenBlock.GroupKey != want || len(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("an eviction sealed or rekeyed the open block: blocks %d -> %d, open block %+v", blocks, len(f.st.Blocks), f.st.OpenBlock)
	}
	if got := f.readyVerifyMembersLocked(f.groupLocked(0, "db1"), f.st.Params.Verifiers); !slices.Equal(got, []string{member}) {
		t.Fatalf("ready verify members = %q", got)
	}
	g := f.groupLocked(0, "db1")
	if got := f.readyVerifyMembersLocked(g, nil); got != nil {
		t.Fatalf("an unlisted member counted: %q", got)
	}
	unverified := cloneVerifiers(f.st.Params.Verifiers)
	for i := range unverified {
		unverified[i].Verify = false
	}
	if got := f.readyVerifyMembersLocked(g, unverified); got != nil {
		t.Fatalf("a member listed without verify counted: %q", got)
	}
}

// TestTableSealKeyMatchesTableOwnerBeforePlacement: the grouping window's key
// is TableOwner's owner with an empty group key before the placement switch,
// answers ok exactly when TableOwner does, and afterwards carries the
// current key of the group of the table's database (the Legacy db.old shares
// db's group).
func TestTableSealKeyMatchesTableOwnerBeforePlacement(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupKeyReadyFSMGK(t)
	tables := []string{"db.t", "db0.x", "db1.y", "db.old", "nope.none"}
	for _, table := range tables {
		owner, ok := f.TableOwner(table)
		key, keyOK := f.TableSealKey(table)
		if keyOK != ok || key != (SealKey{Owner: owner}) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: TableSealKey = %+v, %v; TableOwner = %d, %v", table, key, keyOK, owner, ok)
		}
	}
	turnOnStage3Switch(t, f, a, Stage3SwitchPlacement)
	f = readyGK(t, f, 0, "db1", stage3TestMember(1))
	ready := mustGroupKeyGK(t, []string{stage3TestMember(1)}, true)
	for table, want := range map[string]SealKey{"db.t": {1, goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill}, "db0.x": {0, goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill},
		"db1.y": {0, ready}, "db.old": {1, goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill}} {
		if key, ok := f.TableSealKey(table); !ok || key != want {
			t.Fatalf("%s: TableSealKey = %+v, %v; want %+v", table, key, ok, want)
		}
	}
	if _, ok := f.TableSealKey("nope.none"); ok {
		t.Fatal("an unknown table has a seal key")
	}
}

// TestRegistryViewServesEachGroupsCurrentKey: plan S3-E3 contract §50-§51.
// The registry view derives each group's key when it is read, from the
// committed group record and verifiers listing, so it is the key admission
// seals under; a consensus update that changes a member's verifiers entry,
// and with it the served key, bumps the registry version once.
func TestRegistryViewServesEachGroupsCurrentKey(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupKeyFSMGK(t)
	member := stage3TestMember(1)
	f = readyGK(t, f, 0, "db1", member)
	served := func() (map[string]string, uint64) {
		t.Helper()
		view, ok := f.TableRegistryView()
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("the registry is disabled")
		}
		keys := map[string]string{}
		for _, g := range view.Groups {
			keys[fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s", g.Group.Owner, g.Group.DatabaseID)] = g.Key
			if want := keyGK(t, f, g.Group.Owner, g.Group.DatabaseID); g.Key != want {
				t.Fatalf("served key of indexer %d database %s = %s, the seal key is %s", g.Group.Owner, g.Group.DatabaseID, g.Key, want)
			}
		}
		return keys, view.Version
	}
	keys, version := served()
	if want := map[string]string{"0/db0": goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill, "0/db1": mustGroupKeyGK(t, []string{member}, true), "1/db": goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill}; !reflect.DeepEqual(keys, want) {
		t.Fatalf("served keys = %v, want %v", keys, want)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, entryUpdateGK(t, f, member, func(v *arbiter.VerifierEntry) { v.Verify = false })))
	keys, after := served()
	if keys["0/db1"] != goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill || after != version+1 {
		t.Fatalf("after clearing %s's verify flag: served keys %v at version %d, want db1 under %s at version %d", member, keys, after, goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill, version+1)
	}
}

// TestBlockSealReasonsCountEveryReason: every seal counts its reason once
// and BlockSealReasons reports every reason of SealReasons, zeros included.
// The counter is node-local: a restored FSM starts from zero. A
// snapshot-query block exists only before the tracks activation, so it is
// sealed on a fresh FSM the way the snapshot-query block tests seal one.
func TestBlockSealReasonsCountEveryReason(t *testing.T) {
	counted := func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, want map[SealReason]uint64) {
		t.Helper()
		got := f.BlockSealReasons()
		if len(got) != len(SealReasons) {
			t.Fatalf("BlockSealReasons = %v, want every one of %v", got, SealReasons)
		}
		for _, r := range SealReasons {
			if got[r] != want[r] {
				t.Fatalf("BlockSealReasons = %v, want %v", got, want)
			}
		}
	}
	counted(t, newTestFSM(t), nil)
	f, a := groupKeyReadyFSMGK(t)
	counted(t, f, map[SealReason]uint64{SealReasonTransition: 1})
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	admitGK(t, f, key, account, 1, "db.t")
	admitGK(t, f, key, account, 2, "db0.x")
	turnOnStage3Switch(t, f, a, Stage3SwitchPlacement)
	counted(t, f, map[SealReason]uint64{SealReasonTransition: 1, SealReasonOwnerSwitch: 1, SealReasonPlacementCutover: 1})

	f = readyGK(t, f, 0, "db1", stage3TestMember(1))
	counted(t, f, nil)
	admitGK(t, f, key, account, 3, "db0.x")
	admitGK(t, f, key, account, 4, "db1.y")
	mustApply(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, entryUpdateGK(t, f, stage3TestMember(1), func(v *arbiter.VerifierEntry) { v.Verify = false })))
	admitGK(t, f, key, account, 5, "db0.x")
	mustSeal(t, f)
	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db0", "z", ev(154, "0x154", 0), ev(155, "0x155", 0), 0))
	mustSeal(t, f)
	counted(t, f, map[SealReason]uint64{SealReasonGroupSwitch: 1, SealReasonKeyChange: 1, SealReasonRequested: 1, SealReasonTransition: 1})

	q := newTestFSM(t)
	seq := seedQueryStatement(t, q, testQueryEnvelope(t, testQueryStatementID(1)), "source-a")
	if _, _, err := q.sealSnapshotQueryBlockLocked(seq, "source-a"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	counted(t, q, map[SealReason]uint64{SealReasonSnapshotQuery: 1})
}
```

```go
package fsm

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
)

// verificationGK is block seq's verification record.
func verificationGK(t *testing.T, f *FSM, seq uint64) *BlockVerification {
	t.Helper()
	bv := f.st.Verifications[seq]
	if bv == nil {
		t.Fatalf("block %d has no verification record", seq)
	}
	return bv
}

// requireKeylessGK fails unless block seq carries no group key and its
// verification no group seal field.
func requireKeylessGK(t *testing.T, f *FSM, seq uint64) {
	t.Helper()
	h := f.st.Blocks[seq-1]
	if h.Track != nil && h.Track.GroupKey != "" {
		t.Fatalf("block %d carries group_key %s", seq, h.Track.GroupKey)
	}
	if bv := verificationGK(t, f, seq); groupSealFieldsPresent(bv) {
		t.Fatalf("block %d verification carries group seal fields %+v", seq, bv)
	}
}

// requireKeyedGK fails unless block seq is sealed under key with the
// recorded members, fill and databases.
func requireKeyedGK(t *testing.T, f *FSM, seq uint64, key string, members []string, databases []GroupRef) {
	t.Helper()
	h := f.st.Blocks[seq-1]
	if h.Track == nil || h.Track.GroupKey != key {
		t.Fatalf("block %d track = %+v, want group_key %s", seq, h.Track, key)
	}
	bv := verificationGK(t, f, seq)
	if bv.GroupKey != key || !slices.Equal(bv.GroupMembers, members) || !bv.GroupFill || !reflect.DeepEqual(bv.GroupDatabases, databases) {
		t.Fatalf("block %d group seal = %q %q %v %+v, want %q %q true %+v", seq, bv.GroupKey, bv.GroupMembers, bv.GroupFill, bv.GroupDatabases, key, members, databases)
	}
}

// restoresGK requires f's plain v21 container to restore.
func restoresGK(t *testing.T, f *FSM) {
	t.Helper()
	if _, err := restoreConfigured(t, f, plainSnapshotBytes(t, f)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("restore of the honest state: %v", err)
	}
}

// TestDatabasesWithEqualKeysShareABlock: Review Focus 2. indexer 0's db0 and
// db1 have the same key while no member is ready, so their statements share
// one open block and one sealed block, which records both databases.
func TestDatabasesWithEqualKeysShareABlock(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := groupKeyFSMGK(t)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	blocks := len(f.st.Blocks)
	first := admitGK(t, f, key, account, 1, "db0.x")
	second := admitGK(t, f, key, account, 2, "db1.y")
	ob := f.st.OpenBlock
	if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks || !slices.Equal(ob.StatementSeqs, []uint64{first, second}) || ob.GroupKey != goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill || ob.GroupMembers != nil || !ob.GroupFill {
		t.Fatalf("open block = %+v after %d -> %d blocks, want both statements under %s", ob, blocks, len(f.st.Blocks), goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill)
	}
	seq := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	requireKeyedGK(t, f, seq, goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill, nil, []GroupRef{{"db0", 1}, {"db1", 1}})
	if h := f.st.Blocks[seq-1]; h.StatementCount != 2 || h.Track.IndexerID != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("sealed header = %+v, want indexer 0's two statements", h)
	}
	if ob := f.st.OpenBlock; ob.GroupKey != "" || ob.GroupMembers != nil || ob.GroupFill || ob.Owner != nil {
		t.Fatalf("the next open block = %+v, want no owner and no group seal", ob)
	}
	restoresGK(t, f)
}

// TestAStatementWithAnotherGroupKeySealsTheOpenBlockFirst: spec §7.1-§7.2. A
// statement of the open block's owner under another key seals the open block
// inside its own admission, as an owner switch does: with the spent-ids root
// before its insert, prepared before any mutation, committed after the insert.
// A refused preparation answers with state unchanged.
func TestAStatementWithAnotherGroupKeySealsTheOpenBlockFirst(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := groupKeyFSMGK(t)
	member := stage3TestMember(1)
	f = readyGK(t, f, 0, "db1", member)
	ready := mustGroupKeyGK(t, []string{member}, true)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	first := admitGK(t, f, key, account, 1, "db0.x")
	before, blocks := "0x"+hex.EncodeToString(f.st.SpentIDs.Root()), len(f.st.Blocks)
	r := submit(t, f, envelopeGK(t, f, key, account, 2, "db1.y"))
	if r != (SubmitResult{Code: arbiter.AdmissionCodeAccepted, StatementSeq: first + 1}) {
		t.Fatalf("switching statement = %+v; the answer must not change", r)
	}
	if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks+1 {
		t.Fatalf("blocks %d -> %d, want exactly one group-switch seal", blocks, len(f.st.Blocks))
	}
	seq := uint64(len(f.st.Blocks))
	requireKeyedGK(t, f, seq, goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill, nil, []GroupRef{{"db0", 1}})
	if h := f.st.Blocks[seq-1]; h.StatementSeqStart != first || h.StatementCount != 1 || h.SpentIDsRootAfter != before {
		t.Fatalf("sealed header = %+v, want db0.x's statement with the root before the switching insert", h)
	}
	if ob := f.st.OpenBlock; !slices.Equal(ob.StatementSeqs, []uint64{first + 1}) || ob.GroupKey != ready || !slices.Equal(ob.GroupMembers, []string{member}) || !ob.GroupFill || *ob.Owner != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("open block = %+v, want db1.y's statement under %s", ob, ready)
	}
	t.Run("seal preparation refused", func(t *testing.T) {
		admitGK(t, f, key, account, 3, "db1.y")
		mustSeal(t, f)
		admitGK(t, f, key, account, 4, "db0.x")
		f.st.OpenBlock.GroupKey = "" // synthesized corruption: a statement-holding open block without its key
		env := envelopeGK(t, f, key, account, 5, "db1.y")
		if got := refusedOwnerSwitch(t, f, env); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, Rejected{Reason: "group switch seal: open block has no group key"}) {
			t.Fatalf("answer = %+v", got)
		}
		f.st.OpenBlock.GroupKey = goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill
		if r := submit(t, f, env); r.Code != arbiter.AdmissionCodeAccepted {
			t.Fatalf("the refused statement's client_seq must stay unspent: %+v", r)
		}
	})
}

// TestOwnerSwitchSealIsUnchangedBeforePlacement: Review Focus 2. With stage3
// committed and the placement switch off, an owner switch seals as it always
// has: no key in the header, no group seal anywhere, and statements of one
// owner share a block whatever their database.
func TestOwnerSwitchSealIsUnchangedBeforePlacement(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := groupKeyReadyFSMGK(t)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 1)
	blocks := len(f.st.Blocks)
	second := admitGK(t, f, key, account, 2, "db0.x")
	third := admitGK(t, f, key, account, 3, "db1.y")
	if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks+1 {
		t.Fatalf("blocks %d -> %d, want one owner-switch seal", blocks, len(f.st.Blocks))
	}
	requireKeylessGK(t, f, uint64(len(f.st.Blocks)))
	if h := f.st.Blocks[len(f.st.Blocks)-1]; h.Track == nil || *h.Track != (L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 1}) {
		t.Fatalf("sealed track = %+v, want indexer 1's without a key", h.Track)
	}
	if ob := f.st.OpenBlock; !slices.Equal(ob.StatementSeqs, []uint64{second, third}) || openBlockGroupFieldsPresent(ob) {
		t.Fatalf("open block = %+v, want indexer 0's two statements without a group seal", ob)
	}
	if got := f.BlockSealReasons(); got[SealReasonOwnerSwitch] != 1 || got[SealReasonGroupSwitch] != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("seal reasons = %v", got)
	}
	if data := plainSnapshotBytes(t, f); stage3FieldsPresentInGroupLayerGK(t, data) {
		t.Fatal("a pre-placement container carries a group seal field")
	}
}

// stage3FieldsPresentInGroupLayerGK reports whether a plain v21 container's
// document carries any group seal field.
func stage3FieldsPresentInGroupLayerGK(t *testing.T, data []byte) bool {
	t.Helper()
	found := false
	rewriteSnapshotDocument(t, data, snapshotVersionV21, func(doc map[string]any) {
		if ob, ok := doc["open_block"].(map[string]any); ok {
			for _, k := range []string{"group_key", "group_members", "group_fill"} {
				if _, ok := ob[k]; ok {
					found = true
				}
			}
		}
		for _, raw := range doc["blocks"].([]any) {
			if tr, ok := raw.(map[string]any)["track"].(map[string]any); ok {
				if _, ok := tr["group_key"]; ok {
					found = true
				}
			}
		}
		for _, raw := range doc["verifications"].(map[string]any) {
			for _, k := range []string{"group_key", "group_members", "group_fill", "group_databases"} {
				if _, ok := raw.(map[string]any)[k]; ok {
					found = true
				}
			}
		}
	})
	return found
}

// TestPlacementSwitchOnSealsTheOpenBlockAndRecordsTheCutover: spec §7.1,
// §10.4 step 5. The update that turns placement on seals a non-empty open
// block first, under no key since the seal is prepared while placement is
// off, and records the sealed tip as the cutover, the switch's cutover block
// too; with an empty open block it seals nothing and records the tip.
func TestPlacementSwitchOnSealsTheOpenBlockAndRecordsTheCutover(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("open block holds statements", func(t *testing.T) {
		f, a := groupKeyReadyFSMGK(t)
		key, account := fixedClient(t)
		admitGK(t, f, key, account, 1, "db0.x")
		admitGK(t, f, key, account, 2, "db1.y")
		blocks := len(f.st.Blocks)
		turnOnStage3Switch(t, f, a, Stage3SwitchPlacement)
		if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks+1 || len(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("blocks %d -> %d, open block %+v: want the open block sealed", blocks, len(f.st.Blocks), f.st.OpenBlock)
		}
		cutover := uint64(len(f.st.Blocks))
		requireKeylessGK(t, f, cutover)
		if c := f.st.Stage3.PlacementCutoverBlock; c == nil || *c != cutover {
			t.Fatalf("placement cutover = %v, want %d", c, cutover)
		}
		if s := f.st.Stage3.Switches[len(f.st.Stage3.Switches)-1]; s.Switch != Stage3SwitchPlacement || s.BlockSeq != cutover {
			t.Fatalf("switch cutover = %+v, want placement at block %d", s, cutover)
		}
		if got := f.BlockSealReasons()[SealReasonPlacementCutover]; got != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("placement_cutover seals = %d", got)
		}
		if f.groupLocked(0, "db0") == nil || f.groupLocked(0, "db1") == nil || f.groupLocked(1, "db") == nil {
			t.Fatal("the switch-on placed no groups")
		}
		restoresGK(t, f)
	})
	t.Run("open block is empty", func(t *testing.T) {
		f, a := groupKeyReadyFSMGK(t)
		blocks := len(f.st.Blocks)
		turnOnStage3Switch(t, f, a, Stage3SwitchPlacement)
		if c := f.st.Stage3.PlacementCutoverBlock; len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks || c == nil || *c != uint64(blocks) {
			t.Fatalf("blocks %d -> %d, cutover %v: want no seal and the tip %d", blocks, len(f.st.Blocks), c, blocks)
		}
		if got := f.BlockSealReasons()[SealReasonPlacementCutover]; got != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("placement_cutover seals = %d, want 0 without a seal", got)
		}
		restoresGK(t, f)
	})
}

// TestBlocksSealedAfterTheCutoverCarryGroupKeyAndEarlierOnesDoNot: Review
// Focus 1. Blocks at or below the cutover, the cutover block included, carry
// no key; every later block does, statement and transition blocks alike,
// and the honest chain restores.
func TestBlocksSealedAfterTheCutoverCarryGroupKeyAndEarlierOnesDoNot(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupKeyReadyFSMGK(t)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	admitGK(t, f, key, account, 1, "db.t")
	turnOnStage3Switch(t, f, a, Stage3SwitchPlacement)
	cutover := *f.st.Stage3.PlacementCutoverBlock
	admitGK(t, f, key, account, 2, "db.t")
	statement := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db0", "z", ev(154, "0x154", 0), ev(155, "0x155", 0), 0))
	transition := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	for seq := uint64(1); seq <= cutover; seq++ {
		requireKeylessGK(t, f, seq)
	}
	requireKeyedGK(t, f, statement, goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill, nil, []GroupRef{{"db", 1}})
	requireKeyedGK(t, f, transition, goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill, nil, []GroupRef{{"db0", 1}})
	if statement != cutover+1 || transition != cutover+2 {
		t.Fatalf("blocks %d and %d after cutover %d", statement, transition, cutover)
	}
	restoresGK(t, f)
}

// TestParamsUpdateFlippingVerifySealsFirst: Review Focus 2. With placement
// on, an update that clears a ready member's verify flag changes its group's
// key, so an open block holding a statement of that group seals first, under
// the old key, and the update's own state follows; the open block of another
// key is left alone.
func TestParamsUpdateFlippingVerifySealsFirst(t *testing.T) {
	member := stage3TestMember(1)
	unverify := func(v *arbiter.VerifierEntry) { v.Verify = false }
	t.Run("the open block holds the group", func(t *testing.T) {
		f, a := groupKeyFSMGK(t)
		f = readyGK(t, f, 0, "db1", member)
		ready := mustGroupKeyGK(t, []string{member}, true)
		key, account := fixedClient(t)
		first := admitGK(t, f, key, account, 1, "db1.y")
		blocks, epoch := len(f.st.Blocks), f.st.ConsensusEpoch
		mustApply(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, entryUpdateGK(t, f, member, unverify)))
		if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks+1 || f.st.ConsensusEpoch != epoch+1 {
			t.Fatalf("blocks %d -> %d, epoch %d -> %d: want one key-change seal and the update", blocks, len(f.st.Blocks), epoch, f.st.ConsensusEpoch)
		}
		seq := uint64(len(f.st.Blocks))
		requireKeyedGK(t, f, seq, ready, []string{member}, []GroupRef{{"db1", 1}})
		if h := f.st.Blocks[seq-1]; h.StatementSeqStart != first || h.StatementCount != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("sealed header = %+v, want the db1.y statement", h)
		}
		if got := keyGK(t, f, 0, "db1"); got != goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill {
			t.Fatalf("db1's key after the update = %s", got)
		}
		if got := f.BlockSealReasons()[SealReasonKeyChange]; got != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("key_change seals = %d", got)
		}
		// The two databases share a key again.
		admitGK(t, f, key, account, 2, "db0.x")
		admitGK(t, f, key, account, 3, "db1.y")
		if ob := f.st.OpenBlock; len(ob.StatementSeqs) != 2 || ob.GroupKey != goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill {
			t.Fatalf("open block = %+v", ob)
		}
		restoresGK(t, f)
	})
	t.Run("the open block holds another key", func(t *testing.T) {
		f, a := groupKeyFSMGK(t)
		f = readyGK(t, f, 0, "db1", member)
		key, account := fixedClient(t)
		admitGK(t, f, key, account, 1, "db0.x")
		blocks := len(f.st.Blocks)
		mustApply(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, entryUpdateGK(t, f, member, unverify)))
		if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks || len(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs) != 1 || f.st.OpenBlock.GroupKey != goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill {
			t.Fatalf("an update that keeps the open block's key sealed it: blocks %d -> %d, open block %+v", blocks, len(f.st.Blocks), f.st.OpenBlock)
		}
		restoresGK(t, f)
	})
}

// TestParamsUpdateDelistingAMemberSealsFirst: Review Focus 2, clarification
// K73. Delisting a ready member removes it from the key, so an open block of
// its group seals first; the member keeps its members entry.
func TestParamsUpdateDelistingAMemberSealsFirst(t *testing.T) {
	member := stage3TestMember(1)
	f, a := groupKeyFSMGK(t)
	f = readyGK(t, f, 0, "db1", member)
	ready := mustGroupKeyGK(t, []string{member}, true)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	admitGK(t, f, key, account, 1, "db1.y")
	admitGK(t, f, key, account, 2, "db1.y")
	blocks := len(f.st.Blocks)
	mustApply(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, entryUpdateGK(t, f, member, nil)))
	if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks+1 || len(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("blocks %d -> %d, open block %+v: want the open block sealed", blocks, len(f.st.Blocks), f.st.OpenBlock)
	}
	requireKeyedGK(t, f, uint64(len(f.st.Blocks)), ready, []string{member}, []GroupRef{{"db1", 1}})
	if _, listed := f.verifierEntryLocked(member); listed {
		t.Fatalf("%s is still listed", member)
	}
	if g := f.groupLocked(0, "db1"); len(g.Members) != 1 || g.Members[0].NodeID != member {
		t.Fatalf("group = %+v, want the delisted member kept", g)
	}
	if got := keyGK(t, f, 0, "db1"); got != goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill {
		t.Fatalf("db1's key after the delisting = %s", got)
	}
	restoresGK(t, f)
}

// TestKeyChangeSealRefusesWithStateUnchangedWhenItCannotBePrepared: Review
// Focus 2 (C10). When the seal an update must commit first cannot be
// prepared, the update is refused with state unchanged. Only a corrupted open
// block makes the preparation fail, so each case synthesizes one, as
// TestRefusedOwnerSwitchSealsNothing does.
func TestKeyChangeSealRefusesWithStateUnchangedWhenItCannotBePrepared(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("placement cutover", func(t *testing.T) {
		f, a := groupKeyReadyFSMGK(t)
		key, account := fixedClient(t)
		admitGK(t, f, key, account, 1, "db0.x")
		owner := *f.st.OpenBlock.Owner
		f.st.OpenBlock.Owner = nil // synthesized corruption
		u := stage3Update(t, f)
		u.Stage3 = stage3WithSwitch(u.Stage3, Stage3SwitchPlacement)
		rejectStage3Unchanged(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, u), "consensus update: placement cutover seal: open block has no owner")
		f.st.OpenBlock.Owner = &owner
		mustApply(t, f, signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, u))
		if !f.PlacementOn() || f.st.Stage3.PlacementCutoverBlock == nil {
			t.Fatal("the repaired update did not turn placement on")
		}
	})
	t.Run("group key change", func(t *testing.T) {
		member := stage3TestMember(1)
		f, a := groupKeyFSMGK(t)
		f = readyGK(t, f, 0, "db1", member)
		key, account := fixedClient(t)
		admitGK(t, f, key, account, 1, "db1.y")
		saved := f.st.OpenBlock.GroupKey
		f.st.OpenBlock.GroupKey = "" // synthesized corruption
		cmd := signedConsensusUpdate(t, a, entryUpdateGK(t, f, member, func(v *arbiter.VerifierEntry) { v.Verify = false }))
		rejectStage3Unchanged(t, f, cmd, "consensus update: group key change seal: open block has no group key")
		f.st.OpenBlock.GroupKey = saved
		blocks := len(f.st.Blocks)
		mustApply(t, f, cmd)
		if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks+1 {
			t.Fatal("the repaired update did not seal first")
		}
	})
}

// TestCommitSealRecordsTheGroupSealInTheVerification: a seal copies the open
// block's key, members and fill into the new BlockVerification and records
// every database of the block's statements with its group's generation at
// the seal; BlockVerificationView serves all four, detached.
func TestCommitSealRecordsTheGroupSealInTheVerification(t *testing.T) {
	member := stage3TestMember(1)
	f, _ := groupKeyFSMGK(t)
	f = readyGK(t, f, 0, "db1", member)
	ready := mustGroupKeyGK(t, []string{member}, true)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	admitGK(t, f, key, account, 1, "db1.y")
	admitGK(t, f, key, account, 2, "db1.y")
	seq := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	generation := f.groupLocked(0, "db1").Generation
	requireKeyedGK(t, f, seq, ready, []string{member}, []GroupRef{{"db1", generation}})
	view, err := f.BlockVerificationView(seq)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if view.GroupKey != ready || !slices.Equal(view.GroupMembers, []string{member}) || !view.GroupFill || !reflect.DeepEqual(view.GroupDatabases, []GroupRef{{"db1", generation}}) {
		t.Fatalf("view group seal = %q %q %v %+v", view.GroupKey, view.GroupMembers, view.GroupFill, view.GroupDatabases)
	}
	view.GroupMembers[0], view.GroupDatabases[0].DatabaseID = "mutated", "mutated"
	if bv := verificationGK(t, f, seq); bv.GroupMembers[0] != member || bv.GroupDatabases[0].DatabaseID != "db1" {
		t.Fatal("BlockVerificationView must return a detached copy")
	}
	if bv := verificationGK(t, f, seq); bv.groupSeal() == nil || bv.groupSeal().Key != ready {
		t.Fatalf("groupSeal() = %+v", bv.groupSeal())
	}
	restoresGK(t, f)

	// The recorded generation is the group's at the seal, not the members'.
	g, _ := groupKeyFSMGK(t)
	g = generationGK(t, g, 0, "db0", 2)
	admitGK(t, g, key, account, 1, "db0.x")
	seq = mustSeal(t, g).BlockSeq
	requireKeyedGK(t, g, seq, goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill, nil, []GroupRef{{"db0", 2}})
	restoresGK(t, g)
}

// generationGK is f restored from its own plain v21 container with owner's
// group of database, and its durable counter, at generation, as a
// RebalanceGroup that changed nothing else would leave them. The open block
// must be empty.
func generationGK(t *testing.T, f *FSM, owner uint64, database string, generation uint64) *FSM {
	t.Helper()
	if len(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("generationGK needs an empty open block")
	}
	set := 0
	data := forgedGK(t, f, func(doc map[string]any) {
		for _, list := range []string{"groups", "group_generations"} {
			for _, raw := range v21Stage3(doc)[list].([]any) {
				entry := raw.(map[string]any)
				if uint64(entry["owner"].(float64)) == owner && entry["database_id"] == database {
					entry["generation"] = generation
					set++
				}
			}
		}
	})
	if set != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("indexer %d database %s: %d of the group and its counter set", owner, database, set)
	}
	restored, err := restoreConfigured(t, f, data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("restore at generation %d: %v", generation, err)
	}
	return restored
}

// Restore rules of the seal key (plan S3-E3 contract §51,
// validateStage3SealKeys): each case forges one field of an honest plain v21
// container and requires the bare and the configured restore to refuse it.

// forgedGK is f's plain v21 container with mutate applied to its document.
func forgedGK(t *testing.T, f *FSM, mutate func(doc map[string]any)) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	return rewriteSnapshotDocument(t, plainSnapshotBytes(t, f), snapshotVersionV21, mutate)
}

// docBlockGK is block seq's header in a decoded snapshot document.
func docBlockGK(doc map[string]any, seq uint64) map[string]any {
	return doc["blocks"].([]any)[seq-1].(map[string]any)
}

// docVerificationGK is block seq's verification record in a decoded
// snapshot document.
func docVerificationGK(doc map[string]any, seq uint64) map[string]any {
	return doc["verifications"].(map[string]any)[fmt.Sprint(seq)].(map[string]any)
}

// TestRestoreRefusesAGroupKeyBeforeTheCutoverOrMissingAfterIt: Review Focus
// 1. Restore checks the cutover record and every block's key and recorded
// group seal against the rules Apply follows.
func TestRestoreRefusesAGroupKeyBeforeTheCutoverOrMissingAfterIt(t *testing.T) {
	off, _ := groupKeyReadyFSMGK(t)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	admitGK(t, off, key, account, 1, "db0.x")
	offBlock := mustSeal(t, off).BlockSeq
	offData := plainSnapshotBytes(t, off)
	f, a := groupKeyReadyFSMGK(t)
	admitGK(t, f, key, account, 1, "db0.x")
	turnOnStage3Switch(t, f, a, Stage3SwitchPlacement)
	cutover := *f.st.Stage3.PlacementCutoverBlock
	admitGK(t, f, key, account, 2, "db0.x")
	keyed := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	restoresGK(t, f)
	const prefix = "snapshot stage3 seal keys: "
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		of     *FSM
		data   []byte
		mutate func(doc map[string]any)
		want   string
	}{
		{"a cutover while the switch is off", off, offData, func(doc map[string]any) {
			v21Stage3(doc)["placement_cutover_block"] = 1
		}, "placement cutover is recorded while the placement switch is off"},
		{"a key while the switch is off", off, offData, func(doc map[string]any) {
			docBlockGK(doc, offBlock)["track"].(map[string]any)["group_key"] = goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill
		}, fmt.Sprintf("block %d carries group_key while the placement switch is off", offBlock)},
		{"no cutover while the switch is on", f, nil, func(doc map[string]any) {
			delete(v21Stage3(doc), "placement_cutover_block")
		}, "placement switch is on without a recorded cutover"},
		{"a cutover beyond the chain", f, nil, func(doc map[string]any) {
			v21Stage3(doc)["placement_cutover_block"] = keyed + 1
		}, fmt.Sprintf("placement cutover %d is beyond the last sealed block %d", keyed+1, keyed)},
		{"a key on the cutover block", f, nil, func(doc map[string]any) {
			docBlockGK(doc, cutover)["track"].(map[string]any)["group_key"] = goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill
		}, fmt.Sprintf("block %d at or below the placement cutover %d carries group_key", cutover, cutover)},
		{"no key after the cutover", f, nil, func(doc map[string]any) {
			delete(docBlockGK(doc, keyed)["track"].(map[string]any), "group_key")
		}, fmt.Sprintf("block %d after the placement cutover %d has no group_key", keyed, cutover)},
		{"a key the verification record does not repeat", f, nil, func(doc map[string]any) {
			docVerificationGK(doc, keyed)["group_key"] = goldenGroupKeyNoMembersNoFill
		}, fmt.Sprintf("block %d group_key differs from its verification record", keyed)},
		{"members the key does not hash", f, nil, func(doc map[string]any) {
			docVerificationGK(doc, keyed)["group_members"] = []any{"member-x"}
		}, fmt.Sprintf("block %d group_key differs from its recorded members and fill", keyed)},
		{"a fill the key does not hash", f, nil, func(doc map[string]any) {
			delete(docVerificationGK(doc, keyed), "group_fill")
		}, fmt.Sprintf("block %d group_key differs from its recorded members and fill", keyed)},
		{"no recorded groups", f, nil, func(doc map[string]any) {
			delete(docVerificationGK(doc, keyed), "group_databases")
		}, fmt.Sprintf("block %d recorded groups are empty, unsorted or repeated", keyed)},
		{"repeated recorded groups", f, nil, func(doc map[string]any) {
			docVerificationGK(doc, keyed)["group_databases"] = []any{map[string]any{"database_id": "db0", "generation": 1}, map[string]any{"database_id": "db0", "generation": 1}}
		}, fmt.Sprintf("block %d recorded groups are empty, unsorted or repeated", keyed)},
		{"a statement outside the recorded groups", f, nil, func(doc map[string]any) {
			docVerificationGK(doc, keyed)["group_databases"] = []any{map[string]any{"database_id": "db1", "generation": 1}}
		}, fmt.Sprintf("block %d statement %d of database \"db0\" is outside its recorded groups", keyed, f.st.Blocks[keyed-1].StatementSeqStart)},
		{"group seal fields on a keyless block", f, nil, func(doc map[string]any) {
			docVerificationGK(doc, cutover)["group_fill"] = true
		}, fmt.Sprintf("block %d without group_key carries group seal fields", cutover)},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			data := tc.data
			if data == nil {
				data = plainSnapshotBytes(t, tc.of)
			}
			restoreRefusedBothWays(t, tc.of, rewriteSnapshotDocument(t, data, snapshotVersionV21, tc.mutate), prefix+tc.want)
		})
	}
}

// TestRestoreRefusesAnOpenBlockKeyThatDiffersFromItsGroups: Review Focus 2.
// An open block holding statements after placement carries exactly the
// current seal of each of its databases' groups; an empty one, or one before
// placement, carries none.
func TestRestoreRefusesAnOpenBlockKeyThatDiffersFromItsGroups(t *testing.T) {
	member := stage3TestMember(1)
	f, _ := groupKeyFSMGK(t)
	f = readyGK(t, f, 0, "db1", member)
	empty := f
	emptyData := plainSnapshotBytes(t, empty)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	f, _ = groupKeyFSMGK(t)
	f = readyGK(t, f, 0, "db1", member)
	admitGK(t, f, key, account, 1, "db1.y")
	restoresGK(t, f)
	const prefix = "snapshot stage3 seal keys: "
	open := func(doc map[string]any) map[string]any { return doc["open_block"].(map[string]any) }
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		of     *FSM
		data   []byte
		mutate func(doc map[string]any)
		want   string
	}{
		{"another key", f, nil, func(doc map[string]any) {
			open(doc)["group_key"] = goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill
		}, `open block group key differs from the current key of database "db1"`},
		{"other members", f, nil, func(doc map[string]any) {
			open(doc)["group_members"] = []any{"member-x"}
		}, `open block group key differs from the current key of database "db1"`},
		{"another fill", f, nil, func(doc map[string]any) {
			delete(open(doc), "group_fill")
		}, `open block group key differs from the current key of database "db1"`},
		{"no key", f, nil, func(doc map[string]any) {
			delete(open(doc), "group_key")
		}, "open block holds statements after placement without a group key"},
		{"a key without statements", empty, emptyData, func(doc map[string]any) {
			open(doc)["group_key"] = goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill
		}, "open block carries a group key without statements or before placement"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			data := tc.data
			if data == nil {
				data = plainSnapshotBytes(t, tc.of)
			}
			restoreRefusedBothWays(t, tc.of, rewriteSnapshotDocument(t, data, snapshotVersionV21, tc.mutate), prefix+tc.want)
		})
	}
	t.Run("a key before placement", func(t *testing.T) {
		g, _ := groupKeyReadyFSMGK(t)
		admitGK(t, g, key, account, 1, "db0.x")
		restoreRefusedBothWays(t, g, forgedGK(t, g, func(doc map[string]any) {
			open(doc)["group_key"] = goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill
		}), prefix+"open block carries a group key without statements or before placement")
	})
}

// TestSnapshotBelowV21RefusesGroupSealFields: every group seal field is
// stage-3 state, which only a v21 container may carry (S3-E2 §46): an open
// block's, a header's or a verification record's field in a v20 container
// is refused before any rule reads it.
func TestSnapshotBelowV21RefusesGroupSealFields(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := tracksFSM(t)
	key, account := fixedClient(t)
	admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 1, 0)
	tracked := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	admitTrack(t, f, key, account, 2, 0)
	data := snapshotBytes(t, f)
	if data[4] != snapshotVersionV20 {
		t.Fatalf("the tracks fixture writes v%d, want v20", data[4])
	}
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(doc map[string]any){
		"open block group_key": func(doc map[string]any) {
			doc["open_block"].(map[string]any)["group_key"] = goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill
		},
		"open block group_members": func(doc map[string]any) { doc["open_block"].(map[string]any)["group_members"] = []any{"member-1"} },
		"open block group_fill":    func(doc map[string]any) { doc["open_block"].(map[string]any)["group_fill"] = true },
		"header group_key": func(doc map[string]any) {
			docBlockGK(doc, tracked)["track"].(map[string]any)["group_key"] = goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill
		},
		"verification group_key":     func(doc map[string]any) { docVerificationGK(doc, tracked)["group_key"] = goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill },
		"verification group_members": func(doc map[string]any) { docVerificationGK(doc, tracked)["group_members"] = []any{"member-1"} },
		"verification group_fill":    func(doc map[string]any) { docVerificationGK(doc, tracked)["group_fill"] = true },
		"verification group_databases": func(doc map[string]any) {
			docVerificationGK(doc, tracked)["group_databases"] = []any{map[string]any{"database_id": "db0", "generation": 1}}
		},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			restoreRefusedBothWays(t, f, rewriteSnapshotDocument(t, data, snapshotVersionV20, mutate), "stage3 state is present in a pre-v21 container")
		})
	}
}

// TestRestoreRefusesATransitionChangeOutsideItsRecordedGroups: restore
// requires every table a keyed transition block changes to belong to one of
// its recorded groups.
func TestRestoreRefusesATransitionChangeOutsideItsRecordedGroups(t *testing.T) {
	f := keyedTransitionFSMGK(t)
	seq := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	table := f.st.Blocks[seq-1].TableSetTransition.Adds[0].TableID
	other := "db0"
	if strings.HasPrefix(table, "db0.") {
		other = "db1"
	}
	data := forgedGK(t, f, func(doc map[string]any) {
		docVerificationGK(doc, seq)["group_databases"] = []any{map[string]any{"database_id": other, "generation": 1}}
	})
	restoreRefusedBothWays(t, f, data, fmt.Sprintf("snapshot stage3 seal keys: transition block %d changes %q outside its recorded groups", seq, table))
}
```

```go
package fsm

import (

// keyedTransitionFSMGK is the group-key fixture with member-1 ready in
// indexer 0's group of db1, so db0 and db1 have different keys, and one
// committed add in each: db0.z and db1.w.
func keyedTransitionFSMGK(t *testing.T) *FSM {
	t.Helper()
	f, _ := groupKeyFSMGK(t)
	f = readyGK(t, f, 0, "db1", stage3TestMember(1))
	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db0", "z", ev(154, "0x154", 0), ev(155, "0x155", 0), 0))
	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db1", "w", ev(156, "0x156", 0), ev(157, "0x157", 0), 0))
	return f
}

// TestTransitionBlocksCarryOneKeysChanges: spec §7.1, S3-E1 K62. After the
// placement switch a transition block carries one (owner, key)'s changes:
// the first key (keys of one owner in string order) seals alone, its header
// names the key, and its verification records the key's members, fill and
// the databases of its changes.
func TestTransitionBlocksCarryOneKeysChanges(t *testing.T) {
	f := keyedTransitionFSMGK(t)
	ready := mustGroupKeyGK(t, []string{stage3TestMember(1)}, true)
	keys, changes := f.pendingTableSetChangesBySealKeyLocked()
	want := []SealKey{{0, goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill}, {0, ready}}
	if strings.Compare(want[1].GroupKey, want[0].GroupKey) < 0 {
		want[0], want[1] = want[1], want[0]
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(keys, want) {
		t.Fatalf("seal keys = %+v, want %+v", keys, want)
	}
	tables := map[string]string{goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill: "db0.z", ready: "db1.w"}
	databases := map[string]string{goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill: "db0", ready: "db1"}
	members := map[string][]string{goldenGroupKeyNoMembersFill: nil, ready: {stage3TestMember(1)}}
	for _, k := range keys {
		c := changes[k]
		if len(c.adds) != 1 || c.adds[0].Key() != tables[k.GroupKey] || c.seal == nil || c.seal.Key != k.GroupKey ||
			!reflect.DeepEqual(c.seal.Databases, []GroupRef{{databases[k.GroupKey], 1}}) {
			t.Fatalf("changes of %+v = %+v / %+v", k, c, c.seal)
		}
	}
	first := keys[0].GroupKey
	seq := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	h := f.st.Blocks[seq-1]
	if h.Track == nil || h.Track.IndexerID != 0 || h.Track.GroupKey != first || len(h.TableSetTransition.Adds) != 1 ||
		h.TableSetTransition.Adds[0].TableID != tables[first] || len(h.TableSetTransition.Retires) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("transition = %+v / %+v, want %s alone under %s", h.Track, h.TableSetTransition, tables[first], first)
	}
	requireKeyedGK(t, f, seq, first, members[first], []GroupRef{{databases[first], 1}})
	if got := f.BlockSealReasons()[SealReasonTransition]; got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("transition seals = %d on the restored FSM", got)
	}
	restoresGK(t, f)
}

// TestOneUnpublishedTransitionPerTrackAcrossKeys: a track holds at most one
// unpublished transition block whatever its key, so the second key's
// change waits for the first one's publication and then seals under its own
// key.
func TestOneUnpublishedTransitionPerTrackAcrossKeys(t *testing.T) {
	f := keyedTransitionFSMGK(t)
	keys, _ := f.pendingTableSetChangesBySealKeyLocked()
	first := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	if want := fmt.Sprintf("table-set transition block %d of indexer 0 is not yet published", first); f.tableSetTransitionBlockedLocked() != want {
		t.Fatalf("plan = %q, want %q", f.tableSetTransitionBlockedLocked(), want)
	}
	if f.TableSetTransitionPending() || f.TableSetTransitionUnsealable() != "" {
		t.Fatal("the second key's change only waits")
	}
	if r := applyExpectReject(t, f, wire.Command{SealL3Block: &wire.SealL3Block{}}); r.Reason != "open block is empty" {
		t.Fatalf("seal while waiting = %q", r.Reason)
	}
	// A track-aware publication (stood in for, as TestOneUnpublishedTransitionPerTrack does).
	setPublishedTrackFrontiers(t, f, replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 0, SafeBlockSeq: first}, replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 1, SafeBlockSeq: 1})
	second := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	if h := f.st.Blocks[second-1]; h.Track == nil || h.Track.GroupKey != keys[1].GroupKey || h.Track.GroupKey == f.st.Blocks[first-1].Track.GroupKey {
		t.Fatalf("second transition track = %+v, want the other key %s", h.Track, keys[1].GroupKey)
	}
}

// every key is the owner alone, so one block carries both databases'
// changes of indexer 0 with a keyless track and no group seal.
func TestTransitionPlanIsUnchangedBeforePlacement(t *testing.T) {

	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db0", "z", ev(154, "0x154", 0), ev(155, "0x155", 0), 0))
	mustApply(t, f, ownedAddCmd(t, f, "db1", "w", ev(156, "0x156", 0), ev(157, "0x157", 0), 0))

	h := f.st.Blocks[seq-1]
	if h.Track == nil || *h.Track != (L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 0}) || len(h.TableSetTransition.Adds) != 2 ||
		h.TableSetTransition.Adds[0].TableID != "db0.z" || h.TableSetTransition.Adds[1].TableID != "db1.w" {

	}
	requireKeylessGK(t, f, seq)
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Create the group key**

Create `fsm/group_key.go`:

```go
package fsm

import (
	"cmp"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
)

// GroupKeyDomain is the replay.CanonicalDigest domain of a group key
// (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §7.1, plan S3-E3 contract §51).
const GroupKeyDomain = "arbiter-group-key-v1"

// groupKeyPreimage is what GroupKey hashes. Its JSON form is frozen by
// fsm/l3_group_key_golden_test.go: the key enters the chain hash of every
// block sealed after the placement cutover, and that hash is anchored on L2.
type groupKeyPreimage struct {
	Members     []string `json:"members"`
	NetworkFill bool     `json:"network_fill"`
}

// GroupKey hashes the sorted ready verify members and the fill flag. A nil
// or empty list hashes as []; an unsorted or repeated list is refused.
func GroupKey(members []string, networkFill bool) (string, error) {
	for i, m := range members {
		if m == "" || (i > 0 && members[i-1] >= m) {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("group key: members must be sorted, unique, non-empty node ids, got %q", members)
		}
	}
	if members == nil {
		members = []string{}
	}
	return replay.CanonicalDigest(GroupKeyDomain, groupKeyPreimage{Members: members, NetworkFill: networkFill})
}

// GroupRef names one database group a block was sealed under, at the
// generation the group had then (S3-E1 K62).
type GroupRef struct {
	DatabaseID string `json:"database_id"`
	Generation uint64 `json:"generation"`
}

// GroupSeal is the group record a block is sealed and verified under.
type GroupSeal struct {
	Key       string
	Members   []string // the ready verify members the key hashes, sorted
	Fill      bool
	Databases []GroupRef // sorted by DatabaseID
}

// SealKey is what the open block and the grouping window key on (spec §7.1,
// §7.2): the owner and, from the placement switch on, the group key of the
// statement's database.
type SealKey struct {
	Owner    uint64
	GroupKey string // "" before placement and for a database without a group
}

// compareSealKeys orders seal keys by owner, then group key.
func compareSealKeys(a, b SealKey) int {
	if c := cmp.Compare(a.Owner, b.Owner); c != 0 {
		return c
	}
	return strings.Compare(a.GroupKey, b.GroupKey)
}

// SealReason is why the FSM sealed a block, the label of
// arbiter_block_seal_reason.
type SealReason string

const (
	SealReasonRequested        SealReason = "requested"         // a SealL3Block command with statements (orchestrator size or age)
	SealReasonTransition       SealReason = "transition"        // a table-set transition block
	SealReasonSnapshotQuery    SealReason = "snapshot_query"    // a snapshot-query block
	SealReasonOwnerSwitch      SealReason = "owner_switch"      // admission: a statement of another owner
	SealReasonGroupSwitch      SealReason = "group_switch"      // admission: same owner, another group key (spec §7.2)
	SealReasonKeyChange        SealReason = "key_change"        // RebalanceGroup, MemberReady or a params update sealed first
	SealReasonPlacementCutover SealReason = "placement_cutover" // the placement switch-on
)

// SealReasons lists every reason in export order.
var SealReasons = []SealReason{SealReasonRequested, SealReasonTransition, SealReasonSnapshotQuery, SealReasonOwnerSwitch, SealReasonGroupSwitch, SealReasonKeyChange, SealReasonPlacementCutover}

// sealReasonCounter counts the blocks this replica's FSM sealed since process
// start, by reason. Like registryWake it is node-local: it is never
// snapshotted, Restore does not reset it, and no Apply decision reads it, so
// it cannot affect determinism. The zero value is ready to use.
type sealReasonCounter struct {
	mu sync.Mutex
	n  map[SealReason]uint64
}

func (c *sealReasonCounter) add(reason SealReason) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if c.n == nil {
		c.n = make(map[SealReason]uint64, len(SealReasons))
	}
	c.n[reason]++
}

func (c *sealReasonCounter) snapshot() map[SealReason]uint64 {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	out := make(map[SealReason]uint64, len(SealReasons))
	for _, reason := range SealReasons {
		out[reason] = c.n[reason]
	}
	return out
}

// BlockSealReasons returns a copy of the seal counts with every reason of
// SealReasons present, zeros included. It takes no FSM lock: the counter has
// its own.
func (f *FSM) BlockSealReasons() map[SealReason]uint64 {
	return f.sealReasons.snapshot()
}

// readyVerifyMembersLocked lists, sorted, the members of g that declared
// readiness (ReadyGeneration != 0) and whose node is listed in verifiers
// with verify (spec §7.1). It reads no node status, so an eviction never
// changes a key (clarification K73), and Leaving records never count.
func (f *FSM) readyVerifyMembersLocked(g *DatabaseGroup, verifiers []arbiter.VerifierEntry) []string {
	return readyVerifyMembers(g, verifiers)
}

// groupSealLocked is g's seal under the verifiers listing verifiers: its key
// over the ready verify members and its fill flag, and g at its generation.
func (f *FSM) groupSealLocked(g *DatabaseGroup, verifiers []arbiter.VerifierEntry) (GroupSeal, error) {
	return groupSealOf(g, verifiers)
}

// readyVerifyMembers and groupSealOf are the state-only halves of the two
// methods above, which restore validation calls on a decoded State.
func readyVerifyMembers(g *DatabaseGroup, verifiers []arbiter.VerifierEntry) []string {
	var out []string
	for _, m := range g.Members {
		if m.ReadyGeneration == 0 {
			continue
		}
		for _, v := range verifiers {
			if v.NodeID == m.NodeID {
				if v.Verify {
					out = append(out, m.NodeID)
				}
				break
			}
		}
	}
	slices.Sort(out)
	return out
}

func groupSealOf(g *DatabaseGroup, verifiers []arbiter.VerifierEntry) (GroupSeal, error) {
	members := readyVerifyMembers(g, verifiers)
	key, err := GroupKey(members, g.NetworkFill)
	if err != nil {
		return GroupSeal{}, err
	}
	return GroupSeal{Key: key, Members: members, Fill: g.NetworkFill, Databases: []GroupRef{{DatabaseID: g.DatabaseID, Generation: g.Generation}}}, nil
}

// currentGroupSealLocked is the seal of owner's group of database under the
// committed verifiers listing, or nil while the placement switch is off and
// for a database without a group.
func (f *FSM) currentGroupSealLocked(owner uint64, database string) (*GroupSeal, error) {
	if !f.placementOnLocked() {
		return nil, nil
	}
	g := f.groupLocked(owner, database)
	if g == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	seal, err := f.groupSealLocked(g, f.st.Params.Verifiers)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &seal, nil
}

// groupSeal is the detached group seal bv's block was sealed and is verified
// under, or nil for a block sealed without a group key.
func (bv *BlockVerification) groupSeal() *GroupSeal {
	if bv == nil || bv.GroupKey == "" {
		return nil
	}
	return &GroupSeal{Key: bv.GroupKey, Members: cloneStrings(bv.GroupMembers), Fill: bv.GroupFill, Databases: slices.Clone(bv.GroupDatabases)}
}

// groupSeal is the detached group seal the open block's statements were
// admitted under, or nil while it has no group key. Its Databases stay empty:
// commitSealLocked records them, with each group's generation, when the
// block seals.
func (ob *OpenL3Block) groupSeal() *GroupSeal {
	if ob == nil || ob.GroupKey == "" {
		return nil
	}
	return &GroupSeal{Key: ob.GroupKey, Members: cloneStrings(ob.GroupMembers), Fill: ob.GroupFill}
}

// statementDatabase is the database of a v2 statement's target table: the
// part of its <database>.<table> key before the first '.', which every
// incarnation of the key records as its DatabaseID (AddTable refuses a
// dotted id, and genesis ids are split at the first '.').
func statementDatabase(ss *StatementState) (string, bool) {
	db, _, ok := splitTableKey(ss.Env.TargetTableID)
	return db, ok
}

// blockGroupRefsLocked lists, sorted by database, every distinct database of
// the statements seqs with the current generation of owner's group of it
// (S3-E1 K62).
func (f *FSM) blockGroupRefsLocked(owner uint64, seqs []uint64) []GroupRef {
	var databases []string
	for _, seq := range seqs {
		if ss := f.st.Statements[seq]; ss != nil {
			if db, ok := statementDatabase(ss); ok {
				databases = append(databases, db)
			}
		}
	}
	slices.Sort(databases)
	databases = slices.Compact(databases)
	refs := make([]GroupRef, 0, len(databases))
	for _, db := range databases {
		ref := GroupRef{DatabaseID: db}
		if g := f.groupLocked(owner, db); g != nil {
			ref.Generation = g.Generation
		}
		refs = append(refs, ref)
	}
	return refs
}

// openBlockKeyChangesLocked reports whether, under the verifiers listing
// verifiers, the key of the group of a database of the open block's
// statements differs from the open block's key. An open block without an
// owner, or one holding a database without a group (restore refuses both),
// counts as changed, so the update seals it first or is refused when that
// seal cannot be prepared.
func (f *FSM) openBlockKeyChangesLocked(verifiers []arbiter.VerifierEntry) (bool, error) {
	ob := f.st.OpenBlock
	if ob.Owner == nil {
		return true, nil
	}
	for _, db := range f.openBlockDatabasesLocked() {
		g := f.groupLocked(*ob.Owner, db)
		if g == nil {
			return true, nil
		}
		seal, err := f.groupSealLocked(g, verifiers)
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		if seal.Key != ob.GroupKey {
			return true, nil
		}
	}
	return false, nil
}

// consensusUpdateSealLocked prepares, before any mutation, the seal a
// consensus update that commits next applies first (spec §7.1, clarification
// C10); applyUpdateConsensusParams commits it right after the new parameters
// are in place. The update that turns the placement switch on seals a
// non-empty open block under no key and records the cutover (cutover is true
// even for an empty open block). Once placement is on, an update under whose
// verifiers listing the key of a database of the open block's statements
// differs from the open block's key seals it first. Any other update returns
// a nil seal. refusal is the Rejected reason when the seal cannot be prepared.
func (f *FSM) consensusUpdateSealLocked(next Params) (seal *preparedSeal, reason SealReason, cutover bool, refusal string) {
	ob := f.st.OpenBlock
	switch {
	case !f.placementOnLocked() && stage3SwitchValue(next.Stage3, Stage3SwitchPlacement):
		if len(ob.StatementSeqs) == 0 {
			return nil, "", true, ""
		}
		p, why := f.prepareStatementSealLocked(f.spentIDsRootLocked())
		if why != "" {
			return nil, "", false, "consensus update: placement cutover seal: " + why
		}
		return p, SealReasonPlacementCutover, true, ""
	case f.placementOnLocked() && len(ob.StatementSeqs) != 0:
		changed, err := f.openBlockKeyChangesLocked(next.Verifiers)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, "", false, "consensus update: group key change seal: " + err.Error()
		}
		if !changed {
			return nil, "", false, ""
		}
		p, why := f.prepareStatementSealLocked(f.spentIDsRootLocked())
		if why != "" {
			return nil, "", false, "consensus update: group key change seal: " + why
		}
		return p, SealReasonKeyChange, false, ""
	}
	return nil, "", false, ""
}

// groupSealFieldsPresent reports a verification record carrying any group
// seal field; stage3FieldsPresent refuses one under a pre-v21 version byte.
func groupSealFieldsPresent(bv *BlockVerification) bool {
	return bv != nil && (bv.GroupKey != "" || len(bv.GroupMembers) != 0 || bv.GroupFill || len(bv.GroupDatabases) != 0)
}

// openBlockGroupFieldsPresent reports an open block carrying any group seal
// field.
func openBlockGroupFieldsPresent(ob *OpenL3Block) bool {
	return ob != nil && (ob.GroupKey != "" || len(ob.GroupMembers) != 0 || ob.GroupFill)
}

// groupRefsSortedAndUnique reports a non-empty list of named databases in
// strictly ascending order.
func groupRefsSortedAndUnique(refs []GroupRef) bool {
	if len(refs) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	for i, r := range refs {
		if r.DatabaseID == "" || (i > 0 && refs[i-1].DatabaseID >= r.DatabaseID) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// groupRefsHold reports whether the sorted refs name database.
func groupRefsHold(refs []GroupRef, database string) bool {
	_, found := slices.BinarySearchFunc(refs, database, func(r GroupRef, db string) int { return strings.Compare(r.DatabaseID, db) })
	return found
}
```

```go
func (f *FSM) prepareStatementSealLocked(spentIDsRoot string) (*preparedSeal, string) {
```

```go
// commitSealLocked applies a prepared seal: it stamps the sealed statements,
// collects the block's source union (sorted, deduped), appends the header and
// its BlockVerification, advances NextL3BlockSeq, opens an empty block without
// an owner at NextStatementSeq and emits EventBlockSealed.
func (f *FSM) commitSealLocked(p *preparedSeal) SealResult {
	hdr := p.header
	srcSet := map[string]bool{}
	for _, seq := range p.seqs {
		ss := f.st.Statements[seq]
		ss.BlockSeq = hdr.L3BlockSeq
		if ss.SourceNode != "" {
			srcSet[ss.SourceNode] = true
		}
	}
	sources := make([]string, 0, len(srcSet))
	for s := range srcSet {
		sources = append(sources, s)
	}
	sort.Strings(sources)
	f.st.Blocks = append(f.st.Blocks, hdr)
	f.st.Verifications[hdr.L3BlockSeq] = &BlockVerification{
		BlockSeq:     hdr.L3BlockSeq,
		SourceNodes:  sources,
		Attestations: map[string]*replay.ReplayAttestation{},
		ByteScans:    map[string]*arbiter.ByteSideScanMsg{},
	}
	f.st.NextL3BlockSeq++
	f.st.OpenBlock = &OpenL3Block{StatementSeqStart: f.st.NextStatementSeq}
	f.emit(Event{Kind: EventBlockSealed, BlockSeq: hdr.L3BlockSeq})
	return SealResult{BlockSeq: hdr.L3BlockSeq, ChainHash: p.chainHash}
}
```

```go
// commitSealLocked applies a prepared seal: it stamps the sealed statements,
// collects the block's source union (sorted, deduped), appends the header and
// its BlockVerification (with the prepared group seal and every database of
// the block at its group's current generation once placement is on),
// advances NextL3BlockSeq, opens an empty block without an owner or group key
// at NextStatementSeq, counts reason and emits EventBlockSealed.
func (f *FSM) commitSealLocked(p *preparedSeal, reason SealReason) SealResult {
	hdr := p.header
	srcSet := map[string]bool{}
	for _, seq := range p.seqs {
		ss := f.st.Statements[seq]
		ss.BlockSeq = hdr.L3BlockSeq
		if ss.SourceNode != "" {
			srcSet[ss.SourceNode] = true
		}
	}
	sources := make([]string, 0, len(srcSet))
	for s := range srcSet {
		sources = append(sources, s)
	}
	sort.Strings(sources)
	f.st.Blocks = append(f.st.Blocks, hdr)
	bv := &BlockVerification{
		BlockSeq:     hdr.L3BlockSeq,
		SourceNodes:  sources,
		Attestations: map[string]*replay.ReplayAttestation{},
		ByteScans:    map[string]*arbiter.ByteSideScanMsg{},
	}
	if g := p.group; g != nil {
		bv.GroupKey, bv.GroupMembers, bv.GroupFill = g.Key, cloneStrings(g.Members), g.Fill
		bv.GroupDatabases = f.blockGroupRefsLocked(hdr.Track.IndexerID, p.seqs)
	}
	f.st.Verifications[hdr.L3BlockSeq] = bv
	f.st.NextL3BlockSeq++
	f.st.OpenBlock = &OpenL3Block{StatementSeqStart: f.st.NextStatementSeq}
	f.sealReasons.add(reason)
	f.emit(Event{Kind: EventBlockSealed, BlockSeq: hdr.L3BlockSeq})
	return SealResult{BlockSeq: hdr.L3BlockSeq, ChainHash: p.chainHash}
}
```

```go
// tableSetChanges is one owner's share of the committed change set.
type tableSetChanges struct {
	adds, retires []*TableIncarnation
}

// pendingTableSetChangesByOwnerLocked groups pendingTableSetChangesLocked by
// incarnationOwnerLocked (spec 2026-10-10 §7.1): the owners in ascending id
// order, each owner's adds and retires in table-key order.
func (f *FSM) pendingTableSetChangesByOwnerLocked() ([]uint64, map[uint64]*tableSetChanges) {
	adds, retires := pendingTableSetChangesLocked(f.st.TableRegistry)
	byOwner := map[uint64]*tableSetChanges{}
	changesOf := func(inc *TableIncarnation) *tableSetChanges {
		owner := f.incarnationOwnerLocked(inc)
		c := byOwner[owner]
		if c == nil {
			c = &tableSetChanges{}
			byOwner[owner] = c
		}
		return c
	}
	for _, inc := range adds {
		c := changesOf(inc)
		c.adds = append(c.adds, inc)
	}
	for _, inc := range retires {
		c := changesOf(inc)
		c.retires = append(c.retires, inc)
	}
	return slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(byOwner)), byOwner
}
```

with:

```go
// tableSetChanges is one seal key's share of the committed change set.
type tableSetChanges struct {
	adds, retires []*TableIncarnation
	// seal is, once the placement switch is on, the group seal the block of
	// these changes is sealed under: their common key with its members and
	// fill, and every database of the changes with its group's generation,
	// sorted (S3-E1 K62). nil before placement.
	seal *GroupSeal
	// refusal is why these changes cannot be sealed, "" when they can: a
	// database without a group while placement is on, which restore makes
	// unreachable.
	refusal string
}

// addGroup merges one change's group seal into c.seal.
func (c *tableSetChanges) addGroup(seal *GroupSeal) {
	if c.seal == nil {
		c.seal = &GroupSeal{Key: seal.Key, Members: cloneStrings(seal.Members), Fill: seal.Fill}
	}
	for _, ref := range seal.Databases {
		if !slices.ContainsFunc(c.seal.Databases, func(r GroupRef) bool { return r.DatabaseID == ref.DatabaseID }) {
			c.seal.Databases = append(c.seal.Databases, ref)
		}
	}
	slices.SortFunc(c.seal.Databases, func(a, b GroupRef) int { return strings.Compare(a.DatabaseID, b.DatabaseID) })
}

// pendingTableSetChangesBySealKeyLocked groups pendingTableSetChangesLocked by
// seal key (spec 2026-10-10 §7.1, spec 2026-10-14 §7.1): the owner
// (incarnationOwnerLocked) and, once the placement switch is on, the current
// key of the group of the change's database. Keys are sorted by owner, then
// group key; each key's adds and retires are in table-key order. Before
// placement every key is the owner alone, so this is the grouping by owner.
func (f *FSM) pendingTableSetChangesBySealKeyLocked() ([]SealKey, map[SealKey]*tableSetChanges) {
	adds, retires := pendingTableSetChangesLocked(f.st.TableRegistry)
	byKey := map[SealKey]*tableSetChanges{}
	changesOf := func(inc *TableIncarnation) *tableSetChanges {
		key := SealKey{Owner: f.incarnationOwnerLocked(inc)}
		seal, err := f.currentGroupSealLocked(key.Owner, inc.DatabaseID)
		refusal := ""
		switch {
		case err != nil:
			refusal = fmt.Sprintf("database %q: %v", inc.DatabaseID, err)
		case seal != nil:
			key.GroupKey = seal.Key
		case f.placementOnLocked():
			refusal = fmt.Sprintf("database %q has no group", inc.DatabaseID)
		}
		c := byKey[key]
		if c == nil {
			c = &tableSetChanges{}
			byKey[key] = c
		}
		if c.refusal == "" {
			c.refusal = refusal
		}
		if seal != nil {
			c.addGroup(seal)
		}
		return c
	}
	for _, inc := range adds {
		c := changesOf(inc)
		c.adds = append(c.adds, inc)
	}
	for _, inc := range retires {
		c := changesOf(inc)
		c.retires = append(c.retires, inc)
	}
	return slices.SortedFunc(maps.Keys(byKey), compareSealKeys), byKey
}
```

```go
// plannedTrackTransitionLocked is plannedTableSetTransitionLocked after the
// tracks activation (spec 2026-10-10 §7.1-§7.2). A transition block carries
// one owner's changes and each track holds at most one unpublished
// transition block, so a stuck track never holds back another owner's change.
// The plan is for the lowest owner id that has changes, no transition block of
// its own its published frontier does not cover, and a change set that
// applies to the published base every block pins; a transition's
// new_schema_root is therefore always relative to that pinned base
// (clarification C1). When no owner can seal, the lowest owner whose change
// set does not fit the base is reported as unsealable; otherwise the reason
// names the lowest owner that waits for its own transition's publication.
func (f *FSM) plannedTrackTransitionLocked() (*tableSetTransitionPlan, string, bool) {
	owners, changes := f.pendingTableSetChangesByOwnerLocked()
	if len(owners) == 0 {
		return nil, "table registry has no unsealed table-set change", false
	}
	// The activation needs an idle barrier and BeginSnapshotQuery is refused
	// after it (clarification C7), so this only keeps the pre-activation rule
	// as a guard.
	if f.snapshotQueryBarrierFencesAdmission() {
		return nil, snapshotQueryAdmissionFencedReason, false
	}
	base := f.st.Manifests[f.st.SafeWatermark.SnapshotID]
	if base == nil || base.StateRoot == "" {
		return nil, "genesis safe snapshot must be published before sealing", true
	}
	waiting, unfit := "", ""
	for _, owner := range owners {
		if seq, ok := f.unpublishedTrackTransitionLocked(owner); ok {
			if waiting == "" {
				waiting = fmt.Sprintf("table-set transition block %d of indexer %d is not yet published", seq, owner)
			}
			continue
		}
		c := changes[owner]
		transition := newTableSetTransition(c.adds, c.retires)
		next, err := transition.resultSet(manifestSchemaSet(base))
		if err != nil {
			if unfit == "" {
				unfit = fmt.Sprintf("table-set transition of indexer %d: %v", owner, err)
			}
			continue
		}
		planned := owner
		return &tableSetTransitionPlan{transition: transition, adds: c.adds, retires: c.retires, next: next, owner: &planned}, "", false
	}
	if unfit != "" {
		return nil, unfit, true
	}
	return nil, waiting, false
}
```

with:

```go
// plannedTrackTransitionLocked is plannedTableSetTransitionLocked after the
// tracks activation (spec 2026-10-10 §7.1-§7.2, spec 2026-10-14 §7.1). A
// transition block carries one seal key's changes, one owner's and from the
// placement switch on one group key's, and each track holds at most one
// unpublished transition block, whatever its key, so a stuck track never holds
// back another owner's change. The plan is for the first seal key (owner,
// then group key) that has changes, no transition block of its owner's its
// published frontier does not cover, and a change set that applies to the
// published base every block pins; a transition's new_schema_root is
// therefore always relative to that pinned base (clarification C1). When no
// key can seal, the first one whose change set does not fit the base or has
// no group is reported as unsealable; otherwise the reason names the lowest
// owner that waits for its own transition's publication. Before placement
// every key is its owner alone, so the plan is the per-owner one.
func (f *FSM) plannedTrackTransitionLocked() (*tableSetTransitionPlan, string, bool) {
	keys, changes := f.pendingTableSetChangesBySealKeyLocked()
	if len(keys) == 0 {
		return nil, "table registry has no unsealed table-set change", false
	}
	// The activation needs an idle barrier and BeginSnapshotQuery is refused
	// after it (clarification C7), so this only keeps the pre-activation rule
	// as a guard.
	if f.snapshotQueryBarrierFencesAdmission() {
		return nil, snapshotQueryAdmissionFencedReason, false
	}
	base := f.st.Manifests[f.st.SafeWatermark.SnapshotID]
	if base == nil || base.StateRoot == "" {
		return nil, "genesis safe snapshot must be published before sealing", true
	}
	waiting, unfit := "", ""
	for _, key := range keys {
		owner := key.Owner
		if seq, ok := f.unpublishedTrackTransitionLocked(owner); ok {
			if waiting == "" {
				waiting = fmt.Sprintf("table-set transition block %d of indexer %d is not yet published", seq, owner)
			}
			continue
		}
		c := changes[key]
		if c.refusal != "" {
			if unfit == "" {
				unfit = fmt.Sprintf("table-set transition of indexer %d: %s", owner, c.refusal)
			}
			continue
		}
		transition := newTableSetTransition(c.adds, c.retires)
		next, err := transition.resultSet(manifestSchemaSet(base))
		if err != nil {
			if unfit == "" {
				unfit = fmt.Sprintf("table-set transition of indexer %d: %v", owner, err)
			}
			continue
		}
		planned := owner
		return &tableSetTransitionPlan{transition: transition, adds: c.adds, retires: c.retires, next: next, owner: &planned, seal: c.seal}, "", false
	}
	if unfit != "" {
		return nil, unfit, true
	}
	return nil, waiting, false
}
```

In `fsm/reads_tracks.go`, insert immediately before the comment `// TrackBlocks lists, ascending, the sealed blocks of track id in (after,` (`:109`, right after `TableOwner`):

```go
// TableSealKey is the seal key the grouping window orders tableID's
// submissions by (plan S3-E3 contract §51, spec 2026-10-14 §7.2): TableOwner's
// owner and, once the placement switch is on, the current key of the group
// of the live incarnation's database (empty for a database without a group).
// ok is false exactly when TableOwner's is. Like TableOwner it runs under the
// read lock only and never builds the derived key index.
func (f *FSM) TableSealKey(tableID string) (SealKey, bool) {
	f.mu.RLock()
	defer f.mu.RUnlock()
	if f.st.Params.TableRegistry == nil {
		return SealKey{}, false
	}
	inc := f.st.TableRegistry.liveReadOnly(tableID)
	if inc == nil {
		return SealKey{}, false
	}
	key := SealKey{Owner: f.incarnationOwnerLocked(inc)}
	if seal, err := f.currentGroupSealLocked(key.Owner, inc.DatabaseID); err == nil && seal != nil {
		key.GroupKey = seal.Key
	}
	return key, true
}
```
