and append to the end of `fsm/stage3_restore.go` (the file already imports `fmt` and `slices`):

```go
// validateStage3SealKeys checks the seal-key record against the rules Apply
// follows (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §7.1, plan S3-E3 contract §51): the
// placement cutover is recorded exactly while the switch is on and lies within
// the chain; no block at or below it carries a group key and every block above
// it does; a keyed block's verification record repeats the key, the members
// and fill it hashes and its databases, sorted, among which every retained
// statement's database and every table a transition changes; and an open
// block holding statements after placement carries the current seal of each
// of its databases' groups. Statements no longer retained are skipped.
func validateStage3SealKeys(st *State) error {
	refuse := func(format string, args ...any) error {
		return fmt.Errorf("snapshot stage3 seal keys: "+format, args...)
	}
	on := stage3SwitchValue(st.Params.Stage3, Stage3SwitchPlacement)
	var recorded *uint64
	if st.Stage3 != nil {
		recorded = st.Stage3.PlacementCutoverBlock
	}
	switch {
	case recorded != nil && !on:
		return refuse("placement cutover is recorded while the placement switch is off")
	case recorded == nil && on:
		return refuse("placement switch is on without a recorded cutover")
	case recorded != nil && *recorded > uint64(len(st.Blocks)):
		return refuse("placement cutover %d is beyond the last sealed block %d", *recorded, len(st.Blocks))
	}
	var cutover uint64
	if recorded != nil {
		cutover = *recorded
	}
	for seq := uint64(1); seq <= uint64(len(st.Blocks)); seq++ {
		h := &st.Blocks[seq-1]
		key := ""
		if h.Track != nil {
			key = h.Track.GroupKey
		}
		switch {
		case !on && key != "":
			return refuse("block %d carries group_key while the placement switch is off", seq)
		case on && seq <= cutover && key != "":
			return refuse("block %d at or below the placement cutover %d carries group_key", seq, cutover)
		case on && seq > cutover && key == "":
			return refuse("block %d after the placement cutover %d has no group_key", seq, cutover)
		}
		bv := st.Verifications[seq]
		if bv == nil {
			continue // validateLatchedConsensus refuses a block without its record
		}
		if key == "" {
			if groupSealFieldsPresent(bv) {
				return refuse("block %d without group_key carries group seal fields", seq)
			}
			continue
		}
		if bv.GroupKey != key {
			return refuse("block %d group_key differs from its verification record", seq)
		}
		if k, err := GroupKey(bv.GroupMembers, bv.GroupFill); err != nil || k != key {
			return refuse("block %d group_key differs from its recorded members and fill", seq)
		}
		if !groupRefsSortedAndUnique(bv.GroupDatabases) {
			return refuse("block %d recorded groups are empty, unsorted or repeated", seq)
		}
		if t := h.TableSetTransition; t != nil {
			changed := make([]string, 0, len(t.Adds)+len(t.Retires))
			for _, add := range t.Adds {
				changed = append(changed, add.TableID)
			}
			changed = append(changed, t.Retires...)
			for _, table := range changed {
				if db, _, ok := splitTableKey(table); !ok || !groupRefsHold(bv.GroupDatabases, db) {
					return refuse("transition block %d changes %q outside its recorded groups", seq, table)
				}
			}
			continue
		}
		for i := uint64(0); i < uint64(h.StatementCount); i++ {
			ss := st.Statements[h.StatementSeqStart+i]
			if ss == nil {
				continue
			}
			if db, ok := statementDatabase(ss); !ok || !groupRefsHold(bv.GroupDatabases, db) {
				return refuse("block %d statement %d of database %q is outside its recorded groups", seq, ss.Seq, db)
			}
		}
	}
	ob := st.OpenBlock
	if ob == nil {
		return nil
	}
	switch {
	case openBlockGroupFieldsPresent(ob) && (len(ob.StatementSeqs) == 0 || !on):
		return refuse("open block carries a group key without statements or before placement")
	case !on || len(ob.StatementSeqs) == 0:
		return nil
	case ob.GroupKey == "":
		return refuse("open block holds statements after placement without a group key")
	case ob.Owner == nil:
		return nil // validateTrackState refuses a statement-holding open block without an owner
	}
	var databases []string
	for _, seq := range ob.StatementSeqs {
		if ss := st.Statements[seq]; ss != nil {
			if db, ok := statementDatabase(ss); ok {
				databases = append(databases, db)
			}
		}
	}
	slices.Sort(databases)
	for _, db := range slices.Compact(databases) {
		var g *DatabaseGroup
		for _, candidate := range st.Stage3.Groups {
			if candidate.Owner == *ob.Owner && candidate.DatabaseID == db {
				g = candidate
				break
			}
		}
		if g == nil {
			return refuse("open block group key differs from the current key of database %q", db)
		}
		seal, err := groupSealOf(g, st.Params.Verifiers)
		if err != nil || seal.Key != ob.GroupKey || seal.Fill != ob.GroupFill || !slices.Equal(seal.Members, ob.GroupMembers) {
			return refuse("open block group key differs from the current key of database %q", db)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
```

```go
package server

import (
	"math/rand/v2"
	"slices"
	"testing"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// sealKeysOf resolves a table to its seal key from keys; a table it does not
// name is unresolvable.
func sealKeysOf(keys map[string]fsm.SealKey) func(string) (fsm.SealKey, bool) {
	return func(table string) (fsm.SealKey, bool) {
		k, ok := keys[table]
		return k, ok
	}
}

// TestOrderBySealKeyGroupsByOwnerAndKey: plan S3-E3 contract §51, spec
// 2026-10-14 §7.2. The window orders by the whole seal key: keys in the order
// of their first held submission, two keys of one owner apart, arrival order
// within a key, unresolvable tables last. With every group key empty it is
// orderByOwner's order, which stays a wrapper of it.
func TestOrderBySealKeyGroupsByOwnerAndKey(t *testing.T) {
	keys := map[string]fsm.SealKey{
		"a": {Owner: 2, GroupKey: "0xk1"}, "b": {Owner: 2, GroupKey: "0xk2"}, "c": {Owner: 2, GroupKey: "0xk1"},
		"d": {Owner: 0, GroupKey: "0xk1"}, "e": {Owner: 2, GroupKey: "0xk2"},
	}
	batch := []*heldSubmission{{tableID: "a"}, {tableID: "b"}, {tableID: "x"}, {tableID: "d"}, {tableID: "c"}, {tableID: "e"}, {tableID: "a"}}
	want := []*heldSubmission{batch[0], batch[4], batch[6], batch[1], batch[5], batch[3], batch[2]}
	if got := orderBySealKey(batch, sealKeysOf(keys)); !slices.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("order = %v, want %v", heldNames(got), heldNames(want))
	}
	owners := map[string]uint64{"a": 2, "b": 2, "c": 2, "d": 0, "e": 2}
	owner := func(table string) (uint64, bool) {
		id, ok := owners[table]
		return id, ok
	}
	ownerKeys := map[string]fsm.SealKey{}
	for table, id := range owners {
		ownerKeys[table] = fsm.SealKey{Owner: id}
	}
	rng := rand.New(rand.NewPCG(72, 1))
	tables := []string{"a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "x"}
	subjects := []string{"", "u", "v"}
	for round := 0; round < 200; round++ {
		var batch []*heldSubmission
		for i := 0; i < 1+rng.IntN(9); i++ {
			batch = append(batch, laneHeld(tables[rng.IntN(len(tables))], subjects[rng.IntN(len(subjects))]))
		}
		if got, want := orderBySealKey(batch, sealKeysOf(ownerKeys)), orderByOwner(batch, owner); !slices.Equal(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("owner-only keys order %v, orderByOwner %v", heldNames(got), heldNames(want))
		}
	}
}

// TestOrderBySealKeyKeepsLaneOrderAcrossKeys: the lane rule is unchanged
// with keys: a submission never moves ahead of an earlier submission of its
// own client lane, also when the lane spans two keys of one owner, and the
// key order resumes after the pulled submission.
func TestOrderBySealKeyKeepsLaneOrderAcrossKeys(t *testing.T) {
	keys := map[string]fsm.SealKey{"a": {Owner: 1, GroupKey: "0xk1"}, "b": {Owner: 1, GroupKey: "0xk2"}}
```

```go
package server

import (
	"slices"
	"testing"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// The group key of plan S3-E3 Task 72's golden vectors
// (fsm/l3_group_key_golden_test.go: members member-b and member-c, fill on).
const servedGroupKey = "0x7cafb3ca53aac2ccec03f3358f69857cab98263df5fb4e4395ddc3b9c5107b7a"

// l3HeaderWithGroupKeyFromPB is l3HeaderWithTrackFromPB that also reads the
// track's group key.
func l3HeaderWithGroupKeyFromPB(m *pb.L3BlockHeader) fsm.L3BlockHeader {
	h := l3HeaderWithTrackFromPB(m)
	if tr := m.GetTrack(); tr != nil {
		h.Track.GroupKey = tr.GetGroupKey()
	}
	return h
}

// TestL3HeaderWireFormCarriesTheGroupKey: GetL3Block copies a keyed header's
// group key (L3BlockTrack.group_key, field 2), so an auditor recomputes the
// chain hash of a block sealed after the placement cutover from the proto
// alone; a keyless header sends an empty key and hashes as before.
func TestL3HeaderWireFormCarriesTheGroupKey(t *testing.T) {
	base := fsm.L3BlockHeader{L3BlockSeq: 7, PrevL3Hash: "0xprev", StatementSeqStart: 12, StatementCount: 1, SchemaSnapshotID: "schema-1",
		ExecutorProfileID: "housegate-replay-mvp-v0", PrevSafeSnapshotID: "snap-6", PrevStateRoot: "0xroot", SpentIDsRootAfter: "0xspent",
		StatementsRoot: "0x26a84c5328ee91532616e484b62ad262476ae476949cbf9f325a89e6463d1049", Track: &fsm.L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 1}}
	keyed := base
	keyed.Track = &fsm.L3BlockTrack{IndexerID: 1, GroupKey: servedGroupKey}
	if got := l3HeaderToPB(keyed).GetTrack(); got.GetIndexerId() != 1 || got.GetGroupKey() != servedGroupKey {
		t.Fatalf("track = %v, want indexer 1 under %s", got, servedGroupKey)
	}
	if got := l3HeaderToPB(base).GetTrack().GetGroupKey(); got != "" {
		t.Fatalf("a keyless header sent group_key %q", got)
	}
	hashes := map[string]bool{}
	for name, h := range map[string]fsm.L3BlockHeader{"keyless": base, "keyed": keyed} {
		raw, err := proto.Marshal(l3HeaderToPB(h))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var decoded pb.L3BlockHeader
		if err := proto.Unmarshal(raw, &decoded); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		want, err := h.ChainHash()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if got, err := l3HeaderWithGroupKeyFromPB(&decoded).ChainHash(); err != nil || got != want {
			t.Fatalf("%s: chain hash from proto = %s (%v), fsm %s", name, got, err, want)
		}
		if hashes[want] {
			t.Fatal("the keyed and the keyless header hash alike")
		}
		hashes[want] = true
	}
}

// TestGetBlockVerificationServesTheGroupSeal: GetBlockVerification serves a
// keyed block's group seal as fields 17-20, group_databases as BlockGroupRef
// in the view's order, detached from the view; a keyless block serves none
// of them.
func TestGetBlockVerificationServesTheGroupSeal(t *testing.T) {
	view := stage3BlockVerificationView()
	got := blockVerificationToPB(view)
	if got.GetGroupKey() != servedGroupKey || !slices.Equal(got.GetGroupMembers(), []string{"member-b", "member-c"}) || !got.GetGroupFill() {
		t.Fatalf("group seal = %q %q %v", got.GetGroupKey(), got.GetGroupMembers(), got.GetGroupFill())
	}
	want := []*pb.BlockGroupRef{{DatabaseId: "dex", GroupGeneration: 3}, {DatabaseId: "dex2", GroupGeneration: 1}}
	if len(got.GetGroupDatabases()) != len(want) {
		t.Fatalf("group_databases = %v, want %v", got.GetGroupDatabases(), want)
	}
	for i := range want {
		if !proto.Equal(got.GetGroupDatabases()[i], want[i]) {
			t.Fatalf("group_databases[%d] = %v, want %v", i, got.GetGroupDatabases()[i], want[i])
		}
	}
	view.GroupMembers[0] = "mutated"
	if got.GetGroupMembers()[0] != "member-b" {
		t.Fatal("blockVerificationToPB must copy group_members")
	}
	keyless := stage3BlockVerificationView()
	keyless.GroupKey, keyless.GroupMembers, keyless.GroupFill, keyless.GroupDatabases = "", nil, false, nil
	if m := blockVerificationToPB(keyless); m.GetGroupKey() != "" || m.GetGroupMembers() != nil || m.GetGroupFill() || m.GetGroupDatabases() != nil {
		t.Fatalf("a keyless block served a group seal: %q %q %v %v", m.GetGroupKey(), m.GetGroupMembers(), m.GetGroupFill(), m.GetGroupDatabases())
	}
}
```

```go
// submit hands one closed window to Raft in owner order. A command whose
// handler's context already ended is not proposed, as proposeTracked would
// not propose it. Once the held submissions were failed after the worker took
// the window (fails moved on), the commands not handed over yet are answered
// NotLeader and never proposed.
func (g *submissionGrouper) submit(batch []*heldSubmission, fails uint64) {
	if failed, closing := g.failedSince(fails); failed {
		answer(batch, g.notLeader(closing))
		return
	}
	order := orderByOwner(batch, g.s.d.FSM.TableOwner)
```

```go
// owner, and from the placement switch on group key). A command whose
// handler's context already ended is not proposed, as proposeTracked would
// not propose it. Once the held submissions were failed after the worker took
// the window (fails moved on), the commands not handed over yet are answered

func (g *submissionGrouper) submit(batch []*heldSubmission, fails uint64) {
```

and replace `orderByOwner`, with its comment, through the end of the file (`:294-361`):

```go
// orderByOwner is a closed window's proposal order (contract §3.8): owners in
// the order of their first held submission, arrival order within an owner,
// and submissions whose table owner cannot be resolved last, in arrival
// order. One rule refines it: a submission never moves ahead of an earlier
// submission of its own client lane (heldSubmission.subject), so admission
// meets every lane's client_seqs in the order they reached the leader, as it
// does without a window. When an owner's next submission waits for its
// lane's earlier submission in a later group, that submission is proposed
// first and the owner order resumes; within an owner, arrival order always
// holds. A submission without a subject (only a malformed statement, which
// admission refuses with its client_seq unspent) has no lane to keep. When
// no lane spans owners against their order, this is exactly the plain
// grouping.
func orderByOwner(batch []*heldSubmission, owner func(tableID string) (uint64, bool)) []*heldSubmission {
	// queues holds batch indices per owner, owners in first-arrival order and
	// the unresolvable queue last; prev is each submission's predecessor in
	// its lane, or -1.
	var queues [][]int
	queueOf := map[uint64]int{}
	var unresolved []int
	prev := make([]int, len(batch))
	lastOfLane := map[string]int{}
	for i, h := range batch {
		prev[i] = -1
		if h.subject != "" {
			if j, ok := lastOfLane[h.subject]; ok {
				prev[i] = j
			}
			lastOfLane[h.subject] = i
		}
		id, ok := owner(h.tableID)
		if !ok {
			unresolved = append(unresolved, i)
			continue
		}
		q, seen := queueOf[id]
		if !seen {
			q = len(queues)
			queueOf[id] = q
			queues = append(queues, nil)
		}
		queues[q] = append(queues[q], i)
	}
	queues = append(queues, unresolved)
	// Each pass proposes the head of the first queue whose head's lane
	// predecessor is already proposed. Such a head always exists: the
	// earliest submission not yet proposed heads its own queue, and its
	// predecessor arrived earlier and is therefore proposed. Without a lane
	// across owners the first non-empty queue always qualifies.
	out := make([]*heldSubmission, 0, len(batch))
	proposed := make([]bool, len(batch))
	for len(out) < len(batch) {
		for q, queue := range queues {
			if len(queue) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			i := queue[0]
			if p := prev[i]; p >= 0 && !proposed[p] {
				continue
			}
			out = append(out, batch[i])
			proposed[i] = true
			queues[q] = queue[1:]
			break
		}
	}
	return out
}
```

with:

```go
// orderBySealKey is a closed window's proposal order (contract §3.8, plan
// S3-E3 contract §51, housegate spec 2026-10-14 §7.2): seal keys, (owner,
// group key), in the order of their first held submission, arrival order
// within a key, and submissions whose table cannot be resolved last, in
// arrival order. One rule refines it: a submission never moves ahead of an
// earlier submission of its own client lane (heldSubmission.subject), so
// admission meets every lane's client_seqs in the order they reached the
// leader, as it does without a window. When a key's next submission waits
// for its lane's earlier submission in a later group, that submission is
// proposed first and the key order resumes; within a key, arrival order
// always holds. A submission without a subject (only a malformed statement,
// which admission refuses with its client_seq unspent) has no lane to keep.
// When no lane spans keys against their order, this is exactly the plain
// grouping. Before the placement switch every key is its owner alone, so the
// order is orderByOwner's.
func orderBySealKey(batch []*heldSubmission, key func(tableID string) (fsm.SealKey, bool)) []*heldSubmission {
	// queues holds batch indices per seal key, keys in first-arrival order
	// and the unresolvable queue last; prev is each submission's predecessor
	// in its lane, or -1.
	var queues [][]int
	queueOf := map[fsm.SealKey]int{}
	var unresolved []int
	prev := make([]int, len(batch))
	lastOfLane := map[string]int{}
	for i, h := range batch {
		prev[i] = -1
		if h.subject != "" {
			if j, ok := lastOfLane[h.subject]; ok {
				prev[i] = j
			}
			lastOfLane[h.subject] = i
		}
		id, ok := key(h.tableID)
		if !ok {
			unresolved = append(unresolved, i)
			continue
		}
		q, seen := queueOf[id]
		if !seen {
			q = len(queues)
			queueOf[id] = q
			queues = append(queues, nil)
		}
		queues[q] = append(queues[q], i)
	}
	queues = append(queues, unresolved)
	// Each pass proposes the head of the first queue whose head's lane
	// predecessor is already proposed. Such a head always exists: the
	// earliest submission not yet proposed heads its own queue, and its
	// predecessor arrived earlier and is therefore proposed. Without a lane
	// across keys the first non-empty queue always qualifies.
	out := make([]*heldSubmission, 0, len(batch))
	proposed := make([]bool, len(batch))
	for len(out) < len(batch) {
		for q, queue := range queues {
			if len(queue) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			i := queue[0]
			if p := prev[i]; p >= 0 && !proposed[p] {
				continue
			}
			out = append(out, batch[i])
			proposed[i] = true
			queues[q] = queue[1:]
			break
		}
	}
	return out
}

// orderByOwner is orderBySealKey with each owner's submissions under one key,
// the window's order before the placement switch (contract §3.8).
func orderByOwner(batch []*heldSubmission, owner func(tableID string) (uint64, bool)) []*heldSubmission {
	return orderBySealKey(batch, func(tableID string) (fsm.SealKey, bool) {
		id, ok := owner(tableID)
		return fsm.SealKey{Owner: id}, ok
	})
}
```

```go
// sealReasonReader is the optional node-local seal counter of a collector
// source: *fsm.FSM's blocks sealed since process start by reason (plan S3-E3
// contract §51, housegate spec 2026-10-14 §7.2). Like stateSizeReader it is
// not part of MetricsSnapshot; a source without it exports no
// arbiter_block_seal_reason series.
type sealReasonReader interface {
	BlockSealReasons() map[fsm.SealReason]uint64
}

// sealReasonCollector exports arbiter_block_seal_reason: one counter series
// per reason of fsm.SealReasons, zeros included, so an alert on group_switch
// never reads an absent series as no seal.
type sealReasonCollector struct {
	source sealReasonReader
	desc   *prometheus.Desc
}

func newSealReasonCollector(source sealReasonReader) *sealReasonCollector {
	return &sealReasonCollector{source: source, desc: prometheus.NewDesc("arbiter_block_seal_reason",
		"Blocks this replica's FSM sealed since process start, by why the open block was sealed; group_switch is a seal caused by a statement of another group key of the same owner (spec §7.2).",
		[]string{"reason"}, nil)}
}

func (c *sealReasonCollector) Describe(ch chan<- *prometheus.Desc) { ch <- c.desc }

func (c *sealReasonCollector) Collect(ch chan<- prometheus.Metric) {
	counts := c.source.BlockSealReasons()
	for _, reason := range fsm.SealReasons {
		ch <- prometheus.MustNewConstMetric(c.desc, prometheus.CounterValue, float64(counts[reason]), string(reason))
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 24: Document the seal-reason counter**

In `README.md`, insert immediately before the line `Challenge history is retained separately in replicated, snapshotted counters:` (`:437` at `526a721`, after whatever paragraph Plan S3-D Task 51 inserted there), followed by one blank line:

```markdown
**Block seal reasons** (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §7.2). `arbiter_block_seal_reason{reason}` counts the blocks this replica's FSM sealed since process start, by why the open block was sealed: `requested` (a `SealL3Block` with statements, the orchestrator's size or age trigger), `transition` (a table-set transition block), `snapshot_query`, `owner_switch` (a statement of another owner), `group_switch` (from the `placement` switch on, a statement of the same owner under another group key), `key_change` (a `RebalanceGroup`, a `MemberReady` or a consensus update that changes the open block's group key sealed it first) and `placement_cutover` (the `placement` switch-on). Every reason is exported from the start. The counter is incremented in Apply on every replica but is not State: it is never snapshotted, a restore does not reset it, and after a restart it counts from 0 again, the log entries the node replays included, so compare rates, not totals, across replicas. Each `group_switch` block costs one anchor transaction and three replays; alert on its increase.
```

In `docs/specs/issue-31-metrics.md`, insert immediately before the line `## Latency semantics` (`:52` at `526a721`):

```markdown
## Block seal reasons (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §7.2)

| Metric | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `arbiter_block_seal_reason{reason}` | Blocks this replica's FSM sealed since process start, by reason: `requested`, `transition`, `snapshot_query`, `owner_switch`, `group_switch`, `key_change`, `placement_cutover`; every reason pre-created at 0 |

This counter is the one metric updated in Raft apply: each seal increments it on every replica, in a node-local counter outside State. It is never snapshotted, a restore does not reset it, and a restarted node counts the seals of the log entries it replays again, so it describes this process's applies, not the chain; use rates.
```

## Task 73: arbiter — `MemberReady` (tag 40), the group half of the eligible ring and the readiness restore rules (S3-E3)

Spec §6.4 (a placed member declares readiness once it holds active, synced replicas of every physical table of its group's database, and enters rings only then), §7.1 (a ready verify member is part of the group key, so a readiness that changes the key seals an open block of the group first), §7.3 (the eligible ring's group half: ready, Active, listed verify members of every group the block is sealed under, not hosted by the block's owner, plus the pool while fill is on or fewer than three qualify; `VERIFIERS_UNAVAILABLE` and `MarkReplaying` share that filter), §10.4 step 6 and §14 (eviction voiding for `MemberReady`), §17 (FSM: `MemberReady`), as fixed by contract §52.1 and clarifications K73 and K74. With the `placement` switch on, Apply records a member's readiness from an ed25519-signed `MemberReady` (Raft tag 40) after the ten checks of contract §52.1, seals an open block holding a statement of the group's database first when the readiness changes the group's key (seal reason `key_change`), and bumps the registry version once through `groupsChangedLocked`. `VerifierGateway.SubmitMemberReady` proposes it (the `SubmitTablePurged` pattern). Plan S3-E2's `eligibleRingLocked` gains the group seal as a third argument: `MarkReplaying` and the WorkSet's unmarkable rule pass the block's recorded seal (`bv.groupSeal()`, through Task 70's `blockRingLocked`), admission's `VERIFIERS_UNAVAILABLE` count passes the current seal of the live incarnation's database, and a `nil` seal is S3-E2's pool-only ring byte for byte. Restore checks every readiness record's generation bounds (`validateStage3Readiness`) and re-verifies every readiness signature under the `ed25519_pubkey` its own epoch listed (`validateMemberReadyProofs`). The registry view and `TableRegistrySnapshot` serve `ready_generation` only (D33). Before the `placement` switch every path is Plan S3-E2's: tag 40 is refused first with state unchanged, no group exists, so no seal reaches the ring, and the view serves no group.

Notes:
- **Where the readiness fields come from.** Contract §50 lists `ReadyGeneration`, `ReadySignature` and `ReadyEpoch` in Task 71's verbatim `GroupMember`, and Task 72's `readyVerifyMembersLocked` already reads `ReadyGeneration` (§51); this task only writes them. Step 1 stops if the fields are missing, because Task 72 cannot have compiled against §51 without them: adding them belongs to Task 71, not here.
- **Order of the checks.** The refusals run in contract §52.1's order, every one before any mutation, so each leaves state, the registry version and the seal counts unchanged (`rejectMemberReadyMR` checks all three). The idempotent answer (8) precedes the signature check (9): a repeat at the recorded generation changes nothing whatever it carries, as a repeated purge report does, and an invalid signature on such a repeat is harmless. Refusal 6 cannot be reached through Apply after the signed-claims activation (rule 6 of `signedClaimsMembershipLocked`, `fsm/signed_claims.go:277-288`, evicts a running verifier the listing does not hold under its registered key), and refusal 10 needs a seal that cannot be prepared; both cases of `TestMemberReadyRefusals` synthesize the state, as the existing owner-switch tests do (`fsm/owner_switch_test.go:164`, `:217`).
- **When readiness changes the key.** The key hashes the group's members with `ReadyGeneration != 0` whose listed entry has `verify`, and its fill flag (Task 72's `readyVerifyMembersLocked`). Readiness never changes the fill flag, so it changes the key exactly when the member was not ready and its entry verifies (`readinessChangesKeyLocked`). A replicate-only member and a re-readiness at a later generation leave the key alone and seal nothing. When the key changes, `prepareGroupSealLocked(owner, [database])` seals only an open block holding a statement of that database: an open block shared by another database of the same owner under the old key is sealed too when it also holds this database, and left alone otherwise, because its key is still the other group's (`TestMemberReadyChangesTheKeyAndSealsAnOpenBlockOfTheGroupFirst`).
- **Readiness per group and generation.** Readiness is stored on the (member, group) record, so a member ready in G(1, db) is not ready in G(0, db0). A `RebalanceGroup` raises the generation without touching a member's readiness, so `JoinedGeneration ≤ ReadyGeneration ≤ Generation` holds and the member stays in key and ring; a readiness at the old generation is refused (7). Task 71 replaces a removed member that is added again with a fresh record, so its old readiness never replays (`TestMemberReadyAtALaterGenerationKeepsTheMemberReady`). `MemberReadyRecorded` answers `true` for any generation up to the recorded one, so the gateway never proposes a stale readiness of a member that is already ready.
- **The ring's group half.** `eligibleMemberLocked` reads the listing (verify, a host other than the block's owner), node status (registered, Active, VERIFIER role) and the current group records (a ready current member of every group of `seal.Databases`; a Leaving record is not current). It never reads `Generation`: a member recorded in the seal stays eligible across a later `RebalanceGroup` that keeps it, and one it removes drops out at once (K74). A seal without databases admits no member, so an open block's seal (`(*OpenL3Block).groupSeal()`, whose `Databases` stay empty) can never widen a ring. The two halves are disjoint (a member entry has a `host_indexer_id`, a pool entry none, `poolVerifierLocked`), so sorting their union keeps it unique, which Task 70's restore rule requires of a stored ring.
- **One filter for admission, `MarkReplaying` and the WorkSet.** Admission counts the ring under the current seal of the live incarnation's database, the seal Task 72 records on the open block for the block's first statement; statements of other databases share that block only under an equal key, and equal keys hash equal ready verify member lists, so the block's recorded seal admits exactly the same members. `MarkReplaying` and the unmarkable rule reach the ring through Task 70's `blockRingLocked`, which now passes the recorded seal, so one hunk changes both. `currentGroupSealLocked` errs only on an unsorted member list, which `readyVerifyMembersLocked` never returns; the admission check answers that as `VERIFIERS_UNAVAILABLE` with the error, before any mutation, rather than inventing a ring.
- **Byte identity before placement.** `applyMemberReady` refuses first while `placement` is off; `currentGroupSealLocked` and `bv.groupSeal()` are `nil` before the cutover, and `eligibleRingLocked(…, nil)` returns `poolRingLocked(sources)` unchanged (`TestEligibleRingWithoutASealIsThePoolOnlyRing`, which also marks a block sealed before the cutover from the pool after placement is on). No state field is added, so every snapshot, chain hash and verification record before the switch is Plan S3-E2's and Task 72's.
- **Restore.** `validateStage3Readiness` is structural and runs with the other stage-3 rules (`validateStage3State`); a Leaving record keeps the readiness it had when its `RebalanceGroup` applied, so its bound is `RemovedGeneration − 1`. `validateMemberReadyProofs` runs at the end of `validateConsensusHistory`, where `paramsByEpoch` and the genesis id are known: it verifies each signature, Leaving records included, under the key `paramsByEpoch[ReadyEpoch]` lists for the node, after checking that the epoch lies between the placement cutover's epoch and the current one. It does not re-check node status, so a member evicted or delisted since restores (`TestRestoreReverifiesMemberReadySignaturesUnderTheirEpoch` delists one).
- **The view serves the ready generation only.** `TableRegistryView` copies every group record (Task 71) and then clears every `ReadySignature` and `ReadyEpoch` of the copy, so no reader of the view, the gRPC mapping included, can carry them (D33); `groupsToPB` maps `ReadyGeneration` to `GroupMember.ready_generation`, which S3-E1's `wire.GroupMember.Ready()` reads. The served value changes only in an Apply that changes a group (`MemberReady`, a `RebalanceGroup` that adds a member again with a fresh record, a group's removal), and each of those bumps the registry version once through `groupsChangedLocked` (contract §50).
- **The gateway.** The order is contract §52.1's. package fsm

```go
import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/ed25519"

	"maps"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"

// The readiness tests (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §6.4, §7.3; plan S3-E3
// contract §52.1) build on Task 71's groups fixture: groupsFSM places
// G(0, db0) = {member-1, member-2, member-3} and G(1, db) = {member-0,
// member-2, member-3}, both at generation 1 with fill on, every member entry
// listed with verify and replicate under its stage3MemberKey and none
// registered; the network pool is v1..v3. The helpers here carry the suffix
// MR so they never collide with another task's.

// memberRegistrationMR is member node's RegisterNode at registration seq seq,
// signed by its fixture key stage3MemberKey(node).
func memberRegistrationMR(t *testing.T, f *FSM, node string, seq uint64) wire.Command {
	t.Helper()
	key := stage3MemberKey(node)
	reg := wire.RegistrationFromPB(wire.RegistrationToPB(arbiter.NodeRegistration{NodeID: node, Roles: []arbiter.NodeRole{arbiter.NodeRoleVerifier},
		Ed25519Pubkey: key.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey), RegistrationSeq: seq}))
	sig, err := authority.SignVerifierMessage(key, authority.VerifierMessageRegistration, messageContextFor(t, f), reg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return wire.Command{RegisterNode: &wire.RegisterNode{Registration: reg, Ed25519Signature: sig}}
}

// memberMarkActiveMR is member node's MarkActive at registration seq seq.
func memberMarkActiveMR(t *testing.T, f *FSM, node string, seq uint64) wire.Command {
	t.Helper()
	sig, err := authority.SignVerifierMessage(stage3MemberKey(node), authority.VerifierMessageMarkActive, messageContextFor(t, f),
		authority.MarkActiveBody{NodeID: node, RegistrationSeq: seq})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return wire.Command{MarkActive: &wire.MarkActive{NodeID: node, RegistrationSeq: seq, Ed25519Signature: sig}}
}

// activeMemberMR registers member node at registration seq 1 and marks it
// Active.
func activeMemberMR(t *testing.T, f *FSM, node string) {
	t.Helper()
	mustApply(t, f, memberRegistrationMR(t, f, node, 1))
	mustApply(t, f, memberMarkActiveMR(t, f, node, 1))
	if n := f.st.Nodes[node]; n == nil || n.Status != NodeActive {
		t.Fatalf("%s = %+v, want Active", node, n)
	}
}

// readyCmdMR is node's MemberReady for G(owner, database) at generation,
// signed by key under ctx.
func readyCmdMR(t *testing.T, key ed25519.PrivateKey, ctx authority.MessageContext, node string, owner uint64, database string, generation uint64) wire.Command {
	t.Helper()
	cmd := wire.MemberReady{NodeID: node, OwnerIndexerID: owner, DatabaseID: database, Generation: generation}
	sig, err := authority.SignMemberReady(key, ctx, cmd.Body())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cmd.Ed25519Signature = sig
	return wire.Command{MemberReady: &cmd}
}

// ownReadyCmdMR is node's MemberReady at generation, signed by its own
// fixture key under f's message context.
func ownReadyCmdMR(t *testing.T, f *FSM, node string, owner uint64, database string, generation uint64) wire.Command {
	t.Helper()
	return readyCmdMR(t, stage3MemberKey(node), messageContextFor(t, f), node, owner, database, generation)
}

// readyMR records node's readiness in G(owner, database) at the group's
// current generation.
func readyMR(t *testing.T, f *FSM, node string, owner uint64, database string) {
	t.Helper()
	mustApply(t, f, ownReadyCmdMR(t, f, node, owner, database, mustGroup(t, f, owner, database).Generation))
	if m := groupMemberRecord(mustGroup(t, f, owner, database), node); m == nil || m.ReadyGeneration == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("%s is not ready in G(%d, %s): %+v", node, owner, database, m)
	}
}

// memberMR is node's current member record in G(owner, database), which
// must exist.
func memberMR(t *testing.T, f *FSM, owner uint64, database, node string) *GroupMember {
	t.Helper()
	m := groupMemberRecord(mustGroup(t, f, owner, database), node)
	if m == nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s is not a current member of G(%d, %s)", node, owner, database)
	}
	return m
}

// currentSealMR is the current group seal of G(owner, database), which must
// exist.
func currentSealMR(t *testing.T, f *FSM, owner uint64, database string) *GroupSeal {
	t.Helper()
	seal, err := f.currentGroupSealLocked(owner, database)
	if err != nil || seal == nil {
		t.Fatalf("seal of G(%d, %s) = %+v, %v", owner, database, seal, err)
	}
	return seal
}

// mustGroupKeyMR is GroupKey(members, fill), which must succeed.
func mustGroupKeyMR(t *testing.T, members []string, fill bool) string {
	t.Helper()
	key, err := GroupKey(members, fill)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return key
}

// rejectMemberReadyMR applies cmd, requires the refusal want, and requires
// the snapshot, the registry version and the seal counts unchanged.
func rejectMemberReadyMR(t *testing.T, f *FSM, cmd wire.Command, want string) {
	t.Helper()
	before, seals := snapshotBytes(t, f), f.BlockSealReasons()
	var version uint64
	if f.st.TableRegistry != nil {
		version = f.st.TableRegistry.Version
	}
	if got := applyExpectReject(t, f, cmd).Reason; got != want {
		t.Fatalf("refusal %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(before, snapshotBytes(t, f)) || (f.st.TableRegistry != nil && f.st.TableRegistry.Version != version) || !maps.Equal(seals, f.BlockSealReasons()) {
		t.Fatal("a refused MemberReady changed state")
	}
}

// forgedStateMR is f's container with its state edited by forge: a bare
// replica restored from f's own container is edited and snapshotted again.
func forgedStateMR(t *testing.T, f *FSM, forge func(st *State)) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	g := restoreInto(t, snapshotBytes(t, f))
	forge(g.st)
	return snapshotBytes(t, g)
}

// stateGroupMR is G(owner, database) of a decoded state.
func stateGroupMR(t *testing.T, st *State, owner uint64, database string) *DatabaseGroup {
	t.Helper()
	for _, g := range st.Stage3.Groups {
		if g.Owner == owner && g.DatabaseID == database {
			return g
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("no group for indexer %d database %q", owner, database)
	return nil
}

// TestMemberReadyRefusals: contract §52.1 refusals 1-7, 9 and 10, in order,
// each with state, the registry version and the seal counts unchanged.
// Refusal 6 and refusal 10 guard states no Apply path builds, so their cases

func TestMemberReadyRefusals(t *testing.T) {

	edit := func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, change func(*wire.MemberReady)) wire.Command {
		cmd := *valid(t, f).MemberReady
		change(&cmd)
		return wire.Command{MemberReady: &cmd}
	}
	required := "member ready: node_id, database_id, generation and ed25519_signature are required"

		{"generation zero", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, _ *authority.Signer) wire.Command {

		}, required},
		{"signature missing", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, _ *authority.Signer) wire.Command {
			return edit(t, f, func(c *wire.MemberReady) { c.Ed25519Signature = "" })

		{"no group", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, _ *authority.Signer) wire.Command {

		}, `member ready: no group for indexer 1 database "nodb"`},
		{"another owner's database", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, _ *authority.Signer) wire.Command {
			return ownReadyCmdMR(t, f, "member-2", 0, "db", 1)
		}, `member ready: no group for indexer 0 database "db"`},
		{"not a member", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, _ *authority.Signer) wire.Command {
			activeMemberMR(t, f, "member-1")
			return ownReadyCmdMR(t, f, "member-1", 1, "db", 1)
		}, `member ready: member-1 is not a current member of group indexer 1 database "db"`},
		{"leaving", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer) wire.Command {
			activeMemberMR(t, f, "member-3")
			mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 1, nil, []string{"member-3"}, true))
			return ownReadyCmdMR(t, f, "member-3", 1, "db", 2)
		}, `member ready: member-3 is not a current member of group indexer 1 database "db"`},
		{"unregistered", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, _ *authority.Signer) wire.Command {
			return valid(t, f)
		}, "member ready: member-2 is not a registered, non-evicted verifier"},
		{"evicted", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer) wire.Command {
			activeMemberMR(t, f, "member-2")
			evictVerifierOA(t, f, a, "member-2", 1)

		{"key not listed", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, _ *authority.Signer) wire.Command {
			activeMemberMR(t, f, "member-2")

		{"generation ahead", func(t *testing.T, f *FSM, _ *authority.Signer) wire.Command {

// TestMemberReadyIsIdempotentAtTheSameGeneration: contract §52.1 refusal 8. A
// readiness repeated at the recorded generation is Applied and changes
// nothing, whatever signature it carries, because the check precedes the
// signature's; the first one bumps the registry version once, since
// ready_generation is served. Readiness is per group.
func TestMemberReadyIsIdempotentAtTheSameGeneration(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := groupsFSM(t)
	activeMemberMR(t, f, "member-2")
	cmd := ownReadyCmdMR(t, f, "member-2", 1, "db", 1)
	version := registryVersion(f)
	mustApply(t, f, cmd)
	m := memberMR(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2")
	if m.ReadyGeneration != 1 || m.ReadySignature != cmd.MemberReady.Ed25519Signature || m.ReadyEpoch != f.st.ConsensusEpoch {
		t.Fatalf("readiness record %+v", m)
	}
	if registryVersion(f) != version+1 {
		t.Fatalf("registry version %d -> %d, want one bump", version, registryVersion(f))
	}
	before, seals, version := snapshotBytes(t, f), f.BlockSealReasons(), registryVersion(f)
	forged := *cmd.MemberReady
	forged.Ed25519Signature = strings.Repeat("ab", ed25519.SignatureSize)
	for _, repeat := range []wire.Command{cmd, {MemberReady: &forged}} {
		if res := mustApply(t, f, repeat); res != (Applied{}) {
			t.Fatalf("repeat = %T %+v, want Applied", res, res)
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(before, snapshotBytes(t, f)) || registryVersion(f) != version || !maps.Equal(seals, f.BlockSealReasons()) {
			t.Fatal("a repeated readiness changed state")
		}
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		owner      uint64
		database   string
		node       string
		generation uint64
		want       bool
	}{
		{1, "db", "member-2", 1, true},
		{1, "db", "member-2", 2, false},
		{1, "db", "member-3", 1, false},
		{0, "db0", "member-2", 1, false},
		{1, "db", "member-2", 0, false},
	} {
		if got := f.MemberReadyRecorded(tc.owner, tc.database, tc.node, tc.generation); got != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("MemberReadyRecorded(%d, %s, %s, %d) = %v, want %v", tc.owner, tc.database, tc.node, tc.generation, got, tc.want)
		}
	}
	if m := memberMR(t, f, 0, "db0", "member-2"); m.ReadyGeneration != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("readiness in G(1, db) made member-2 ready in G(0, db0): %+v", m)
	}
}

// TestMemberReadyAtALaterGenerationKeepsTheMemberReady: spec §6.4. A member
// stays ready, in the key and in the ring when a RebalanceGroup raises its
// group's generation; a readiness at the old generation is then refused and
// one at the new generation records without a key change, so it seals
// nothing. A member removed and added again starts unready, so its earlier
// readiness never replays against the new membership.
func TestMemberReadyAtALaterGenerationKeepsTheMemberReady(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	activeMemberMR(t, f, "member-2")
	readyMR(t, f, "member-2", 1, "db")
	key := currentSealMR(t, f, 1, "db").Key
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 1, nil, []string{"member-3"}, true))
	if g := mustGroup(t, f, 1, "db"); g.Generation != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("generation %d after the rebalance, want 2", g.Generation)
	}
	if m := memberMR(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2"); m.ReadyGeneration != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("member-2 after the rebalance = %+v, want ready at generation 1", m)
	}
	seal := currentSealMR(t, f, 1, "db")
	if seal.Key != key || !slices.Equal(seal.Members, []string{"member-2"}) {
		t.Fatalf("seal after the rebalance = %+v, want key %s over member-2", seal, key)
	}
	if ring := f.eligibleRingLocked(1, []string{"s1"}, seal); !slices.Contains(ring, "member-2") {
		t.Fatalf("ring %v lost member-2 at generation 2", ring)
	}
	rejectMemberReadyMR(t, f, ownReadyCmdMR(t, f, "member-2", 1, "db", 1), "member ready: generation 1 differs from generation 2 of the group")
	clientKey, account := fixedClient(t)
	stmt := admitTrack(t, f, clientKey, account, 1, 1)
	blocks, seals := len(f.st.Blocks), f.BlockSealReasons()
	mustApply(t, f, ownReadyCmdMR(t, f, "member-2", 1, "db", 2))
	if m := memberMR(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2"); m.ReadyGeneration != 2 || m.ReadyEpoch != f.st.ConsensusEpoch {
		t.Fatalf("member-2 = %+v, want ready at generation 2", m)
	}
	if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks || !maps.Equal(seals, f.BlockSealReasons()) || !slices.Equal(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs, []uint64{stmt}) {
		t.Fatal("a readiness that keeps the key sealed the open block")
	}
	if seal := currentSealMR(t, f, 1, "db"); seal.Key != key {
		t.Fatalf("key %s, want %s", seal.Key, key)
	}
	if !f.MemberReadyRecorded(1, "db", "member-2", 1) || !f.MemberReadyRecorded(1, "db", "member-2", 2) || f.MemberReadyRecorded(1, "db", "member-2", 3) {
		t.Fatal("a readiness at generation 2 must answer generations 1 and 2 as recorded, and 3 not")
	}
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 2, nil, []string{"member-2"}, true))
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 3, []string{"member-2"}, nil, true))
	if m := memberMR(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2"); m.JoinedGeneration != 4 || m.ReadyGeneration != 0 || m.ReadySignature != "" || m.ReadyEpoch != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("re-added member-2 = %+v, want a fresh record at generation 4", m)
	}
	if seal := currentSealMR(t, f, 1, "db"); len(seal.Members) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("re-added member-2 counts in the key: %+v", seal)
	}
	readyMR(t, f, "member-2", 1, "db")
	if _, err := restoreConfigured(t, f, snapshotBytes(t, f)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("restore of the honest state: %v", err)
	}
}

// TestMemberReadyChangesTheKeyAndSealsAnOpenBlockOfTheGroupFirst: Review
// Focus 2, spec §7.1. A readiness that changes a group's key seals an open
// block holding a statement of the group's database first, under the old
// key (seal reason key_change); readiness that leaves this block's key alone
// (a replicate-only member, another owner's group) seals nothing. The next
// statement of the database opens a block under the new key, and the
// readiness bumps the registry version once.
func TestMemberReadyChangesTheKeyAndSealsAnOpenBlockOfTheGroupFirst(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	for _, node := range []string{"member-2", "member-3"} {
		activeMemberMR(t, f, node)
	}
	updateStage3(t, f, a, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) {
		entry := groupMemberEntry(t, f, 3, "member-3")
		entry.Verify = false
		*u = withVerifier(*u, entry)
	})
	clientKey, account := fixedClient(t)
	first := admitTrack(t, f, clientKey, account, 1, 1)
	old := mustGroupKeyMR(t, nil, true)
	if ob := f.st.OpenBlock; ob.GroupKey != old || ob.GroupMembers != nil || !ob.GroupFill {
		t.Fatalf("open block = %+v, want the key of no ready member with fill", ob)
	}
	blocks, seals := len(f.st.Blocks), f.BlockSealReasons()
	readyMR(t, f, "member-3", 1, "db")
	readyMR(t, f, "member-2", 0, "db0")
	if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks || !slices.Equal(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs, []uint64{first}) || f.st.OpenBlock.GroupKey != old || !maps.Equal(seals, f.BlockSealReasons()) {
		t.Fatal("a readiness that leaves the open block's key alone sealed it")
	}
	version := registryVersion(f)
	readyMR(t, f, "member-2", 1, "db")
	if registryVersion(f) != version+1 {
		t.Fatalf("registry version %d -> %d, want one bump", version, registryVersion(f))
	}
	if len(f.st.Blocks) != blocks+1 || len(f.st.OpenBlock.StatementSeqs) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("blocks %d -> %d, open block %+v: the readiness did not seal first", blocks, len(f.st.Blocks), f.st.OpenBlock)
	}
	hdr := f.st.Blocks[len(f.st.Blocks)-1]
	if hdr.Track == nil || hdr.Track.IndexerID != 1 || hdr.Track.GroupKey != old || hdr.StatementSeqStart != first || hdr.StatementCount != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("sealed header = %+v, want the statement under the old key", hdr)
	}
	bv := f.st.Verifications[hdr.L3BlockSeq]
	if bv.GroupKey != old || bv.GroupMembers != nil || !bv.GroupFill || !slices.Equal(bv.GroupDatabases, []GroupRef{{DatabaseID: "db", Generation: 1}}) {
		t.Fatalf("sealed group record = %q %v %v %+v", bv.GroupKey, bv.GroupMembers, bv.GroupFill, bv.GroupDatabases)
	}
	want := maps.Clone(seals)
	want[SealReasonKeyChange]++
	if got := f.BlockSealReasons(); !maps.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("seal counts %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
	next := mustGroupKeyMR(t, []string{"member-2"}, true)
	admitTrack(t, f, clientKey, account, 2, 1)
	if ob := f.st.OpenBlock; ob.GroupKey != next || !slices.Equal(ob.GroupMembers, []string{"member-2"}) || !ob.GroupFill {
		t.Fatalf("open block = %+v, want the new key %s", ob, next)
	}
	if _, err := restoreConfigured(t, f, snapshotBytes(t, f)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("restore of the honest state: %v", err)
	}
}

// TestRegistryViewCarriesTheReadyGenerationWithoutItsProof: decision D33.
// The registry view serves each record's ready generation, a Leaving one's
// included, and never its signature or epoch, which stay in state for
// restore.
func TestRegistryViewCarriesTheReadyGenerationWithoutItsProof(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	for _, node := range []string{"member-2", "member-3"} {
		activeMemberMR(t, f, node)
		readyMR(t, f, node, 1, "db")
	}
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 1, nil, []string{"member-3"}, true))
	view, ok := f.TableRegistryView()
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("no registry view")
	}
	var g *GroupView
	for i := range view.Groups {
		if view.Groups[i].Group.Owner == 1 && view.Groups[i].Group.DatabaseID == "db" {
			g = &view.Groups[i]
		}
	}
	if g == nil || len(g.Group.Leaving) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("view of G(1, db) = %+v", g)
	}
	served := append([]GroupMember{g.Group.Leaving[0].Member}, g.Group.Members...)
	for _, m := range served {
		ready := m.NodeID == "member-2" || m.NodeID == "member-3"
		if (m.ReadyGeneration == 1) != ready || m.ReadySignature != "" || m.ReadyEpoch != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("served record %+v", m)
		}
	}
	if m := memberMR(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2"); m.ReadySignature == "" || m.ReadyEpoch == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("the view cleared the state record %+v", m)
	}
}

// TestRestoreReverifiesMemberReadySignaturesUnderTheirEpoch: contract §52.1.
// Restore verifies each readiness, a Leaving record's included, under the
// ed25519 key the verifiers parameter of its own epoch lists, so a member
// delisted since restores; a signature over another body, an epoch before
// the placement switch or one that lists no entry for the node is refused,
// naming the member and its group.
func TestRestoreReverifiesMemberReadySignaturesUnderTheirEpoch(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	for _, node := range []string{"member-2", "member-3"} {
		activeMemberMR(t, f, node)
		readyMR(t, f, node, 1, "db")
	}
	readyEpoch := memberMR(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2").ReadyEpoch
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 1, nil, []string{"member-3"}, true))
	updateStage3(t, f, a, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) {
		u.Verifiers = slices.DeleteFunc(slices.Clone(u.Verifiers), func(v arbiter.VerifierEntry) bool { return v.NodeID == "member-2" })
	})
	if _, listed := findVerifierEntry(f.st.Params.Verifiers, "member-2"); listed || f.st.Nodes["member-2"].Status != NodeEvicted {
		t.Fatal("member-2 is still listed or not evicted")
	}
	if m := memberMR(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2"); m.ReadyGeneration != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("delisting changed member-2's record: %+v", m)
	}
	restoresBothWaysOA(t, f, snapshotBytes(t, f))
	var placementEpoch uint64
	for _, c := range f.st.Stage3.Switches {
		if c.Switch == Stage3SwitchPlacement {
			placementEpoch = c.Epoch
		}
	}
	otherBody := readyCmdMR(t, stage3MemberKey("member-2"), messageContextFor(t, f), "member-2", 1, "db", 2).MemberReady.Ed25519Signature
	prefix := `snapshot member member-2 readiness of group of indexer 1 database "db": `
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name  string
		forge func(g *DatabaseGroup)
		want  string
	}{
		{"signature over another body", func(g *DatabaseGroup) { groupMemberRecord(g, "member-2").ReadySignature = otherBody },
			prefix + "member ready: signature does not verify"},
		{"epoch before placement", func(g *DatabaseGroup) { groupMemberRecord(g, "member-2").ReadyEpoch = placementEpoch - 1 },
			prefix + fmt.Sprintf("ready epoch %d is outside the placement epochs [%d, %d]", placementEpoch-1, placementEpoch, f.st.ConsensusEpoch)},
		{"epoch without the entry", func(g *DatabaseGroup) { groupMemberRecord(g, "member-2").ReadyEpoch = f.st.ConsensusEpoch },
			prefix + fmt.Sprintf("member-2 is not a verifiers entry in epoch %d", f.st.ConsensusEpoch)},
		{"leaving record", func(g *DatabaseGroup) { g.Leaving[0].Member.ReadySignature = otherBody },
			`snapshot member member-3 readiness of group of indexer 1 database "db": member ready: signature does not verify`},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			forged := forgedStateMR(t, f, func(st *State) { tc.forge(stateGroupMR(t, st, 1, "db")) })
			if err := restoreErr(t, forged); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), tc.want) {
				t.Fatalf("restore = %v, want %q", err, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
	if readyEpoch < placementEpoch {
		t.Fatalf("ready epoch %d precedes the placement epoch %d", readyEpoch, placementEpoch)
	}
}

// TestRestoreRefusesAReadyGenerationOutsideTheMembership: contract §52.1. A
// current member's ready generation lies in [joined, generation] and a
// Leaving record's below its removal generation, and a ready generation, its
// signature and its epoch are set together.
func TestRestoreRefusesAReadyGenerationOutsideTheMembership(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	for _, node := range []string{"member-2", "member-3"} {
		activeMemberMR(t, f, node)
		readyMR(t, f, node, 1, "db")
	}
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 1, nil, []string{"member-3"}, true))
	restoresBothWaysOA(t, f, snapshotBytes(t, f))
	prefix := `snapshot stage3 readiness: member `
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name  string
		forge func(g *DatabaseGroup)
		want  string
	}{
		{"above the generation", func(g *DatabaseGroup) { groupMemberRecord(g, "member-2").ReadyGeneration = 3 },
			prefix + `member-2 of group of indexer 1 database "db" has ready_generation 3 outside [1, 2]`},
		{"below the joined generation", func(g *DatabaseGroup) { groupMemberRecord(g, "member-2").JoinedGeneration = 2 },
			prefix + `member-2 of group of indexer 1 database "db" has ready_generation 1 outside [2, 2]`},
		{"leaving at its removal", func(g *DatabaseGroup) { g.Leaving[0].Member.ReadyGeneration = 2 },
			prefix + `member-3 of group of indexer 1 database "db" has ready_generation 2 outside [1, 1]`},
		{"generation without a signature", func(g *DatabaseGroup) { groupMemberRecord(g, "member-2").ReadySignature = "" },
			prefix + `member-2 of group of indexer 1 database "db" has a readiness signature without a ready generation, or the reverse`},
		{"epoch without a generation", func(g *DatabaseGroup) { groupMemberRecord(g, "member-0").ReadyEpoch = 4 },
			prefix + `member-0 of group of indexer 1 database "db" has a readiness signature without a ready generation, or the reverse`},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			forged := forgedStateMR(t, f, func(st *State) { tc.forge(stateGroupMR(t, st, 1, "db")) })
			if err := restoreErr(t, forged); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), tc.want) {
				t.Fatalf("restore = %v, want %q", err, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
```

```go
	block := claimedBlockOA(t, f, clientKey, account, 1, 1)
	if ws := mustWorkSet(t, f); !slices.Equal(ws.SealedUnmarked, []uint64{block}) || ws.Unmarkable != nil {
		t.Fatalf("WorkSet: sealed unmarked %v, unmarkable %v", ws.SealedUnmarked, ws.Unmarkable)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, memberRegistrationMR(t, f, "member-2", 2))
	if n := f.st.Nodes["member-2"]; n.Status != NodeSyncing {
		t.Fatalf("member-2 after its re-registration = %+v", n)
	}
	if ws := mustWorkSet(t, f); slices.Contains(ws.SealedUnmarked, block) || !slices.Equal(ws.Unmarkable, []uint64{block}) {
		t.Fatalf("WorkSet with member-2 Syncing: sealed unmarked %v, unmarkable %v", ws.SealedUnmarked, ws.Unmarkable)
	}
	rejectStage3Unchanged(t, f, markReplayingCmdOA(block), "eligible verifier ring below 3 (spec §7.3 floor)")
	mustApply(t, f, memberMarkActiveMR(t, f, "member-2", 2))
	if ws := mustWorkSet(t, f); !slices.Equal(ws.SealedUnmarked, []uint64{block}) || ws.Unmarkable != nil {
		t.Fatalf("WorkSet with member-2 Active again: sealed unmarked %v, unmarkable %v", ws.SealedUnmarked, ws.Unmarkable)
	}
	markReplayingOA(t, f, block)
	if bv := f.st.Verifications[block]; !slices.Equal(bv.EligibleRing, []string{"member-0", "member-2", "v3"}) {
		t.Fatalf("block %d ring = %v", block, bv.EligibleRing)
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Add `MemberReady`, the member filter and the readiness restore rules**

Create `fsm/member_ready.go`:

```go
package fsm

import (
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// Member readiness (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §6.4, §7.3; plan S3-E3 contract
// §52.1). A placed member holds no replica of its group's database yet. Once
// it holds active, synced replicas of every physical table of the database
// it signs MemberReady (Raft tag 40) with the ed25519 key of its verifiers
// entry, and from then on it may enter the eligible rings of the group's
// blocks. A ready verify member is part of the group key (contract §51), so a
// readiness that changes the key seals an open block holding a statement of
// the group's database first, under the old key (the C10 discipline).
// Readiness is recorded per (member, group): a member stays ready across
// later generations of the same group, and a member a RebalanceGroup adds
// again after it left starts unready, so an old readiness never replays
// against a re-placed membership.

// memberReadyBeforePlacementReason is Apply's first refusal of MemberReady
// (plan S3-E1 K67, contract §49); VerifierGateway.SubmitMemberReady answers
// it without a proposal.
const memberReadyBeforePlacementReason = "member readiness is refused until the placement switch is on"

// groupMemberRecord is the current member record of nodeID in g, or nil. A
// Leaving record is not a current member.
func groupMemberRecord(g *DatabaseGroup, nodeID string) *GroupMember {
	if g == nil {
		return nil
	}
	for i := range g.Members {
		if g.Members[i].NodeID == nodeID {
			return &g.Members[i]
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// readinessChangesKeyLocked reports whether recording member m of a group as
// ready changes the group's key under the committed listing. The key hashes
// the members with ReadyGeneration != 0 whose listed entry has verify
// (readyVerifyMembersLocked) and the fill flag, which readiness leaves alone,
// so the key changes exactly when m is not ready yet and its entry verifies.
// A replicate-only member, and a member ready at an earlier generation of the
// group, leave the key as it is.
func (f *FSM) readinessChangesKeyLocked(m *GroupMember) bool {
	if m.ReadyGeneration != 0 {
		return false
	}
	entry, ok := f.verifierEntryLocked(m.NodeID)
	return ok && entry.Verify
}

// applyMemberReady applies MemberReady (tag 40). Every refusal leaves state
// unchanged; the order and texts are contract §52.1's. A repeat at the
// recorded generation is answered Applied before the signature check, like a
// repeated purge report: it changes nothing, whatever it carries.
func (f *FSM) applyMemberReady(c *wire.MemberReady) any {
	if !f.placementOnLocked() {
		return Rejected{Reason: memberReadyBeforePlacementReason}
	}
	if c.NodeID == "" || c.DatabaseID == "" || c.Generation == 0 || c.Ed25519Signature == "" {
		return Rejected{Reason: "member ready: node_id, database_id, generation and ed25519_signature are required"}
	}
	g := f.groupLocked(c.OwnerIndexerID, c.DatabaseID)
	if g == nil {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member ready: no group for indexer %d database %q", c.OwnerIndexerID, c.DatabaseID)}
	}
	m := groupMemberRecord(g, c.NodeID)
	if m == nil {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member ready: %s is not a current member of group indexer %d database %q", c.NodeID, c.OwnerIndexerID, c.DatabaseID)}
	}
	node := f.st.Nodes[c.NodeID]
	if node == nil || node.Status == NodeEvicted || !hasRole(node.Registration.Roles, arbiter.NodeRoleVerifier) {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member ready: %s is not a registered, non-evicted verifier", c.NodeID)}
	}
	if !listsVerifier(f.st.Params.Verifiers, c.NodeID, node.Registration.Ed25519Pubkey) {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member ready: (%s, ed25519_pubkey) is not a verifiers entry", c.NodeID)}
	}
	if c.Generation != g.Generation {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member ready: generation %d differs from generation %d of the group", c.Generation, g.Generation)}
	}
	if m.ReadyGeneration == c.Generation {
		return Applied{}
	}
	msgCtx, err := f.messageContextLocked()
	if err == nil {
		err = authority.VerifyMemberReady(ed25519.PublicKey(node.Registration.Ed25519Pubkey), msgCtx, c.Body(), c.Ed25519Signature)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member ready: %s signature: %v", c.NodeID, err)}
	}
	// Seal first (C10): a readiness that changes the key seals an open block
	// holding a statement of the group's database under its old key. The
	// seal is prepared after every check and before any mutation, so a
	// refused preparation leaves state unchanged.
	var seal *preparedSeal
	if f.readinessChangesKeyLocked(m) {
		p, reason := f.prepareGroupSealLocked(c.OwnerIndexerID, []string{c.DatabaseID})
		if reason != "" {
			return Rejected{Reason: "member ready key change seal: " + reason}
		}
		seal = p
	}
	if seal != nil {
		// The sealed block records the group as it was.
		f.commitSealLocked(seal, SealReasonKeyChange)
	}
	m.ReadyGeneration, m.ReadySignature, m.ReadyEpoch = c.Generation, c.Ed25519Signature, f.st.ConsensusEpoch
	f.groupsChangedLocked()
	return Applied{}
}

// MemberReadyRecorded reports, under the read lock, whether nodeID is a
// current member of group (owner, database) whose recorded readiness is at
// generation or a later one. VerifierGateway.SubmitMemberReady answers such
// a request without a proposal: the member is ready already, and nothing the
// command could record is missing.
func (f *FSM) MemberReadyRecorded(owner uint64, database, nodeID string, generation uint64) bool {
	f.mu.RLock()
	defer f.mu.RUnlock()
	if !f.placementOnLocked() || generation == 0 {
		return false
	}
	m := groupMemberRecord(f.groupLocked(owner, database), nodeID)
	return m != nil && m.ReadyGeneration != 0 && m.ReadyGeneration >= generation
}

// eligibleMemberLocked reports whether group member nodeID may enter the
// eligible ring of a block of owner sealed (or about to be sealed) under
// seal (spec §7.3, contract §52.1): its listed verifiers entry has verify and
// is hosted by an indexer other than owner; its node is a registered, Active
// verifier; it is a ready current member of every group seal names, so a
// member a RebalanceGroup removed since (a Leaving record) never qualifies;
// and, while exclude_quarantined_hosts is on, its host is not quarantined. A
// seal naming no group admits no member.
func (f *FSM) eligibleMemberLocked(nodeID string, owner uint64, seal *GroupSeal) bool {
	entry, ok := f.verifierEntryLocked(nodeID)
	if !ok || !entry.Verify || entry.HostIndexerID == nil || *entry.HostIndexerID == owner {
		return false
	}
	n := f.st.Nodes[nodeID]
	if n == nil || n.Status != NodeActive || !hasRole(n.Registration.Roles, arbiter.NodeRoleVerifier) {
		return false
	}
	if len(seal.Databases) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	for _, ref := range seal.Databases {
		m := groupMemberRecord(f.groupLocked(owner, ref.DatabaseID), nodeID)
		if m == nil || m.ReadyGeneration == 0 {
			return false
		}
	}
	if s3 := f.st.Params.Stage3; s3 != nil && s3.ExcludeQuarantinedHosts && f.indexerQuarantinedLocked(*entry.HostIndexerID) {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

// dropUnservedReadiness clears every readiness signature and epoch of g, a
// detached copy the registry view serves: no runbook or live task reads them
// (decision D33), so the view carries only each record's ready generation.
// Restore re-verifies the signatures from the snapshot, never from a view.
func dropUnservedReadiness(g *DatabaseGroup) {
	for i := range g.Members {
		g.Members[i].ReadySignature, g.Members[i].ReadyEpoch = "", 0
	}
	for i := range g.Leaving {
		g.Leaving[i].Member.ReadySignature, g.Leaving[i].Member.ReadyEpoch = "", 0
	}
}

// validateStage3Readiness checks every stored readiness record (contract
// §52.1), called from validateStage3State. A current member's ready
// generation is 0 or lies in [JoinedGeneration, Generation]. A Leaving
// record's lies in [JoinedGeneration, RemovedGeneration-1]: MemberReady
// refuses a Leaving record, which keeps the readiness it had when its
// RebalanceGroup applied. A ready generation, its signature and its epoch are
// set together. validateMemberReadyProofs re-verifies the signatures, which
// needs the parameters of every epoch.
func validateStage3Readiness(st *State) error {
	if st.Stage3 == nil {
		return nil
	}
	for _, g := range st.Stage3.Groups {
		for _, m := range g.Members {
			if err := readinessRecordError(g, m, g.Generation); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		for _, l := range g.Leaving {
			last := uint64(0)
			if l.RemovedGeneration > 0 {
				last = l.RemovedGeneration - 1
			}
			if err := readinessRecordError(g, l.Member, last); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// readinessRecordError is validateStage3Readiness's rule for record m of g,
// whose ready generation may not exceed last.
func readinessRecordError(g *DatabaseGroup, m GroupMember, last uint64) error {
	ready := m.ReadyGeneration != 0
	if ready != (m.ReadySignature != "") || ready != (m.ReadyEpoch != 0) {
		return fmt.Errorf("snapshot stage3 readiness: member %s of group of indexer %d database %q has a readiness signature without a ready generation, or the reverse", m.NodeID, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID)
	}
	if ready && (m.ReadyGeneration < m.JoinedGeneration || m.ReadyGeneration > last) {
		return fmt.Errorf("snapshot stage3 readiness: member %s of group of indexer %d database %q has ready_generation %d outside [%d, %d]", m.NodeID, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, m.ReadyGeneration, m.JoinedGeneration, last)
	}
	return nil
}

// validateMemberReadyProofs re-verifies every stored readiness signature,
// Leaving records included (contract §52.1), called at the end of
// validateConsensusHistory. Each one is checked under the ed25519 key that
// the verifiers parameter of the record's epoch lists for the node, over the
// member-ready body of the group at the recorded generation and this
// network's message context. MemberReady applies only while placement is on,
// so the epoch lies between the epoch of the placement cutover and the
// current one. Node status is not re-checked: a member evicted or delisted
// since stays ready, and its proof stays valid under the epoch it was signed
// in. Groups and members are visited in state order, so every replica names
// the same corruption.
func validateMemberReadyProofs(st *State, paramsByEpoch []Params, genesisID string) error {
	if st.Stage3 == nil {
		return nil
	}
	floor := uint64(len(paramsByEpoch))
	for _, c := range st.Stage3.Switches {
		if c.Switch == Stage3SwitchPlacement {
			floor = c.Epoch
		}
	}
	ctx := authority.MessageContext{NetworkID: st.Params.NetworkID, GenesisSnapshotID: genesisID}
	for _, g := range st.Stage3.Groups {
		records := make([]GroupMember, 0, len(g.Members)+len(g.Leaving))
		records = append(records, g.Members...)
		for _, l := range g.Leaving {
			records = append(records, l.Member)
		}
		for _, m := range records {
			if m.ReadyGeneration == 0 {
				continue
			}
			if err := memberReadyProofError(g, m, paramsByEpoch, floor, ctx); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("snapshot member %s readiness of group of indexer %d database %q: %w", m.NodeID, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, err)
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// memberReadyProofError verifies the readiness record m of g under the
// parameters of its epoch.
func memberReadyProofError(g *DatabaseGroup, m GroupMember, paramsByEpoch []Params, floor uint64, ctx authority.MessageContext) error {
	if m.ReadyEpoch < floor || m.ReadyEpoch >= uint64(len(paramsByEpoch)) {
		return fmt.Errorf("ready epoch %d is outside the placement epochs [%d, %d]", m.ReadyEpoch, floor, len(paramsByEpoch)-1)
	}
	entry, ok := findVerifierEntry(paramsByEpoch[m.ReadyEpoch].Verifiers, m.NodeID)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s is not a verifiers entry in epoch %d", m.NodeID, m.ReadyEpoch)
	}
	body := arbiter.MemberReadyBody{NodeID: m.NodeID, OwnerIndexerID: g.Owner, DatabaseID: g.DatabaseID, Generation: m.ReadyGeneration}
	return authority.VerifyMemberReady(ed25519.PublicKey(entry.Ed25519Pubkey), ctx, body, m.ReadySignature)
}
```

```go
	sort.Strings(ring)

}
```

```go
// stage3ServerUpdateMG commits a consensus update carrying every committed
// list, flag and the stage3 parameter, edited by edit, bypassing the admin
// handler. Helpers here carry the suffix MG (member gateway).
func stage3ServerUpdateMG(t *testing.T, node *fakeNode, edit func(*arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate)) {
	t.Helper()
	view, err := node.f.ConsensusParamsView()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

		u.SIIndexers, u.Verifiers, u.TracksEnabled = view.Current.SIIndexers, view.Current.Verifiers, view.Current.TracksEnabled
		if s := view.Current.Stage3; s != nil {
			c := *s
			u.Stage3 = &c
		}
		edit(u)
	})
}

// readyRequestMG is member-2's SubmitMemberReady request for G(owner,
// database) at generation, signed by key over f's message context.
func readyRequestMG(t *testing.T, f *fsm.FSM, key ed25519.PrivateKey, owner uint64, database string, generation uint64) *pb.MemberReadyCmd {
	t.Helper()
	cmd := wire.MemberReady{NodeID: "member-2", OwnerIndexerID: owner, DatabaseID: database, Generation: generation}
	sig, err := authority.SignMemberReady(key, serverMessageContext(t, f), cmd.Body())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cmd.Ed25519Signature = sig
	return wire.MemberReadyToRequest(cmd)
}

// memberGateway is the VerifierGateway of a server over node.
func memberGateway(node raftnode.ConsensusNode, f *fsm.FSM) *verifierGatewayService {
	return &verifierGatewayService{s: New(Deps{Node: node, FSM: f, Cfg: Config{NodeID: "arb-0", ApplyTimeout: time.Second}})}
}

// raceNodeMG is a recording node that commits before, once, ahead of the
// first proposal it receives: a committed race the proposal then applies
// behind.
type raceNodeMG struct {
	*recordingNode
	before func()
}

func (n *raceNodeMG) Apply(cmd []byte, timeout time.Duration) raft.ApplyFuture {
	if b := n.before; b != nil {
		n.before = nil
		b()
	}
	return n.recordingNode.Apply(cmd, timeout)
}

// TestSubmitMemberReadyAnswersFailedPreconditionBeforePlacement: plan S3-E1
// K67, contract §52.1. The shape refusals answer first; before the
// placement switch a well-formed request answers FailedPrecondition with
// Apply's text, and nothing is proposed.
func TestSubmitMemberReadyAnswersFailedPreconditionBeforePlacement(t *testing.T) {
	rec := newRecordingNode(t)
	activateServerTracks(t, rec.fakeNode)
	gw := memberGateway(rec, rec.f)
	ctx := context.Background()
	full := &pb.MemberReadyCmd{NodeId: "member-2", OwnerIndexerId: 1, DatabaseId: "db", Generation: 1, Ed25519Signature: "ab"}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		edit func(*pb.MemberReadyCmd)
		want string
	}{
		{func(r *pb.MemberReadyCmd) { r.NodeId = "" }, "node_id is required"},
		{func(r *pb.MemberReadyCmd) { r.DatabaseId = "" }, "database_id is required"},
		{func(r *pb.MemberReadyCmd) { r.Generation = 0 }, "generation is required"},
		{func(r *pb.MemberReadyCmd) { r.Ed25519Signature = "" }, "ed25519_signature is required"},
	} {
		req := &pb.MemberReadyCmd{NodeId: full.NodeId, OwnerIndexerId: full.OwnerIndexerId, DatabaseId: full.DatabaseId, Generation: full.Generation, Ed25519Signature: full.Ed25519Signature}
		tc.edit(req)
		if _, err := gw.SubmitMemberReady(ctx, req); status.Code(err) != codes.InvalidArgument || status.Convert(err).Message() != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("request %v = %v, want InvalidArgument %q", req, err, tc.want)
		}
	}
	if _, err := gw.SubmitMemberReady(ctx, full); status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || status.Convert(err).Message() != memberReadyBeforePlacementMessage {
		t.Fatalf("before placement = %v", err)
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a refused readiness was proposed")
	}
}

// TestSubmitMemberReadyIsIdempotent: contract §52.1. The first request is
// proposed as sent and commits; a repeat is answered from committed state
// without a proposal. A follower answers NotLeader.
func TestSubmitMemberReadyIsIdempotent(t *testing.T) {
	rec := newRecordingNode(t)
	memberGatewayFixture(t, rec.fakeNode)
	gw := memberGateway(rec, rec.f)
	ctx := context.Background()
	req := readyRequestMG(t, rec.f, memberKeyMG(), 1, "db", 1)
	if _, err := gw.SubmitMemberReady(ctx, req); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("first readiness: %v", err)
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("%d proposals, want 1", rec.proposals())
	}
	lastProposalIs(t, rec, wire.Command{MemberReady: func() *wire.MemberReady { c := wire.MemberReadyFromRequest(req); return &c }()})
	if !rec.f.MemberReadyRecorded(1, "db", "member-2", 1) {
		t.Fatal("the readiness did not commit")
	}
	if view, _ := rec.f.TableRegistryView(); view.Groups[0].Group.Members[0].ReadyGeneration != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("served member %+v", view.Groups[0].Group.Members[0])
	}
	if _, err := gw.SubmitMemberReady(ctx, req); err != nil || rec.proposals() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("repeat = %v after %d proposals, want Ack without a proposal", err, rec.proposals())
	}
	rec.leader = false
	if _, err := gw.SubmitMemberReady(ctx, req); !isNotLeader(err) {
		t.Fatalf("follower = %v, want NotLeader", err)
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("a follower proposed")
	}
}

// TestSubmitMemberReadyMapsApplyRefusals: contract §52.1. An Apply refusal
// is FailedPrecondition with the FSM's reason, unless the refusal raced the
// same readiness: here member-2's readiness and its eviction commit ahead of
// the proposal, which Apply then refuses, and the gateway answers Ack from
// the committed readiness.
func TestSubmitMemberReadyMapsApplyRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	rec := newRecordingNode(t)
	memberGatewayFixture(t, rec.fakeNode)
	gw := memberGateway(rec, rec.f)
	ctx := context.Background()
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		req  *pb.MemberReadyCmd
		want string
	}{
		{readyRequestMG(t, rec.f, serverVerifierKey(8), 1, "db", 1), "member ready: member-2 signature: member ready: signature does not verify"},
		{readyRequestMG(t, rec.f, memberKeyMG(), 1, "nodb", 1), `member ready: no group for indexer 1 database "nodb"`},
		{readyRequestMG(t, rec.f, memberKeyMG(), 1, "db", 2), "member ready: generation 2 differs from generation 1 of the group"},
	} {
		if _, err := gw.SubmitMemberReady(ctx, tc.req); status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || status.Convert(err).Message() != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("request %v = %v, want FailedPrecondition %q", tc.req, err, tc.want)
		}
	}
	if rec.f.MemberReadyRecorded(1, "db", "member-2", 1) {
		t.Fatal("a refused readiness was recorded")
	}

	race := newRecordingNode(t)
	memberGatewayFixture(t, race.fakeNode)
	req := readyRequestMG(t, race.f, memberKeyMG(), 1, "db", 1)
	evict := arbiter.EvictNodeCommand{NodeID: "member-2", ExpectedRegistrationSeq: 1, Reason: "member lost"}
	token, err := serverTestAuthority.SignEvictNodeWithContext(evict, serverAuthorityContext(t, race.f))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	node := &raceNodeMG{recordingNode: race, before: func() {
		mustDirectApply(t, race.fakeNode, wire.Command{MemberReady: func() *wire.MemberReady { c := wire.MemberReadyFromRequest(req); return &c }()})
		mustDirectApply(t, race.fakeNode, wire.Command{EvictNode: &wire.EvictNode{NodeID: evict.NodeID, ExpectedRegistrationSeq: 1, Reason: evict.Reason, AuthorityJWS: token}})
	}}
	if _, err := memberGateway(node, race.f).SubmitMemberReady(ctx, req); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("raced readiness = %v, want Ack", err)
	}
	if race.proposals() != 1 || !race.f.MemberReadyRecorded(1, "db", "member-2", 1) {
		t.Fatalf("%d proposals, recorded %v", race.proposals(), race.f.MemberReadyRecorded(1, "db", "member-2", 1))
	}
}
```

```go
// TestTableRegistryToPBServesTheReadyGenerationOnly: contract §52.1, D33.
// Each member's ready_generation is served; the readiness signature and
// epoch reach no served message, even when a view carries them: neither
// GroupMember nor LeavingMember has a field for them, and the signature
// appears in neither the binary nor the JSON encoding of the snapshot.
func TestTableRegistryToPBServesTheReadyGenerationOnly(t *testing.T) {
	signature := strings.Repeat("5e", 64)
	view := fsm.TableRegistryView{Groups: []fsm.GroupView{{
		Group: fsm.DatabaseGroup{Owner: 1, DatabaseID: "db", Generation: 3, Salt: "0xsalt", NetworkFill: true,
			Members: []fsm.GroupMember{
				{NodeID: "member-0", JoinedGeneration: 1, Class: fsm.MemberBootstrapping, ReadyGeneration: 2, ReadySignature: signature, ReadyEpoch: 9},
				{NodeID: "member-2", JoinedGeneration: 3, Class: fsm.MemberBootstrapping},
			},
			Leaving: []fsm.LeavingMember{{Member: fsm.GroupMember{NodeID: "member-3", JoinedGeneration: 1, Class: fsm.MemberLeaving, ReadyGeneration: 1,
				ReadySignature: signature, ReadyEpoch: 7}, RemovedGeneration: 2, Entry: replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 1, SafeBlockSeq: 9, AppliedPromotionSeq: 4}}},
			PastMembers: []string{"member-3"}},
		MemberViews: []fsm.GroupMemberView{{}, {}},
	}}}
	snap := tableRegistryToPB(view)
	members := snap.GetGroups()[0].GetMembers()
	if len(members) != 2 || members[0].GetReadyGeneration() != 2 || members[1].GetReadyGeneration() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("served members %v", members)
	}
	for _, msg := range []proto.Message{&pb.GroupMember{}, &pb.LeavingMember{}} {
		fields := msg.ProtoReflect().Descriptor().Fields()
		for i := 0; i < fields.Len(); i++ {
			if name := string(fields.Get(i).Name()); strings.Contains(name, "signature") || strings.Contains(name, "epoch") {
				t.Fatalf("%s serves %s", msg.ProtoReflect().Descriptor().Name(), name)
			}
		}
	}
	binary, err := proto.Marshal(snap)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	text, err := protojson.Marshal(snap)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if bytes.Contains(binary, []byte(signature)) || bytes.Contains(text, []byte(signature)) {
		t.Fatal("the readiness signature reached the served snapshot")
	}
}
```

Create `server/member_gateway.go`:

```go
package server

import (
	"context"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// memberReadyBeforePlacementMessage is the FSM's first refusal of MemberReady
// (plan S3-E1 K67, plan S3-E3 contract §49). Before the placement switch the
// gateway answers it as FailedPrecondition without a proposal.
const memberReadyBeforePlacementMessage = "member readiness is refused until the placement switch is on"

// SubmitMemberReady records a group member's readiness (housegate spec
// 2026-10-14 §6.4, Raft tag 40; plan S3-E3 contract §52.1). The member names
// itself by node_id and Apply verifies its ed25519 signature, so the gateway
// checks only the request's shape and the switch. Behind the read barrier, a
// readiness already recorded at this generation or a later one is answered
// without a proposal, and so is a refusal that raced the same readiness (the
// SubmitTablePurged pattern); any other refusal is FailedPrecondition with
// the FSM's reason. A follower answers NotLeader.
func (svc *verifierGatewayService) SubmitMemberReady(ctx context.Context, req *pb.MemberReadyCmd) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	if err := requireStreamID("node_id", req.GetNodeId()); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	switch {
	case req.GetDatabaseId() == "":
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "database_id is required")
	case req.GetGeneration() == 0:
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "generation is required")
	case req.GetEd25519Signature() == "":
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "ed25519_signature is required")
	}
	if !svc.s.d.FSM.PlacementOn() {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, memberReadyBeforePlacementMessage)
	}
	if err := svc.s.consensusReadBarrier(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	cmd := wire.MemberReadyFromRequest(req)
	recorded := func() bool {
		return svc.s.d.FSM.MemberReadyRecorded(cmd.OwnerIndexerID, cmd.DatabaseID, cmd.NodeID, cmd.Generation)
	}
	if recorded() {
		return &pb.Ack{}, nil
	}
	res, err := svc.s.propose(ctx, wire.Command{MemberReady: &cmd})
	if err != nil {
		// A refusal can race the member's own earlier readiness and a later
		// change of the group or the node: answer from the committed state
		// the refusal was decided on.
		if status.Code(err) == codes.InvalidArgument && recorded() {
			return &pb.Ack{}, nil
		}
		return nil, applyRefusalAsFailedPrecondition(err)
	}
	if _, ok := res.(fsm.Applied); !ok {
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "unexpected member ready result %T", res)
	}
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}
```
