Notes:
- **Switch-off identity.** Every field this task adds is `omitempty` or a nil pointer, the WorkSet row is nil before the switch, and the publication hook runs only while `checkpointsOnLocked()`, so no pre-switch Apply, snapshot, registry version or chain hash changes: the existing goldens (`TestStage3V21PlainContainerGolden`, `TestStage3V21InternedContainerGolden`, the pre-tracks and L3 track goldens) pass untouched in Step 16. The `checkpoints` switch-on itself needs no hook in `onStage3SwitchOnLocked`: the advances start empty and the first publication after it appends the first entry, so a member's lag counts only advances published from the switch on (K76).
- **Ordering inside `applyMemberCheckpoint`.** Refusals 7–10 are per group and run group by group in the checkpoint's order, before refusals 11–14, which are per checkpoint. Refusal 4 already refuses an evicted node with the contract's text, so the S3-E2 §47 voiding helper would never fire after it and is not called (contract §49: placement implies `eviction_voiding`). A same-entry re-checkpoint (excluded sets shrunk or grown, or another subset of groups) keeps every class; a first checkpoint or a new entry is classified, which may make a member `lagging` at once when its entry is older than every recorded advance.
- **Lag and versions.** `memberLagLocked` counts the owner's recorded advances after the entry, so it never exceeds `max_lag_publications + 1` (D31), and a member becomes `lagging` only when that count exceeds `max_lag_publications`, which means saturated. A publication with an append bumps the registry version once when the owner's groups hold a checkpoint, through `groupsChangedLocked` when a class moved and through `registryChangedLocked` alone otherwise. One case cannot be folded: a publication that also flips a table in `applyPublishedTrackTransitionsLocked` (which bumps on its own, before this hook) bumps twice. Versions only need to increase and no content is served under two versions, so followers are unaffected; recorded in Appendix B with the S3-E2 Task 69 precedent.
- **Beyond the contract's lists** (each recorded in Appendix B): the restore refusal `checkpoint state exists while the checkpoints switch is off` (Apply never writes any of it before the switch, so a container that carries some is forged); a missing `CheckpointSeqs` entry counts as `checkpoint_seq 0` in `validateMemberCheckpointProofs`, because Apply sets the entry with every stored checkpoint and never removes it; a Leaving record's checkpoint must name a generation in `[JoinedGeneration, RemovedGeneration − 1]`; the config refusal `dispatch.member_lagging_timeout must not be negative`; `SubmitMemberCheckpoint` answers `checkpoint is required` before `checkpoint.node_id is required` (in the contract's order the first text could never be returned, since a missing checkpoint has no node id), refuses an unknown exclusion reason as `InvalidArgument` with the wire decoder's text, and re-answers `Ack` when a refusal raced the same checkpoint (the `SubmitTablePurged` and `SubmitMemberReady` pattern); `TestTableRegistryToPBCarriesCheckpointsAndLag`; the server tests live in the new `server/member_checkpoint_test.go` rather than Task 73's `server/member_gateway_test.go` and Task 71's `server/groups_admin_test.go`, so neither file's imports need merging.
- **Fixture facts.** `checkpointsFSM` is `groupsFSM` with member-2 registered and the `reselection` and `checkpoints` switches on (switch 7 must precede switch 8). Its manifests published before the switches carry no track frontiers, so every test first passes and publishes one block (`publishOwnerBlock`, which also cleans the block's promoted part so the drain gate lets later consensus updates through). An owner-1 block advances only owner 1's entry; each published manifest still names every enrolled indexer's frontier. The quarantine test promotes a block before `QuarantineIndexer` and acknowledges it during the quarantine (amendment A7), which is how an owner's published entry advances while it is quarantined. The server fixture publishes table-set transition blocks (`publishServerTransition`), which need no statements: indexer 2's `db.b` gives a manifest with frontiers, and indexer 1's `dbc.c` later moves indexer 1's published entry.
- **Checked while drafting.** Every code block of this task was applied, in step order, to a `git archive` export of a scratch arbiter tree: origin/main `526a721` with stand-ins of Plan S3-E2 Tasks 64–70 and of this plan's Tasks 71–74 (the drafters' working copies of 2026-10-16, Task 74's reduced to its Apply arm, state fields, latch and restore hooks), against arbiter-core and arbiter-proto stubs built from Plan S3-E1's contract (the Task 60 check tree) through `replace` directives. Every failing run below printed what it states, `go vet` is clean, the five touched packages pass under `-race`, and `GOWORK=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod GOPROXY=off go test ./...` of the export passes (2026-10-16). Forty single-point mutations (the lagging threshold, the quarantine exemption in the append and in the class rule, the hysteresis bounds, the signer-scoped seq, refusals 9, 10, 13 and 14, the same-entry rule, both bump paths, the trim, the view's lag and copies, each restore and proof rule, the WorkSet row, the gateway's idempotence, the RPC's authority check, the orchestrator's restart, zero and pruning rules, the config default and refusal, the CLI's entry fields) are each caught by at least one named test. `bazel run //:gazelle` ran offline on the export: for this task's files it adds exactly the srcs listed under Files and no deps line (it also relabels arbiter-core, an artefact of the export's `replace` directives that the branch's pins do not have); Bazel build and test were not run (no offline module cache for the stubbed modules). The published-manifest binding of Step 14 and `TestRestoreRefusesACheckpointOffItsPublishedManifest` were added after this check, in review; what was run for them is in Appendix B (Task 75, review fixes).

Create `fsm/member_checkpoint_test.go`:

```go
package fsm

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority/authoritytest"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// The checkpoints fixture (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §9.1, §9.2; plan S3-E3
// contract §52.3) is Task 71's groupsFSM, G(0, db0) = {member-1, member-2,
// member-3} and G(1, db) = {member-0, member-2, member-3}, both at generation
// 1 with fill on, with the reselection and checkpoints switches on and
// member-2 registered. No manifest published so far carries track
// frontiers, so every test publishes one (publishOwnerBlock) before a member
// can checkpoint. member-2 signs with its fixture replica signer
// (stage3ReplicaSigner) unless a test rotates it.

// checkpointsFSM is the checkpoints fixture.
func checkpointsFSM(t *testing.T) (*FSM, *authority.Signer) {
	t.Helper()
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	registerMember(t, f, "member-2")
	turnOnStage3Switch(t, f, a, Stage3SwitchReselection)
	turnOnStage3Switch(t, f, a, Stage3SwitchCheckpoints)
	return f, a
}

// publishOwnerBlock passes one block of owner's table (a fresh account's
// statement 1), publishes the manifest ManifestInputs describes, which
// advances owner's entry and carries every enrolled indexer's frontier, and
// cleans the block's promoted part, so the drain gate lets the next consensus
// update through.
func publishOwnerBlock(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer, owner uint64) replay.SafeSnapshotManifest {
	t.Helper()
	key, account := testAccount(t)
	_, promotions := passTrackBlock(t, f, a, key, account, owner, 1)
	m := publishManifestInputs(t, f)
	for _, p := range promotions {
		cleanTrackPromotion(t, f, a, p)
	}
	return m
}

// frontierOf is m's track frontier of indexer id, which must exist.
func frontierOf(t *testing.T, m replay.SafeSnapshotManifest, id uint64) replay.TrackFrontier {
	t.Helper()
	e, ok := manifestTrackFrontier(&m, id)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("manifest %s carries no frontier for indexer %d", m.SnapshotID, id)
	}
	return e
}

// cpGroup is a checkpoint group of database at generation, excluding
// excluded.
func cpGroup(database string, generation uint64, excluded ...arbiter.ExcludedTable) arbiter.CheckpointGroup {
	return arbiter.CheckpointGroup{DatabaseID: database, GroupGeneration: generation, Excluded: excluded}
}

// memberCheckpointAt is node's checkpoint seq for owner over groups at
// manifest m, whose frontier of owner is its entry.
func memberCheckpointAt(t *testing.T, m replay.SafeSnapshotManifest, node string, owner, seq uint64, groups ...arbiter.CheckpointGroup) arbiter.MemberCheckpoint {
	t.Helper()
	return arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{NodeID: node, OwnerIndexerID: owner, CheckpointSeq: seq, Groups: groups, SnapshotID: m.SnapshotID,
		Entry: frontierOf(t, m, owner)}
}

// signedCheckpoint is cp signed by signer over f's network and genesis at
// authoritytest.Iat.
func signedCheckpoint(t *testing.T, f *FSM, signer *authority.Signer, cp arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) wire.Command {
	t.Helper()
	jws, err := signer.SignMemberCheckpointAt(messageContextFor(t, f), cp, authoritytest.Iat)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return wire.Command{MemberCheckpoint: &wire.MemberCheckpoint{Checkpoint: cp, ReplicaJWS: jws}}
}

// memberCheckpointCmd is cp signed by its node's fixture replica signer.
func memberCheckpointCmd(t *testing.T, f *FSM, cp arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) wire.Command {
	t.Helper()
	return signedCheckpoint(t, f, stage3ReplicaSigner(t, cp.NodeID), cp)
}

// memberOf is the current member record of node in G(owner, database).
func memberOf(t *testing.T, f *FSM, owner uint64, database, node string) *GroupMember {
	t.Helper()
	g := mustGroup(t, f, owner, database)
	i := groupMemberIndex(g, node)
	if i < 0 {
		t.Fatalf("%s is not a member of G(%d, %s)", node, owner, database)
	}
	return &g.Members[i]
}

// requireClass requires node's class in G(owner, database).
func requireClass(t *testing.T, f *FSM, owner uint64, database, node string, want MemberClass) {
	t.Helper()
	if got := memberOf(t, f, owner, database, node).Class; got != want {
		t.Fatalf("%s in G(%d, %s) is %s, want %s", node, owner, database, got, want)
	}
}

// storedSeq is the CheckpointSeqs entry of (node, owner).
func storedSeq(t *testing.T, f *FSM, node string, owner uint64) MemberCheckpointSeq {
	t.Helper()
	i, found := checkpointSeqIndex(f.st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs, node, owner)
	if !found {
		t.Fatalf("no checkpoint seq for (%s, %d)", node, owner)
	}
	return f.st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs[i]
}

// rotateReplicaSigner lists node's entry on indexer host with the replica
// signer of rotated and a fresh consent of the host's enrolment key, and
// returns the new signer.
func rotateReplicaSigner(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer, host uint64, node, rotated string) *authority.Signer {
	t.Helper()
	key := sha256.Sum256([]byte(rotated))
	signer := authoritytest.MustSigner(t, hex.EncodeToString(key[:]))
	entry := groupMemberEntry(t, f, host, node)
	entry.ReplicaSigner = strings.ToLower(signer.Address())
	entry.ConsentJWS = memberConsent(t, f, groupHostSigner(t, f, host), entry)
	listGroupMembers(t, f, a, entry)
	return signer
}

// reregisterMember registers member node again at registration seq.
func reregisterMember(t *testing.T, f *FSM, node string, seq uint64) {
	t.Helper()
	key := stage3MemberKey(node)
	reg := wire.RegistrationFromPB(wire.RegistrationToPB(arbiter.NodeRegistration{NodeID: node, Roles: []arbiter.NodeRole{arbiter.NodeRoleVerifier},
		Ed25519Pubkey: key.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey), RegistrationSeq: seq}))
	sig, err := authority.SignVerifierMessage(key, authority.VerifierMessageRegistration, messageContextFor(t, f), reg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, wire.Command{RegisterNode: &wire.RegisterNode{Registration: reg, Ed25519Signature: sig}})
}

func TestMemberCheckpointRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	off, _ := groupsFSM(t)
	registerMember(t, off, "member-2")
	rejectGroupCommand(t, off, wire.Command{MemberCheckpoint: &wire.MemberCheckpoint{Checkpoint: arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{NodeID: "member-2"}, ReplicaJWS: "a.b.c"}},
		"member checkpoints are refused until the checkpoints switch is on", false)

	f, a := checkpointsFSM(t)
	registerMember(t, f, "member-1")
	m := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	genesis, ok := f.ManifestByID(mustGenesisID(t, f))
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("no genesis manifest")
	}
	valid := func() arbiter.MemberCheckpoint { return memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 1, cpGroup("db", 1)) }
	with := func(edit func(*arbiter.MemberCheckpoint)) arbiter.MemberCheckpoint {
		cp := valid()
		edit(&cp)
		return cp
	}
	foreign := authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.IndexerKeyHex1)
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		cmd    wire.Command
		want   string
		prefix bool
	}{
		{"2 no node", memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.NodeID = "" })), "member checkpoint: node_id, snapshot_id and replica_jws are required", false},
		{"2 no snapshot", wire.Command{MemberCheckpoint: &wire.MemberCheckpoint{Checkpoint: with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.SnapshotID = "" }), ReplicaJWS: "a.b.c"}},
			"member checkpoint: node_id, snapshot_id and replica_jws are required", false},
		{"2 no token", wire.Command{MemberCheckpoint: &wire.MemberCheckpoint{Checkpoint: valid()}}, "member checkpoint: node_id, snapshot_id and replica_jws are required", false},
		{"3 no groups", wire.Command{MemberCheckpoint: &wire.MemberCheckpoint{Checkpoint: with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.Groups = nil }), ReplicaJWS: "a.b.c"}},
			"member checkpoint: groups must be non-empty and sorted by database_id without duplicates", false},
		{"3 unsorted", wire.Command{MemberCheckpoint: &wire.MemberCheckpoint{Checkpoint: with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) {
			cp.Groups = []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{cpGroup("db", 1), cpGroup("da", 1)}
		}), ReplicaJWS: "a.b.c"}}, "member checkpoint: groups must be non-empty and sorted by database_id without duplicates", false},
		{"4 unregistered", memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.NodeID = "member-0" })),
			"member checkpoint: member-0 is not a registered, non-evicted verifier", false},
		{"5 pool verifier", memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.NodeID = "v1" })),
			"member checkpoint: v1 has no listed replicate entry with a replica_signer", false},
		{"6 wrong signer", signedCheckpoint(t, f, foreign, valid()), "member checkpoint: replica signature: ", true},
		{"6 wrong context", wire.Command{MemberCheckpoint: &wire.MemberCheckpoint{Checkpoint: valid(), ReplicaJWS: func() string {
			jws, err := stage3ReplicaSigner(t, "member-2").SignMemberCheckpointAt(authority.MessageContext{NetworkID: "other", GenesisSnapshotID: mustGenesisID(t, f)}, valid(), authoritytest.Iat)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			return jws
		}()}}, "member checkpoint: replica signature: ", true},
		{"7 no group", memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) {
			cp.Groups = []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{cpGroup("db", 1), cpGroup("nodb", 1)}
		})),
			`member checkpoint: no group for indexer 1 database "nodb"`, false},
		{"8 not a member", memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.NodeID = "member-1" })),
			`member checkpoint: member-1 is not a current member of group indexer 1 database "db"`, false},
		{"9 future generation", memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.Groups = []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{cpGroup("db", 2)} })),
			`member checkpoint: group_generation 2 of database "db" is outside [1, 1]`, false},
		{"9 generation 0", memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.Groups = []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{cpGroup("db", 0)} })),
			`member checkpoint: group_generation 0 of database "db" is outside [1, 1]`, false},
		{"10 not a table", memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) {
			cp.Groups = []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{cpGroup("db", 1, arbiter.ExcludedTable{TableID: "db.nope", Reason: arbiter.ExclusionNotInstalled})}
		})), `member checkpoint: excluded tables of database "db" must be sorted, unique SI tables of the database with a known reason`, false},
		{"10 another database", memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) {
			cp.Groups = []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{cpGroup("db", 1, arbiter.ExcludedTable{TableID: "db0.x", Reason: arbiter.ExclusionDiverged})}
		})), `member checkpoint: excluded tables of database "db" must be sorted, unique SI tables of the database with a known reason`, false},
		{"10 Legacy table", memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) {
			cp.Groups = []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{cpGroup("db", 1, arbiter.ExcludedTable{TableID: "db.old", Reason: arbiter.ExclusionForeign})}
		})), `member checkpoint: excluded tables of database "db" must be sorted, unique SI tables of the database with a known reason`, false},
		{"12 unpublished", memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.SnapshotID = "0xnope" })),
			"member checkpoint: snapshot 0xnope is not a published manifest", false},
		{"13 another entry", memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.Entry.AppliedPromotionSeq++ })),
			fmt.Sprintf("member checkpoint: entry differs from track_frontiers[1] of snapshot %s", m.SnapshotID), false},
		{"13 no frontiers", memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, with(func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.SnapshotID = genesis.SnapshotID })),
			fmt.Sprintf("member checkpoint: entry differs from track_frontiers[1] of snapshot %s", genesis.SnapshotID), false},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) { rejectGroupCommand(t, f, tc.cmd, tc.want, tc.prefix) })
	}
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, valid()))
	rejectGroupCommand(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, valid()), "member checkpoint: checkpoint_seq 1 is not above 1", false)
	later := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, later, "member-2", 1, 2, cpGroup("db", 1))))
	rejectGroupCommand(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 3, cpGroup("db", 1))),
		"member checkpoint: entry precedes the previous checkpoint entry of member-2 for indexer 1", false)
	evictedOne, ea := checkpointsFSM(t)
	mm := publishOwnerBlock(t, evictedOne, ea, 1)
	mustApply(t, evictedOne, evictCmd(t, evictedOne, ea, "member-2", 1))
	rejectGroupCommand(t, evictedOne, memberCheckpointCmd(t, evictedOne, memberCheckpointAt(t, mm, "member-2", 1, 1, cpGroup("db", 1))),
		"member checkpoint: member-2 is not a registered, non-evicted verifier", false)
}

func TestAReplayedOrLowerCheckpointSeqIsRefused(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := checkpointsFSM(t)
	m := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	accepted := memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 5, cpGroup("db", 1)))
	mustApply(t, f, accepted)
	rejectGroupCommand(t, f, accepted, "member checkpoint: checkpoint_seq 5 is not above 5", false)
	rejectGroupCommand(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 4, cpGroup("db", 1))),
		"member checkpoint: checkpoint_seq 4 is not above 5", false)
	later := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	rejectGroupCommand(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, later, "member-2", 1, 5, cpGroup("db", 1))),
		"member checkpoint: checkpoint_seq 5 is not above 5", false)
	// A sequence of another owner is its own: member-2's first checkpoint
	// for indexer 0 may start at 1.
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, later, "member-2", 0, 1, cpGroup("db0", 1))))
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, later, "member-2", 1, 6, cpGroup("db", 1))))
	if s := storedSeq(t, f, "member-2", 1); s.CheckpointSeq != 6 || s.ReplicaSigner != strings.ToLower(stage3ReplicaSigner(t, "member-2").Address()) {
		t.Fatalf("stored seq %+v", s)
	}
}

func TestASameEntryCheckpointReplacesOnlyItsListedGroups(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := checkpointsFSM(t)
	m := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	addGroupTable(t, f, 1, "dbx", "t", 200)
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 1, cpGroup("db", 1), cpGroup("dbx", 1))))
	both := *memberOf(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2").Checkpoint
	second := memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 2, cpGroup("dbx", 1, arbiter.ExcludedTable{TableID: "dbx.t", Reason: arbiter.ExclusionNotInstalled}))
	version := registryVersion(f)
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, second))
	if got := memberOf(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2").Checkpoint; !reflect.DeepEqual(*got, both) || got.Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("the unlisted group's checkpoint changed: %+v", got)
	}
	if got := memberOf(t, f, 1, "dbx", "member-2").Checkpoint; got == nil || !memberCheckpointsEqual(got.Checkpoint, second) || got.Epoch != f.st.ConsensusEpoch {
		t.Fatalf("the listed group's checkpoint = %+v", got)
	}
	requireClass(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2", MemberCaughtUp)
	requireClass(t, f, 1, "dbx", "member-2", MemberCaughtUp)
	if registryVersion(f) != version+1 || storedSeq(t, f, "member-2", 1).CheckpointSeq != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("registry version %d (was %d), stored seq %+v", registryVersion(f), version, storedSeq(t, f, "member-2", 1))
	}
}

func TestASameEntryCheckpointMayShrinkOrGrowExcluded(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := checkpointsFSM(t)
	m := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	excludeT := arbiter.ExcludedTable{TableID: "db.t", Reason: arbiter.ExclusionNotInstalled}
	for seq, group := range []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{
		cpGroup("db", 1, excludeT),
		cpGroup("db", 1),
		cpGroup("db", 1, arbiter.ExcludedTable{TableID: "db.t", Reason: arbiter.ExclusionDiskThreshold}),
	} {
		cp := memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, uint64(seq+1), group)
		mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, cp))
		got := memberOf(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2")
		if !memberCheckpointsEqual(got.Checkpoint.Checkpoint, cp) || got.Class != MemberCaughtUp {
			t.Fatalf("checkpoint %d: stored %+v as %s", seq+1, got.Checkpoint, got.Class)
		}
	}
}

func TestCheckpointSeqIsDurableAcrossGroupRemovalLeavingAndReregistration(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := checkpointsFSM(t)
	m := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	dbx := addGroupTable(t, f, 1, "dbx", "t", 200)
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 3, cpGroup("db", 1), cpGroup("dbx", 1))))
	want := MemberCheckpointSeq{NodeID: "member-2", OwnerIndexerID: 1, CheckpointSeq: 3, ReplicaSigner: strings.ToLower(stage3ReplicaSigner(t, "member-2").Address())}
	requireStored := func(stage string) {
		t.Helper()
		if got := storedSeq(t, f, "member-2", 1); got != want {
			t.Fatalf("%s: stored seq %+v, want %+v", stage, got, want)
		}
		view, _ := f.TableRegistryView()
		if !slices.Contains(view.MemberCheckpointSeqs, want) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: the view publishes %+v", stage, view.MemberCheckpointSeqs)
		}
	}
	// Leaving: member-2 leaves G(1, db) and keeps its checkpoint there.
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 1, nil, []string{"member-2"}, true))
	requireStored("after leaving")
	// Group removal: dbx's only incarnation is purged, which removes G(1, dbx).
	purgeByOwnerAndPool(t, f, "dbx", "t", 210, dbx)
	mustApply(t, f, memberPurged(t, f, "member-2", dbx))
	if f.groupLocked(1, "dbx") != nil {
		t.Fatal("G(1, dbx) outlived its last physical incarnation")
	}
	requireStored("after group removal")
	// Re-registration replaces the node record only.
	reregisterMember(t, f, "member-2", 2)
	requireStored("after re-registration")
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 2, []string{"member-2"}, nil, true))
	rejectGroupCommand(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 3, cpGroup("db", 3))),
		"member checkpoint: checkpoint_seq 3 is not above 3", false)
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 4, cpGroup("db", 3))))
	if got := storedSeq(t, f, "member-2", 1).CheckpointSeq; got != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("stored seq %d, want 4", got)
	}
}

func TestCheckpointSeqRestartsWhenTheReplicaSignerRotates(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := checkpointsFSM(t)
	m := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 5, cpGroup("db", 1))))
	rotated := rotateReplicaSigner(t, f, a, 2, "member-2", "rotated member-2 replica key")
	if got := f.storedCheckpointSeqLocked("member-2", 1, strings.ToLower(rotated.Address())); got != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("the stored seq under the new signer = %d, want 0", got)
	}
	rejectGroupCommand(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 6, cpGroup("db", 1))),
		"member checkpoint: replica signature: ", true)
	mustApply(t, f, signedCheckpoint(t, f, rotated, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 1, cpGroup("db", 1))))
	if got := storedSeq(t, f, "member-2", 1); got.CheckpointSeq != 1 || got.ReplicaSigner != strings.ToLower(rotated.Address()) {
		t.Fatalf("stored seq after the rotation %+v", got)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(snapshotBytes(t, restoreInto(t, snapshotBytes(t, f))), snapshotBytes(t, f)) {
		t.Fatal("a state with a rotated replica signer does not round-trip")
	}
}

func TestAMemberThatLostItsStateResumesAboveThePublishedSeq(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := checkpointsFSM(t)
	m := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 7, cpGroup("db", 1))))
	// The member lost its journal: a fresh one would start at 1, which is
	// refused; the registry view publishes where it must resume.
	rejectGroupCommand(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 1, cpGroup("db", 1))),
		"member checkpoint: checkpoint_seq 1 is not above 7", false)
	view, _ := f.TableRegistryView()
	signer := strings.ToLower(stage3ReplicaSigner(t, "member-2").Address())
	var resume uint64
	for _, s := range view.MemberCheckpointSeqs {
		if s.NodeID == "member-2" && s.OwnerIndexerID == 1 && s.ReplicaSigner == signer {
			resume = s.CheckpointSeq + 1
		}
	}
	if resume != 8 {
		t.Fatalf("the published seq resumes at %d, want 8", resume)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, resume, cpGroup("db", 1))))
}

func TestRegistryViewPublishesTheCheckpointSeq(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := checkpointsFSM(t)
	m := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	signer := strings.ToLower(stage3ReplicaSigner(t, "member-2").Address())
	for _, cp := range []arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{
		memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 2, cpGroup("db", 1)),
		memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 0, 1, cpGroup("db0", 1)),
	} {
		version := registryVersion(f)
		mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, cp))
		if registryVersion(f) != version+1 {
			t.Fatalf("checkpoint for indexer %d bumped the registry version %d -> %d", cp.OwnerIndexerID, version, registryVersion(f))
		}
	}
	view, _ := f.TableRegistryView()
	want := []MemberCheckpointSeq{{NodeID: "member-2", OwnerIndexerID: 0, CheckpointSeq: 1, ReplicaSigner: signer},
		{NodeID: "member-2", OwnerIndexerID: 1, CheckpointSeq: 2, ReplicaSigner: signer}}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(view.MemberCheckpointSeqs, want) {
		t.Fatalf("view seqs %+v, want %+v", view.MemberCheckpointSeqs, want)
	}
	// The view is a detached copy.
	view.MemberCheckpointSeqs[0].CheckpointSeq = 99
	view.Groups[1].Group.Members[1].Checkpoint.Checkpoint.Groups[0].GroupGeneration = 99
	if storedSeq(t, f, "member-2", 0).CheckpointSeq != 1 || memberOf(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2").Checkpoint.Checkpoint.Groups[0].GroupGeneration != 1 {
		t.Fatal("the registry view aliases committed state")
	}
}

func TestRestoreReverifiesCheckpointSignaturesUnderEachEpochsReplicaSigner(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := checkpointsFSM(t)
	m := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 0, 1, cpGroup("db0", 1))))
	oldEpoch := f.st.ConsensusEpoch
	rotated := rotateReplicaSigner(t, f, a, 2, "member-2", "rotated member-2 replica key")
	mustApply(t, f, signedCheckpoint(t, f, rotated, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 1, cpGroup("db", 1))))
	if got := memberOf(t, f, 0, "db0", "member-2").Checkpoint.Epoch; got != oldEpoch || f.st.ConsensusEpoch == oldEpoch {
		t.Fatalf("the indexer 0 checkpoint is recorded in epoch %d; the rotation epoch is %d", got, f.st.ConsensusEpoch)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(snapshotBytes(t, restoreInto(t, snapshotBytes(t, f))), snapshotBytes(t, f)) {
		t.Fatal("checkpoints under two epochs' signers do not round-trip")
	}
	groupOf := func(st *State, owner uint64) *DatabaseGroup {
		for _, g := range st.Stage3.Groups {
			if g.Owner == owner {
				return g
			}
		}
		t.Fatalf("no group of indexer %d", owner)
		return nil
	}
	recordOf := func(st *State, owner uint64) *MemberCheckpointRecord {
		g := groupOf(st, owner)
		return g.Members[groupMemberIndex(g, "member-2")].Checkpoint
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(st *State)
	}{
		{"old record under the rotated signer's epoch", func(st *State) { recordOf(st, 0).Epoch = st.ConsensusEpoch }},
		{"new record under the old signer's epoch", func(st *State) { recordOf(st, 1).Epoch = oldEpoch }},
		{"another token", func(st *State) { recordOf(st, 0).ReplicaJWS = recordOf(st, 1).ReplicaJWS }},
		{"an edited body", func(st *State) {
			recordOf(st, 0).Checkpoint.Groups[0].Excluded = []arbiter.ExcludedTable{{TableID: "db0.x", Reason: arbiter.ExclusionRetiring}}
		}},
	} {
		owner := uint64(0)
		if strings.HasPrefix(tc.name, "new") {
			owner = 1
		}
		want := fmt.Sprintf("snapshot member member-2 checkpoint 1 of indexer %d: ", owner)
		if err := restoreErr(t, forgedGroupsSnapshot(t, f, tc.mutate)); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), want) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: restore = %v, want %q", tc.name, err, want)
		}
	}
	far := forgedGroupsSnapshot(t, f, func(st *State) { recordOf(st, 0).Epoch = st.ConsensusEpoch + 1 })
	if err := restoreErr(t, far); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "is beyond the consensus epoch") {
		t.Fatalf("restore of a future epoch = %v", err)
	}
}

func TestRestoreRefusesACheckpointSeqBelowAStoredCheckpoint(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := checkpointsFSM(t)
	m := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 3, cpGroup("db", 1))))
	lowered := forgedGroupsSnapshot(t, f, func(st *State) { st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs[0].CheckpointSeq = 2 })
	want := "snapshot member member-2 checkpoint_seq 2 of indexer 1 is below a stored checkpoint 3"
	if err := restoreErr(t, lowered); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), want) {
		t.Fatalf("restore = %v, want %q", err, want)
	}
	dropped := forgedGroupsSnapshot(t, f, func(st *State) { st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs = nil })
	want = "snapshot member member-2 checkpoint_seq 0 of indexer 1 is below a stored checkpoint 3"
	if err := restoreErr(t, dropped); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), want) {
		t.Fatalf("restore = %v, want %q", err, want)
	}
	// A seq accepted under another signer does not bound the record.
	other := forgedGroupsSnapshot(t, f, func(st *State) {
		st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs[0].CheckpointSeq, st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs[0].ReplicaSigner = 1, "0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000ff"
	})
	if err := restoreErr(t, other); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("restore with a seq of another signer = %v", err)
	}
}

func TestRestoreRefusesAClassInconsistentWithItsCheckpoint(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := checkpointsFSM(t)
	registerMember(t, f, "member-3")
	m0 := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m0, "member-2", 1, 1, cpGroup("db", 1))))
	m1 := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m1, "member-3", 1, 1, cpGroup("db", 1))))
	requireClass(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2", MemberBehind)
	requireClass(t, f, 1, "db", "member-3", MemberCaughtUp)
	member := func(st *State, node string) *GroupMember {
		for _, g := range st.Stage3.Groups {
			if g.Owner == 1 && g.DatabaseID == "db" {
				return &g.Members[groupMemberIndex(g, node)]
			}
		}
		t.Fatal("no G(1, db)")
		return nil
	}
	published := frontierOf(t, m1, 1)
	past := published
	past.SafeBlockSeq++
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		mutate func(st *State)
		want   string
	}{
		{func(st *State) { member(st, "member-0").Class = MemberBehind }, `member member-0 of group of indexer 1 database "db" is behind without a checkpoint, or bootstrapping with one`},
		{func(st *State) { member(st, "member-2").Class = MemberBootstrapping }, `member member-2 of group of indexer 1 database "db" is bootstrapping without a checkpoint, or bootstrapping with one`},
		{func(st *State) { member(st, "member-2").Class = MemberCaughtUp }, `member member-2 of group of indexer 1 database "db" is caught_up at an entry other than the published one, or behind at it`},
		{func(st *State) { member(st, "member-3").Class = MemberBehind }, `member member-3 of group of indexer 1 database "db" is caught_up at an entry other than the published one, or behind at it`},
		{func(st *State) { member(st, "member-2").ObservedEntry = &published }, `member member-2 of group of indexer 1 database "db" has an observed entry without being lagging, or lagging without one, or one past the published entry`},
		{func(st *State) { member(st, "member-2").Class = MemberLagging }, `member member-2 of group of indexer 1 database "db" has an observed entry without being lagging, or lagging without one, or one past the published entry`},
		{func(st *State) {
			member(st, "member-2").Class, member(st, "member-2").ObservedEntry = MemberLagging, &past
		}, `member member-2 of group of indexer 1 database "db" has an observed entry without being lagging, or lagging without one, or one past the published entry`},
		{func(st *State) { member(st, "member-2").Checkpoint.Checkpoint.NodeID = "member-3" }, `checkpoint of member member-2 in group of indexer 1 database "db" names another node, owner or database, or a generation outside [1, 1]`},
		{func(st *State) { member(st, "member-2").Checkpoint.Checkpoint.Groups[0].DatabaseID = "db0" }, `checkpoint of member member-2 in group of indexer 1 database "db" names another node, owner or database, or a generation outside [1, 1]`},
		{func(st *State) { member(st, "member-2").Checkpoint.Checkpoint.Groups[0].GroupGeneration = 2 }, `checkpoint of member member-2 in group of indexer 1 database "db" names another node, owner or database, or a generation outside [1, 1]`},
		{func(st *State) {
			s := st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs
			st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs = []MemberCheckpointSeq{s[1], s[0]}
		}, "checkpoint seqs are not sorted by (node_id, owner_indexer_id) without duplicates"},
		{func(st *State) { st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances = append(st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances, st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances[0]) }, "owner advances are not sorted by owner without duplicates"},
		{func(st *State) {
			r := st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances[0].Recent
			st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances[0].Recent = []replay.TrackFrontier{r[1], r[0]}
		}, "owner advances of indexer 1 are not strictly ascending, exceed 9 entries or pass its published entry"},
		{func(st *State) { st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances[0].Recent = append(st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances[0].Recent, past) }, "owner advances of indexer 1 are not strictly ascending, exceed 9 entries or pass its published entry"},
	} {
		want := "snapshot stage3 checkpoints: " + tc.want
		if err := restoreErr(t, forgedGroupsSnapshot(t, f, tc.mutate)); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), want) {
			t.Fatalf("restore = %v, want %q", err, want)
		}
	}
	off, _ := groupsFSM(t)
	forged := forgedGroupsSnapshot(t, off, func(st *State) {
		st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs = []MemberCheckpointSeq{{NodeID: "member-2", OwnerIndexerID: 1, CheckpointSeq: 1, ReplicaSigner: "0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000ff"}}
	})
	if err := restoreErr(t, forged); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "snapshot stage3 checkpoints: checkpoint state exists while the checkpoints switch is off") {
		t.Fatalf("restore before the switch = %v", err)
	}
}

// TestRestoreRefusesACheckpointOffItsPublishedManifest: restore binds every
// stored checkpoint, a Leaving record's included, to a published manifest
// whose track_frontiers entry for its owner is its entry, as
// MemberCheckpoint's refusals 12 and 13 bind it at Apply, and every recent
// advance of an owner to an entry a published manifest carries for it (plan
// S3-E3 contract §52.3). Each forged checkpoint is signed again by its node's
// replica signer under its stored epoch and keeps its checkpoint_seq and a
// class that agrees with its entry, so the proofs and the class rules pass
// and only the binding can refuse it; the class rules alone would take a
// checkpoint ahead of the published entry for behind.
func TestRestoreRefusesACheckpointOffItsPublishedManifest(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := checkpointsFSM(t)
	registerMember(t, f, "member-3")
	m0 := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m0, "member-2", 1, 1, cpGroup("db", 1))))
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m0, "member-3", 1, 1, cpGroup("db", 1))))
	// member-2 leaves G(1, db) and keeps its checkpoint in its Leaving record.
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 1, "db", 1, nil, []string{"member-2"}, true))
	m1 := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	requireClass(t, f, 1, "db", "member-3", MemberBehind)
	// Checkpoints on published manifests, a Leaving record's included, and
	// the advances publications appended restore unchanged.
	if !bytes.Equal(snapshotBytes(t, restoreInto(t, snapshotBytes(t, f))), snapshotBytes(t, f)) {
		t.Fatal("checkpoints on published manifests do not round-trip")
	}
	group := func(st *State) *DatabaseGroup {
		for _, g := range st.Stage3.Groups {
			if g.Owner == 1 && g.DatabaseID == "db" {
				return g
			}
		}
		t.Fatal("no G(1, db)")
		return nil
	}
	current := func(st *State) *MemberCheckpointRecord {
		g := group(st)
		return g.Members[groupMemberIndex(g, "member-3")].Checkpoint
	}
	leaving := func(st *State) *MemberCheckpointRecord {
		for _, l := range group(st).Leaving {
			if l.Member.NodeID == "member-2" {
				return l.Member.Checkpoint
			}
		}
		t.Fatal("member-2 is not Leaving G(1, db)")
		return nil
	}
	// resign edits rec's checkpoint and signs it again with its node's
	// replica signer, keeping its epoch and checkpoint_seq.
	resign := func(rec *MemberCheckpointRecord, edit func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint)) {
		edit(&rec.Checkpoint)
		jws, err := stage3ReplicaSigner(t, rec.Checkpoint.NodeID).SignMemberCheckpointAt(messageContextFor(t, f), rec.Checkpoint, authoritytest.Iat)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		rec.ReplicaJWS = jws
	}
	recent := func(st *State) []replay.TrackFrontier {
		i, found := ownerAdvancesIndex(st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances, 1)
		if !found || len(st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances[i].Recent) != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("owner advances %+v, want m0's and m1's entries of indexer 1", st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances)
		}
		return st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances[i].Recent
	}
	ahead := frontierOf(t, m1, 1)
	ahead.SafeBlockSeq++
	offManifest := func(node, snapshot string) string {
		return fmt.Sprintf(`checkpoint of member %s in group of indexer 1 database "db" names snapshot %s, which is not a published manifest, or an entry other than its track_frontiers entry for the indexer`, node, snapshot)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(st *State)
		want   string
	}{
		{"an unpublished snapshot", func(st *State) {
			resign(current(st), func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.SnapshotID = "0xnope" })
		}, offManifest("member-3", "0xnope")},
		{"an entry ahead of the published one", func(st *State) {
			resign(current(st), func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.Entry = ahead })
		}, offManifest("member-3", m0.SnapshotID)},
		{"another published manifest's snapshot", func(st *State) {
			resign(current(st), func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.SnapshotID = m1.SnapshotID })
		}, offManifest("member-3", m1.SnapshotID)},
		{"a Leaving record on an unpublished snapshot", func(st *State) {
			resign(leaving(st), func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.SnapshotID = "0xnope" })
		}, offManifest("member-2", "0xnope")},
		{"a Leaving record ahead of the published entry", func(st *State) {
			resign(leaving(st), func(cp *arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) { cp.Entry = ahead })
		}, offManifest("member-2", m0.SnapshotID)},
		// Indexer 0's entry of m0, which m0 carries for indexer 0 only and
		// which sorts before m1's entry of indexer 1.
		{"another indexer's published entry", func(st *State) {
			recent(st)[0] = frontierOf(t, m0, 0)
		}, "owner advances of indexer 1 hold an entry that no published manifest carries for the indexer"},
		// m0's block with one more applied promotion: still below m1's
		// later block, so ascending and not past the published entry, but
		// no manifest carries it.
		{"an advance no publication made", func(st *State) {
			recent(st)[0].AppliedPromotionSeq++
		}, "owner advances of indexer 1 hold an entry that no published manifest carries for the indexer"},
	} {
		want := "snapshot stage3 checkpoints: " + tc.want
		if err := restoreErr(t, forgedGroupsSnapshot(t, f, tc.mutate)); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), want) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: restore = %v, want %q", tc.name, err, want)
		}
	}
}

// TestInternedBodyKeepsTheGroupLayer: plan S3-E2 contract §46's interned body
// round-trips a state holding every part of the group layer, built through
// Apply: groups and a Leaving record (Task 71), blocks sealed under group
// keys (Task 72), a readiness record (Task 73), a re-selection (Task 74), and
// checkpoints, checkpoint seqs and owner advances (this task).
func TestInternedBodyKeepsTheGroupLayer(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := groupsFSM(t)
	registerMember(t, f, "member-2")
	key := stage3MemberKey("member-2")
	active, err := authority.SignVerifierMessage(key, authority.VerifierMessageMarkActive, messageContextFor(t, f),
		authority.MarkActiveBody{NodeID: "member-2", RegistrationSeq: 1})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, wire.Command{MarkActive: &wire.MarkActive{NodeID: "member-2", RegistrationSeq: 1, Ed25519Signature: active}})
	ready := wire.MemberReady{NodeID: "member-2", OwnerIndexerID: 1, DatabaseID: "db", Generation: 1}
	if ready.Ed25519Signature, err = authority.SignMemberReady(key, messageContextFor(t, f), ready.Body()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, wire.Command{MemberReady: &ready})
	turnOnStage3Switch(t, f, a, Stage3SwitchReselection)
	turnOnStage3Switch(t, f, a, Stage3SwitchCheckpoints)
	m := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 0)
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 0, 1, cpGroup("db0", 1))))
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 1, cpGroup("db", 1))))
	mustApply(t, f, rebalanceCmd(t, f, a, 0, "db0", 1, nil, []string{"member-3"}, true))
	// An owner 1 block marked under its group seal, whose first verifier is
	// evicted before it answers and replaced from the stored ring.
	keyA, account := testAccount(t)
	stmt := admitTrack(t, f, keyA, account, 1, 1)
	block := mustSeal(t, f).BlockSeq
	bindTrackClaim(t, f, stmt)
	mustApply(t, f, wire.Command{MarkReplaying: &wire.MarkReplaying{BlockSeq: block}})
	bv := f.st.Verifications[block]
	if len(bv.EligibleRing) <= VerifierSelectN {
		t.Fatalf("eligible ring %v leaves no replacement", bv.EligibleRing)
	}
	set := slices.Clone(bv.VerifierSet)
	mustApply(t, f, evictCmd(t, f, a, set[0], f.st.Nodes[set[0]].Registration.RegistrationSeq))
	reselect := wire.ReselectVerifiers{L3BlockSeq: block, ExpectedSet: set}
	if reselect.AuthorityJWS, err = a.SignReselectVerifiersWithContextAt(reselect.Canonical(), authorityContextFor(t, f), authoritytest.Iat); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, wire.Command{ReselectVerifiers: &reselect})
	plain := snapshotBytes(t, f)
	_, plainBody, plainTail := v21Parts(t, plain)
	for _, field := range []string{`"groups":`, `"group_generations":`, `"leaving":`, `"frozen_e":`, `"past_members":`, `"ready_signature":`,
		`"group_key":`, `"group_databases":`, `"placement_cutover_block":`, `"reselections":`, `"checkpoint":`, `"checkpoint_seqs":`,
		`"owner_advances":`, `"purge_members":`} {
		if !bytes.Contains(plainBody, []byte(field)) {
			t.Fatalf("the plain body carries no %s", field)
		}
	}
	interned := persistedSnapshotBytes(t, f)
	kind, body, tail := v21Parts(t, interned)
	if kind != snapshotBodyInterned || !bytes.Equal(tail, plainTail) {
		t.Fatalf("persisted body kind %d", kind)
	}
	rehydrated, err := RehydrateSnapshotBody(body)
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(rehydrated, plainBody) {
		t.Fatalf("the interned body does not rehydrate to the plain body: %v", err)
	}
	if got := snapshotBytes(t, restoreInto(t, interned)); !bytes.Equal(got, plain) {
		t.Fatal("the interned container restores to another state")
	}
}
```

```go
package fsm

// Member classes and lag (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §9.2; plan S3-E3

// setLagBounds commits max_lag_publications and lag_low.
func setLagBounds(t *testing.T, f *FSM, a *authority.Signer, maxLag, low uint32) {
	t.Helper()
	updateStage3(t, f, a, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) {
		u.Stage3.MaxLagPublications, u.Stage3.LagLow = maxLag, low
	})
}

// ownerRecent is owner's recent advances.
func ownerRecent(f *FSM, owner uint64) []replay.TrackFrontier {
	if i, found := ownerAdvancesIndex(f.st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances, owner); found {
		return f.st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances[i].Recent
	}
	return nil
}

// servedLag is the lag the registry view serves for node in G(owner,
// database).
func servedLag(t *testing.T, f *FSM, owner uint64, database, node string) uint32 {
	t.Helper()
	view, _ := f.TableRegistryView()
	for _, g := range view.Groups {
		if g.Group.Owner != owner || g.Group.DatabaseID != database {
			continue
		}
		for i, m := range g.Group.Members {
			if m.NodeID == node {
				return g.MemberViews[i].LagAdvances
			}
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("the view serves no %s in G(%d, %s)", node, owner, database)
	return 0
}

	checkpoint(ms[4]) // at the observed entry, not past it

	checkpoint(ms[5]) // past the observed entry, lag 2 is not below 2

	requireClass(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2", MemberCaughtUp)

func TestPublicationBumpsTheRegistryVersionWhenAMemberHoldsACheckpoint(t *testing.T) {
	f, a := checkpointsFSM(t)
	publish := func(owner uint64) (replay.SafeSnapshotManifest, uint64) {
		t.Helper()
		key, account := testAccount(t)
		_, promotions := passTrackBlock(t, f, a, key, account, owner, 1)
		version := registryVersion(f)
		m := publishManifestInputs(t, f)
		bumps := registryVersion(f) - version
		for _, p := range promotions {
			cleanTrackPromotion(t, f, a, p)
		}
		return m, bumps
	}
	m, bumps := publish(1)
	if bumps != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a publication without a checkpoint in the owner's groups bumped %d times", bumps)
	}
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m, "member-2", 1, 1, cpGroup("db", 1))))
	if _, bumps := publish(1); bumps != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("a publication that moved a class bumped %d times, want 1", bumps)
	}
	requireClass(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2", MemberBehind)
	if _, bumps := publish(1); bumps != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("a publication that moved only a lag bumped %d times, want 1", bumps)
	}
	if _, bumps := publish(0); bumps != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a publication of an owner whose groups hold no checkpoint bumped %d times", bumps)
	}
}
```

```go
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority/authoritytest"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// MarkMemberLagging (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §9.2, §16; plan S3-E3
// contract §52.3, K77) on the checkpoints fixture of
// member_checkpoint_test.go.

// markLaggingCmd is MarkMemberLagging of node in G(owner, database) observed
// at observed, signed by signer under f's current authority context.
func markLaggingCmd(t *testing.T, f *FSM, signer *authority.Signer, node string, owner uint64, database string, observed replay.TrackFrontier) wire.Command {
	t.Helper()
	cmd := wire.MarkMemberLagging{NodeID: node, OwnerIndexerID: owner, DatabaseID: database, ObservedEntry: observed}
	token, err := signer.SignMarkMemberLaggingWithContextAt(cmd.Canonical(), authorityContextFor(t, f), authoritytest.Iat)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cmd.AuthorityJWS = token
	return wire.Command{MarkMemberLagging: &cmd}
}

// behindMember is the checkpoints fixture with member-2 checkpointed in G(1,
// db) at the first published manifest and behind after the second; it
// returns both manifests' frontiers of indexer 1.
func behindMember(t *testing.T) (*FSM, *authority.Signer, replay.TrackFrontier, replay.TrackFrontier) {
	t.Helper()
	f, a := checkpointsFSM(t)
	m1 := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, m1, "member-2", 1, 1, cpGroup("db", 1))))
	m2 := publishOwnerBlock(t, f, a, 1)
	requireClass(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2", MemberBehind)
	return f, a, frontierOf(t, m1, 1), frontierOf(t, m2, 1)
}

func TestMarkMemberLaggingRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	off, offA := groupsFSM(t)
	rejectGroupCommand(t, off, markLaggingCmd(t, off, offA, "member-2", 1, "db", replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 1}),
		"marking a member lagging is refused until the checkpoints switch is on", false)

	f, a, entry, published := behindMember(t)
	registerMember(t, f, "member-3")
	foreign := authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.IndexerKeyHex1)
	beyond := published
	beyond.AppliedPromotionSeq++
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		cmd    wire.Command
		want   string
		prefix bool
	}{
		{"2 no node", wire.Command{MarkMemberLagging: &wire.MarkMemberLagging{OwnerIndexerID: 1, DatabaseID: "db", AuthorityJWS: "a.b.c"}},
			"mark member lagging: node_id and database_id are required", false},
		{"2 no database", wire.Command{MarkMemberLagging: &wire.MarkMemberLagging{NodeID: "member-2", OwnerIndexerID: 1, AuthorityJWS: "a.b.c"}},
			"mark member lagging: node_id and database_id are required", false},
		{"3 no group", markLaggingCmd(t, f, a, "member-2", 1, "nodb", published), `mark member lagging: no group for indexer 1 database "nodb"`, false},
		{"4 unsigned", wire.Command{MarkMemberLagging: &wire.MarkMemberLagging{NodeID: "member-2", OwnerIndexerID: 1, DatabaseID: "db", ObservedEntry: published}},
			`mark member lagging indexer 1 database "db": authority: `, true},
		{"4 not an authority", markLaggingCmd(t, f, foreign, "member-2", 1, "db", published), `mark member lagging indexer 1 database "db": authority: `, true},
		{"4 another command", func() wire.Command {
			cmd := markLaggingCmd(t, f, a, "member-2", 1, "db", published)
			other := *cmd.MarkMemberLagging
			other.ObservedEntry = entry
			return wire.Command{MarkMemberLagging: &other}
		}(), `mark member lagging indexer 1 database "db": authority: `, true},
		{"5 not a member", markLaggingCmd(t, f, a, "member-1", 1, "db", published), `mark member lagging: member-1 is not a current member of group indexer 1 database "db"`, false},
		{"7 bootstrapping", markLaggingCmd(t, f, a, "member-0", 1, "db", published), "mark member lagging: member-0 is bootstrapping", false},
		{"8 at the checkpoint entry", markLaggingCmd(t, f, a, "member-2", 1, "db", entry),
			"mark member lagging: observed_entry must be after the checkpoint entry of member-2 and at or before the published entry of indexer 1", false},
		{"8 beyond the published entry", markLaggingCmd(t, f, a, "member-2", 1, "db", beyond),
			"mark member lagging: observed_entry must be after the checkpoint entry of member-2 and at or before the published entry of indexer 1", false},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) { rejectGroupCommand(t, f, tc.cmd, tc.want, tc.prefix) })
	}
	// A caught_up member sits at the published entry, so no observed entry
	// is after it and at or before it.
	mustApply(t, f, memberCheckpointCmd(t, f, memberCheckpointAt(t, mustManifest(t, f), "member-3", 1, 1, cpGroup("db", 1))))
	requireClass(t, f, 1, "db", "member-3", MemberCaughtUp)
	rejectGroupCommand(t, f, markLaggingCmd(t, f, a, "member-3", 1, "db", published),
		"mark member lagging: observed_entry must be after the checkpoint entry of member-3 and at or before the published entry of indexer 1", false)
	mustApply(t, f, markLaggingCmd(t, f, a, "member-2", 1, "db", published))
	rejectGroupCommand(t, f, markLaggingCmd(t, f, a, "member-2", 1, "db", published), "mark member lagging: member-2 is lagging", false)
	mustApply(t, f, quarantineQ(t, f, a, 1, 0, "operator hold"))
	rejectGroupCommand(t, f, markLaggingCmd(t, f, a, "member-3", 1, "db", published), "mark member lagging: indexer 1 is quarantined and accrues no lag", false)
}

// mustManifest is f's latest published manifest.
func mustManifest(t *testing.T, f *FSM) replay.SafeSnapshotManifest {
	t.Helper()
	m, ok := f.ManifestByID(f.SafeWatermarkView().SnapshotID)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("no published manifest")
	}
	return *m
}

func TestMarkMemberLaggingRecordsTheObservedEntry(t *testing.T) {
	f, a, _, published := behindMember(t)
	if rows := f.MemberLagWork(); len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].NodeID != "member-2" {
		t.Fatalf("lag rows %+v", rows)
	}
	version := registryVersion(f)
	mustApply(t, f, markLaggingCmd(t, f, a, "member-2", 1, "db", published))
	m := memberOf(t, f, 1, "db", "member-2")
	if m.Class != MemberLagging || m.ObservedEntry == nil || *m.ObservedEntry != published {
		t.Fatalf("member-2 = %s observed at %+v, want lagging at %+v", m.Class, m.ObservedEntry, published)
	}
	if registryVersion(f) != version+1 {
		t.Fatalf("registry version %d, want %d", registryVersion(f), version+1)
	}
	if rows := f.MemberLagWork(); len(rows) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a lagging member is still a lag row: %+v", rows)
	}
	view, _ := f.TableRegistryView()
	for _, g := range view.Groups {
		if g.Group.Owner == 1 && g.Group.DatabaseID == "db" {
			served := g.Group.Members[groupMemberIndex(&g.Group, "member-2")]
			if served.Class != MemberLagging || served.ObservedEntry == nil || *served.ObservedEntry != published || served.ObservedEntry == m.ObservedEntry {
				t.Fatalf("the view serves %+v", served)
			}
		}
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(snapshotBytes(t, restoreInto(t, snapshotBytes(t, f))), snapshotBytes(t, f)) {
		t.Fatal("a lagging member does not round-trip")
	}
}
```

```go
// cloneGroupMember is a deep copy of m: its checkpoint record and observed
// entry are detached.
func cloneGroupMember(m GroupMember) GroupMember {
	if m.Checkpoint != nil {
		rec := *m.Checkpoint
		rec.Checkpoint = cloneMemberCheckpoint(m.Checkpoint.Checkpoint)
		m.Checkpoint = &rec
	}
	if m.ObservedEntry != nil {

	}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Add checkpoints, classes and lag**

Create `fsm/member_checkpoint.go`:

```go
package fsm

import (
	"bytes"
	"cmp"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// Member checkpoints and classes (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §9.1, §9.2; plan
// S3-E3 contract §52.3, clarification K76). From the checkpoints switch on a
// replicate member states, with its verifiers-entry replica_signer, that its
// copies of the listed groups' tables equal a published manifest at its
// owner's entry. Each accepted checkpoint carries a checkpoint_seq above the
// one stored for (member, owner) under the same replica_signer; the stored
// value survives group removal, leaving and re-registration, is published in
// the registry view, and restarts only when the replica_signer rotates. A
// member's class in a group follows from its checkpoint entry: caught_up at
// the owner's published entry, behind before it, lagging once it trails by
// more than max_lag_publications published advances of a non-quarantined
// owner, and back to behind only past the entry it was marked at with lag
// below lag_low. Lag is counted in the owner's recent advances, which every
// publication appends while the switch is on, so the state stays bounded by
// owners × (max_lag_publications + 1) and needs no walk of the chain.

// MemberCheckpointRecord is a stored checkpoint: the signed body, the
// replica_signer's token, and the consensus epoch whose verifiers listing
// supplied that signer, under which restore re-verifies it.
type MemberCheckpointRecord struct {
	Checkpoint arbiter.MemberCheckpoint `json:"checkpoint"`
	ReplicaJWS string                   `json:"replica_jws"`
	Epoch      uint64                   `json:"epoch"`
}

// MemberCheckpointSeq is the highest accepted checkpoint_seq of one member
// for one owner, with the replica_signer it was accepted under.
type MemberCheckpointSeq struct {
	NodeID         string `json:"node_id"`
	OwnerIndexerID uint64 `json:"owner_indexer_id"`
	CheckpointSeq  uint64 `json:"checkpoint_seq"`
	ReplicaSigner  string `json:"replica_signer"` // the key it was accepted under
}

// OwnerAdvances is one owner's recent published advances: the distinct
// entries its published entry advanced to while it was not quarantined,
// oldest first, at most max_lag_publications + 1 of them.
type OwnerAdvances struct {
	Owner  uint64                 `json:"owner"`
	Recent []replay.TrackFrontier `json:"recent,omitempty"` // strictly ascending, at most max_lag_publications + 1
}

// memberCheckpointsBeforeSwitchReason is Apply's first refusal of
// MemberCheckpoint (plan S3-E1 K67, contract §49);
// VerifierGateway.SubmitMemberCheckpoint answers it without a proposal.
const memberCheckpointsBeforeSwitchReason = "member checkpoints are refused until the checkpoints switch is on"

// checkpointExclusionReasons is the closed set of exclusion reasons (plan
// S3-E1 K63).
var checkpointExclusionReasons = []arbiter.CheckpointExclusionReason{arbiter.ExclusionNotInstalled, arbiter.ExclusionDiverged,
	arbiter.ExclusionForeign, arbiter.ExclusionDiskThreshold, arbiter.ExclusionAuditPending, arbiter.ExclusionRetiring}

// entryCompare orders two entries of one owner's track (K76) by
// (SafeBlockSeq, AppliedPromotionSeq); IndexerID is not compared. Neither
// field ever decreases along the watermark chain, so this is the chain's
// order.
func entryCompare(a, b replay.TrackFrontier) int {
	if c := cmp.Compare(a.SafeBlockSeq, b.SafeBlockSeq); c != 0 {
		return c
	}
	return cmp.Compare(a.AppliedPromotionSeq, b.AppliedPromotionSeq)
}

// ownerAdvancesIndex is the index of owner's record in advances and whether
// it exists.
func ownerAdvancesIndex(advances []OwnerAdvances, owner uint64) (int, bool) {
	return slices.BinarySearchFunc(advances, owner, func(a OwnerAdvances, o uint64) int { return cmp.Compare(a.Owner, o) })
}

// memberLagLocked is a member's lag in published advances of owner (spec
// §9.2): how many of the owner's recent advances lie after entry. Recent
// holds at most MaxLagPublications+1 entries, so the lag saturates there
// (D31).
func (f *FSM) memberLagLocked(owner uint64, entry replay.TrackFrontier) uint32 {
	if f.st.Stage3 == nil {
		return 0
	}
	i, found := ownerAdvancesIndex(f.st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances, owner)
	if !found {
		return 0
	}
	var lag uint32
	for _, e := range f.st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances[i].Recent {
		if entryCompare(e, entry) > 0 {
			lag++
		}
	}
	return lag
}

// classifyMemberLocked sets the class of member m of one of owner's groups
// from its checkpoint entry (spec §9.2); a member without a checkpoint keeps
// its class. A lagging member returns, clearing its observed entry, only once
// its entry is past the observed one and its lag is below lag_low: to
// caught_up at the owner's published entry, else to behind. Any other member
// becomes lagging, observed at the published entry, when its lag exceeds
// max_lag_publications and the owner is not quarantined, and otherwise
// caught_up at the published entry or behind before it.
func (f *FSM) classifyMemberLocked(owner uint64, m *GroupMember) {
	if m.Checkpoint == nil {
		return
	}
	entry := m.Checkpoint.Checkpoint.Entry
	published := f.publishedTrackFrontierLocked(owner)
	lag := f.memberLagLocked(owner, entry)
	params := f.st.Params.Stage3
	settle := func() {
		m.ObservedEntry = nil
		if entryCompare(entry, published) == 0 {
			m.Class = MemberCaughtUp
		} else {
			m.Class = MemberBehind
		}
	}
	if m.Class == MemberLagging {
		if m.ObservedEntry != nil && entryCompare(entry, *m.ObservedEntry) > 0 && lag < params.LagLow {
			settle()
		}
		return
	}
	if lag > params.MaxLagPublications && !f.indexerQuarantinedLocked(owner) {
		observed := published
		m.Class, m.ObservedEntry = MemberLagging, &observed
		return
	}
	settle()
}

// recordOwnerAdvanceLocked is the checkpoints switch's half of a publication
// (K76), called by applyPublishSafeSnapshot after the track transitions while
// the switch is on. For each owner whose entry in manifest is after its base
// under parent it appends that entry to the owner's recent advances, unless
// the owner is quarantined (a quarantined owner accrues no lag), and then
// reclassifies every caught_up or behind member of the owner's groups,
// because the published entry moved. An append can change the served
// lag_advances of every member of the owner's groups that holds a checkpoint
// (a saturated one stays at MaxLagPublications+1), so when such a member
// exists the Apply bumps the registry version once: through
// groupsChangedLocked when a class changed, else through registryChangedLocked
// alone.
func (f *FSM) recordOwnerAdvanceLocked(parent, manifest *replay.SafeSnapshotManifest) {
	classChanged, lagServed := false, false
	for _, entry := range manifest.TrackFrontiers {
		if base, ok := f.trackBaseFrontierLocked(parent, entry.IndexerID); ok && entryCompare(entry, base) <= 0 {
			continue
		}
		owner := entry.IndexerID
		if !f.indexerQuarantinedLocked(owner) {
			f.appendOwnerAdvanceLocked(owner, entry)
			lagServed = lagServed || f.ownerHoldsCheckpointLocked(owner)
		}
		for _, g := range f.st.Stage3.Groups {
			if g.Owner != owner {
				continue
			}
			for i := range g.Members {
				m := &g.Members[i]
				if m.Class != MemberCaughtUp && m.Class != MemberBehind {
					continue
				}
				before := m.Class
				f.classifyMemberLocked(owner, m)
				classChanged = classChanged || m.Class != before
			}
		}
	}
	switch {
	case classChanged:
		f.groupsChangedLocked()
	case lagServed:
		f.registryChangedLocked(f.st.TableRegistry)
	}
}

// appendOwnerAdvanceLocked appends entry to owner's recent advances, keeping
// them strictly ascending and the newest MaxLagPublications+1.
func (f *FSM) appendOwnerAdvanceLocked(owner uint64, entry replay.TrackFrontier) {
	i, found := ownerAdvancesIndex(f.st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances, owner)
	if !found {
		f.st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances = slices.Insert(f.st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances, i, OwnerAdvances{Owner: owner})
	}
	rec := &f.st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances[i]
	if n := len(rec.Recent); n > 0 && entryCompare(entry, rec.Recent[n-1]) <= 0 {
		return
	}
	rec.Recent = append(rec.Recent, entry)
	if limit := int(f.st.Params.Stage3.MaxLagPublications) + 1; len(rec.Recent) > limit {
		rec.Recent = slices.Delete(rec.Recent, 0, len(rec.Recent)-limit)
	}
}

// ownerHoldsCheckpointLocked reports whether a current member of one of
// owner's groups holds a checkpoint, which the registry view serves a lag
// for.
func (f *FSM) ownerHoldsCheckpointLocked(owner uint64) bool {
	for _, g := range f.st.Stage3.Groups {
		if g.Owner != owner {
			continue
		}
		for _, m := range g.Members {
			if m.Checkpoint != nil {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}

// trimOwnerAdvancesLocked keeps the newest MaxLagPublications+1 recent
// advances of every owner, so a lowered max_lag_publications bounds every lag
// at once. applyUpdateConsensusParams calls it when the value changes; that
// update changes Params.Stage3, which already bumps the registry version.
func (f *FSM) trimOwnerAdvancesLocked() {
	if f.st.Stage3 == nil || f.st.Params.Stage3 == nil {
		return
	}
	limit := int(f.st.Params.Stage3.MaxLagPublications) + 1
	for i := range f.st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances {
		if rec := &f.st.Stage3.OwnerAdvances[i]; len(rec.Recent) > limit {
			rec.Recent = slices.Delete(rec.Recent, 0, len(rec.Recent)-limit)
		}
	}
}

// checkpointSeqIndex is the index of (nodeID, owner) in seqs and whether it
// exists; seqs is sorted by (NodeID, OwnerIndexerID).
func checkpointSeqIndex(seqs []MemberCheckpointSeq, nodeID string, owner uint64) (int, bool) {
	return slices.BinarySearchFunc(seqs, MemberCheckpointSeq{NodeID: nodeID, OwnerIndexerID: owner}, compareCheckpointSeqKey)
}

// compareCheckpointSeqKey orders checkpoint seqs by (NodeID, OwnerIndexerID).
func compareCheckpointSeqKey(a, b MemberCheckpointSeq) int {
	if c := strings.Compare(a.NodeID, b.NodeID); c != 0 {
		return c
	}
	return cmp.Compare(a.OwnerIndexerID, b.OwnerIndexerID)
}

// storedCheckpointSeqLocked is the stored checkpoint_seq of (nodeID, owner),
// 0 when none is stored or it was accepted under another replica signer: a
// rotated signer restarts the sequence (spec §9.1).
func (f *FSM) storedCheckpointSeqLocked(nodeID string, owner uint64, replicaSigner string) uint64 {
	if f.st.Stage3 == nil {
		return 0
	}
	i, found := checkpointSeqIndex(f.st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs, nodeID, owner)
	if !found || f.st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs[i].ReplicaSigner != replicaSigner {
		return 0
	}
	return f.st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs[i].CheckpointSeq
}

// setCheckpointSeqLocked records s, keeping CheckpointSeqs sorted.
func (f *FSM) setCheckpointSeqLocked(s MemberCheckpointSeq) {
	i, found := checkpointSeqIndex(f.st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs, s.NodeID, s.OwnerIndexerID)
	if found {
		f.st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs[i] = s
		return
	}
	f.st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs = slices.Insert(f.st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs, i, s)
}

// cloneMemberCheckpoint is a deep copy of cp.
func cloneMemberCheckpoint(cp arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) arbiter.MemberCheckpoint {
	if cp.Groups != nil {
		groups := make([]arbiter.CheckpointGroup, len(cp.Groups))
		for i, g := range cp.Groups {
			g.Excluded = slices.Clone(g.Excluded)
			groups[i] = g
		}
		cp.Groups = groups
	}
	return cp
}

// memberCheckpointsEqual reports whether a and b are the same checkpoint,
// compared in their JSON form, so an empty excluded list equals an absent
// one as it does in the signed hash.
func memberCheckpointsEqual(a, b arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) bool {
	x, errA := json.Marshal(a)
	y, errB := json.Marshal(b)
	return errA == nil && errB == nil && bytes.Equal(x, y)
}

// checkpointGroupsSorted reports a non-empty group list strictly ascending by
// database id, each id non-empty.
func checkpointGroupsSorted(groups []arbiter.CheckpointGroup) bool {
	for i, g := range groups {
		if g.DatabaseID == "" || (i > 0 && groups[i-1].DatabaseID >= g.DatabaseID) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return len(groups) > 0
}

// checkpointExclusionsValidLocked reports whether cg excludes only, sorted
// by table id without repeats and each for a known reason, SI tables of its
// database owned by owner whose live incarnation is physical.
func (f *FSM) checkpointExclusionsValidLocked(owner uint64, cg arbiter.CheckpointGroup) bool {
	for i, e := range cg.Excluded {
		if (i > 0 && cg.Excluded[i-1].TableID >= e.TableID) || !slices.Contains(checkpointExclusionReasons, e.Reason) {
			return false
		}
		if db, _, ok := splitTableKey(e.TableID); !ok || db != cg.DatabaseID {
			return false
		}
		live := f.st.TableRegistry.Live(e.TableID)
		if live == nil || !live.hasPhysicalTables() || f.incarnationOwnerLocked(live) != owner {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// manifestTrackFrontier is m's track_frontiers entry for id.
func manifestTrackFrontier(m *replay.SafeSnapshotManifest, id uint64) (replay.TrackFrontier, bool) {
	for _, e := range m.TrackFrontiers {
		if e.IndexerID == id {
			return e, true
		}
	}
	return replay.TrackFrontier{}, false
}

// applyMemberCheckpoint applies MemberCheckpoint (tag 41). Every refusal
// leaves state unchanged; the order and texts are contract §52.3's, and the
// per-group refusals 7 to 10 run group by group in the checkpoint's order.
// The manifest must be on the watermark chain, which is exactly
// State.Manifests (K76), and the entry must not precede the member's previous
// checkpoint entry in any listed group. Each listed group then stores the
// whole signed checkpoint, groups the checkpoint does not list keep theirs,
// and the stored checkpoint_seq of (member, owner) moves to it.
func (f *FSM) applyMemberCheckpoint(c *wire.MemberCheckpoint) any {
	if !f.checkpointsOnLocked() {
		return Rejected{Reason: memberCheckpointsBeforeSwitchReason}
	}
	cp := c.Checkpoint
	if cp.NodeID == "" || cp.SnapshotID == "" || c.ReplicaJWS == "" {
		return Rejected{Reason: "member checkpoint: node_id, snapshot_id and replica_jws are required"}
	}
	if !checkpointGroupsSorted(cp.Groups) {
		return Rejected{Reason: "member checkpoint: groups must be non-empty and sorted by database_id without duplicates"}
	}
	node := f.st.Nodes[cp.NodeID]
	if node == nil || node.Status == NodeEvicted || !hasRole(node.Registration.Roles, arbiter.NodeRoleVerifier) {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member checkpoint: %s is not a registered, non-evicted verifier", cp.NodeID)}
	}
	entry, listed := f.verifierEntryLocked(cp.NodeID)
	if !listed || !entry.Replicate || entry.ReplicaSigner == "" {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member checkpoint: %s has no listed replicate entry with a replica_signer", cp.NodeID)}
	}
	msgCtx, err := f.messageContextLocked()
	if err == nil {
		err = authority.VerifyMemberCheckpoint(msgCtx, cp, c.ReplicaJWS, entry.ReplicaSigner)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member checkpoint: replica signature: %v", err)}
	}
	owner := cp.OwnerIndexerID
	members := make([]*GroupMember, len(cp.Groups))
	for i, cg := range cp.Groups {
		g := f.groupLocked(owner, cg.DatabaseID)
		if g == nil {
			return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member checkpoint: no group for indexer %d database %q", owner, cg.DatabaseID)}
		}
		j := groupMemberIndex(g, cp.NodeID)
		if j < 0 {
			return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member checkpoint: %s is not a current member of group indexer %d database %q", cp.NodeID, owner, cg.DatabaseID)}
		}
		m := &g.Members[j]
		if cg.GroupGeneration < m.JoinedGeneration || cg.GroupGeneration > g.Generation {
			return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member checkpoint: group_generation %d of database %q is outside [%d, %d]",
				cg.GroupGeneration, cg.DatabaseID, m.JoinedGeneration, g.Generation)}
		}
		if !f.checkpointExclusionsValidLocked(owner, cg) {
			return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member checkpoint: excluded tables of database %q must be sorted, unique SI tables of the database with a known reason", cg.DatabaseID)}
		}
		members[i] = m
	}
	if stored := f.storedCheckpointSeqLocked(cp.NodeID, owner, entry.ReplicaSigner); cp.CheckpointSeq <= stored {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member checkpoint: checkpoint_seq %d is not above %d", cp.CheckpointSeq, stored)}
	}
	manifest := f.st.Manifests[cp.SnapshotID]
	if manifest == nil {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member checkpoint: snapshot %s is not a published manifest", cp.SnapshotID)}
	}
	if frontier, ok := manifestTrackFrontier(manifest, owner); !ok || frontier != cp.Entry {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member checkpoint: entry differs from track_frontiers[%d] of snapshot %s", owner, cp.SnapshotID)}
	}
	for _, m := range members {
		if m.Checkpoint != nil && entryCompare(cp.Entry, m.Checkpoint.Checkpoint.Entry) < 0 {
			return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("member checkpoint: entry precedes the previous checkpoint entry of %s for indexer %d", cp.NodeID, owner)}
		}
	}
	for _, m := range members {
		previous := m.Checkpoint
		m.Checkpoint = &MemberCheckpointRecord{Checkpoint: cloneMemberCheckpoint(cp), ReplicaJWS: c.ReplicaJWS, Epoch: f.st.ConsensusEpoch}
		// A same-entry re-checkpoint (excluded sets changed, or a group
		// added) keeps the class; a first checkpoint or a new entry is
		// classified.
		if m.Class == MemberBootstrapping || previous == nil || previous.Checkpoint.Entry != cp.Entry {
			f.classifyMemberLocked(owner, m)
		}
	}
	f.setCheckpointSeqLocked(MemberCheckpointSeq{NodeID: cp.NodeID, OwnerIndexerID: owner, CheckpointSeq: cp.CheckpointSeq, ReplicaSigner: entry.ReplicaSigner})
	f.groupsChangedLocked()
	return Applied{}
}

// MemberCheckpointRecorded reports whether every group cp lists stores
// exactly cp for its node, so VerifierGateway.SubmitMemberCheckpoint answers
// a repeat without a proposal. It reads applied state; the gateway calls it
// behind the read barrier.
func (f *FSM) MemberCheckpointRecorded(cp arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) bool {
	f.mu.RLock()
	defer f.mu.RUnlock()
	if len(cp.Groups) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	for _, cg := range cp.Groups {
		g := f.groupLocked(cp.OwnerIndexerID, cg.DatabaseID)
		if g == nil {
			return false
		}
		j := groupMemberIndex(g, cp.NodeID)
		if j < 0 || g.Members[j].Checkpoint == nil || !memberCheckpointsEqual(g.Members[j].Checkpoint.Checkpoint, cp) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
```

```go
package fsm

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// MarkMemberLagging (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §9.2, §16; plan S3-E3
// contract §52.3, clarification K77) marks a caught_up or behind member of
// one group lagging at an observed entry of its owner. The leader's
// orchestrator proposes it once a member's checkpoint entry has stayed behind
// the owner's published entry for dispatch.member_lagging_timeout, and an
// operator may send it through ConsensusAdmin.MarkMemberLagging when the
// leader's timer has not fired (a leader change restarts it). Both are
// authority-signed, and Apply re-checks committed state, so a stale or
// replayed command never marks a member that has since caught up.

// markMemberLaggingBeforeSwitchReason is Apply's first refusal of
// MarkMemberLagging (plan S3-E1 K67, contract §49); the RPC answers it
// without a proposal.
const markMemberLaggingBeforeSwitchReason = "marking a member lagging is refused until the checkpoints switch is on"

// applyMarkMemberLagging applies MarkMemberLagging (tag 42). Every refusal
// leaves state unchanged; the order and texts are contract §52.3's. The
// observed entry must be strictly after the member's checkpoint entry and at
// or before the owner's published entry, so it names lag that exists now.
func (f *FSM) applyMarkMemberLagging(c *wire.MarkMemberLagging) any {
	if !f.checkpointsOnLocked() {
		return Rejected{Reason: markMemberLaggingBeforeSwitchReason}
	}
	if c.NodeID == "" || c.DatabaseID == "" {
		return Rejected{Reason: "mark member lagging: node_id and database_id are required"}
	}
	owner := c.OwnerIndexerID
	g := f.groupLocked(owner, c.DatabaseID)
	if g == nil {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("mark member lagging: no group for indexer %d database %q", owner, c.DatabaseID)}
	}
	kind := fmt.Sprintf("mark member lagging indexer %d database %q", owner, c.DatabaseID)
	if reason := f.authorityCommandRefusalLocked(kind, func(v *authority.Validator, ctx authority.ConsensusContext) error {
		_, err := v.VerifyMarkMemberLagging(c.Canonical(), c.AuthorityJWS, ctx)
		return err
	}); reason != "" {
		return Rejected{Reason: reason}
	}
	j := groupMemberIndex(g, c.NodeID)
	if j < 0 {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("mark member lagging: %s is not a current member of group indexer %d database %q", c.NodeID, owner, c.DatabaseID)}
	}
	if f.indexerQuarantinedLocked(owner) {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("mark member lagging: indexer %d is quarantined and accrues no lag", owner)}
	}
	m := &g.Members[j]
	if m.Class != MemberCaughtUp && m.Class != MemberBehind {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("mark member lagging: %s is %s", c.NodeID, m.Class)}
	}
	published := f.publishedTrackFrontierLocked(owner)
	if m.Checkpoint == nil || entryCompare(c.ObservedEntry, m.Checkpoint.Checkpoint.Entry) <= 0 || entryCompare(c.ObservedEntry, published) > 0 {
		return Rejected{Reason: fmt.Sprintf("mark member lagging: observed_entry must be after the checkpoint entry of %s and at or before the published entry of indexer %d", c.NodeID, owner)}
	}
	observed := c.ObservedEntry
	m.Class, m.ObservedEntry = MemberLagging, &observed
	f.groupsChangedLocked()
	return Applied{}
}

// memberLagWorkLocked lists, while the checkpoints switch is on, every
// caught_up or behind member whose checkpoint entry precedes its
// non-quarantined owner's published entry, sorted by (Owner, DatabaseID,
// NodeID): groups are stored in (owner, database) order and members in node
// order. A caught_up member sits at the published entry, so in practice every
// row is behind.
func (f *FSM) memberLagWorkLocked() []MemberLagWork {
	if !f.checkpointsOnLocked() {
		return nil
	}
	var out []MemberLagWork
	for _, g := range f.st.Stage3.Groups {
		if f.indexerQuarantinedLocked(g.Owner) {
			continue
		}
		published := f.publishedTrackFrontierLocked(g.Owner)
		for _, m := range g.Members {
			if (m.Class != MemberCaughtUp && m.Class != MemberBehind) || m.Checkpoint == nil {
				continue
			}
			if entry := m.Checkpoint.Checkpoint.Entry; entryCompare(entry, published) < 0 {
				out = append(out, MemberLagWork{NodeID: m.NodeID, Owner: g.Owner, DatabaseID: g.DatabaseID, Class: m.Class,
					Checkpoint: entry, Published: published})
			}
		}
	}
	return out
}

// MemberLagWork is memberLagWorkLocked under the read lock; WorkSet carries
// the same rows as MemberLag.
func (f *FSM) MemberLagWork() []MemberLagWork {
	f.mu.RLock()
	defer f.mu.RUnlock()
	return f.memberLagWorkLocked()
}
```
