```go
// checkpointStatePresent reports any checkpoint, class or lag state: a stored
// checkpoint_seq, an owner's recent advances, or a member (or Leaving record)
// holding a checkpoint or an observed entry.
func checkpointStatePresent(s3 *Stage3State) bool {
	if len(s3.CheckpointSeqs) != 0 || len(s3.OwnerAdvances) != 0 {
		return true
	}
	for _, g := range s3.Groups {
		for _, m := range g.Members {
			if m.Checkpoint != nil || m.ObservedEntry != nil {
				return true
			}
		}
		for _, l := range g.Leaving {
			if l.Member.Checkpoint != nil || l.Member.ObservedEntry != nil {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}

// checkpointNamesGroup reports whether rec is a checkpoint of node for owner
// that lists database at a group generation within [low, high].
func checkpointNamesGroup(rec *MemberCheckpointRecord, node string, owner uint64, database string, low, high uint64) bool {
	cp := rec.Checkpoint
	if cp.NodeID != node || cp.OwnerIndexerID != owner {
		return false
	}
	for _, cg := range cp.Groups {
		if cg.DatabaseID == database {
			return cg.GroupGeneration >= low && cg.GroupGeneration <= high
		}
	}
	return false
}

// validateStage3Checkpoints is the restore rule of the checkpoint, class and
// lag state (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §9.1, §9.2; plan S3-E3 contract
// §52.3): none of it before the checkpoints switch; stored checkpoint seqs
// sorted by (node, owner) and owners' recent advances sorted by owner, each
// strictly ascending, at most max_lag_publications + 1 long, never past the
// owner's published entry and each an entry a published manifest carries for
// the owner; every current member bootstrapping exactly while it has no
// checkpoint, caught_up exactly at the owner's published entry and behind
// before it, and holding an observed entry, at or before the published entry,
// exactly while lagging; and every stored checkpoint, a Leaving record's
// included, naming its node, its group's owner and database at a generation
// the member held, and a published manifest whose track_frontiers entry for
// the owner is its entry, as MemberCheckpoint's refusals 12 and 13 require at
// Apply. No Apply prunes State.Manifests, so the manifest every stored
// checkpoint and advance was accepted against is still there, and on the
// watermark chain (validateRestoredTrackChain), so a bound entry is never
// past the published one. validateMemberCheckpointProofs re-verifies the
// signatures; node status is never read.
func validateStage3Checkpoints(st *State) error {
	s3 := st.Stage3
	if s3 == nil {
		return nil
	}
	refuse := func(format string, args ...any) error {
		return fmt.Errorf("snapshot stage3 checkpoints: "+format, args...)
	}
	// offManifest refuses a stored checkpoint that MemberCheckpoint's
	// refusal 12 or 13 would have refused at Apply.
	offManifest := func(node string, g *DatabaseGroup, rec *MemberCheckpointRecord) error {
		return refuse("checkpoint of member %s in group of indexer %d database %q names snapshot %s, which is not a published manifest, or an entry other than its track_frontiers entry for the indexer",
			node, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, rec.Checkpoint.SnapshotID)
	}
	if !stage3SwitchValue(st.Params.Stage3, Stage3SwitchCheckpoints) {
		if checkpointStatePresent(s3) {
			return refuse("checkpoint state exists while the checkpoints switch is off")
		}
		return nil
	}
	for i, s := range s3.CheckpointSeqs {
		if s.NodeID == "" || (i > 0 && compareCheckpointSeqKey(s3.CheckpointSeqs[i-1], s) >= 0) {
			return refuse("checkpoint seqs are not sorted by (node_id, owner_indexer_id) without duplicates")
		}
	}
	for i := 1; i < len(s3.OwnerAdvances); i++ {
		if s3.OwnerAdvances[i-1].Owner >= s3.OwnerAdvances[i].Owner {
			return refuse("owner advances are not sorted by owner without duplicates")
		}
	}
	view := &FSM{st: st}
	limit := int(st.Params.Stage3.MaxLagPublications) + 1
	carried := publishedTrackFrontiers(st)
	for _, adv := range s3.OwnerAdvances {
		published := view.publishedTrackFrontierLocked(adv.Owner)
		ok := len(adv.Recent) <= limit
		for i, e := range adv.Recent {
			if (i > 0 && entryCompare(adv.Recent[i-1], e) >= 0) || entryCompare(e, published) > 0 {
				ok = false
			}
		}
		if !ok {
			return refuse("owner advances of indexer %d are not strictly ascending, exceed %d entries or pass its published entry", adv.Owner, limit)
		}
		// recordOwnerAdvanceLocked appends only the owner's entry of the
		// manifest it publishes.
		for _, e := range adv.Recent {
			if e.IndexerID != adv.Owner || !carried[e] {
				return refuse("owner advances of indexer %d hold an entry that no published manifest carries for the indexer", adv.Owner)
			}
		}
	}
	for _, g := range s3.Groups {
		published := view.publishedTrackFrontierLocked(g.Owner)
		for _, m := range g.Members {
			if (m.Class == MemberBootstrapping) == (m.Checkpoint != nil) {
				return refuse("member %s of group of indexer %d database %q is %s without a checkpoint, or bootstrapping with one", m.NodeID, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, m.Class)
			}
			if m.Checkpoint != nil {
				atPublished := entryCompare(m.Checkpoint.Checkpoint.Entry, published) == 0
				if (m.Class == MemberCaughtUp && !atPublished) || (m.Class == MemberBehind && atPublished) {
					return refuse("member %s of group of indexer %d database %q is caught_up at an entry other than the published one, or behind at it", m.NodeID, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID)
				}
			}
			if (m.ObservedEntry != nil) != (m.Class == MemberLagging) || (m.ObservedEntry != nil && entryCompare(*m.ObservedEntry, published) > 0) {
				return refuse("member %s of group of indexer %d database %q has an observed entry without being lagging, or lagging without one, or one past the published entry", m.NodeID, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID)
			}
			if m.Checkpoint != nil && !checkpointNamesGroup(m.Checkpoint, m.NodeID, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, m.JoinedGeneration, g.Generation) {
				return refuse("checkpoint of member %s in group of indexer %d database %q names another node, owner or database, or a generation outside [%d, %d]", m.NodeID, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, m.JoinedGeneration, g.Generation)
			}
			if m.Checkpoint != nil && !checkpointOnPublishedManifest(st, m.Checkpoint) {
				return offManifest(m.NodeID, g, m.Checkpoint)
			}
		}
		// A Leaving record keeps the checkpoint it held as a member, taken at
		// a generation before the one that removed it, against a published
		// manifest like any other: the copy floor and the Leaving release
		// read its entry.
		for _, l := range g.Leaving {
			m := l.Member
			if m.Checkpoint != nil && !checkpointNamesGroup(m.Checkpoint, m.NodeID, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, m.JoinedGeneration, l.RemovedGeneration-1) {
				return refuse("checkpoint of member %s in group of indexer %d database %q names another node, owner or database, or a generation outside [%d, %d]", m.NodeID, g.Owner, g.DatabaseID, m.JoinedGeneration, l.RemovedGeneration-1)
			}
			if m.Checkpoint != nil && !checkpointOnPublishedManifest(st, m.Checkpoint) {
				return offManifest(m.NodeID, g, m.Checkpoint)
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}
```

In `fsm/member_checkpoint.go` (Step 7's file), right after `manifestTrackFrontier`, insert the two state-only halves the rule reads (the file already imports `replay`, which `fsm/stage3_restore.go` does not):

```go
// checkpointOnPublishedManifest reports whether rec's checkpoint names a
// published manifest (State.Manifests, which no Apply prunes) whose
// track_frontiers entry for its owner is its entry: MemberCheckpoint's
// refusals 12 and 13 at Apply, checked again on restore.
func checkpointOnPublishedManifest(st *State, rec *MemberCheckpointRecord) bool {
	cp := rec.Checkpoint
	manifest := st.Manifests[cp.SnapshotID]
	if manifest == nil {
		return false
	}
	frontier, ok := manifestTrackFrontier(manifest, cp.OwnerIndexerID)
	return ok && frontier == cp.Entry
}

// publishedTrackFrontiers is the set of track_frontiers entries the published
// manifests carry. recordOwnerAdvanceLocked appends only such an entry to an
// owner's recent advances, so restore requires each recent advance to be one.
func publishedTrackFrontiers(st *State) map[replay.TrackFrontier]bool {
	carried := map[replay.TrackFrontier]bool{}
	for _, manifest := range st.Manifests {
		if manifest == nil {
			continue
		}
		for _, e := range manifest.TrackFrontiers {
			carried[e] = true
		}
	}
	return carried
}
```

```go
	if err := validateReselectionProofs(st, paramsByEpoch, genesisID); err != nil {
		return err

	return validateMemberCheckpointProofs(st, paramsByEpoch, genesisID)

// validateMemberCheckpointProofs re-verifies every stored checkpoint, a
// Leaving record's included (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §9.1, plan S3-E3
// contract §52.3): its replica_signer token over the checkpoint under the
// signer that the verifiers listing of its own epoch names for the node, the
// way the acknowledgement proofs are re-verified. When that signer is the
// one the (member, owner) checkpoint_seq was last accepted under, the stored
// checkpoint_seq must be at least the record's; a missing entry counts as 0.
// Node status is not re-checked. Groups and members are visited in state
// order, so every replica names the same corruption.
func validateMemberCheckpointProofs(st *State, paramsByEpoch []Params, genesisID string) error {
	if st.Stage3 == nil {
		return nil
	}
	ctx := authority.MessageContext{NetworkID: st.Params.NetworkID, GenesisSnapshotID: genesisID}
	check := func(nodeID string, rec *MemberCheckpointRecord) error {
		cp := rec.Checkpoint
		if rec.Epoch >= uint64(len(paramsByEpoch)) {
			return fmt.Errorf("snapshot member %s checkpoint %d of indexer %d: epoch %d is beyond the consensus epoch %d",
				nodeID, cp.CheckpointSeq, cp.OwnerIndexerID, rec.Epoch, len(paramsByEpoch)-1)
		}
		entry, ok := findVerifierEntry(paramsByEpoch[rec.Epoch].Verifiers, nodeID)
		if !ok || entry.ReplicaSigner == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("snapshot member %s checkpoint %d of indexer %d: epoch %d lists no replica_signer for the node",
				nodeID, cp.CheckpointSeq, cp.OwnerIndexerID, rec.Epoch)
		}
		if err := authority.VerifyMemberCheckpoint(ctx, cp, rec.ReplicaJWS, entry.ReplicaSigner); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("snapshot member %s checkpoint %d of indexer %d: %w", nodeID, cp.CheckpointSeq, cp.OwnerIndexerID, err)
		}
		var stored MemberCheckpointSeq
		if i, found := checkpointSeqIndex(st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs, nodeID, cp.OwnerIndexerID); found {
			stored = st.Stage3.CheckpointSeqs[i]
		} else {
			stored.ReplicaSigner = entry.ReplicaSigner
		}
		if stored.ReplicaSigner == entry.ReplicaSigner && stored.CheckpointSeq < cp.CheckpointSeq {
			return fmt.Errorf("snapshot member %s checkpoint_seq %d of indexer %d is below a stored checkpoint %d",
				nodeID, stored.CheckpointSeq, cp.OwnerIndexerID, cp.CheckpointSeq)
		}
		return nil
	}
	for _, g := range st.Stage3.Groups {
		for _, m := range g.Members {
			if m.Checkpoint != nil {
				if err := check(m.NodeID, m.Checkpoint); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
		for _, l := range g.Leaving {
			if l.Member.Checkpoint != nil {
				if err := check(l.Member.NodeID, l.Member.Checkpoint); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}
```

```go
	placementServer(t, node)
	registerServerMember(t, node)
	applyServerStage3Update(t, node, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) { u.Stage3.Reselection = true })
	applyServerStage3Update(t, node, func(u *arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate) { u.Stage3.Checkpoints = true })

// serverCheckpointRequest is member-2's checkpoint seq of G(1, db) at m with
// excluded, signed by signer.
func serverCheckpointRequest(t *testing.T, f *fsm.FSM, signer *authority.Signer, m replay.SafeSnapshotManifest, seq uint64, excluded ...arbiter.ExcludedTable) *pb.MemberCheckpointCmd {
	t.Helper()
	var entry replay.TrackFrontier
	for _, e := range m.TrackFrontiers {
		if e.IndexerID == 1 {
			entry = e
		}
	}
	cp := arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{NodeID: "member-2", OwnerIndexerID: 1, CheckpointSeq: seq,
		Groups: []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{{DatabaseID: "db", GroupGeneration: 1, Excluded: excluded}}, SnapshotID: m.SnapshotID, Entry: entry}
	jws, err := signer.SignMemberCheckpoint(serverMessageContext(t, f), cp)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return wire.MemberCheckpointToRequest(wire.MemberCheckpoint{Checkpoint: cp, ReplicaJWS: jws})
}

// memberGateway is the VerifierGateway over rec.
func memberGateway(rec *recordingNode) *verifierGatewayService {
	return &verifierGatewayService{s: New(Deps{Node: rec, FSM: rec.f, Cfg: Config{NodeID: "arb-0", ApplyTimeout: time.Second}})}
}

// TestSubmitMemberCheckpointAnswersFailedPreconditionBeforeTheSwitch: the
// shape refusals come first; before the checkpoints switch the gateway
// answers Apply's text as FailedPrecondition and proposes nothing.
func TestSubmitMemberCheckpointAnswersFailedPreconditionBeforeTheSwitch(t *testing.T) {
	rec := newRecordingNode(t)
	placementServer(t, rec.fakeNode)
	gw := memberGateway(rec)
	ctx := context.Background()
	cp := &pb.MemberCheckpoint{NodeId: "member-2", OwnerIndexerId: 1, CheckpointSeq: 1, SnapshotId: "0xsnap",
		Groups: []*pb.CheckpointGroup{{DatabaseId: "db", GroupGeneration: 1}}, Entry: &pb.TrackFrontier{IndexerId: 1}}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		req  *pb.MemberCheckpointCmd
		want string
	}{
		{&pb.MemberCheckpointCmd{ReplicaJws: "a.b.c"}, "checkpoint is required"},
		{&pb.MemberCheckpointCmd{Checkpoint: &pb.MemberCheckpoint{OwnerIndexerId: 1}, ReplicaJws: "a.b.c"}, "checkpoint.node_id is required"},
		{&pb.MemberCheckpointCmd{Checkpoint: cp, ReplicaJws: "not-a-jws"}, "replica_jws must be a JWS compact serialization with 3 dot-separated parts"},
		{&pb.MemberCheckpointCmd{Checkpoint: &pb.MemberCheckpoint{NodeId: "member-2", Groups: []*pb.CheckpointGroup{{DatabaseId: "db",
			Excluded: []*pb.ExcludedTable{{TableId: "db.t"}}}}}, ReplicaJws: "a.b.c"},
			"wire: member checkpoint excludes db.t with reason CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_UNSPECIFIED, which is not a known CheckpointExclusionReason"},
	} {
		if _, err := gw.SubmitMemberCheckpoint(ctx, tc.req); status.Code(err) != codes.InvalidArgument || status.Convert(err).Message() != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("request %v = %v, want InvalidArgument %q", tc.req, err, tc.want)
		}
	}
	if _, err := gw.SubmitMemberCheckpoint(ctx, &pb.MemberCheckpointCmd{Checkpoint: cp, ReplicaJws: "a.b.c"}); status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition ||
		status.Convert(err).Message() != memberCheckpointsBeforeSwitchMessage {
		t.Fatalf("before the switch = %v", err)
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a refused checkpoint was proposed")
	}
}

// TestSubmitMemberCheckpointIsIdempotentForTheStoredCheckpoint: the first
// submission commits; a repeat of the stored checkpoint, with the same or
// another token, is answered without a proposal; another checkpoint at the
// same seq reaches Apply and its refusal is FailedPrecondition with the FSM's
// reason.
func TestSubmitMemberCheckpointIsIdempotentForTheStoredCheckpoint(t *testing.T) {
	rec := newRecordingNode(t)
	m := checkpointServer(t, rec.fakeNode)
	gw := memberGateway(rec)
	ctx := context.Background()
	req := serverCheckpointRequest(t, rec.f, serverMemberReplica(t), m, 1)
	if _, err := gw.SubmitMemberCheckpoint(ctx, req); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("%d proposals, want 1", rec.proposals())
	}
	lastProposalIs(t, rec, wire.Command{MemberCheckpoint: func() *wire.MemberCheckpoint {
		c, err := wire.MemberCheckpointFromRequest(req)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return &c
	}()})
	view, _ := rec.f.TableRegistryView()
	if len(view.MemberCheckpointSeqs) != 1 || view.MemberCheckpointSeqs[0].CheckpointSeq != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("checkpoint seqs %+v", view.MemberCheckpointSeqs)
	}
	resigned := proto.Clone(req).(*pb.MemberCheckpointCmd)
	resigned.ReplicaJws = serverCheckpointRequest(t, rec.f, serverMemberReplica(t), m, 1).GetReplicaJws()
	for _, again := range []*pb.MemberCheckpointCmd{req, resigned} {
		if _, err := gw.SubmitMemberCheckpoint(ctx, again); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("a stored checkpoint was proposed again: %d proposals", rec.proposals())
	}
	other := serverCheckpointRequest(t, rec.f, serverMemberReplica(t), m, 1, arbiter.ExcludedTable{TableID: "db.t", Reason: arbiter.ExclusionAuditPending})
	_, err := gw.SubmitMemberCheckpoint(ctx, other)
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || status.Convert(err).Message() != "member checkpoint: checkpoint_seq 1 is not above 1" {
		t.Fatalf("another checkpoint at the stored seq = %v", err)
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("%d proposals, want 2", rec.proposals())
	}
}

// TestMarkMemberLaggingRPCAuthorizesAndProposes: before the switch and with
// updates disabled the RPC refuses first; shape and authority refusals
// propose nothing; a signed command for a member that is not behind reaches
// Apply and is refused there; once the member is behind the same RPC commits.
func TestMarkMemberLaggingRPCAuthorizesAndProposes(t *testing.T) {
	early := newRecordingNode(t)
	placementServer(t, early.fakeNode)
	req := &pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd{NodeId: "member-2", OwnerIndexerId: 1, DatabaseId: "db", ObservedEntry: &pb.TrackFrontier{IndexerId: 1}, AuthorityJws: "a.b.c"}
	if _, err := evictionAdmin(early, 5*time.Minute).MarkMemberLagging(context.Background(), req); status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition ||
		status.Convert(err).Message() != memberLaggingRefusedMessage {
		t.Fatalf("before the switch = %v", err)
	}
	disabled := evictionAdmin(early, 5*time.Minute)
	disabled.s.d.Cfg.ConsensusUpdatesEnabled = false
	if _, err := disabled.MarkMemberLagging(context.Background(), req); status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || status.Convert(err).Message() != consensusUpdatesDisabledMessage {
		t.Fatalf("updates disabled = %v", err)
	}

	rec := newRecordingNode(t)
	m := checkpointServer(t, rec.fakeNode)
	admin := evictionAdmin(rec, 5*time.Minute)
	ctx := context.Background()
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		req  *pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd
		want string
	}{
		{&pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd{OwnerIndexerId: 1, DatabaseId: "db", ObservedEntry: &pb.TrackFrontier{IndexerId: 1}, AuthorityJws: "a.b.c"}, "node_id is required"},
		{&pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd{NodeId: "member-2", OwnerIndexerId: 1, ObservedEntry: &pb.TrackFrontier{IndexerId: 1}, AuthorityJws: "a.b.c"}, "database_id is required"},
		{&pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd{NodeId: "member-2", OwnerIndexerId: 1, DatabaseId: "db", AuthorityJws: "a.b.c"}, "observed_entry is required"},
		{&pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd{NodeId: "member-2", OwnerIndexerId: 1, DatabaseId: "db", ObservedEntry: &pb.TrackFrontier{IndexerId: 1}, AuthorityJws: "nope"},
			"authority_jws must be a JWS compact serialization with 3 dot-separated parts"},
	} {
		if _, err := admin.MarkMemberLagging(ctx, tc.req); status.Code(err) != codes.InvalidArgument || status.Convert(err).Message() != tc.want {

	}
	lagging := func(signer *authority.Signer, observed replay.TrackFrontier) *pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd {
		t.Helper()
		cmd := wire.MarkMemberLagging{NodeID: "member-2", OwnerIndexerID: 1, DatabaseID: "db", ObservedEntry: observed}
		token, err := signer.SignMarkMemberLaggingWithContext(cmd.Canonical(), serverAuthorityContext(t, rec.f))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		cmd.AuthorityJWS = token
		return wire.MarkMemberLaggingToRequest(cmd)
	}
	frontier := func(m replay.SafeSnapshotManifest) replay.TrackFrontier {
		for _, e := range m.TrackFrontiers {
			if e.IndexerID == 1 {
				return e
			}
		}
		t.Fatal("no frontier of indexer 1")
		return replay.TrackFrontier{}
	}
	if _, err := admin.MarkMemberLagging(ctx, lagging(authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.IndexerKeyHex1), frontier(m))); status.Code(err) != codes.PermissionDenied ||
		!strings.HasPrefix(status.Convert(err).Message(), "mark member lagging authority: ") {
		t.Fatalf("a non-authority key = %v", err)
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a refused request was proposed")
	}
	_, err := admin.MarkMemberLagging(ctx, lagging(serverTestAuthority, frontier(m)))
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || status.Convert(err).Message() != "mark member lagging: member-2 is bootstrapping" {
		t.Fatalf("a bootstrapping member = %v", err)
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("%d proposals, want 1", rec.proposals())
	}
	// member-2 checkpoints at m; indexer 1's own transition then moves its
	// published entry, so member-2 is behind and the RPC commits.
	mustDirectApply(t, rec.fakeNode, func() wire.Command {
		c, err := wire.MemberCheckpointFromRequest(serverCheckpointRequest(t, rec.f, serverMemberReplica(t), m, 1))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return wire.Command{MemberCheckpoint: &c}
	}())
	addServerTable(t, rec.fakeNode, 1, "dbc", "c", 160)
	latest := publishServerTransition(t, rec.fakeNode)
	req = lagging(serverTestAuthority, frontier(latest))
	if _, err := admin.MarkMemberLagging(ctx, req); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	lastProposalIs(t, rec, wire.Command{MarkMemberLagging: func() *wire.MarkMemberLagging { c := wire.MarkMemberLaggingFromRequest(req); return &c }()})
	view, _ := rec.f.TableRegistryView()
	for _, g := range view.Groups {
		if g.Group.Owner == 1 && g.Group.DatabaseID == "db" {
			if got := g.Group.Members[0]; got.Class != fsm.MemberLagging || got.ObservedEntry == nil || *got.ObservedEntry != frontier(latest) {
				t.Fatalf("member-2 = %+v", got)
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestTableRegistryToPBCarriesCheckpointsAndLag(t *testing.T) {
	entry := replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 1, SafeBlockSeq: 4, AppliedPromotionSeq: 2}

		Groups: []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{{DatabaseID: "db", GroupGeneration: 2, Excluded: []arbiter.ExcludedTable{{TableID: "db.t", Reason: arbiter.ExclusionRetiring}}}}}
	view := fsm.TableRegistryView{Groups: []fsm.GroupView{{
		Group: fsm.DatabaseGroup{Owner: 1, DatabaseID: "db", Generation: 2, Salt: "0xsalt", Members: []fsm.GroupMember{
			{NodeID: "member-0", JoinedGeneration: 1, Class: fsm.MemberBootstrapping},
			{NodeID: "member-2", JoinedGeneration: 1, Class: fsm.MemberLagging, Checkpoint: &fsm.MemberCheckpointRecord{Checkpoint: cp, ReplicaJWS: "h.p.s", Epoch: 7},
				ObservedEntry: &observed},
		}},

	}}, MemberCheckpointSeqs: []fsm.MemberCheckpointSeq{
		{NodeID: "member-2", OwnerIndexerID: 0, CheckpointSeq: 1, ReplicaSigner: "0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000a2"},
		{NodeID: "member-2", OwnerIndexerID: 1, CheckpointSeq: 3, ReplicaSigner: "0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000a2"},

	got := tableRegistryToPB(view)
	member := got.GetGroups()[0].GetMembers()[1]
	want := &pb.GroupMember{NodeId: "member-2", JoinedGeneration: 1, MemberClass: pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_LAGGING, LagAdvances: 9,
		ObservedEntry: &pb.TrackFrontier{IndexerId: 1, SafeBlockSeq: 9, AppliedPromotionSeq: 5},
		Checkpoint: &pb.MemberCheckpointRecord{ReplicaJws: "h.p.s", Epoch: 7, Checkpoint: &pb.MemberCheckpoint{NodeId: "member-2", OwnerIndexerId: 1, CheckpointSeq: 3,
			SnapshotId: "0xsnap", Entry: &pb.TrackFrontier{IndexerId: 1, SafeBlockSeq: 4, AppliedPromotionSeq: 2},
			Groups: []*pb.CheckpointGroup{{DatabaseId: "db", GroupGeneration: 2, Excluded: []*pb.ExcludedTable{{TableId: "db.t",
				Reason: pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_RETIRING}}}}}}}
	if !proto.Equal(member, want) {
		t.Fatalf("member %v\nwant   %v", member, want)
	}
	if first := got.GetGroups()[0].GetMembers()[0]; first.Checkpoint != nil || first.ObservedEntry != nil || first.GetLagAdvances() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a member without a checkpoint = %v", first)
	}
	seqs := got.GetMemberCheckpointSeqs()
	if len(seqs) != 2 || seqs[0].GetOwnerIndexerId() != 0 || seqs[1].GetCheckpointSeq() != 3 || seqs[1].GetReplicaSigner() != "0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000a2" {
		t.Fatalf("member_checkpoint_seqs %v", seqs)
	}
	if tableRegistryToPB(fsm.TableRegistryView{}).GetMemberCheckpointSeqs() != nil {
		t.Fatal("a view without checkpoint seqs serves some")
	}
}
```

```go
// memberCheckpointsBeforeSwitchMessage is the FSM's first refusal of
// MemberCheckpoint (plan S3-E1 K67, plan S3-E3 contract §49). Before the
// checkpoints switch the gateway answers it as FailedPrecondition without a
// proposal.
const memberCheckpointsBeforeSwitchMessage = "member checkpoints are refused until the checkpoints switch is on"

// SubmitMemberCheckpoint records a replicate member's checkpoint (housegate
// spec 2026-10-14 §9.1, Raft tag 41; plan S3-E3 contract §52.3). The member
// names itself by checkpoint.node_id and Apply verifies its replica_signer
// token, so the gateway checks only the request's shape and the switch.
// Behind the read barrier, a checkpoint every listed group already stores is
// answered without a proposal, and so is a refusal that raced the same
// checkpoint (the SubmitTablePurged pattern); any other refusal is
// FailedPrecondition with the FSM's reason. A follower answers NotLeader.
func (svc *verifierGatewayService) SubmitMemberCheckpoint(ctx context.Context, req *pb.MemberCheckpointCmd) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	if req.GetCheckpoint() == nil {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "checkpoint is required")
	}
	if err := requireStreamID("checkpoint.node_id", req.GetCheckpoint().GetNodeId()); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(strings.Split(req.GetReplicaJws(), ".")) != 3 {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "replica_jws must be a JWS compact serialization with 3 dot-separated parts")
	}
	cmd, err := wire.MemberCheckpointFromRequest(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, err.Error())
	}
	if !svc.s.d.FSM.CheckpointsOn() {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, memberCheckpointsBeforeSwitchMessage)
	}
	if err := svc.s.consensusReadBarrier(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if svc.s.d.FSM.MemberCheckpointRecorded(cmd.Checkpoint) {
		return &pb.Ack{}, nil
	}
	res, err := svc.s.propose(ctx, wire.Command{MemberCheckpoint: &cmd})
	if err != nil {
		if status.Code(err) == codes.InvalidArgument && svc.s.d.FSM.MemberCheckpointRecorded(cmd.Checkpoint) {
			return &pb.Ack{}, nil
		}
		return nil, applyRefusalAsFailedPrecondition(err)
	}
	if _, ok := res.(fsm.Applied); !ok {
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "unexpected member checkpoint result %T", res)
	}
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}
```

```go
// memberLaggingRefusedMessage refuses ConsensusAdmin.MarkMemberLagging
// before the checkpoints switch (plan S3-E1 K67): Apply refuses Raft tag 42
// with the same text, so the leader proposes nothing earlier.
const memberLaggingRefusedMessage = "marking a member lagging is refused until the checkpoints switch is on"

// MarkMemberLagging marks one group member lagging on an authority-signed
// request (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §9.2, §16; plan S3-E3 K77), for the
// operator when the leader's member_lagging_timeout has not fired. It keeps
// RebalanceGroup's order and texts: updates enabled, the switch, shape,
// leadership, authority with the configured token age. Apply re-verifies the
// token and re-checks the membership, the class, the quarantine and the
// observed entry against committed state; its refusal reaches the caller as
// FailedPrecondition with the FSM's reason. Ack means committed.
func (svc *consensusAdminService) MarkMemberLagging(ctx context.Context, req *pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	if !svc.s.d.Cfg.ConsensusUpdatesEnabled {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, consensusUpdatesDisabledMessage)
	}
	// Applied state is enough: the switch is one-way.
	if !svc.s.d.FSM.CheckpointsOn() {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, memberLaggingRefusedMessage)
	}
	cmd := wire.MarkMemberLaggingFromRequest(req)
	switch {
	case cmd.NodeID == "":
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "node_id is required")
	case cmd.DatabaseID == "":
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "database_id is required")
	case req.GetObservedEntry() == nil:
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "observed_entry is required")
	case len(strings.Split(cmd.AuthorityJWS, ".")) != 3:
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "authority_jws must be a JWS compact serialization with 3 dot-separated parts")
	}
	consensus, validator, err := svc.quarantineAuthority(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err := validator.AuthorizeMarkMemberLagging(cmd.Canonical(), cmd.AuthorityJWS, consensus); err != nil {
		// The validator names the recovered address or the failed check and
		// never the token itself; keep it that way.
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "mark member lagging authority: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := svc.s.propose(ctx, wire.Command{MarkMemberLagging: &cmd}); err != nil {
		return nil, applyRefusalAsFailedPrecondition(err)
	}
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}
```

```go
// memberCheckpointSeqsToPB maps the stored checkpoint seqs, in state order.
func memberCheckpointSeqsToPB(seqs []fsm.MemberCheckpointSeq) []*pb.MemberCheckpointSeq {
	if len(seqs) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]*pb.MemberCheckpointSeq, 0, len(seqs))
	for _, s := range seqs {
		out = append(out, &pb.MemberCheckpointSeq{NodeId: s.NodeID, OwnerIndexerId: s.OwnerIndexerID, CheckpointSeq: s.CheckpointSeq, ReplicaSigner: s.ReplicaSigner})
	}
	return out
}
```

```go
package orchestrator

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// The leader's MarkMemberLagging proposal (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §9.2,
// plan S3-E3 K77) on tracksHarnessO's leader, driven by synthetic
// WorkSet.MemberLag rows and a controlled clock. The fake node answers every
// MarkMemberLagging with a rejection and records it, so nothing reaches the
// FSM, whose checkpoints switch is off.

// memberLagHarness is tracksHarnessO with a fixed clock, the member lagging
// timeout, and the MarkMemberLagging commands the leader proposes.
type memberLagHarness struct {
	o        *Loop
	f        *fsm.FSM
	signer   *authority.Signer
	clock    time.Time
	proposed []wire.MarkMemberLagging
}

func newMemberLagHarness(t *testing.T, timeout time.Duration) *memberLagHarness {
	t.Helper()
	f, node, _, o, _, signer := tracksHarnessO(t)
	h := &memberLagHarness{o: o, f: f, signer: signer, clock: time.Unix(1_900_000_000, 0)}
	o.now = func() time.Time { return h.clock }
	o.d.Cfg.MemberLaggingTimeout = timeout
	node.rejectApply = func(c wire.Command) (fsm.Rejected, bool) {
		if c.MarkMemberLagging == nil {
			return fsm.Rejected{}, false
		}
		h.proposed = append(h.proposed, *c.MarkMemberLagging)
		return fsm.Rejected{Reason: "recorded by the test"}, true
	}
	return h
}

// lagRow is member-2's row in G(1, db) with its checkpoint entry at safe
// block checkpoint and the published entry at safe block 9.
func lagRow(checkpoint uint64) fsm.MemberLagWork {
	return fsm.MemberLagWork{NodeID: "member-2", Owner: 1, DatabaseID: "db", Class: fsm.MemberBehind,
		Checkpoint: replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 1, SafeBlockSeq: checkpoint, AppliedPromotionSeq: checkpoint},
		Published:  replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 1, SafeBlockSeq: 9, AppliedPromotionSeq: 9}}
}

// pass advances the clock by d and handles one WorkSet with rows.
func (h *memberLagHarness) pass(t *testing.T, d time.Duration, rows ...fsm.MemberLagWork) {
	t.Helper()
	h.clock = h.clock.Add(d)
	if err := h.o.handleMemberLagging(context.Background(), fsm.WorkSet{MemberLag: rows}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestOrchestratorProposesMarkMemberLaggingAfterTheTimeout(t *testing.T) {
	h := newMemberLagHarness(t, 30*time.Minute)
	row := lagRow(4)
	h.pass(t, 0, row)
	h.pass(t, 30*time.Minute-time.Second, row)
	if len(h.proposed) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("proposed before the timeout: %+v", h.proposed)
	}
	h.pass(t, time.Second, row)
	if len(h.proposed) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("%d proposals at the timeout, want 1", len(h.proposed))
	}
	got := h.proposed[0]
	if got.NodeID != "member-2" || got.OwnerIndexerID != 1 || got.DatabaseID != "db" || got.ObservedEntry != row.Published {
		t.Fatalf("proposed %+v, want member-2 of G(1, db) observed at %+v", got, row.Published)
	}
	view, err := h.f.ConsensusParamsView()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	validator := authority.Validator{AllowedAddresses: map[string]bool{strings.ToLower(h.signer.Address()): true}}
	ctx := authority.ConsensusContext{NetworkID: view.Current.NetworkID, GenesisSnapshotID: view.GenesisSnapshotID, AuthorityEpoch: view.Epoch}
	if _, err := validator.VerifyMarkMemberLagging(got.Canonical(), got.AuthorityJWS, ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("the proposal's token does not verify: %v", err)
	}
	// Apply refused it (the member caught up meanwhile, here: the fake): the
	// row stays and is proposed again on the next pass.
	h.pass(t, time.Second, row)
	if len(h.proposed) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("%d proposals after a refusal, want 2", len(h.proposed))
	}
	// A row that disappeared loses its timer.
	h.pass(t, time.Second)
	if len(h.o.lagSince) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("timers of vanished rows kept: %+v", h.o.lagSince)
	}
	h.pass(t, time.Hour, row)
	if len(h.proposed) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("a reappearing row was proposed without waiting the timeout again")
	}
}

func TestOrchestratorMemberLaggingTimerRestartsOnANewCheckpoint(t *testing.T) {
	h := newMemberLagHarness(t, 30*time.Minute)
	h.pass(t, 0, lagRow(4))
	h.pass(t, 20*time.Minute, lagRow(6)) // a new checkpoint entry, still behind
	h.pass(t, 10*time.Minute, lagRow(6))
	if len(h.proposed) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("proposed %+v 10 minutes after the new checkpoint", h.proposed)
	}
	h.pass(t, 20*time.Minute, lagRow(6))
	if len(h.proposed) != 1 || h.proposed[0].ObservedEntry != lagRow(6).Published {
		t.Fatalf("proposals %+v, want one 30 minutes after the new checkpoint", h.proposed)
	}
	// Rows of other members are timed independently.
	other := lagRow(6)
	other.NodeID = "member-3"
	h.pass(t, time.Minute, lagRow(6), other)
	if len(h.proposed) != 2 || h.proposed[1].NodeID != "member-2" {
		t.Fatalf("proposals %+v", h.proposed)
	}
}

func TestOrchestratorMemberLaggingTimeoutZeroDisablesProposals(t *testing.T) {
	h := newMemberLagHarness(t, 0)
	for range 4 {
		h.pass(t, 24*time.Hour, lagRow(4))
	}
	if len(h.proposed) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a zero timeout proposed %+v", h.proposed)
	}
}
```

Create `orchestrator/member_lagging.go`:

```go
package orchestrator

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// memberLagKey names one group member's lag row.
type memberLagKey struct {
	node     string
	owner    uint64
	database string
}

// memberLagTimer is when this leader first saw the row's checkpoint entry
// behind its owner's published entry.
type memberLagTimer struct {
	checkpoint replay.TrackFrontier
	since      time.Time
}

// handleMemberLagging proposes MarkMemberLagging for every WorkSet.MemberLag
// row whose checkpoint entry has stayed behind its owner's published entry
// for Cfg.MemberLaggingTimeout (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §9.2, plan S3-E3
// K77), observed at the published entry. The timers are leader-local and
// start empty each term: a row's timer starts at the first WorkSet that
// shows it, restarts when its checkpoint entry changes, and is dropped with
// the row. A zero timeout disables the proposals. Apply re-checks committed
// state, so a rejected proposal (a member that caught up meanwhile) is
// ignored, as for MarkReplaying.
func (o *Loop) handleMemberLagging(ctx context.Context, ws fsm.WorkSet) error {
	now := o.now()
	seen := make(map[memberLagKey]bool, len(ws.MemberLag))
	var due []fsm.MemberLagWork
	for _, row := range ws.MemberLag {
		key := memberLagKey{node: row.NodeID, owner: row.Owner, database: row.DatabaseID}
		seen[key] = true
		timer, ok := o.lagSince[key]
		if !ok || timer.checkpoint != row.Checkpoint {
			o.lagSince[key] = memberLagTimer{checkpoint: row.Checkpoint, since: now}
			continue
		}
		if timeout := o.d.Cfg.MemberLaggingTimeout; timeout > 0 && now.Sub(timer.since) >= timeout {
			due = append(due, row)
		}
	}
	for key := range o.lagSince {
		if !seen[key] {
			delete(o.lagSince, key)
		}
	}
	if len(due) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	consensus, ok := o.authoritySigningContext("member lagging signing")
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	for _, row := range due {
		cmd := wire.MarkMemberLagging{NodeID: row.NodeID, OwnerIndexerID: row.Owner, DatabaseID: row.DatabaseID, ObservedEntry: row.Published}
		token, err := o.d.Signer.SignMarkMemberLaggingWithContext(cmd.Canonical(), consensus)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("sign member lagging of %s in indexer %d database %q: %w", row.NodeID, row.Owner, row.DatabaseID, err)
		}
		cmd.AuthorityJWS = token
		if _, err := o.propose(ctx, wire.Command{MarkMemberLagging: &cmd}); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, ErrRejected) {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
```

```go
}
```

```go
func TestMemberLaggingFlagRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	g, addr := groupsFixture(t)
	full := []string{"--address", addr, "--node", "member-2", "--owner", "1", "--database", "db",
		"--observed-safe-block-seq", "90", "--observed-applied-promotion-seq", "40"}
	without := func(flag string) []string {
		out := []string{"member", "lagging"}
		for i := 0; i < len(full); i += 2 {
			if full[i] != flag {
				out = append(out, full[i], full[i+1])
			}
		}
		return out
	}
	for _, flag := range []string{"--address", "--node", "--owner", "--database", "--observed-safe-block-seq", "--observed-applied-promotion-seq"} {
		if err := run(context.Background(), without(flag), &bytes.Buffer{}); err == nil || err.Error() != flag+" is required" {
			t.Fatalf("without %s = %v", flag, err)
		}
	}
	badAddress := append([]string{"member", "lagging"}, full...)
	badAddress[3] = "not-an-address"
	if err := run(context.Background(), badAddress, &bytes.Buffer{}); err == nil || err.Error() != "--address must be a direct node host:port" {
		t.Fatalf("a bad address = %v", err)
	}
	for _, args := range [][]string{{"member"}, {"member", "evict"}} {
		if err := run(context.Background(), args, &bytes.Buffer{}); err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "usage:") {
			t.Fatalf("%v = %v, want the usage", args, err)
		}
	}
	t.Setenv(authorityPrivateKeyEnv, "")
	if err := run(context.Background(), append([]string{"member", "lagging"}, full...), &bytes.Buffer{}); err == nil || err.Error() != authorityPrivateKeyEnv+" is required" {
		t.Fatalf("without the key = %v", err)
	}
	t.Setenv(authorityPrivateKeyEnv, "zz")
	err := run(context.Background(), append([]string{"member", "lagging"}, full...), &bytes.Buffer{})
	if err == nil || err.Error() != authorityPrivateKeyEnv+" is invalid: expected a 32-byte secp256k1 private key in hex" || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "zz") {
		t.Fatalf("an invalid key = %v", err)
	}
	if len(g.laggings) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a refused invocation reached the leader")
	}
}
```

```go
// runMember dispatches member lagging.
func runMember(ctx context.Context, args []string, out io.Writer) error {
	if len(args) == 0 || args[0] != "lagging" {
		return errors.New(usage)
	}
	return runMemberLagging(ctx, args[1:], out)
}

// runMemberLagging signs and submits one MarkMemberLagging (housegate spec
// 2026-10-14 §9.2, §16; plan S3-E3 contract §52.3): the operator's lever when
// the leader's member_lagging_timeout has not fired. The observed entry is
// the owner's published entry the operator read with consensus tracks; Apply
// refuses one that is not after the member's checkpoint entry or beyond the
// owner's published entry.
func runMemberLagging(ctx context.Context, args []string, out io.Writer) error {
	fs := flag.NewFlagSet("member lagging", flag.ContinueOnError)
	address := fs.String("address", "", "leader gRPC host:port")
	timeout := fs.Duration("timeout", 10*time.Second, "timeout for the entire operation")
	node := fs.String("node", "", "required member node id")
	owner := fs.Uint64("owner", 0, "required owner SI indexer id")
	database := fs.String("database", "", "required database id")
	safeBlock := fs.Uint64("observed-safe-block-seq", 0, "required: safe_block_seq of the owner's observed published entry")
	appliedPromotion := fs.Uint64("observed-applied-promotion-seq", 0, "required: applied_promotion_seq of the owner's observed published entry")
	if help, err := parseGroupFlags(fs, args, out); help || err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := requireFlags(fs, "address", "node", "owner", "database", "observed-safe-block-seq", "observed-applied-promotion-seq"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := checkHostPort("address", *address); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if *timeout <= 0 {
		return errors.New("--timeout must be positive")
	}
	keyHex := os.Getenv(authorityPrivateKeyEnv)
	if keyHex == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", authorityPrivateKeyEnv)
	}
	signer, err := authority.NewSignerFromHex(keyHex)
	if err != nil {
		// Do not copy key material or parser fragments into operator logs.
		return fmt.Errorf("%s is invalid: expected a 32-byte secp256k1 private key in hex", authorityPrivateKeyEnv)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, *timeout)
	defer cancel()
	client, closeFn, err := dialAdmin(*address)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("connect to %s: %w", *address, err)
	}
	defer closeFn()
	state, err := client.GetConsensusParams(ctx, &emptypb.Empty{})
	if err != nil {
		return rpcError("read consensus parameters", *address, err)
	}
	if state.GetProtocolVersion() != arbiter.ConsensusAdminProtocolVersion {
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported consensus admin protocol %d (this CLI supports %d)", state.GetProtocolVersion(), arbiter.ConsensusAdminProtocolVersion)
	}
	consensus := authority.ConsensusContext{NetworkID: state.GetNetworkId(), GenesisSnapshotID: state.GetGenesisSnapshotId(), AuthorityEpoch: state.GetEpoch()}
	cmd := wire.MarkMemberLagging{NodeID: *node, OwnerIndexerID: *owner, DatabaseID: *database,
		ObservedEntry: replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: *owner, SafeBlockSeq: *safeBlock, AppliedPromotionSeq: *appliedPromotion}}
	token, err := signer.SignMarkMemberLaggingWithContext(cmd.Canonical(), consensus)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("sign member lagging: %w", err)
	}
	cmd.AuthorityJWS = token
	if _, err := client.MarkMemberLagging(ctx, wire.MarkMemberLaggingToRequest(cmd)); err != nil {
		return groupRPCError("mark member lagging", *address, err)
	}
	type observedEntry struct {
		IndexerID           string `json:"indexer_id"`
		SafeBlockSeq        string `json:"safe_block_seq"`
		AppliedPromotionSeq string `json:"applied_promotion_seq"`
	}
	result := struct {
		NodeID        string        `json:"node_id"`
		Owner         string        `json:"owner"`
		Database      string        `json:"database"`
		ObservedEntry observedEntry `json:"observed_entry"`
		Outcome       string        `json:"outcome"`
	}{cmd.NodeID, strconv.FormatUint(cmd.OwnerIndexerID, 10), cmd.DatabaseID, observedEntry{strconv.FormatUint(cmd.ObservedEntry.IndexerID, 10),

	encoder := json.NewEncoder(out)
	encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
	return encoder.Encode(result)
}
```

### 49. What Plan S3-E3 changes (read first), the names it consumes, branch and commands (Tasks 71–75)

**Activation model.**
- Five new Raft commands become reachable in Apply, each behind its switch. Their tags were fixed and released by Plan S3-E1 (§39) and are decoded by every `CORE_TAG_P5` binary.
- Before its switch each Apply arm returns, with state unchanged and as the first check, exactly the S3-E1 K67 text:

  | Tag | Command | Switch | Refusal (verbatim) |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | 38 | `RebalanceGroup` | `placement` | `group rebalancing is refused until the placement switch is on` |
  | 39 | `ReselectVerifiers` | `reselection` | `re-selection is refused until the reselection switch is on` |
  | 40 | `MemberReady` | `placement` | `member readiness is refused until the placement switch is on` |
  | 41 | `MemberCheckpoint` | `checkpoints` | `member checkpoints are refused until the checkpoints switch is on` |
  | 42 | `MarkMemberLagging` | `checkpoints` | `marking a member lagging is refused until the checkpoints switch is on` |

- The leader proposes none of them before its switch: the WorkSet rows of §52 are empty, and the RPCs of §50 and §52 answer `FailedPrecondition` with the same texts (S3-E1 K67).
- Switch predicates, `fsm/stage3_groups.go` (Task 71):
  - `func (f *FSM) placementOnLocked() bool`: `f.stage3SwitchOnLocked(Stage3SwitchPlacement)` (S3-E2 §45's generic predicate).
  - `func (f *FSM) reselectionOnLocked() bool` and `func (f *FSM) checkpointsOnLocked() bool`, the same way with `Stage3SwitchReselection` and `Stage3SwitchCheckpoints`.
  - Read-locked exports `func (f *FSM) PlacementOn() bool`, `ReselectionOn() bool` and `CheckpointsOn() bool`, wrappers of S3-E2's `Stage3SwitchOn(name)`.
- Byte identity:
  - Every new field below is `omitempty` (or a nil pointer). Before the `placement` switch, `Stage3State.Groups`, `GroupGenerations`, `PlacementCutoverBlock`, `CheckpointSeqs` and `OwnerAdvances` are empty.
  - Every `L3BlockTrack.GroupKey`, every `OpenL3Block` and `BlockVerification` group field, every `BlockVerification.Reselections` entry and every `ThreeWayVerdict.ReselectionsAtLatch` is absent. `commitSealLocked`, the admission seal, `applyMarkReplaying`, the transition planner and the grouper behave exactly as on Plan S3-E2's branch. Every registry-version bump this plan adds (§50) needs a group, the `placement` switch or a stored checkpoint, so none happens before the switch.
  - Placement, the seal key and the seal-reason counter are node-local or switch-gated, so a replay of any pre-stage-3 log yields identical state digests. Plan S3-E4 Task 78's `TestPreActivationHistoryIsByteIdenticalAcrossStage3` pins this.
- Placement implies `eviction_voiding` (switch 2 < 5, S3-E2 §44). Every check below that refuses an Evicted node therefore holds whether or not it also calls S3-E2 §47's voiding helper.
- No frozen constant, no v21 framing byte and no existing golden changes. The v21 interned body (S3-E2 §46) carries the new fields as part of the documents it rehydrates; `TestInternedBodyKeepsTheGroupLayer` (Task 75) pins that.

```go
// Stage3State gains, after the fields Plan S3-E2 defines (§44):
//	Groups           []*DatabaseGroup  `json:"groups,omitempty"`            // sorted by (Owner, DatabaseID), unique
//	GroupGenerations []GroupGeneration `json:"group_generations,omitempty"` // sorted by (Owner, DatabaseID), unique; survives group removal

type MemberClass string

const (
	MemberBootstrapping MemberClass = "bootstrapping"
	MemberCaughtUp      MemberClass = "caught_up"
	MemberBehind        MemberClass = "behind"
	MemberLagging       MemberClass = "lagging"
	MemberLeaving       MemberClass = "leaving"
)

// MemberClasses lists every class in export order.
var MemberClasses = []MemberClass{MemberBootstrapping, MemberCaughtUp, MemberBehind, MemberLagging, MemberLeaving}

type DatabaseGroup struct {
	Owner       uint64          `json:"owner"`
	DatabaseID  string          `json:"database_id"`
	Generation  uint64          `json:"generation"`
	Salt        string          `json:"salt"`
	NetworkFill bool            `json:"network_fill"`
	Members     []GroupMember   `json:"members,omitempty"`      // sorted by NodeID, unique
	Leaving     []LeavingMember `json:"leaving,omitempty"`      // sorted by Member.NodeID, unique, disjoint from Members
	PastMembers []string        `json:"past_members,omitempty"` // sorted, unique, disjoint from Members
}

type GroupMember struct {
	NodeID           string                  `json:"node_id"`
	JoinedGeneration uint64                  `json:"joined_generation"`
	Class            MemberClass             `json:"class"`
	ReadyGeneration  uint64                  `json:"ready_generation,omitempty"` // Task 73; 0 = not ready
	ReadySignature   string                  `json:"ready_signature,omitempty"`  // Task 73
	ReadyEpoch       uint64                  `json:"ready_epoch,omitempty"`      // Task 73

	ObservedEntry    *replay.TrackFrontier   `json:"observed_entry,omitempty"`   // Task 75
}

type LeavingMember struct {
	Member            GroupMember          `json:"member"` // Class == MemberLeaving
	RemovedGeneration uint64               `json:"removed_generation"`
	Entry             replay.TrackFrontier `json:"entry"`                      // O's published entry when the RebalanceGroup applied
	FrozenE           []string             `json:"frozen_e,omitempty"`         // E's node ids then, sorted, the leaving member excluded
	FrozenEDomains    uint32               `json:"frozen_e_domains,omitempty"` // |E| then

}

type GroupGeneration struct {

	DatabaseID string `json:"database_id"`

}
```

**Pure placement (verbatim; `fsm/placement.go`, exported so `arbiter-admin` and auditors re-derive it).**
```go
const GroupPlacementDomain = "arbiter-group-placement-v1"

const maxPlacementWeight = 64

type PlacementCandidate struct {
	NodeID        string
	HostIndexerID uint64
	FailureDomain string
	Weight        uint32
	Verify        bool
}

type PlacementInput struct {
	NetworkID          string
	Owner              uint64
	OwnerFailureDomain string
	Database           string
	Salt               string
	GroupSize          uint32
	NetworkFillDefault bool
	Candidates         []PlacementCandidate
}

type PlacementScore struct {
	NodeID  string
	Score   string // "0x" + 64 lowercase hex: the largest draw
	Chosen  bool
	Skipped string // "", "host" or "failure_domain"
}

type Placement struct {
	Members     []string         // chosen node ids, ascending
	NetworkFill bool
	Order       []PlacementScore // every candidate, descending Score, ties by ascending NodeID
}

type placementPreimage struct {
	NetworkID string `json:"network_id"`
	Owner     uint64 `json:"owner"`
	Database  string `json:"database"`
	Salt      string `json:"salt"`
	NodeID    string `json:"node_id"`
	I         uint32 `json:"i"`
}

func PlacementDraw(networkID string, owner uint64, database, salt, nodeID string, i uint32) (string, error)
func PlacementScoreOf(networkID string, owner uint64, database, salt, nodeID string, weight uint32) (string, error)
func PlaceGroup(in PlacementInput) (Placement, error)
```
- `PlacementDraw` is `replay.CanonicalDigest(GroupPlacementDomain, placementPreimage{...})`.
- `PlacementScoreOf` is the largest of the draws `i = 0 … weight−1`, compared as fixed-length lowercase hex. That ordering equals the order of the 256-bit big-endian values.
- `PlaceGroup`:
  1. Orders every candidate by descending score, ties by ascending `NodeID`.
  2. Starts with the owner's host (`Owner`) and `OwnerFailureDomain` marked used.
  3. Walks the order. A candidate whose `HostIndexerID` is used is `Skipped: "host"`, one whose `FailureDomain` is used is `Skipped: "failure_domain"`, any other is `Chosen` and marks its host and domain used. The walk stops once `GroupSize` are chosen.
  4. Sets `NetworkFill = NetworkFillDefault || (chosen with Verify) < 3`.
- `PlaceGroup` refusals (verbatim):
  - `placement: group_size must be at least 1`;
  - `placement: weight of %s must be 1-64, got %d`;
  - `placement: candidate %s is listed twice`;
  - `placement: candidate %s has no failure_domain`.

**FSM placement (`fsm/stage3_groups.go`).**
```go
func indexerFailureDomain(params Params, id uint64) string // params.Stage3.IndexerFailureDomains[id], "" when absent
func (f *FSM) placementCandidatesLocked(params Params, owner uint64) []PlacementCandidate
func (f *FSM) placementSaltLocked(owner uint64, database string, created *arbiter.L2EventRef) (string, error)
func (f *FSM) placeGroupLocked(params Params, owner uint64, database, salt string) (*DatabaseGroup, error)
func (f *FSM) backfillGroupsLocked(params Params) ([]*DatabaseGroup, error)
func (f *FSM) installGroupLocked(g *DatabaseGroup)
func (f *FSM) dropUnplacedGroupsLocked()
func (f *FSM) prunePastMembersLocked()
func (f *FSM) addPurgeMembersLocked(owner uint64, database string, nodes []string)
func (f *FSM) groupLocked(owner uint64, database string) *DatabaseGroup
func (f *FSM) groupOfIncarnationLocked(inc *TableIncarnation) *DatabaseGroup
func (f *FSM) copyFloorSetLocked(g *DatabaseGroup, strict bool, exclude string) (nodes []string, domains uint32)
func (f *FSM) groupVerifierFloorLocked(g *DatabaseGroup, params Params) int
func (f *FSM) groupsChangedLocked()
func (f *FSM) authorityCommandRefusalLocked(kind string, verify func(*authority.Validator, authority.ConsensusContext) error) string
func (f *FSM) prepareGroupSealLocked(owner uint64, databases []string) (*preparedSeal, string)
func (f *FSM) openBlockDatabasesLocked() []string
```
- **Candidates** (spec §6.3):
  - A candidate is a `params.Verifiers` entry with `HostIndexerID != nil`, `Verify || Replicate`, and a node that is absent from `f.st.Nodes` or not `NodeEvicted`.
  - Its host must be an `si_indexers` entry of `params` other than `owner`, and must not be quarantined (`indexerQuarantinedLocked`) while `params.Stage3.ExcludeQuarantinedHosts`.
  - The candidate carries the entry's `Weight`, `FailureDomain` and `Verify`. `OwnerFailureDomain` is `indexerFailureDomain(params, owner)`.
- **Salt** (S3-E1 K61):
  - It comes from the lowest-`Seq` incarnation of (`owner`, `database`) with `hasPhysicalTables()`, or from `created` for an `AddTable` that has not appended yet.
  - It is the genesis snapshot id (`genesisSnapshotIDLocked`) when that incarnation's `Origin` is `genesis`, else its `Created.BlockHash`.
  - Refusal (verbatim): `placement salt: incarnation %d of %s has no created block hash`.
- **Generation:** a new group's `Generation` is its `GroupGenerations` entry plus one (1 when absent). `installGroupLocked` writes both and keeps `Groups` and `GroupGenerations` sorted.
- **`AddTable`** (spec §6.3):
  - **Before any mutation:** when `placementOnLocked()`, the new incarnation would be physical (`Pending`) and `groupLocked(owner, database) == nil`, `applyAddTable` computes the group from `c.Created`. A placement error refuses the command with state unchanged (verbatim `add table: placement: %v`).
  - **After `appendIncarnation`:** it installs that group, then calls `addPurgeMembersLocked` with the group's members for every physical incarnation of (`owner`, `database`), the new one included.
  - A `Legacy` or `Refused` incarnation never places or keeps a group.
- **Switch-on backfill** (spec §6.3, §10.4 step 5):
  - When `applyUpdateConsensusParams` turns `placement` on, it computes `backfillGroupsLocked(next)` after the S3-E2 gates and before any mutation. That function places one group per (owner, database) holding a physical incarnation, genesis-origin incarnations included, in ascending (owner, database) order over `next`.
  - A placement error refuses with `consensus update: placement backfill: %v`. A planned group below the per-group floor refuses with `consensus update: placement would leave group of indexer %d database %q with %d verifiers, below the per-group floor of 3`.
  - After `f.st.Params = next` and after §51's cutover seal, it installs every planned group and adds each group's members to the `PurgeMembers` of every physical incarnation of its database.
- **Removal** (spec §6.2):
  - `completePurgesLocked` ends with `if f.st.Stage3 != nil { f.dropUnplacedGroupsLocked(); f.prunePastMembersLocked() }`. `dropUnplacedGroupsLocked` removes every group whose (owner, database) no longer has a physical incarnation and leaves its `GroupGenerations` entry unchanged.
  - `prunePastMembersLocked` removes a past member `p` once it is evicted, or once every incarnation of the group's database that lists `p` in `PurgeMembers` is `Purged` or has `p` in `PurgedBy`.
- **`PurgeMembers`** (S3-E1 K60, S3-E2 §47):
  - It is written at three moments: when an incarnation is recorded (`applyAddTable`, the group's current members), at placement and backfill, and at every member a `RebalanceGroup` adds. Each write goes to every physical incarnation of the group's database.
  - `addPurgeMembersLocked` merges sorted and unique. If Plan S3-E2 Task 69 already writes the record-time half through a helper, Task 71 replaces that helper's body with this rule.
- **E** (spec §9.3; read by Plan S3-E4): `copyFloorSetLocked(g, strict, exclude)` returns the sorted node ids and the count of distinct failure domains of those `g.Members` that meet every condition below:
  - not `exclude`, listed in `f.st.Params.Verifiers` with `Replicate && Counts`, and not `NodeEvicted`;
  - class `caught_up` or `behind` (`lagging` too when `strict`);
  - `FailureDomain` different from `indexerFailureDomain(f.st.Params, g.Owner)`.
- **Per-group verifier floor** (spec §6.1, K73):
  - `groupVerifierFloorLocked(g, params)` counts `g.Members` listed in `params.Verifiers` with `Verify` whose node is not `NodeEvicted`, plus, when `g.NetworkFill`, the `params.Verifiers` entries without `HostIndexerID` whose node is not `NodeEvicted`.
  - Task 71 appends to S3-E2's Apply-only hook `stage3MembershipRefusalLocked(next Params) string` (S3-E2 §45) this rule: for each group in order, a count below 3 refuses with `consensus update would leave group of indexer %d database %q with %d verifiers; at least 3 are required`.
  - It runs in the Apply-only half and never on restore, and `EvictNode` never calls it.
- **Authority commands:** `authorityCommandRefusalLocked(kind, verify)` verifies under `authority.Validator{AllowedAddresses: authorityAddressSet(f.st.Params.AuthorityAddresses)}` with the exact current `{network, genesis, epoch}` and no clock, like `trackCommandLocked` (`arbiter:fsm/quarantine.go:114-146`). Its refusal is `<kind>: authority: <err>`. The caller passes `kind` with its target already formatted, for example `fmt.Sprintf("rebalance group indexer %d database %q", owner, database)` or `fmt.Sprintf("reselect verifiers block %d", seq)`, which yields the verbatim refusals below.
- **Seal first:** `prepareGroupSealLocked(owner, databases)` returns `nil, ""` when the open block holds no statement whose live incarnation belongs to (`owner`, one of `databases`). Otherwise it returns `prepareStatementSealLocked(f.spentIDsRootLocked())` and mutates nothing. `openBlockDatabasesLocked` lists the sorted distinct databases of the open block's statements.
- **`groupsChangedLocked()`** reruns `completePurgesLocked()` and then `registryChangedLocked(f.st.TableRegistry)`. Every Apply of this plan that changes a group calls it once, last; Plan S3-E4 Task 76 inserts its release evaluation at its start.

**`RebalanceGroup` (tag 38; `fsm/rebalance_group.go`, `func (f *FSM) applyRebalanceGroup(c *wire.RebalanceGroup) any`).** Refusals, in this order, verbatim:
1. `group rebalancing is refused until the placement switch is on`
2. `rebalance group: database_id is required`
3. `rebalance group: add and remove must be sorted, unique and disjoint node ids`
4. `rebalance group: no group for indexer %d database %q`
5. `rebalance group indexer %d database %q: authority: %v` (`authority.Validator.VerifyRebalanceGroup(c.Canonical(), c.AuthorityJWS, ctx)`)
6. `rebalance group: expected_generation %d differs from generation %d of indexer %d database %q`
7. `rebalance group: %s is not a member of the group` (each `remove`)
8. `rebalance group: %s is already a member of the group` (each `add`)
9. `rebalance group: %s is not a listed, non-evicted member entry with verify or replicate` (each `add`)
10. `rebalance group: host indexer %d of %s is not enrolled`
11. `rebalance group: %s is hosted by the owner indexer %d`
12. `rebalance group: %s and %s share host indexer %d` (over the resulting members, sorted pairs)
13. `rebalance group: %s and %s share failure domain %q` (the same)
14. `rebalance group: %s is in the owner's failure domain %q`
15. `rebalance group: the command changes nothing` (`add` and `remove` empty and `network_fill` unchanged)
16. `rebalance group: the result has %d verifiers, below the per-group floor of 3`
17. `rebalance group: network_fill off needs at least 3 listed verify members, the result has %d`
18. `rebalance group seal: %s` (`prepareGroupSealLocked(owner, []string{database})`)

Effects, after every check:
1. Commit the prepared seal: §51's `commitSealLocked(p, SealReasonKeyChange)`. The sealed block records the group as it was.
2. Raise `Generation` and its `GroupGenerations` entry by one.
3. Move each removed member to `Leaving`:
   - its record with `Class: MemberLeaving`, `RemovedGeneration` = the new generation, `Entry = f.publishedTrackFrontierLocked(owner)`;
   - `FrozenE` and `FrozenEDomains` from `copyFloorSetLocked(groupBefore, false, nodeID)`, computed before any change of this command;
   - the node is merged into `PastMembers`.
4. Add each new member as `GroupMember{NodeID, JoinedGeneration: <new generation>, Class: MemberBootstrapping}`, dropping a `Leaving` record of the same node.
5. Set `NetworkFill = c.NetworkFill`.
6. `addPurgeMembersLocked(owner, database, c.Add)`.
7. `groupsChangedLocked()`.

**Registry view and transport.**
- `TableRegistryView` gains `Groups []GroupView` (deep copies, in state order). The view types (verbatim, `fsm/table_registry.go`):
  ```go
  type GroupView struct {
  	Group       DatabaseGroup
  	Key         string            // Task 72
  	MemberViews []GroupMemberView // one per Group.Members entry, in the same order
  }

  // GroupMemberView holds the values the view derives for one current member
  // when it is read; none of them is FSM state.
  type GroupMemberView struct {
  	HostIndexerID *uint64 // the HostIndexerID of the member's listed verifiers entry; nil while it is delisted (D27)
  	LagAdvances   uint32  // Task 75: memberLagLocked(owner, checkpoint entry), 0 without a checkpoint; saturates at MaxLagPublications+1 (D31)
  }
  ```
  `TableRegistryView` builds `MemberViews` under the same read lock as the rest of the view, from `f.st.Params.Verifiers` and, from Task 75, `Stage3State.OwnerAdvances`. Task 71 fills `Group` and `HostIndexerID`, Task 72 fills `Key`, and Task 75 fills `LagAdvances`. The view carries no ready verify members (D33).
- It also gains `MemberCheckpointSeqs []MemberCheckpointSeq`, filled by Task 75.
- **Mapping.** `tableRegistryToPB` maps these fields to `TableRegistrySnapshot.groups` and `member_checkpoint_seqs` (S3-E1 §39). It goes through `func groupsToPB(v []fsm.GroupView) []*pb.DatabaseGroup` and `var memberClassToPB = map[fsm.MemberClass]pb.MemberClass{...}` (`server/table_registry.go`):
  - `Owner` → `owner_indexer_id`, `Salt` → `placement_salt`, `GroupView.Key` → `group_key`.
  - Each `Group.Members[i]` → `pb.GroupMember`, with `member_class` (the four non-leaving classes). `host_indexer_id` is `MemberViews[i].HostIndexerID`, left absent when nil, and `lag_advances` is `uint64(MemberViews[i].LagAdvances)`.
  - Each `LeavingMember` → `pb.LeavingMember{node_id: Member.NodeID, removed_generation, release_entry: Entry, frozen_members: FrozenE, frozen_domains: FrozenEDomains, released}`.
  - `ReadySignature` and `ReadyEpoch` are not served (D33).
- **Registry version.** Every Apply that changes a value the view serves bumps the registry version once (one bump per Apply, folded into any other bump of the same Apply), so `WatchTableRegistry` followers learn it:
  - every Apply that changes a group, through `groupsChangedLocked`;
  - while `placementOnLocked()`, a `ConsensusParamsUpdate` that adds, removes or changes the `verifiers` entry of a node that is a current member of a group. That covers the served `host_indexer_id` and, from Task 72, the served `group_key`. It sets the update's `registryChanged` (`arbiter:fsm/consensus_updates.go:105-139`).
  - from Task 75, a publication that appends an advance of an owner whose groups hold a member with a checkpoint, because it can change that member's served `lag_advances` (§52.3).

**`ConsensusAdmin.RebalanceGroup` (`server/groups_admin.go`).**
- Order and texts follow `QuarantineIndexer` (`arbiter:server/signed_messages.go:102-133`):
  1. `FailedPrecondition` `consensusUpdatesDisabledMessage` when `!ConsensusUpdatesEnabled`.
  2. `FailedPrecondition` `group rebalancing is refused until the placement switch is on` while `!FSM.PlacementOn()`.
  3. `InvalidArgument` `database_id is required`, `add and remove must be sorted, unique and disjoint node ids` and `authority_jws must be a JWS compact serialization with 3 dot-separated parts`.
  4. `consensusLeaderCheck`; `PermissionDenied` `rebalance group authority: %v` from `AuthorizeRebalanceGroup` with the configured token age.
  5. `propose(wire.Command{RebalanceGroup: &cmd})`, with a refusal mapped by `applyRefusalAsFailedPrecondition`.
- `Ack` means committed.

**`arbiter-admin` (`cmd/arbiter-admin/groups.go`; `run` dispatches `group` to `runGroup` and `consensus groups` to `runConsensusGroups`). Usage lines (appended to `usage`, verbatim):**
```
arbiter-admin consensus groups --data-address HOST:PORT [--timeout 10s]
arbiter-admin group preview --address HOST:PORT --data-address HOST:PORT [--timeout 10s]
arbiter-admin group rebalance --address HOST:PORT --owner N --database D --expected-generation G [--add NODE]... [--remove NODE]... --network-fill true|false [--timeout 10s]
```
- **`consensus groups`** reads `TableRegistry.GetTableRegistry` on `--data-address` (the data-plane listener, S3-E1 K64). It prints `{"registry_version": "<n>", "groups": [<DatabaseGroup>...], "member_checkpoint_seqs": [<MemberCheckpointSeq>...]}`, each element in protojson with `UseProtoNames`, two-space indent.
- **`group preview`** reads three things:
  - `GetConsensusParams` (verifiers, `stage3`, `si_indexers`, network and genesis ids) and `GetNodeFeatures` from `--address`;
  - `GetTrackState` (quarantine) from `--address`;
  - `GetTableRegistry` from `--data-address`.

  It runs `fsm.PlaceGroup` per (owner, database) holding a physical incarnation, with the FSM's candidate and salt rules, and prints `{"groups": [{"owner": "<n>", "database": "<d>", "salt": "<s>", "members": [...], "network_fill": <bool>, "order": [{"node_id": "...", "score": "0x...", "chosen": <bool>, "skipped": "..."}]}]}`.
  - It refuses with `group preview: member entry %s is not among the leader's non-evicted registrations; register it or delist it before previewing` when a listed host-bound entry is not in `GetNodeFeatures`. The preview is then exact, because the FSM counts an unregistered entry as non-evicted.
  - It also refuses with `group preview: stage3 is not set` before the activation.
- **`group rebalance`**:
  - Reads `ARBITER_AUTHORITY_PRIVATE_KEY_HEX`; the missing and invalid texts are those of `runIndexer`, `arbiter:cmd/arbiter-admin/main.go:930-938`.
  - Signs `wire.RebalanceGroup{...}.Canonical()` with `SignRebalanceGroupWithContext` under the leader's `{network, genesis, epoch}` from `GetConsensusParams`, calls `ConsensusAdmin.RebalanceGroup`, and prints `{"owner": "<n>", "database": "<d>", "expected_generation": "<g>", "add": [...], "remove": [...], "network_fill": <bool>, "outcome": "committed"}`.
  - Flag refusals: `--%s is required`, `--add and --remove must name distinct nodes`, `--network-fill must be true or false`, `--address must be a direct node host:port`.
  - RPC failures go through `func groupRPCError(operation, address string, err error) error`, which follows `indexerRPCError` but names `consensus groups` as the read-back.

**Metrics (`metrics/metrics.go`).** The collector reads `func (f *FSM) GroupStats() []GroupOwnerStats`, with `type GroupOwnerStats struct { Owner uint64; Groups int; Members map[MemberClass]int }`. One row per si_indexers entry is returned while `Stage3 != nil`, and none before.
- `arbiter_database_groups{owner}` (gauge): "Placed database groups of one SI indexer in this replica's FSM. Only after the stage-3 activation."
- `arbiter_group_members{owner,class}` (gauge, every class of `MemberClasses` exported, zeros included): "Group member records of one SI indexer's groups by class, Leaving records included. Only after the stage-3 activation."

**Restore (`validateStage3Groups(st *State) error`, called from `validateStage3State`).** Every error starts with `snapshot stage3 groups: `, followed by one of:
- `groups are not sorted by (owner, database_id) without duplicates`
- `group generations are not sorted by (owner, database_id) without duplicates`
- `group of indexer %d database %q exists while the placement switch is off`
- `database %q of indexer %d has a physical incarnation and no group`
- `group of indexer %d database %q has no physical incarnation`
- `group of indexer %d database %q has generation %d, the durable counter is %d`
- `group of indexer %d database %q has no salt`
- `members of group of indexer %d database %q are not sorted and unique`
- `member %s of group of indexer %d database %q has joined_generation %d outside [1, %d]`
- `member %s of group of indexer %d database %q has class %q`
- `leaving member %s of group of indexer %d database %q is malformed: %s`
- `past members of group of indexer %d database %q are not sorted, unique and disjoint from members`
- `member %s of group of indexer %d database %q is missing from purge_members of incarnation %d`
